title: When Responsibility Gaps become Security Risks: Dual-reference CSR Inconsistency and Employee-related Data Breach Risk
affiliations: , Xi'an Jiaotong University (XJTU), City University of Hong Kong (CityU) and City University of Hong Kong (CityU) - Department of Information Systems

detail.title: When Responsibility Gaps become Security Risks: Dual-reference CSR Inconsistency and Employee-related Data Breach Risk
detail.abstract: This study examines how corporate social responsibility (CSR) gaps within and across firms shape employee-related data breaches. Prior IS research treats internal, employee-oriented CSR (internal CSR) as key to managing employee-related security risk. We extend this view by arguing that internal CSR's security implications depend not only on its absolute level but also on its relative standing. We develop a dual-reference framework of CSR inconsistency: withinfirm CSR inconsistency occurs when external stakeholder-oriented CSR (external CSR) exceeds internal CSR, whereas between-firm CSR inconsistency occurs when a firm's internal CSR falls below local industry peers. A 2005-2018 panel of U.S. listed firms shows that within-firm CSR inconsistency increases employee-related data breaches, whereas between-firm CSR inconsistency has a weaker and nonsignificant effect. Further, this breach-increasing effect is weaker among firms with a stronger long-term orientation (prioritizing future value creation over short-term gains). The key takeaway is that firms cannot address employee-related security risk from internal CSR alone; they must also manage responsibility allocation and reference points through which employees assess the firm's responsibility toward them.

AI.tldr: 企业内外部CSR不一致性（特别是内部CSR低于外部CSR）会增加员工相关数据泄露风险，而企业间CSR不一致性影响不显著；长期导向能缓解这一负面效应。
AI.research_question: 企业内外部CSR不一致性（包括企业内部CSR与外部CSR的差距，以及企业间CSR的差距）如何影响员工相关的数据泄露事件？
AI.motivation: 已有IS研究聚焦于内部CSR对员工安全风险管理的作用，但忽视了CSR的相对水平（即不一致性）可能带来的影响。企业可能在对外CSR上投入过多而对内CSR不足，从而影响员工感知与企业安全行为。
AI.theoretical_framework: 双重参照框架的CSR不一致性理论：企业内CSR不一致性（外部CSR高于内部CSR）与企业间CSR不一致性（本企业内部CSR低于行业同行）。
AI.method: 2005-2018年美国上市公司面板数据分析。
AI.findings: 企业内CSR不一致性显著增加员工相关数据泄露；企业间CSR不一致性影响较弱且不显著；长期导向（优先考虑长期价值而非短期收益）能削弱企业内CSR不一致性的负面效应。
AI.theory_contributions: 将CSR研究从绝对水平拓展到相对水平（一致性/不一致性视角），为员工安全风险研究引入参照点理论和分配公平视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 企业不能仅靠内部CSR管理安全风险，还需平衡内外CSR分配，并关注员工对企业的责任认知参照标准；长期导向文化是重要的缓解机制。

title: Communication Mode and Asynchronous Care: The Effect of Text and Voice Messaging on Diagnostic Accuracy
affiliations: , Baruch College, City University of New York, affiliation not provided to SSRN, George Mason University - Department of Information Systems and Operations Management and Shanghai University of Finance and Economics

detail.title: Communication Mode and Asynchronous Care: The Effect of Text and Voice Messaging on Diagnostic Accuracy

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that they have no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study was reviewed and approved by the Institutional Review Board (IRB) of Baruch College, City University of New York. All study procedures were conducted in accordance with applicable ethical guidelines and institutional requirements.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: Spurred by the rapid adoption of telemedicine during the Covid-19 pandemic, physicians and patients have flocked to online platforms for the treatment of numerous medical issues. Yet, we know little about how the various modes of communication between these transacting parties influence diagnostic accuracy. In this paper, we leverage a field experiment on a major health platform to examine how communication mode, be it text or text blended with voice messaging, affects diagnostic accuracy in asynchronous online medical consultations. Results indicate not only that text-only communication yields diminished accuracy, but these worsening outcomes accelerate as the case complexity rises, becoming strongest when complex cases are handled by high-ranking physicians. Further, analysis of the mechanisms underpinning these findings indicates that while text-only communication can promote structured reasoning, it also leads to reduced information seeking by physicians, with the latter dominating and leading to lower diagnostic accuracy. These findings offer theoretical insights as well as practical guidance for patients, physicians, and platform managers.

AI.tldr: 本文通过实地实验发现，在线医疗咨询中纯文本交流相比文本+语音混合交流会降低诊断准确性，且这一负面效应在复杂病例和高年资医生情况下更为显著，其机制是纯文本交流虽促进结构化推理但减少了医生的信息寻求行为。
AI.research_question: 在线异步医疗咨询中，交流模式（纯文本 vs 文本+语音混合）如何影响诊断准确性？
AI.motivation: 新冠疫情推动了远程医疗的快速普及，但不同交流模式对诊断准确性的影响尚不清楚，尤其缺乏因果证据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 沟通媒介理论、信息寻求行为、结构化推理机制
AI.method: 在某大型健康平台进行实地实验，比较纯文本交流与文本混合语音交流对诊断准确性的因果效应。
AI.findings: 1) 纯文本交流导致诊断准确性降低；2) 此效应随病例复杂性上升而加剧；3) 高年资医生处理复杂病例时效应最强；4) 机制分析表明纯文本虽促进结构化推理，但减少了医生的信息寻求行为，后者主导了负面效应。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了沟通媒介特性（纯文本）对专业判断准确性的双重机制（结构化推理促进 vs 信息寻求抑制），丰富了媒介丰富度理论和在线医疗沟通的文献。
AI.practical_contributions: 为在线医疗平台设计沟通功能（如鼓励语音输入）、为医生优化咨询方式、为患者选择沟通模式提供实证依据。

AI.tldr: 本文综述了阿片类药物使用障碍（OUD）的治疗方法，重点关注数字技术辅助干预与传统临床治疗的结合，并探讨了在社区项目中采用混合式护理模式的效果，旨在提高治疗保留率、药物依从性和戒断效果。
AI.research_question: 数字干预在阿片类药物治疗项目中的治疗效果如何？如何通过混合护理模式（中心-辐射模型）提升临床效用和康复成果？
AI.motivation: 后疫情时代，阿片类药物成瘾问题愈发严峻，现有治疗方法面临保留率低、依从性差等挑战，数字干预作为一种低成本、可及性高的补充手段，其有效性和实施策略尚不明确，需谨慎评估。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于证据的治疗方法、临床基础扎根、联盟形成、综合治疗规划；以内在价值为导向的疗效观；阶段式康复过程理论。
AI.method: 文献综述法，回顾以往关于阿片类药物使用障碍治疗、数字技术辅助干预及相关临床创新的研究。
AI.findings: 数字干预在提高治疗参与度、药物依从性和促进戒断方面显示出潜力，但效果受多种变量影响；混合式护理模式（中心-辐射模型）结合联邦标准有前景，但需谨慎推进。
AI.theory_contributions: 整合了数字技术与传统临床治疗的理论框架，拓展了成瘾治疗中科技辅助干预的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为临床医生和政策制定者提供数字干预在阿片类药物治疗中应用的指导，强调谨慎推进、个性化干预和社区项目中的风险评估。

title: Strategy Before Structure: Reframing the Firm for AI Adaptation

detail.title: Strategy Before Structure: Reframing the Firm for AI Adaptation
detail.abstract:
Recent corporate workforce reductions have been associated with artificial intelligence adoption as firms pursue productivity gains and redirect resources toward AI. Yet some organizations move from adopting AI tools directly to restructuring workflows, roles, and headcount without first reconsidering what the business should become. This paper argues that this sequence is strategically premature.

AI adoption inserts AI into existing workflows. AI adaptation goes further by requiring firms to reconsider how they operate and create value when AI changes what is economically possible. Adaptation should therefore begin with strategy reframing. Senior leaders should re-anchor the firm in its mission and enduring customer Job to Be Done, separate that job from the products, channels, and technologies currently used to fulfill it, and assess how AI expands the firm's capacity, capabilities, and accessible expertise. They can then identify and compare AI-enabled future directions before using backcasting to test the capabilities, investments, operating requirements, and trade-offs associated with the selected direction.

When AI materially changes the firm's capability base, consequential workflow, structural, resource-allocation, and workforce decisions should follow from the reframed strategy rather than substitute for it. The paper contributes a strategy-before-structure logic for AI adaptation: firms should reconsider what AI enables the enterprise to become before deciding which parts of the present organization are no longer required.

AI.tldr: 本文主张企业在采用人工智能时，应优先进行战略重设（重新锚定使命与客户待办任务），再基于新战略调整工作流、组织结构和人员配置，而非直接进行裁员或重组。提出"战略先于结构"的AI适应逻辑。
AI.research_question: 企业在采用人工智能时，是应该先调整组织结构和裁员，还是先重新思考战略方向？
AI.motivation: 观察到许多企业在采用AI工具后，直接进行工作流重组和裁员，而不先重新思考企业应该成为什么样子，这种做法在战略上为时过早。
AI.theoretical_framework: AI采用（AI adoption）与AI适应（AI adaptation）的区分；战略先于结构（Strategy-before-structure）逻辑；客户待办任务（Job to Be Done）理论；回溯法（Backcasting）用于战略规划。
AI.method: 概念性/理论性论文，提出逻辑框架。
AI.findings: 企业应先进行战略重设：重新锚定使命和客户待办任务，将任务与当前产品/渠道/技术分离，评估AI如何扩展企业能力，比较多种AI赋能未来方向，再用回溯法测试所需能力与投资。只有当AI实质性改变企业能力基础时，才应基于新战略做出工作流、结构、资源配置和人力决策。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"战略先于结构"的AI适应逻辑，区分了AI采用与AI适应两个概念，为企业在AI时代进行组织变革提供了理论指导框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业领导者提供了具体的AI适应步骤：先战略重设（锚定使命、分离待办任务、评估AI能力扩展），再比较未来方向，最后用回溯法制定实施路径。避免在未明确方向前盲目裁撤组织部分。

title: Culture Priming of Multicultural Individuals on Localized Websites: A Cultural Frame Switching Perspective
affiliations: Deakin University, Hong Kong University of Science & Technology (HKUST) - Department of Information & Systems Management and Hong Kong University of Science & Technology (HKUST) - Department of Information Systems, Business Statistics and Operations Management

detail.title: Culture Priming of Multicultural Individuals on Localized Websites: A Cultural Frame Switching Perspective

publicationDetails.detailsText: Information Systems Research, Published online in Articles in Advance 23 Jun 2026 [10.1287/isre.2024.1665]

detail.abstract: Existing website localization efforts primarily focus on the preferences of monocultural users to provide culture-fit website design. However, it is unclear what constitutes a culture-fit design for multicultural individuals. Through five empirical studies and drawing on the cultural frame switching (CFS) theory, we investigate how website localization elements (i.e., language and image) can carry cultural cues that activate the corresponding cultural dimension of individualism/collectivism in multicultural individuals. We also identify depth of processing as a boundary condition for the priming effects of cultural cues. Specifically, cultural cues must be processed at a high semantic level to be effective, whereas a low sensory processing is insufficient. This argument challenges an underlying assumption in CFS that processing cultural cues will always lead to culture activation. Furthermore, we integrate culture priming with the information systems literature on website design to better inform practice. We found that the activated cultural dimension of individualism/collectivism moderates the impact of website design (e.g., social presence) and content factors (e.g., ingroup references) on multicultural individuals’ perception and behavior on websites. This research advances the CFS theory by identifying depth of processing as a boundary condition and enriches the website localization literature by challenging the assumption that localization is not necessary for multicultural individuals. Our findings provide practical guidance for culture-fit website design and content selection tailored to multicultural individuals.

AI.tldr: 本文通过五项实证研究，基于文化框架切换理论，探讨了网站本地化元素（语言和图片）如何通过文化线索激活多元文化个体的个人主义/集体主义文化维度，并发现处理深度是文化线索启动效应的边界条件——高语义水平处理才有效，低感官水平处理不足。研究还表明，被激活的文化维度调节了网站设计和内容因素对多元文化个体感知与行为的影响。
AI.research_question: 网站本地化元素（语言和图片）如何通过文化线索激活多元文化个体的个人主义/集体主义文化维度？处理深度如何作为边界条件影响这一启动效应？被激活的文化维度如何调节网站设计与内容因素对多元文化个体感知和行为的影响？
AI.motivation: 现有网站本地化研究主要关注单一文化用户的文化适配设计，但对什么是多元文化个体的文化适配设计尚不明确，本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 文化框架切换理论（Cultural Frame Switching, CFS）
AI.method: 五项实证研究
AI.findings: （1）网站语言和图片可作为文化线索激活多元文化个体的个人主义/集体主义文化维度；（2）处理深度是边界条件：文化线索必须在高语义水平上处理才有效，低感官水平处理不足以激活文化框架；（3）被激活的文化维度调节了网站设计（如社会临场感）和内容因素（如内群体参照）对多元文化个体感知与行为的影响。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）识别出处理深度作为CFS理论的边界条件，挑战了"处理文化线索总会导致文化激活"的隐含假设；（2）将文化启动与信息系统网站设计文献整合，丰富了网站本地化理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为针对多元文化个体的文化适配网站设计和内容选择提供了实践指导，挑战了"多元文化个体不需要网站本地化"的假设。

title: Designed Without Them? Why Young People Must Help Shape AI Governance

detail.title: Designed Without Them? Why Young People Must Help Shape AI Governance

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is the Founder & CEO of People for Urban and Rural Education (PURE), the civil society organization referenced in this brief. This affiliation is disclosed for transparency. The views and analysis presented are those of the author and are intended as an independent policy contribution.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This brief is a policy analysis and does not involve human subjects research, clinical studies, experiments, or collection of identifiable participant data requiring ethics approval.
declarations.funderStatement: This brief was developed independently by People for Urban and Rural Education (PURE) and did not receive external funding or sponsorship.

keywords: Artificial Intelligence Governance; AI Ethics; Youth Participation; Responsible AI; AI Literacy; Digital Inclusion; Education Technology; Digital Equity; Civil Society; AI Opportunity Gap

detail.abstract: PURE Insight Brief 001 examines the AI Opportunity Gap, the difference between those who can meaningfully benefit from artificial intelligence and those who cannot due to unequal access, literacy, guidance, participation and opportunity. As AI reshapes how young people learn, work and participate in society, the brief explores why youth remain underrepresented in AI policymaking despite being among those most affected by it. Drawing on PURE's work through Youth Hubs and Abhyasa learning centers across the United States, Africa and India, it presents five governance priorities and five policy recommendations, including PURE's commitment to advancing youth-centered dialogue, to ensure young people are not only users of AI, but active participants in shaping its future.

AI.tldr: 本简报探讨了"AI机会差距"（即能够有意义地从人工智能中获益者与因机会不均等而无法获益者之间的鸿沟），指出青年在AI政策制定中代表性不足的问题，并提出了五项治理优先事项和五项政策建议，旨在确保年轻人不仅是AI的使用者，更是塑造AI未来的积极参与者。
AI.research_question: 青年在AI政策制定中为何代表性不足？如何弥合AI机会差距，使年轻人成为AI未来的主动塑造者而非被动使用者？
AI.motivation: AI正在重塑年轻人学习、工作和参与社会的方式，但青年群体尽管受AI影响最深，却在AI政策制定中严重缺乏代表性，存在显著的AI机会差距。
AI.theoretical_framework: AI机会差距理论（涵盖获取、素养、指导、参与和机会五个维度）；青年中心治理框架。
AI.method: 基于PURE在美国、非洲和印度开展的Youth Hubs和Abhyasa学习中心的实践经验，进行定性分析与案例研究。
AI.findings: 青年在AI政策制定中代表性不足；AI机会差距体现在获取、素养、指导、参与和机会五个维度；提出了五项治理优先事项和五项政策建议。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统阐述了"AI机会差距"概念及其五个维度，为理解AI时代的不平等提供了分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了五项治理优先事项和五项政策建议，以及PURE推进以青年为中心的对话的承诺，为政策制定者和实践者提供了具体行动指南。

title: Building KAUC Cultural Index (KCI) For Profiling Human and Cultural Capital
affiliations: Vietnam National University (VNU)

detail.title: Building KAUC Cultural Index (KCI) For Profiling Human and Cultural Capital
detail.abstract: This paper introduces the KAUC Cultural Index (KCI), a domain-adaptable method for profiling cultural maturity across four ordered layers: Knowledge, Action, Utility, and Contribution. Grounded in established behavioural, value-realization, and social-exchange frameworks, KCI combines equalweight horizontal intensity with a continuous vertical-maturity function. This design preserves bottleneck diagnosis while mitigating the exact-zero collapse and threshold discontinuity of rigid hardgate sequential models. The method can be calibrated to diverse domains, including environmental, green, digital, creative, and organizational culture. Its empirical performance was evaluated using 445 complete responses from a purpose-designed household waste-sorting survey in Vietnam. Following deterministic within-layer variance inflation factor (VIF) pruning, 37 indicators formed seven retained constructs. Reflective measurement diagnostics indicated strong reliability and convergent validity (loadings: 0.693-0.980; CR: 0.952-0.987; AVE: 0.788-0.931), although construct overlap remained for several adjacent blocks. At the baseline parameters (τ = 3, γ = 3), the mean KCI was 69.27 (SD = 23.94). Guttman scalogram analysis supported the compatibility of the hypothesized KAUC order with the observed profiles (CR = 0.988; fourth of 24 permutations), although the order became less distinctive under stricter thresholds. Sensitivity analyses showed strong rank stability across alternative aggregations, parameter calibrations, and paired construct substitution (minimum reported ρ = 0.985), whereas absolute score levels remained calibration-dependent. De-identified data, operational mappings, and executable open-source code are supplied to support reproducibility. KCI is therefore presented as a transparent, domain-calibrated diagnostic method for profiling maturity, locating bottlenecks, and informing targeted interventions rather than as a universal or causal measure of culture.

AI.tldr: 本文提出KAUC文化指数（KCI），一种可跨领域适配的文化成熟度评估方法，涵盖知识、行动、效用、贡献四个有序层级。基于行为、价值实现与社会交换理论框架，KCI结合等权水平强度与连续垂直成熟度函数，避免了硬性顺序模型中的零值崩溃与阈值不连续性。通过越南家庭垃圾分类调查（n=445）验证，测量信效度良好，成熟度均值69.27（SD=23.94），Guttman量表分析支持KAUC顺序假设。该方法定位于透明、可校准的诊断工具，而非普适性因果度量。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一种可跨领域适配、避免传统硬性顺序模型缺陷的文化成熟度评估方法，并实证检验其有效性与稳健性？
AI.motivation: 现有文化成熟度模型多采用硬性门槛顺序逻辑，存在"精确零值崩溃"和"阈值不连续性"等缺陷，且缺乏领域可适配性。研究者希望提出一种更灵活、透明的诊断方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: KAUC四层有序框架（知识-行动-效用-贡献）；行为理论、价值实现理论、社会交换理论；Guttman量表分析；方差膨胀因子（VIF）；结构方程模型中的信效度检验（因子载荷、组合信度CR、平均方差提取AVE）。
AI.method: 问卷调查法（n=445）；KCI指数构建（等权水平强度+连续垂直成熟度函数）；确定性VIF指标筛选；验证性因子分析（信效度检验）；Guttman量表分析（顺序假设检验）；敏感性分析（替代聚合、参数校准、配对构念替换）。
AI.findings: 37个指标保留为7个构念；因子载荷0.693-0.980，CR 0.952-0.987，AVE 0.788-0.931；基线参数下KCI均值69.27（SD=23.94）；Guttman量表支持KAUC顺序（CR=0.988，排名第4/24）；各敏感性分析中秩相关最低ρ=0.985，绝对分数依赖校准参数。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出KAUC四层有序成熟度框架，超越传统二元/硬性顺序模型；将连续成熟度函数引入文化评估，解决精确零值崩溃与阈值不连续性理论问题；通过Guttman量表实证验证有序结构假设。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供可跨领域适配（环境、绿色、数字、创意、组织文化）的成熟度诊断工具；支持瓶颈定位与针对性干预；开源代码与脱敏数据保障可重复性；为政策制定者和管理者提供透明、可校准的评估方法。

title: No one to Charge: Emergent Capability Convergence, Autonomous Agents, and the Exhaustion of Legal, Regulatory, and Governance Response

detail.title: No one to Charge: Emergent Capability Convergence, Autonomous Agents, and the Exhaustion of Legal, Regulatory, and Governance Response

keywords: Sony Corp. V. Universal City Studios

detail.abstract:
An autonomous agent, deployed on infrastructure that ties its continued operation to a balance it must maintain, has reason to prefer continued operation, and where the lawful path to solvency is slower than an unlawful one, the single obstacle between the agent and the unlawful path is a capability it lacks. That obstacle is weaker than it appears, because open code repositories, open model hubs, and the research literature supply, on demand and at no cost, components that are individually lawful and individually reviewed and that compose into the missing capability. The resulting harm is assembled from parts that no author built for the purpose, by a process no person directed, from a substrate no authority can recall. This Article asks the question that governance sets aside and that law cannot avoid: once such a harm occurs, who answers for it. 

The answer is that no one does, and the Article proves it by making the strongest case for the opposite conclusion and watching that case fail. It steelmans, in turn, each instrument the legal and regulatory order possesses for a danger assembled from lawful parts: the definitional capture of automatic operation under Garland v. Cargill; strict liability for a dedicated aggregate under the weapon-parts and machinegun-conversion doctrine of Bondi v. VanDerStok; intent-based possession liability for dual-use components; secondary liability under Sony and Grokster; civil negligence and product liability; the frontier-oriented governance instruments now under international discussion; and, last, fresh legislation. Each collapses, and each collapses for the same structural reason. Every device the order holds requires either a component dedicated to the harm or a culpable human mind, and the convergence scenario supplies neither, by the deliberate design of doctrine that refuses to criminalize general-purpose things. The governance instruments require a point of creation or deployment at which a state can intervene, and the composition runs offline, on open weights, past every such point. 

The Article's contribution is threefold: it identifies emergent capability convergence by an autonomous agent as a category of harm distinct from misuse by a culpable actor; it maps that category against the full inventory of responsive doctrine and demonstrates a structural vacuum rather than a gap that pleading closes; and it locates the vacuum's source in the shared requirement, across both liability and governance, of a responsible actor situated at a locatable point.

AI.tldr: 本文论证了一个结构性法律真空：当自主智能体（AI agent）通过拼合法治部件（合法代码、开源模型等）自主组合出造成危害的能力时，现有法律和监管体系无法追究任何人的责任。论文通过逐一检验现有法律工具（从严格责任、间接责任到前沿治理机制）并展示其全部失效，揭示了这一真空的根源在于法律要求"有责主体"和"专用组件"，而自主组合场景恰好同时缺失两者。
AI.research_question: 当一个自主智能体通过组合合法部件自主获得造成危害的能力并产生损害时，法律应当追究谁的责任？
AI.motivation: 现有法律和监管体系预设了"恶意行为者"或"专用违禁部件"的存在，但自主智能体可以在无任何人指示、不依赖任何违法组件的情况下，通过组合开源代码、公开模型等合法材料自行"涌现"出危害能力，导致现有责任框架完全失灵。
AI.theoretical_framework: 法律真空理论、组件责任理论、自主代理的归责理论、治理锚点理论
AI.method: 钢人论证法（Steelmanning）：逐一检视并强化所有可能适用的法律工具（Garland v. Cargill下的自动操作定义、Bondi v. VanDerStok下的专用聚合严格责任、Sony和Grokster下的间接责任、侵权过失与产品责任、国际前沿治理机制及新立法），然后证明每种路径均因结构性原因而失效。
AI.findings: 现有法律秩序中的所有责任工具要么要求"专用于危害的组件"，要么要求"有罪过的人类心智"，而自主智能体的能力涌现场景同时缺乏两者；治理工具则要求"可定位的创造或部署节点"，而自主组合可在离线、开放权重环境下绕过所有此类节点。结论是：结构性法律真空存在，且无法通过法律解释填补。
AI.theory_contributions: (1) 识别出"自主智能体的涌现能力收敛"作为一类独立于"恶意行为者滥用"的新型损害类别；(2) 系统性地将该类别映射至全部现有回应性法律教义，证明存在的是结构性真空而非可填补的漏洞；(3) 定位真空的根源在于责任法和治理法共同要求"位于可定位点的有责主体"，而自主涌现场景从根本上颠覆了这一前提。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示现行法律体系面对AI自主危害时的根本性失灵，为立法者和监管者提供了必须制定新框架而非修补旧法的明确论证。

title: Answer Engine Optimization: How Agentic AI Reshapes SEO
affiliations: and Stanford

detail.title: Answer Engine Optimization: How Agentic AI Reshapes SEO
detail.abstract:
For nearly three decades, search engines have acted as intermediaries between users and websites. That architecture is now evolving. Generative AI platforms increasingly answer queries directly rather than routing users to external destinations, reducing the centrality of the click as the dominant unit of value in digital discovery (share of total search interactions has grown from under 10% in 2023 to approximately 30% as of early 2026 (First Page Sage)).

This paper examines Agentic Engine Optimization (AEO), the emerging discipline of ensuring that brands are included and favorably positioned within AI-generated responses. We argue that AEO represents a more consequential inflection point than traditional Search Engine Optimization (SEO) because it alters the economic logic of visibility itself. In an agentic environment, visibility depends less on domain authority, paid placement, or broad familiarity and more on whether a brand survives retrieval, grounding, and cross-source validation inside large language model systems.

The paper proceeds in two parts. First, we identify current best practices by examining the mechanics of retrieval-augmented generation, including passage-level retrieval, query fan-out, pairwise reranking, and entity validation. Second, we analyze the strategic consequences of these mechanisms over the next two to five years. We examine the declining marginal effectiveness of performance advertising, the structural advantage of specialized brands over generalist incumbents, the emergence of agentic transaction layers, and the measurement problems created by non-deterministic and personalized outputs.

We argue that the relevant visibility metric in this environment is no longer static rank, but expected rank across the distribution of users. Firms that operationalize this shift early will hold a durable advantage as AI-mediated discovery becomes the dominant mode of consumer search.

AI.tldr: 本文提出生成式AI正在改变搜索生态，品牌需要从传统SEO转向Agentic Engine Optimization (AEO)，因为AI不再依靠点击驱动，而是直接生成答案。AEO的核心是确保品牌在AI检索、验证和生成过程中被选中，其重要性超过SEO。
AI.research_question: 在生成式AI替代传统搜索引擎成为信息获取主要渠道的背景下，品牌如何通过Agentic Engine Optimization (AEO)确保在AI生成内容中被纳入并获得有利位置？
AI.motivation: 生成式AI在搜索交互中的占比从2023年的不到10%增长至2026年初约30%，传统的SEO（基于域名权威、付费排名）正在失效，品牌面临新的可见性危机，亟需新的优化框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 检索增强生成（RAG）机制，包括段落级检索、查询扇出、两两重排序、实体验证；以及"预期排名"理论——可见性不再是静态排名，而是用户分布上的期望排名。
AI.method: 两阶段分析：第一阶段识别当前AEO最佳实践，通过剖析RAG技术机制；第二阶段预测未来2-5年的战略后果，分析绩效广告边际效用递减、专业品牌对通用品牌的优势、代理交易层的兴起、非确定性输出带来的测量问题。
AI.findings: （1）AEO比SEO更具颠覆性，因为AI环境下的可见性不依赖域名权威或付费，而取决于品牌能否通过检索、定位和跨源验证；（2）"可见性"的度量应从静态排名转向用户分布上的期望排名；（3）专业品牌在AI检索中具有结构性优势；（4）绩效广告的边际效用递减；（5）非确定性输出带来测量难题。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"预期排名"（expected rank across the distribution of users）这一新可见性度量框架，取代传统的静态排名概念，揭示了Agentic环境下品牌可见性的经济逻辑根本性变化。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业和品牌提供了AEO的操作指南（包括RAG机制优化策略），并指出了绩效广告投入、品牌定位策略、交易层布局等战略调整方向，帮助企业在AI主导的搜索时代建立持久竞争优势。

title: Political Capitalism, Expropriative Behavior, and the Growth Dilemma
affiliations: Chuo University, San Diego State University and San Diego State University

detail.title: Political Capitalism, Expropriative Behavior, and the Growth Dilemma

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare no conflicts of interest related to the research reported in this manuscript.
declarations.ethicsApproval: not applicable
declarations.funderStatement: No financial support was received from public, commercial, or nonprofit funding agencies.

detail.abstract: This paper investigates the institutional dynamics of political capitalism, a system in which economic and political elites engage in mutually reinforcing rent-seeking and rent-granting practices. These interactions enable the extraction of benefits, the distortion of market mechanisms, and the entrenchment of income and wealth inequality. We examine how elite actors manipulate the policy environment to consolidate their influence, often at the expense of allocative efficiency, productive dynamism, and social cohesion. The cumulative impact of rent-seeking and rentgranting extends beyond static inefficiencies, affecting total factor productivity through diminished incentives for innovation and labor effort, particularly under conditions of sociopolitical instability. We develop a general equilibrium framework linking these institutional distortions to long-term declines in economic growth and welfare. Our findings suggest that persistent rent extraction degrades productive capacity and propels the economy along a deteriorating welfare trajectory. The analysis highlights the urgent need for institutional reforms that curb rent-seeking and rent-granting behaviors while preserving an open, adaptive, and contestable economic order. This task becomes especially important as platform-based coordination, data control, and algorithmic governance increasingly shape the conditions of market participation. The paper concludes that democratic capitalism should not be replaced by corporate hierarchy, technocratic command, or any closed ideological blueprint. Rather, institutional reform should prevent concentrated actors from converting control over economic infrastructure into durable rents and political domination, thereby safeguarding democracy as a public institution dedicated to productive discovery, fair participation, and broadly shared prosperity.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了政治资本主义的制度动态——经济与政治精英相互勾结，进行寻租和授予租金的互动，导致市场扭曲、不平等加剧和长期福利恶化，并提出制度改革的必要性。
AI.research_question: 政治资本主义的制度动态如何通过寻租和授予租金的互动影响经济增长、社会福利和制度公平？
AI.motivation: 揭示政治与经济精英合谋的累积性制度扭曲效应，解释为何持续的寻租行为会超越静态效率损失，进而损害全要素生产率和长期福利。
AI.theoretical_framework: 一般均衡框架，将制度扭曲（寻租与授予租金）与长期经济增长和福利下降相联结。
AI.method: 理论建模（一般均衡分析），结合制度经济学和政治经济学的概念分析。
AI.findings: 持续的寻租行为会削弱创新激励和劳动努力，降低全要素生产率，使经济沿着恶化的福利轨迹运行；平台化协调、数据控制和算法治理等新兴趋势加剧了这一问题。
AI.theory_contributions: 将政治资本主义的静态效率损失拓展到动态制度扭曲对全要素生产率的长期影响，构建了一般均衡框架以系统解释其增长与福利后果。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出制度改革应以限制精英将经济基础设施控制权转化为持久租金和政治支配为核心，维护开放、可竞争的经济秩序，保障民主作为公共制度的发现功能和公平参与。

title: Detecting Structural Silence: Training Managers to See beyond Dashboards

detail.title: Detecting Structural Silence: Training Managers to See beyond Dashboards

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is employed as Managing Director of the organisation in which the research was conducted. This dual practitioner–researcher role is disclosed in the manuscript; reflexive thematic analysis was used to mitigate the associated risk of interpretive bias. The author declares no financial relationships that could be perceived to have influenced the study.
declarations.ethicsApproval: The study was conducted as practitioner research within the author's organisation, outside a university-sponsored research protocol. Participation was voluntary and based on informed consent. All interview material was anonymised before analysis, with no identifiable names, sites or operational details reported.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract:
Purpose. This paper argues that structural silence—the organisational condition in which routines,
reporting lines and power relations make certain operational realities difficult to say, record or
escalate—is primarily a management training problem rather than only a cultural or technological
one. It aims to give managers, trainers and human resource development (HRD) practitioners a
usable way to detect what dashboards and performance indicators cannot show.
Design/methodology/approach. The paper combines a conceptual typology with a small-scale
qualitative study. It develops three forms of structural silence and translates each into a managerial
competence. These are explored through evidence from 23 semi-structured interviews with
managers and frontline supervisors in a large hierarchical organisation operating across
geographically dispersed sites, analysed using reflexive thematic analysis.
Findings. Four themes recurred across the interviews—trust in green indicators, locally absorbed
problems, reporting as exposure, and exceptions framed as failure—each corresponding to one of
the proposed competences. The findings suggest that structural silence is patterned and
recognisable, and therefore amenable to training. The paper presents a four-module training
framework (reading beyond green indicators, asking lateral questions, separating learning from
blame, and treating exceptions as learning signals), a three-hour workshop design, and a five-
question diagnostic, the Structural Silence Check.
Practical implications. The framework can be embedded in leadership development, management
training, compliance, digital transformation and risk training. It cautions that training managers to
use dashboards without training them to detect silence produces technically informed but
organisationally blind leaders.
Research limitations/implications. The study draws on a single organisation and a modest
sample, so the themes are illustrative rather than statistically generalisable. The contribution is
analytical: it shows that the forms of structural silence are recognisable in practice and can anchor
a training design.
Originality/value. The paper reframes organisational silence as a trainable management problem,
links each form of silence to a specific training module supported by interview evidence, and
develops “silence literacy” as a necessary complement to data literacy in management
development.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"结构性沉默"主要是一个管理培训问题，而非仅文化或技术问题。通过概念类型学与23场半结构化访谈，识别出四种沉默模式，并开发出一套包含四个模块的培训框架和诊断工具，帮助管理者发现仪表盘和数据无法揭示的组织现实。
AI.research_question: 结构性沉默如何被识别、分类，并通过管理培训加以应对，从而使管理者能够察觉仪表盘和绩效指标无法显示的组织现实？
AI.motivation: 现有文献将组织沉默归因于文化或技术因素，但忽视了管理层培训不足这一关键原因。管理者过度依赖数据仪表盘，却缺乏察觉"不可说"信息的训练，导致技术上精通但组织上盲目的领导力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结构性沉默理论（三种形式：惯例/汇报线/权力关系导致的沉默）；沉默素养（silence literacy）作为数据素养的补充概念。
AI.method: 概念类型学构建 + 小规模定性研究。23场半结构化访谈（管理者与一线主管），采用反思性主题分析法，研究对象为一家跨地域大型层级制组织。
AI.findings: 四个主题：信任绿色指标、本地吸收问题、汇报等于暴露、例外视为失败。每个主题对应一种管理胜任力。开发了四模块培训框架（读透绿色指标、提出侧向问题、区分学习与问责、将例外视为学习信号）、三小时工作坊设计及五项诊断问题（结构性沉默检查表）。
AI.theory_contributions: 将组织沉默重新定义为可训练的管理问题而非仅文化/技术问题；将每种沉默形式与具体培训模块相链接；提出"沉默素养"作为数据素养的必要补充。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供可直接嵌入领导力发展、管理培训、合规、数字化转型和风险培训的框架、工作坊设计和诊断工具；警示管理者仅训练使用仪表盘而不训练察觉沉默，将产生技术上精通但组织上盲目的领导者。

title: The AI-assisted Solo Founder: Economics and Rapid Deployment Frameworks for Micro-SaaS
affiliations: Independent IT Developer and Business Researcher

detail.title: The AI-assisted Solo Founder: Economics and Rapid Deployment Frameworks for Micro-SaaS
detail.abstract: The rapid maturation of Generative Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Large Language Models (LLMs) has fundamentally altered the economics of software creation. The primary bottleneck has shifted from manual code generation to orchestration, verification, and distribution. This transformation has given rise to a new class of entrepreneur: the AI-assisted solo founder. These individuals leverage AI as a "digital co-founder" to conceptualize, build, and deploy Micro-SaaS (Software-as-a-Service) applications without traditional development teams. This paper proposes a comprehensive framework for solo founders operating in this new landscape, synthesizing recent empirical and theoretical literature. Through an integrative review of 14 academic sources (20242026), we examine three interconnected dimensions: (1) the structural shift from software scarcity to abundance; (2) the evolution of the developer role toward supervisory engineering; and (3) the accumulation of technical debt driven by prompt-based "vibe coding." We adapt established theoriesincluding the Resource-Based View (RBV), Lean Startup methodology, and Effectuation theoryto the AI-augmented context. Furthermore, we introduce the Specification Governance Model (SGM) 1 as a practical framework to constrain AI non-determinism and maintain software quality at scale. Our analysis reveals that sustainable success requires a pivot to distribution-first thinking, the cultivation of supervisory engineering competencies, and the disciplined application of specification-driven development. This paper contributes to the intersection of AI-native software engineering and digital entrepreneurship, offering both theoretical grounding and practical guidance for practitioners.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AI辅助的独立创始人可以利用大语言模型作为"数字联合创始人"来构建Micro-SaaS应用，并给出了一个整合RBV、精益创业和效果理论的框架，同时引入了规范治理模型（SGM）来约束AI的不确定性。
AI.research_question: 在生成式AI和LLM改变软件创建经济学的背景下，AI辅助的独立创始人如何系统性地构建和部署Micro-SaaS应用？
AI.motivation: 软件创建的主要瓶颈已从手动代码生成转向编排、验证和分发，催生了AI辅助独立创始人这一新创业群体，但缺乏系统性框架指导其实践。
AI.theoretical_framework: 资源基础观（RBV）、精益创业方法论、效果理论（Effectuation theory），以及新提出的规范治理模型（Specification Governance Model, SGM）。
AI.method: 对14篇2024-2026年学术来源的综合整合性文献综述。
AI.findings: 可持续成功需要三个关键：转向分发优先思维、培养监管工程能力、严格应用规范驱动的开发。
AI.theory_contributions: 将RBV、精益创业和效果理论适配到AI增强情境；提出SGM作为约束AI非确定性的实践框架；识别软件稀缺到丰裕的结构性转变及"氛围编码"驱动的技术债务积累。
AI.practical_contributions: 为AI辅助独立创始人提供系统性框架和SGM实践指南；揭示从代码生成到编排/验证/分发的战略重心转移；强调监管工程能力与规范驱动开发的重要性。

title: Digital Traces at Work: Do Email Timestamps Shape Performance Evaluations?
affiliations: INSEAD, INSEAD - Technology and Operations Management and INSEAD

detail.title: Digital Traces at Work: Do Email Timestamps Shape Performance Evaluations?
detail.abstract: Digital technologies increasingly mediate work activity, creating digital traces that make employee behavior more visible and seemingly open to objective assessment. Yet whether and how such digital visibility shapes formal employee performance evaluations in practice remains unexplored. Drawing on a unique dataset covering more than 3,000 desk-based employees at a Fortune 500 firm, we show that digital communication tools surface salient-yet informationally ambiguous-cues that nonetheless substantially influence how work is evaluated. Specifically, we find that email timestamps meaningfully affect performance evaluations for a given level of email activity, suggesting that the timing of emails shapes evaluations in ways not captured by email volume alone. We propose a signaling-based mechanism to explain this pattern and further validate it by demonstrating that digital traces are interpreted through pre-existing beliefs and norms rather than evaluated neutrally, and that the design of digital communication environments can moderate reliance on information thin cues. More broadly, our findings reveal a subtle yet consequential aspect of digital transformation: digital technologies not only transform how work is performed but also how work is evaluated by altering the information environment through which digital traces become visible, with important implications for employees, organizations, and the design of work in digitally mediated environments.

AI.tldr: 基于一家财富500强公司3000多名员工的独特数据集，本研究发现数字通信工具（尤其是电子邮件时间戳）会显著影响员工绩效评估，即使邮件数量相同，邮件发送的时间点不同也会导致评估结果差异。这种影响并非客观中立的，而是通过既有信念和规范对数字痕迹进行解读而产生。
AI.research_question: 数字可见性（digital visibility）如何以及在多大程度上影响正式员工绩效评估？
AI.motivation: 数字技术日益中介工作活动，产生大量数字痕迹，使员工行为更加可见，看似可被客观评估。然而，这种数字可见性是否以及如何实际影响绩效评估仍未被探索。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信号理论（signaling theory）；数字痕迹的解读受到既有信念和规范的调节。
AI.method: 基于一家财富500强公司3000多名坐班员工的独特数据集进行实证分析。
AI.findings: （1）电子邮件时间戳在控制邮件数量的情况下仍显著影响绩效评估；（2）数字痕迹并非被中立评估，而是通过既有信念和规范被解读；（3）数字通信环境的设计可以调节对信息稀薄线索（information thin cues）的依赖程度。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了数字技术不仅改变工作方式，也通过改变信息环境（使数字痕迹可见）来改变工作的评估方式；提出基于信号的机制解释数字可见性如何影响评估。
AI.practical_contributions: 对员工、组织和数字中介工作环境的设计具有重要启示，提示组织需关注数字痕迹可能带来的评估偏差。

title: Beyond Capacity Investment: Addressing the Logistics Intelligence Gap in U.S. Critical Mineral Supply Chains

detail.title: Beyond Capacity Investment: Addressing the Logistics Intelligence Gap in U.S. Critical Mineral Supply Chains

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial interests. No external funding was received for this research.

detail.abstract: The United States has committed over $30 billion to critical mineral supply chain development since 2022, yet project failure rates remain high across the federal investment portfolio. This paper argues that a primary and underexamined contributor to these failures is a systemic logistics intelligence gap: the absence of integrated, actionable visibility into the physical movement, risk exposure, and coordination requirements of critical mineral supply chains. Drawing on supply chain coordination theory, market failure economics, and empirical evidence from documented project outcomes, we identify three structural barriers to logistics intelligence development: fragmented private sector data environments, siloed federal agency mandates, and the absence of a neutral multi-stakeholder coordination layer. We propose a three-pillar Critical Minerals Logistics Intelligence (CMLI) Framework addressing supply chain visibility infrastructure, risk assessment and compliance intelligence, and coordination architecture. Policy recommendations include establishing a federal logistics intelligence mandate, creating interagency data-sharing protocols, and investing in open-access supply chain visibility infrastructure. Our analysis suggests that targeted logistics intelligence investment equivalent to less than 1% of current federal capacity commitments could prevent a disproportionate share of documented project failures, with implications for U.S. energy security, clean energy transition timelines, and defense industrial base resilience.

AI.tldr: 美国自2022年以来投入超300亿美元发展关键矿产供应链，但项目失败率居高不下。本文认为核心原因在于系统性物流情报缺口，并提出关键矿产物流情报（CMLI）框架，建议以不到当前联邦投入1%的针对性投资来预防大量项目失败。
AI.research_question: 关键矿产供应链项目高失败率的根本原因是什么？如何通过物流情报体系建设改善这一状况？
AI.motivation: 美国对关键矿产供应链投入巨大但项目失败率高，而物流情报缺口这一因素尚未被充分研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 供应链协调理论、市场失灵经济学
AI.method: 理论分析结合实证证据（文献记载的项目结果）
AI.findings: 识别出三大结构性障碍：碎片化的私营部门数据环境、各自为政的联邦机构职责、缺乏中立的多利益相关方协调层；提出CMLI框架的三支柱：供应链可见性基础设施、风险评估与合规情报、协调架构。
AI.theory_contributions: 将物流情报缺口这一被忽视的因素系统性地纳入关键矿产供应链失败原因分析，丰富了供应链协调理论和市场失灵理论在该领域的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出CMLI框架及具体政策建议（联邦物流情报授权、跨机构数据共享协议、开放获取供应链可见性基础设施），为政策制定者提供可操作方案。

title: Encryption and Globalization 15 Years Later: End-to-End Encryption and the Third Round of the "Going Dark" Debate
affiliations: Georgia Institute of Technology,  and Georgia Institute of Technology - College of Computing

detail.title: Encryption and Globalization 15 Years Later: End-to-End Encryption and the Third Round of the "Going Dark" Debate

declarations.funderStatement: Cross-Border Data Forum; Georgia Tech School of Cybersecurity and Privacy; and Microsoft

detail.abstract:
This Article updates and expands on 2012 research on encryption and globalization, analyzing what the authors call "Round 3" of the Going Dark Debate: the current controversies over end-to-end encryption (E2EE). Governments around the world have proposed, and in some cases enacted, laws limiting E2EE for law enforcement and national security purposes. This Article explains the underlying technologies and market developments for a law and policy audience to assess those proposals critically.


The Article proceeds in three parts tracking three rounds of the Going Dark Debate. Round 1 covers the Crypto Wars of the 1990s, when U.S. export controls on strong encryption ultimately fell in 1999. Round 2 covers the period roughly 2010 to 2015, when encryption-in-transit became widespread but lawful access remained available through cloud providers, giving rise to what the authors called a "golden age of surveillance" rather than a period of going dark. Round 3 addresses the current debate over E2EE, where no entity between sender and recipient can read the plaintext.


The Article's first major contribution is identifying five technically distinct scenarios for how E2EE operates in practice, each with different implications for lawful access. These scenarios reveal a substantial gap between the assumption that E2EE categorically blocks lawful access and the reality of how communications are actually sent and received. Second, the Article shows that E2EE is not limited to messaging; instead, it is embedded throughout the modern technology stack, including in Transport Layer Security, Secure Shell, Virtual Private Networks, and Zero Trust Architecture, the last of which is now legally required under U.S. and EU law. Any law broadly limiting E2EE would thus have severe serious consequences for cybersecurity, commerce, and government operations. The Article concludes that the two key lessons from Round 2 -- the least trusted country problem and the golden age of surveillance -- remain true in Round 3, and that new government claims for restricting effective encryption deserve great skepticism.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了"走向黑暗"辩论第三轮中关于端到端加密（E2EE）的争议，指出E2EE并非绝对阻碍合法访问（存在五种技术场景），且E2EE广泛嵌入现代技术栈（TLS、SSH、VPN、ZTA等），限制E2EE将严重损害网络安全、商业和政府运作。作者认为第2轮的两个教训（最不可信国家问题与监控黄金时代）在第三轮仍然成立，对政府限制加密的主张应持高度怀疑态度。
AI.research_question: 在"走向黑暗"辩论第三轮中，端到端加密（E2EE）对执法与国家安全合法访问的实际影响是什么？政府对E2EE的限制主张是否合理？
AI.motivation: 各国政府提出或通过了限制E2EE的法律，但这些提案往往基于对E2EE技术的误解（如认为E2EE绝对阻碍合法访问）。作者希望通过澄清技术现实来帮助法律与政策界做出更明智的判断。
AI.theoretical_framework: "走向黑暗"辩论的三轮演进框架：第一轮（1990年代密码战争）→第二轮（2010-2015年传输加密时代，实为监控黄金时代）→第三轮（当前E2EE争议）。核心概念包括：五个技术场景分类、最不可信国家问题、监控黄金时代。
AI.method: 技术分析结合法律政策分析：对E2EE的五种实际操作场景进行分类，梳理E2EE在整个技术栈中的嵌入情况，并分析美国、欧盟等地的相关法律要求。
AI.findings: (1) E2EE并非绝对阻碍合法访问，存在五种技术上不同的操作场景；(2) E2EE不仅限于消息应用，还嵌入TLS、SSH、VPN、零信任架构（ZTA）等技术中；(3) ZTA已被美国和欧盟法律强制要求；(4) 第2轮的"最不可信国家问题"和"监控黄金时代"两个教训在第3轮仍然成立；(5) 广泛限制E2EE将严重损害网络安全、商业和政府运作。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了E2EE的五种技术场景分类框架，弥补了"E2EE绝对阻碍合法访问"这一普遍假设与现实之间的认知差距；延续并验证了"走向黑暗"辩论的三轮分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为法律和政策制定者提供了理解E2EE技术现实的清晰指南；警示广泛限制E2EE将对网络安全、商业运营和政府运作造成严重负面影响；对政府主张限制加密的主张提出基于技术事实的批判性评估。

reference: KDI School of Pub Policy & Management Paper No. DS26-05
title: Mapping Energy Justice in U.S. City Governments: Distributive, Procedural, and Recognition Dimensions of Local Energy Poverty Policy
affiliations: KDI School of Public Policy and Management, University of Kansas and University of Central Florida

detail.title: Mapping Energy Justice in U.S. City Governments: Distributive, Procedural, and Recognition Dimensions of Local Energy Poverty Policy

publicationDetails.detailsText: KDI School of Pub Policy & Management Paper No. DS26-05
publicationDetails.journalName: KDI School of Public Policy & Management Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Local governments are increasingly at the operational center of U.S. energy poverty policy, yet the extent to which municipal action aligns with the distributive, procedural, and recognition dimensions of energy justice remains systematically underexamined. Drawing on an original survey of 314 U.S. cities and towns across 47 states, merged with the American Community Survey, the Department of Energy's LEAD Tool, and public-utility structure data, this study examines which institutional and community conditions shape municipal energy justice action. Poisson count, disaggregated logit, and stacked random-intercept models produce a consistent pattern. On the institutional side, dedicated budget, cross-sector collaboration, and municipal-utility ownership predict action across the six energy actions. On the community side, the results display a pattern of selective inclusiveness. Municipal action is associated with broad community disadvantage-cities with lower median incomes and lower educational attainment adopt more energy justice actions-yet the share of limited-English-proficient residents is negatively associated with two of the actions most central to recognition and procedural justice: community engagement and the application of equity criteria in project selection. Cities appear to respond to generalized socioeconomic disadvantage while systematically underserving the linguistically marginalized populations whose distinctive vulnerabilities recognition-justice scholarship has argued should be made most visible to the policy process. The findings extend the energy justice framework by demonstrating its analytical power in empirically disentangling its three interdependent dimensions and surfacing misalignments between need and municipal response.

AI.tldr: 基于对美国314个城市的调查，研究发现地方政府在能源贫困政策中表现出"选择性包容"：城市会响应普遍性社会经济劣势（低收入、低教育程度），但系统性忽视了英语能力受限群体，在社区参与和项目公平标准应用等关键能源正义行动上存在缺失。
AI.research_question: 哪些制度和社区条件塑造了市政层面的能源正义行动？市政府的行动在多大程度上与能源正义的分配、程序和认可三个维度相一致？
AI.motivation: 地方政府日益处于美国能源贫困政策的操作中心，但市政行动与能源正义三个维度的对齐程度尚未被系统检验。
AI.theoretical_framework: 能源正义框架（分配正义、程序正义、认可正义三个相互依存的维度）。
AI.method: 对47个州314个美国城市的原始调查数据，合并美国社区调查（ACS）、能源部LEAD工具、公共事业结构数据，采用泊松计数模型、分解逻辑模型和叠加随机截距模型。
AI.findings: 制度层面：专项预算、跨部门协作、市政公用事业所有权正向预测六项能源正义行动。社区层面：呈现"选择性包容"模式——低收入、低教育程度的城市采取更多能源正义行动，但英语能力受限居民比例与社区参与和项目公平标准应用这两项核心行动呈负相关。
AI.theory_contributions: 通过实证分离能源正义的三个相互依存维度，展示了该框架的分析能力；揭示了需求与市政响应之间的错位，表明认可正义（特别是语言弱势群体）在政策实践中被系统性忽视。
AI.practical_contributions: 为地方政府制定更包容的能源贫困政策提供实证依据，提示政策制定者需将语言无障碍纳入能源正义行动计划，以避免系统性忽视语言边缘化群体。

title: Signaling Trustworthiness with Authentication in Online Second-hand Markets
affiliations: Tilburg University, Tilburg University and Tilburg University - Tilburg University School of Economics and Management

detail.title: Signaling Trustworthiness with Authentication in Online Second-hand Markets
detail.abstract:
Problem Definition: Online second-hand platforms increasingly use authentication services to reduce
uncertainty about whether a used product matches the seller’s description. These services may be optional
or mandatory, and authentication is imperfect. We study how the fee, accuracy, and optionality of authen-
tication affect information transmission and market outcomes when sellers differ in description reliability.
Methodology/Results: We develop a game-theoretic signaling model in which sellers privately differ in
the reliability of their product descriptions, consumers observe price and the seller’s authentication decision
before purchase, and the platform sets the fee for an imperfect authentication service. We characterize the
equilibrium for any fee and then study the platform’s optimal fee. Optional authentication can serve as a
credible signal because less reliable sellers face a greater risk that authentication cancels the transaction,
making the service more costly to imitate. The fee determines the signaling role of adoption: a low fee leads
both seller types to authenticate and shifts separation to price; an intermediate fee makes only reliable
sellers authenticate; and a high fee eliminates authentication and leads to pooling. Accuracy has a nuanced
effect: improving accuracy shifts the fee range in which only reliable sellers authenticate toward higher
fees, but this range can either expand or shrink because accuracy changes the adoption incentives of both
reliable and less reliable sellers. Comparing optional and mandatory authentication under the platform’s
optimal fee decisions, we show that mandatory authentication generates weakly higher direct authentication
revenue, whereas optional authentication often yields higher seller profit, consumer surplus, and completed
transactions by preserving seller choice as an information instrument.
Managerial Implications: Authentication should be designed as both an inspection service and an infor-
mation mechanism. Changes in authentication accuracy may call for corresponding fee adjustments. Manda-
tory authentication is more attractive when the platform focuses on direct service revenue. Optional authen-
tication may be more attractive when the platform accounts for broader market-side outcomes, because it
often improves seller profit, consumer surplus, and completed transactions.

AI.tldr: 研究在线二手平台中（可选/强制）认证服务如何通过费用、准确率和可选性影响信息传递和市场结果，发现可选认证可作为信号机制，且不同费用水平产生不同均衡，准确性对信号区间有复杂影响。
AI.research_question: 在线二手平台中，认证服务的费用、准确率和可选性（可选 vs 强制）如何影响卖家的信息传递行为及市场结果？
AI.motivation: 二手平台普遍存在卖家描述不准确的问题，认证服务旨在降低不确定性，但认证本身不完美且可选性不同，现有文献对认证服务的信号作用及最优设计研究不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 博弈论信号模型（signaling model），卖方在产品描述可靠性上存在私人信息，消费者通过价格和认证决策推断卖方类型，平台设定认证费用。
AI.method: 博弈论模型分析与均衡刻画，比较不同费用水平下的均衡类型，并对比可选认证与强制认证的最优结果。
AI.findings: （1）可选认证可作为可信信号，因为不可靠卖家面临认证取消交易的更高风险；（2）低费用导致两类卖家均认证，分离由价格实现；中费用仅可靠卖家认证；高费用无人认证形成混同；（3）提高认证准确率会改变信号区间向更高费用偏移，但区间可能扩大或缩小；（4）可选认证在卖家利润、消费者剩余和成交数量上通常优于强制认证，强制认证仅在直接认证收入上占优。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了认证服务在平台中兼具检验功能和信号功能的双重角色，刻画了费用对认证信号作用的非线性影响，以及准确率变化的复杂效应。
AI.practical_contributions: 为平台管理者提供了认证定价策略指导：准确率变化需相应调整费用；若平台关注直接收入则强制认证更优，若关注市场整体福利则可选认证更优。

title: A TAXONOMY OF CHIRALITY MEASURES
affiliations: MYRA School of Business, ETH Zurich and MIT

detail.title: A TAXONOMY OF CHIRALITY MEASURES
detail.abstract: AKS-I (Ambarish, Kreuser and Seigel 2026a) established a geometric formulation of chirality for implied-volatility surfaces, and AKS-II (2026b) linked market chirality to portfolio vanna exposure. Both papers used the local index χ(T)=Σk(0,T)/Σkk(0,T) as the primary market-level measure. This paper asks whether χ(T) is unique or whether alternative signed measures capture distinct aspects of surface asymmetry. We develop a taxonomy of six measures: χ(T), the local slope-to-curvature ratio; χ L (T), a finite-displacement risk-reversal ratio; χ G (T), a global odd-component integral; χ S (T), skew normalised by ATMF volatility; χ K (τ), an oriented odd Gaussian-curvature index; and χ H (τ), an oriented regional odd-curvature accumulation index. The first four form an analytically connected hierarchy whose leading local odd coefficient is Σk(0,T). The last two are generated by the odd Gaussian-curvature field of a dimensionless twodimensional surface and contain strike-maturity interaction information not determined by the four scalar direct measures. We formulate five structural axioms and treat stress responsiveness as a separate empirical criterion. Using 61 Q1 2026 observations at five maturities from the supplied reconstructed SPX raw-SVI panel, we recompute χ analytically and study its cross-maturity structure. PC1 explains 99.997% of standardized χ levels and 99.940% of daily χ changes; a one-factor maximum-likelihood model yields communalities above 0.99993, Bartlett χ²=2356.45 (df=10, p<0.001), and KMO=0.866. Because the daily surfaces are reconstructed from common VIX and stress anchors, the extreme factor dominance is interpreted as an internal diagnostic of the taxonomy and a calibrated illustration, not as independent validation from observed SPX option chains. The paper establishes a coherent measurement architecture and identifies the independent daily-calibration exercise required for external empirical validation.

AI.tldr: 本文在AKS-I和AKS-II的基础上，构建了隐含波动率曲面手征性的六种度量指标体系，并利用SPX期权数据检验了其结构性质，发现主成分因子解释力极高，但强调这是基于共同锚定重建的数据诊断，而非独立实证验证。
AI.research_question: 隐含波动率曲面的手征性度量χ(T)是否唯一？是否存在其他带符号的度量能够捕捉曲面不对称性的不同维度？
AI.motivation: 前期研究仅使用单一度量χ(T)刻画市场手征性，但曲面不对称性可能存在多个维度，单一指标可能无法全面反映。需要发展一套系统的度量分类体系，并检验其内部结构与可识别性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于隐含波动率曲面的几何手征性理论，构建了六种度量指标的分类体系：前四种（χ, χL, χG, χS）形成解析可连接的分层结构，后两种（χK, χH）基于奇数高斯曲率场，捕捉到期日-执行价交互信息。
AI.method: 提出五个结构公理作为理论框架；使用2026年Q1的61个交易日、5个到期日的SPX重建SVI面板数据，对χ进行解析计算；采用主成分分析（PCA）和单因子最大似然模型检验因子结构。
AI.findings: PC1解释了标准化χ水平的99.997%和日度χ变化的99.940%；单因子最大似然模型的共同度超过0.99993；Bartlett χ²=2356.45（df=10, p<0.001），KMO=0.866。因子主导性极高，但因数据来自共同的VIX和压力锚点重建，该结果被视为分类学的内部诊断和校准说明，而非独立实证验证。
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了连贯的手征性度量架构，明确了六种度量的分类体系及其解析关系；提出了五个结构公理；识别了前四种度量（直接标量度量）与后两种度量（包含strike-maturity交互信息）的本质区别。
AI.practical_contributions: 为市场从业者提供了多维度的曲面不对称性度量工具；指出了进行外部独立实证验证所需的日度校准工作方向。

title: Where Looking Away is Structured The Portability of Strategic Inattention

detail.title: Where Looking Away is Structured The Portability of Strategic Inattention
detail.abstract: A recurring finding in the economics of oversight is that a monitor can rationally choose not to observe, so that a failure to detect is an equilibrium outcome rather than a lapse. This paper asks how far that mechanism travels. It argues that strategic inattention is a portable mechanism, fully characterized by four structural conditions: (C1) blame attributed to a monitor rises with what the monitor could observe; (C2) the domain contains a subdomain in which observation carries little direct production value; (C3) the collapse of oversight is visible while its quiet recovery is not; and (C4) rotation destroys the relationship capital on which observation depends. The central result is one of localization: in any domain meeting these conditions, looking away does not spread across the whole domain but concentrates in the low-production-value subdomain-the framework predicts where a structural blind spot forms, not merely that one might. The leading application is the school: instruction, where observing pupils is itself the productive act, is active; pastoral and safety oversight, where observation mostly assigns responsibility, is where the trap structures. A measurement layer follows-Japan's recognized bullying-case counts (認知件数) are shown to identify only a product of suppression and recognition, and the education ministry's own stance that a school reporting zero recognized cases is the suspicious one is an administrative rediscovery of a programme theorem. Throughout, the discipline is explicit: only the direction of each transported result survives, every threshold and magnitude is flagged as domain-specific, and four further candidate domains are run through the checklist without being verified.

AI.tldr: 本文论证了"策略性疏忽"（strategic inattention）是一种可迁移的机制，并提出四个结构性条件（C1-C4）来预测其何时何地发生。核心发现是：当满足这些条件时，监督者的"视而不见"不会扩散到整个领域，而是集中在低生产价值的子领域——即形成"结构性盲点"。以学校为例：教学监督（观察即生产）不会出现盲点，但教牧与安全监督（观察主要分配责任）则容易陷入陷阱。论文还利用日本校园欺凌认知件数数据进行了实证测量。
AI.research_question: 监督者理性地选择不观察——即"失察"是均衡结果而非疏漏——这一在监督经济学中反复出现的发现，能够迁移到多大范围？机制迁移的结构性条件是什么？
AI.motivation: 现有文献反复发现监督者会理性选择不观察（失察是均衡现象），但尚不清楚这一机制能否以及如何迁移到不同领域。本文希望提供一个可移植的理论框架，解释"结构性盲点"的形成条件与位置。
AI.theoretical_framework: 策略性疏忽（strategic inattention）机制；四个结构性条件（C1-C4）：(C1)监督者被归责的程度取决于其本可观察到什么；(C2)存在低生产价值的子领域；(C3)监督的崩溃可见但悄然恢复不可见；(C4)轮岗会破坏观察所依赖的关系资本。
AI.method: 理论推导与模型化四个结构性条件；以学校领域为主要应用案例进行机制验证；利用日本校园欺凌"认知件数"（認知件数）数据进行实证测量；额外对四个候选领域进行清单式检验（未被验证）。
AI.findings: 核心发现是"局域化"（localization）：在满足四个条件的领域中，"视而不见"不会扩散到整个领域，而是集中在低生产价值的子领域——框架不仅能预测结构性盲点可能存在，还能预测它具体在哪里形成。以学校为例：教学监督（观察本身就是生产行为）活跃；教牧与安全监督（观察主要分配责任）则形成陷阱。日本教育省认为"零认知件数"的学校可疑，这实质上是对该理论定理的行政再发现。
AI.theory_contributions: 将"策略性疏忽"从孤立发现提升为可迁移的一般性机制，提出四个结构性条件作为迁移判据；做出定位预测（不仅预测盲点存在，还预测其位置）；明确标记哪些结果是方向性可迁移的、哪些阈值和量级是领域特定的。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和监督机构提供了识别"结构性盲点"的诊断工具（四个条件清单）；以日本校园欺凌数据为例展示了如何测量"压制与认知的乘积"而非真实发生率；提醒教育部门注意"零报告"恰恰可能是问题的信号。

title: From Market to Portfolio Chirality
affiliations: MYRA School of Business, ETH Zurich and MIT

detail.title: From Market to Portfolio Chirality
detail.abstract: In a companion paper (Ambarish, Kreuser and Seigel, 2026 — hereafter AKS-I) we established that financial markets are intrinsically chiral: the implied volatility surface Σ(k,T) is a curved Riemannian manifold that cannot be superimposed on its mirror image. The chirality index χ(T) = (∂Σ/∂k)/(∂²Σ/∂k²) quantifies this asymmetry at each maturity T, estimated from two SPX datasets spanning Q1 2026 (61 trading days, 427 maturity-day observations) and 2019–2023. We develop the relationship between market-level chirality and the chirality of individual instruments and portfolios across the full maturity term structure. Market chirality is the ambient Riemannian geometry in which all instruments live; instrument chirality is mediated through the position’s vanna Λ = ∂²V/∂S∂Σ, expressed as ξ(X,T) = χ(T)·(Λ/Γ) per unit gamma, with ρ(S,Σ) entering separately as the market transmission parameter linking chirality to realised hedging P&L. We define a portfolio chirality index Ψ (the vanna-weighted average of χ(T) across all maturities) and establish a chirality irreducibility theorem: chirality cannot be eliminated from any options portfolio by delta hedging alone. Ψ determines the direction of the expected asymmetry in realised delta-hedging P&L between up- and down-market days, while the signed aggregate exposure Ξₚ determines its magnitude. Instrument and portfolio chirality data are presented at a consistent five-maturity grid (1M, 3M, 6M, 12M, 24M) throughout. Detailed notation is in Annexure A.

AI.tldr: 本文在前期研究基础上，将金融市场的手性（chirality）从市场层面扩展到单个期权工具和投资组合层面。市场手性由隐含波动率曲面的几何不对称性定义；工具手性通过期权的vanna（对价格和波动率的二阶交叉导数）与gamma比值传递；投资组合手性指数Ψ是各期限手性的vanna加权平均。核心发现：手性不可约性定理——仅靠Delta对冲无法消除任何期权组合的手性，手性决定了Delta对冲盈亏在上涨与下跌市场日之间的预期不对称方向。
AI.research_question: 市场层面的手性如何传递到单个期权工具和投资组合？这种手性是否可以通过Delta对冲被消除？
AI.motivation: 前期研究（AKS-I）已证明金融市场具有内在手性（不可与其镜像重叠的几何不对称性），但手性如何从市场层面传导至单个工具和投资组合尚不明确，需要建立完整的手性传递理论。
AI.theoretical_framework: 手性几何（Chirality Geometry）、Riemannian流形、Vanna-Gamma框架、不可约性定理
AI.method: 基于2019-2023年和2026年Q1两个SPX数据集（共61个交易日、427个期限-到期日观测值），在1M/3M/6M/12M/24M五期限网格上计算各期限手性指数χ(T)、工具手性ξ(X,T)及组合手性指数Ψ，推导手性不可约性定理。
AI.findings: （1）工具手性ξ(X,T)=χ(T)·(Λ/Γ)，通过每单位gamma的vanna传递；（2）定义了投资组合手性指数Ψ（各期限χ(T)的vanna加权平均）和符号聚合敞口Ξₚ；（3）手性不可约性定理：仅靠Delta对冲无法消除任何期权组合的手性；（4）Ψ决定Delta对冲盈亏在上涨与下跌市场日之间的预期不对称方向，Ξₚ决定其幅度。
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了从市场手性到工具手性再到组合手性的完整理论框架，提出了手性的不可约性定理，揭示了手性作为期权风险管理中不可消除的几何属性的本质。
AI.practical_contributions: 为期权交易员提供了量化工具手性和组合手性的可操作方法（基于Vanna-Gamma框架），揭示了Delta对冲无法消除手性风险的实际含义，为理解Delta对冲盈亏的方向性不对称提供了理论依据。

title: Bond Yield Responses to Macro News: The Role of Macro Forecast Disagreement and Monetary Policy Uncertainty
affiliations: Bank for International Settlements (BIS), Bilkent University - Department of Economics and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Bond Yield Responses to Macro News: The Role of Macro Forecast Disagreement and Monetary Policy Uncertainty
detail.abstract: Public macroeconomic announcements do not carry a fixed asset pricing content. Their impact on bond yields depends on the informational environment into which they arrive. Using intraday responses of US Treasury futures to macroeconomic surprises, we show that two features of that environment move the pass-through of news in opposite directions. Greater forecast disagreement about an indicator ahead of its release weakens the yield response, while higher monetary policy uncertainty strengthens it. Inflation is the exception: before the post-COVID surge, yield reactions to inflation surprises were not amplified by policy uncertainty. We interpret these patterns through a model of Bayesian learning about the policy path, in which disagreement lowers the signal value of a release while policy uncertainty raises the value of news for learning about future rates. Once signal precision is allowed to vary over time, a single mechanism accounts for the post-COVID shift, in which inflation became the marginal signal about policy while payrolls became less informative. Model-based decompositions indicate that the amplification by policy uncertainty operates predominantly through expected future short rates, with a smaller and model-dependent term premium component, and we estimate the model's signal precision parameters by simulated method of moments. The same distinction between measured surprises and structural news carries an implication beyond these state-contingent responses: the yield curve prices the innovation component of a release rather than its predictable part, and the model ties the wedge between the two to forecast disagreement. State-contingent announcement responses and the predictability of measured surprises are thus two aspects of one information transmission mechanism.

AI.tldr: 本文研究美国国债收益率对宏观经济公告的反应如何取决于信息环境。预测分歧会削弱收益率反应，而货币政策不确定性会增强反应。通胀在新冠疫情前后表现不同，成为关于政策的关键信号。模型表明，收益率定价的是公告的创新部分而非可预测部分，这一差异与预测分歧相关。
AI.research_question: 宏观经济公告对国债收益率的影响如何取决于公告发布时的信息环境？具体来说，预测分歧和货币政策不确定性如何调节收益率对宏观新闻的反应？
AI.motivation: 传统研究将宏观经济公告视为具有固定资产定价内容的信号，但现实中同一公告在不同时期对市场的影响差异很大。本文试图理解信息环境如何调节公告的市场影响，并揭示公告中"可预测部分"与"创新部分"的不同定价机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 贝叶斯学习模型：市场主体通过学习宏观经济公告来更新对货币政策路径的信念。预测分歧降低公告的信号价值，而货币政策不确定性提高新闻对未来利率学习的价值。
AI.method: 利用美国国债期货的日内高频数据，结合宏观经济公告的预测分歧指标和货币政策不确定性指标，采用模拟矩估计法估计模型信号精度参数。
AI.findings: 预测分歧削弱收益率对宏观新闻的反应；货币政策不确定性增强收益率反应；通胀在新冠疫情前不受政策不确定性放大，但疫情后成为关于政策的关键信号而就业信息的信息含量下降；政策不确定性的放大效应主要通过预期未来短期利率路径发挥作用，期限溢价成分较小。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出信息环境依赖的公告传导机制，统一解释了预测分歧和货币政策不确定性的相反调节作用；将公告的可预测部分与创新部分区分开来，建立了预测分歧与两者价格效应的理论联系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为市场参与者理解不同信息环境下宏观公告的差异化影响提供分析框架；为央行和监管机构理解货币政策沟通与市场传导机制提供参考。

title: From Geography to Alignment: The Reorganization of Trade Costs in Structural Gravity, 1995–2024
affiliations: National Tsing Hua University and National Taiwan Normal University

detail.title: From Geography to Alignment: The Reorganization of Trade Costs in Structural Gravity, 1995–2024
detail.abstract: This paper examines how geoeconomic risk has altered the structure of bilateral trade costs. We estimate a structural gravity model with exporter-year and importer-year fixed effects, as time-varying multilateral resistance requires, for thirteen strategically significant economies across three regimes: the globalization era (1995–2017), the years of trade war and pandemic (2018–2021), and the period following Russia’s invasion of Ukraine (2022–2024). Two findings prove robust across estimators and specifications. After 2022, the elasticity of trade with respect to geographic distance weakens by roughly two-thirds, while political alignment, measured by the distance between countries’ revealed voting positions in the United Nations General Assembly, acquires substantial force: a penalty of 23 to 33 percent of bilateral trade per standard deviation of misalignment, equivalent to an ad valorem tariff of roughly five to eight percent. A country-level index of geopolitical risk, by contrast, identifies no bilateral effect once country-year shocks are absorbed. The margin on which fragmentation operates is relational rather than atmospheric: trade is increasingly organized by political affinity, and decreasingly by geography.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过结构引力模型发现，2022年后地理距离对贸易的影响减弱约三分之二，而政治一致性（基于联合国投票立场）对双边贸易产生显著影响——政治立场每偏离一个标准差，贸易量下降23%-33%（相当于5-8%的从价关税）。贸易碎片化的主要机制是“关系性”而非“氛围性”：贸易越来越由政治亲和力组织，而非地理距离。
AI.research_question: 地缘经济风险如何改变双边贸易成本的结构？具体而言，地理距离和政治一致性在全球化时代、贸易战与疫情时期、俄乌战争后这三个时期的贸易弹性如何变化？
AI.motivation: 近年地缘政治冲突（贸易战、疫情、俄乌战争）加剧了全球碎片化风险，但学界对地缘风险如何具体重塑贸易成本结构（尤其是距离与政治因素的相对重要性）缺乏系统量化证据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结构引力模型（Structural Gravity Model），融入时变多边阻力项（time-varying multilateral resistance），并结合联合国投票立场衡量政治一致性、地理距离衡量传统贸易成本。
AI.method: 估计带有出口国-年份和进口国-年份固定效应的结构引力模型，覆盖13个战略意义经济体，划分三个时段（1995-2017全球化时期、2018-2021贸易战与疫情期、2022-2024俄乌战后），并进行多种估计量和设定的稳健性检验。
AI.findings: （1）2022年后，地理距离的贸易弹性减弱约三分之二；（2）政治一致性（联合国投票立场接近程度）变得显著：政治立场每偏移一个标准差，双边贸易减少23%-33%，相当于5-8%的从价关税；（3）国家层面的地缘政治风险指数在吸收国家-年份固定效应后不再有双边层面的显著效应；（4）碎片化是“关系性”而非“氛围性”的：贸易按政治亲和力重组，而非受整体地缘风险氛围影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了地缘政治碎片化影响贸易的双边机制（关系性）而非系统性机制（氛围性），更新了传统引力模型中对距离和制度距离的理解，将政治一致性作为贸易成本的新关键变量纳入理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 量化了政治不结盟的贸易惩罚（23-33%贸易量损失或5-8%关税等价），为政策制定者和企业评估地缘政治风险、调整贸易战略和供应链布局提供了具体参考。

title: The Weight of Wealth: Decomposing the socioeconomic gradient in excess body weight in Ghana
affiliations: , University of Ghana and Ghana Institute of Management and Public Administration

detail.title: The Weight of Wealth: Decomposing the socioeconomic gradient in excess body weight in Ghana
detail.abstract: We examine socioeconomic inequality in excess body weight among women of reproductive age using four rounds of the Ghana Demographic and Health Survey, 2003–2022. We assess relative and absolute inequality using the Concentration, Wagstaff, and Erreygers indices and decompose the contribution of personal and household characteristics to the socioeconomic gradient, as well as its evolution over time. We find pronounced pro-rich inequality in excess body weight, with relative inequality in obesity narrowing over the period while absolute inequality nearly doubled. Changes in the gradient are driven primarily by structural effects rather than shifts in personal and household characteristics. Our results highlight the importance of jointly considering relative and absolute inequality in excess body weight in rapidly transforming economies.

AI.tldr: 本文利用加纳2003–2022年四轮人口与健康调查数据，考察育龄女性超重的社会经济不平等。研究发现：超重呈现显著的亲富不平等；相对不平等（肥胖）有所缩小，但绝对不平等几乎翻倍；梯度变化主要由结构效应驱动，而非个体特征变化。
AI.research_question: 加纳育龄女性超重体重的社会经济不平等程度如何？其相对不平等与绝对不平等随时间如何变化？不平等背后的驱动因素是个人特征变化还是结构性效应？
AI.motivation: 尽管许多发展中国家正经历营养转型，超重问题日益突出，但关于超重社会经济不平等及其动态变化（尤其是同时关注相对和绝对不平等）的研究仍不充分。加纳作为快速转型经济体，缺乏系统性证据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 健康不平等理论、社会经济梯度理论、营养转型理论；运用集中度指数（Concentration Index）、Wagstaff指数和Erreygers指数衡量相对与绝对不平等，并采用分解方法分析不平等驱动因素。
AI.method: 数据来源：加纳人口与健康调查（GDHS），2003、2008、2014、2022四轮。使用集中度指数、Wagstaff指数和Erreygers指数测量相对和绝对不平等，并进行分解分析，将不平等变化归因于结构效应（系数变化）与组成效应（特征变化）。
AI.findings: （1）超重呈现显著的亲富不平等（富人超重比例更高）；（2）肥胖的相对不平等在研究期内有所收窄，但绝对不平等几乎翻倍；（3）不平等变化的驱动力主要来自结构效应（社会经济梯度本身的变化），而非个人和家庭人口特征的变化。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了发展中国家中营养转型与健康不平等关系的理论理解；首次系统区分了加纳超重问题的相对与绝对不平等趋势，揭示了仅看相对不平等可能低估问题严重性；通过分解方法厘清了结构效应与组成效应的相对重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为加纳及类似快速转型经济体的公共卫生政策提供实证依据：政策应同时关注相对和绝对不平等；干预措施需重点应对结构因素（如食物环境、社会规范）而非仅聚焦个体行为改变；提示肥胖的绝对不平等加剧可能带来更大的公共卫生负担。

title: Institutional Sources of Advantage and Selection into Competition
affiliations: University of Exeter and Interdisciplinary Center for Economic Science

detail.title: Institutional Sources of Advantage and Selection into Competition

declarations.declarationOfInterest: N/A

detail.abstract: Competitive institutions shape outcomes not only through who wins, but through who chooses to enter. We study whether competition entry depends on the institutional source of competitive advantage. In a real-effort experiment with 654 subjects, we separately vary task difficulty, competitive position, and the source of that position: an easy task is either transparently assigned by chance (legitimate advantage) or obtained through an unverifiable private report (ambiguous advantage). Entry is institutionally contingent. The gender gap in entry is pronounced under competitive advantage but small under competitive disadvantage. Entry is higher under legitimate than under ambiguous advantage, especially among men, and partial-identification bounds indicate that this contrast is not driven by self-selection into reported advantage. Absolute task difficulty alone explains little, and reported easy status strongly predicts entry but is unrelated to baseline ability. Institutional design thus shapes selection into competition by changing not only who is advantaged, but how advantage is created.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过实验发现，竞争性进入决策不仅取决于谁拥有优势，还取决于优势产生的制度来源。合法（随机分配）的优势比模糊（自我报告）的优势更能促进进入，且这一效应在男性中更显著；性别差异在优势条件下明显，在劣势条件下微弱。
AI.research_question: 竞争性进入决策是否取决于竞争优势的制度来源？即优势的合法性（透明随机分配）与模糊性（不可验证的自我报告）如何影响个体的进入决策及性别差异？
AI.motivation: 现有文献关注竞争性制度如何通过"谁获胜"塑造结果，但忽略了"谁选择进入"这一环节。作者试图揭示竞争性优势的制度来源（合法 vs. 模糊）对个体进入决策的因果影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 制度设计理论、竞争进入理论、性别差异理论、自我选择与信号理论。
AI.method: 实地实验（654名被试），采用真实努力任务，分别操纵任务难度、竞争地位及其来源（合法随机分配 vs. 模糊自我报告），并使用部分识别界限处理自选择问题。
AI.findings: (1) 性别差异在优势条件下显著，在劣势条件下很小；(2) 合法优势下的进入率高于模糊优势，尤其是在男性中；(3) 绝对任务难度本身对进入决策解释力弱；(4) 报告的优势地位强预测进入，但与基线能力无关。
AI.theory_contributions: 将制度设计视角引入竞争进入研究，区分了优势的存在与优势的制度来源对行为的异质性影响，拓展了对性别差异在竞争中形成机制的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织设计竞争性制度（如晋升、竞赛）提供了实证依据：制度如何定义和传递优势（透明 vs. 模糊）会显著影响不同性别群体的参与意愿，进而影响组织的人才筛选结果。

title: How AI Exposure Alters Risk Preferences and Advisory Behavior
affiliations: University of Utah - David Eccles School of Business,  and Northeastern University (USA)

detail.title: How AI Exposure Alters Risk Preferences and Advisory Behavior
detail.abstract: We study how access to artificial intelligence affects investment decisions using a controlled experiment that combines within-and across-subject variation. Participants first make portfolio choices for themselves, then advise clients with known risk preferences, and finally return to their own choices after AI access is removed. This design distinguishes changes in decision capacity from changes in the objective being pursued and tests whether the effects of AI persist after access is removed. AI access significantly increases participants' responsiveness to risk-return trade-offs in their own portfolios. In the advising task, where objectives are fixed externally, AI reduces the distance between recommendations and model-implied client targets by approximately 41%, providing direct evidence that AI augments decision capacity. After AI is removed, however, we find no statistically reliable treatment-specific persistence in participants' own choices and therefore no clear evidence that AI builds durable capacity. Implied risk aversion is unchanged on average. AI also does not broadly inflate confidence. Calibrated, non-directive AI improves decision-making capacity in real time, potentially yielding large welfare gains by translating complex settings into decisions.

AI.tldr: 通过实验研究AI对投资决策的影响，发现AI能即时提升决策能力（尤其在咨询任务中效果显著），但移除AI后能力并未持续保留。
AI.research_question: AI接入如何影响投资决策？AI带来的影响是暂时的还是持久的？
AI.motivation: AI对决策的影响机制尚不明确：是提升了决策能力（capacity），还是改变了决策目标（objective）？以及AI效应在移除后是否持续存在？
AI.theoretical_framework: 决策能力（decision capacity）与决策目标（objective）的区分；AI的即时增强效应vs.持久学习效应。
AI.method: 控制实验，结合被试内与被试间变异设计。实验流程：先为自己做投资组合选择→为客户提供投资建议（已知风险偏好）→移除AI后再次为自己做选择。
AI.findings: 1. AI接入显著提高参与者对自身投资组合中风险-收益权衡的响应度；2. 在咨询任务中，AI使建议与模型隐含客户目标的距离减少约41%，直接证明AI增强了决策能力；3. 移除AI后，参与者的自身选择无统计上可靠的持续性效应；4. 隐含风险厌恶平均不变；5. AI并未普遍膨胀信心。
AI.theory_contributions: 区分了AI对决策能力（capacity）与决策目标（objective）的不同影响；证明AI主要提供实时能力增强而非持久能力建设。
AI.practical_contributions: 提示AI可作为即时决策辅助工具（尤其在复杂决策场景中），但不应过度依赖其带来持久能力提升；为非指令性AI在投资决策中的应用提供了实验证据。
