AI.practical_contributions: 为管理者提供诊断AI环境下信息污染的实用词汇（SMOG）；给出六种"除雾"能力的实践指南，帮助组织在AI时代恢复决策的信息可靠性。

title: The mission statement movement of the 1990s: what 519 organizations actually did

detail.title: The mission statement movement of the 1990s: what 519 organizations actually did

declarations.ethicsApproval: This research involved no patients or clinical participants. Data were collected through voluntary mail and fax surveys of senior executives, completed in their professional capacity and concerning their organizations' management practices. Consistent with standard practice for survey research, voluntary completion and return of the questionnaire constituted consent to participate; respondents were free to decline or to leave any item unanswered, without consequence. The surveys were conducted in the mid-to-late 1990s in accordance with the research norms prevailing at the host institution at that time. All results are reported in aggregate, and no individual respondent or organization is identified in the paper.

detail.abstract:
Purpose — The mission statement was the most widely adopted management instrument of the 1980s and 1990s, yet systematic contemporaneous evidence about how organizations actually created, communicated and used their missions has remained fragmentary. This paper documents the mission statement movement at its peak, as a historical record, using the largest database on mission statement practice ever assembled.

Design/methodology/approach — The paper draws on the Mission Audit database: 559 survey responses from 519 organizations collected in the mid-to-late 1990s using a structured instrument covering more than 1,000 variables on mission creation, content, communication, systems alignment and perceived outcomes. Because the mission movement was itself cross-sectoral, the sample deliberately spans corporations, healthcare organizations and municipalities; the analysis is descriptive, reporting per-item distributions (typical item n = 300–372) for the pooled sample, with every headline finding re-verified separately within the corporate and healthcare subsamples.

Findings — Regardless of sector, and in the accounts of its own senior executives, the mission movement was top management talking largely to itself. Missions were young (median creation year 1992) and created overwhelmingly by CEOs and senior teams (96% and 95% moderately/highly involved) to provide direction and build culture, with front-line employees (34%), customers (17%) and suppliers (2%) largely absent. Content emphasized purpose (93%), customer satisfaction (83%) and values (77%) over strategy and financial objectives. Communication effectiveness declined monotonically down the hierarchy (CEO 3.74/4; non-managers 3.21; suppliers 2.60), and missions were least aligned with the systems that govern behaviour — rewards (2.65/5) and promotion (2.74/5). This internalization gap coincided with mediocre functional outcomes (mission as energy source: 5.1/9), while systems alignment showed the strongest association with mission achievement, commitment and guidance (r = 0.53–0.61). Each of these headline patterns replicated within the corporate and healthcare subsamples.

Originality/value — This is the first comprehensive descriptive synthesis of the full Mission Audit database — a systematic contemporaneous record of the 1990s mission movement — with the paper's relationship to earlier studies drawing on elements of the database mapped explicitly. It documents a defining management fashion in practice and offers a data-based explanation for its signature disappointment: the mission as a plaque on the wall.

AI disclosure — This working paper was prepared with assistance from Claude (Anthropic, 2026), and used under the author's direction for data cleaning and statistical analysis of the data archive, reference verification, and drafting and revision of text; all data, the survey instrument, the interpretations, and the conclusions are the author's, who takes full responsibility for the accuracy, integrity, and originality of the work.

AI.tldr: 基于519个组织的大规模调查数据，本文记录了1990年代使命宣言运动的实践全貌，发现使命宣言主要由高层管理者主导制定，一线员工、客户和供应商参与度低，沟通效果随层级递减，与奖励、晋升等制度体系的匹配度最弱，导致使命沦为“墙上标语”的普遍失望。
AI.research_question: 组织实际如何创建、沟通和使用使命宣言？
AI.motivation: 使命宣言是20世纪八九十年代最广泛采用的管理工具，但关于组织如何实际创建、沟通和使用使命的系统性同期证据仍然零散。本文旨在用最大规模的数据库记录使命宣言运动在高峰时期的实践全貌。
AI.theoretical_framework: 管理时尚理论、使命宣言与组织行为/文化/战略对齐理论
AI.method: 基于Mission Audit数据库，包含519个组织的559份调查问卷（1990年代中后期收集），涵盖1000多个变量，采用描述性统计分析，报告每个项目的分布，并在企业和医疗子样本中分别验证主要发现。
AI.findings: 1）使命宣言主要由CEO和高层团队（96%和95%高度参与）创建，一线员工（34%）、客户（17%）和供应商（2%）基本缺席；2）沟通效果沿层级单调递减（CEO 3.74/4，非管理者3.21，供应商2.60）；3）使命与行为治理体系（奖励2.65/5，晋升2.74/5）对齐最弱；4）系统对齐与使命实现、承诺和指引的关联最强（r=0.53-0.61）。所有主要发现在企业和医疗子样本中一致。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次对Mission Audit数据库进行全面描述性综合，提供了关于使命宣言运动同期系统性记录，从数据层面解释了使命宣言沦为“墙上标语”的管理失望现象。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了使命宣言实践的关键缺陷：高层主导、基层缺位、与奖惩制度脱节。为管理者提供了将使命从口号落地为实际行动的具体方向，尤其是加强系统对齐（奖励、晋升）的必要性。

title: The Permanent Vacancy Economy: How AI Delegation can unlock Trapped GDP

detail.title: The Permanent Vacancy Economy: How AI Delegation can unlock Trapped GDP

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is the founder and CEO of Almma.AI. This paper is conceptual and presents no empirical results; the views expressed are the author's own.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study involved no human participants, animals, or personal data.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: Modern economies exhibit persistent labor vacancies that suppress output and wages in sectors where labor supply has been structurally inadequate for years. Building on publicly available labor data and prior estimates of vacancy-induced output losses, this paper argues that AI delegation can substitute for absent workers rather than displace present ones. The operative distinction is the vacancy substitution frame: AI systems acting on unfilled roles produce net-additive output, while AI systems acting on occupied roles reallocate economic activity. In supply-constrained labor markets, this distinction changes the welfare calculus, resolves the apparent Jevons paradox, and identifies a mechanism to recover persistently suppressed GDP without requiring workforce displacement. Estimates of vacancy-induced output loss-grounded in publicly available BLS data-suggest the magnitude of recoverable output warrants treatment as a macroeconomic policy variable, not merely a microeconomic friction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"空缺替代框架"（vacancy substitution frame），区分AI替代空缺岗位与替代在职岗位：前者可产生净增产出，后者仅重新分配经济活动。在劳动力供给受限的市场中，AI可用于填补长期结构性劳动力短缺导致的岗位空缺，从而恢复被抑制的GDP，而无需取代现有工人。
AI.research_question: 在劳动力供给长期结构性不足的经济中，AI如何通过填补空缺岗位而非替代现有工人来影响产出和工资？
AI.motivation: 现代经济中存在持续的劳动空缺，这些空缺抑制了产出和工资。现有讨论多关注AI替代工人的风险，但忽视了AI可用于填补长期无人填补的空缺岗位的可能性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 空缺替代框架（vacancy substitution frame）、杰文斯悖论（Jevons paradox）
AI.method: 基于公开可用的BLS（劳工统计局）劳动力数据，结合先前关于空缺导致的产出损失的估计，进行理论论证与经验估算。
AI.findings: AI填补空缺岗位可产生净增产出，改变福利计算，解决杰文斯悖论，并识别出一种无需替代劳动力即可恢复被抑制GDP的机制。空缺导致的产出损失规模应被视为宏观经济政策变量，而非微观经济摩擦。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"空缺替代框架"作为理解AI经济影响的新视角，挑战了AI必然导致大规模失业的假设，并重新解释了杰文斯悖论在劳动市场中的含义。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了将AI部署作为宏观经济工具的思路，可用于恢复因长期劳动空缺而损失的GDP，同时避免大规模失业问题。

title: AI-Driven Digital Transformation and Women Entrepreneurship: Evidence from the Western Balkans
affiliations: and AAB College - Faculty of Economics

detail.title: AI-Driven Digital Transformation and Women Entrepreneurship: Evidence from the Western Balkans
detail.abstract: From 2010 to 2025, this research looks at the Western Balkans to see how artificial intelligence (AI) helped women become more economically independent and entrepreneurs. This study aims to examine the effects of artificial intelligence (AI), digital transformation (DT), innovation (I), and human capital (HC) on the success and longevity of businesses run by women in emerging markets. To investigate the direct and indirect links among the major variables, the study uses an integrated empirical framework that incorporates Fixed Effects (FE), Hausman-Taylor estimation, Difference-inDifferences (DID), Structural Equation Modeling (SEM), and interaction models. Adopting AI has a favorable and statistically significant impact on innovative ability, company success, and the empowerment of women entrepreneurs, according to the research. The results show that women-led enterprises are more likely to adopt and use AI technologies when they have digital skills, education, and access to finance. Furthermore, the DID analysis verifies that the region's female entrepreneurs have flourished and will continue to thrive thanks to policies that encourage digital transformation and entrepreneurship after 2019. Using a variety of advanced econometric methods that have seldom been combined in prior research on transition economies, this study builds an integrated empirical model that connects the adoption of artificial intelligence (AI), innovation, company performance, and the empowerment of women entrepreneurs in the Western Balkans.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了2010-2025年间人工智能如何帮助西巴尔干地区女性提升经济独立性并成为企业家，发现AI采纳对创新能力、企业绩效和女性赋权有显著正向影响，且数字化政策促进了女性创业发展。
AI.research_question: 人工智能、数字化转型、创新和人力资本如何影响西巴尔干新兴市场女性创业企业的成功与持续性？
AI.motivation: 西巴尔干地区作为转型经济体，女性创业面临独特挑战，而AI等数字化力量可能成为赋能工具，但此前缺乏综合实证研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 整合了AI采纳理论、数字化转型理论、创新理论、人力资本理论与女性创业赋权理论。
AI.method: 采用固定效应模型、Hausman-Taylor估计、双重差分法（DID）、结构方程模型（SEM）和交互效应模型的综合实证框架。
AI.findings: (1) AI采纳对创新能力、企业绩效和女性创业赋权有显著正向影响；(2) 数字技能、教育和融资渠道促进女性采用AI技术；(3) 2019年后推动数字化和创业的政策显著促进了女性创业者发展。
AI.theory_contributions: 构建了连接AI采纳、创新、企业绩效与女性赋权的综合实证模型，填补了转型经济体女性创业研究的空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了促进女性创业的数字化政策证据，强调了教育、数字技能和融资支持的重要性。

title: Ties between Cooperatives: A Study on the Practice and Impact of Using Common Administrators
affiliations: and Universidade Federal do Rio Grande do Sul (UFRGS) - Departamento de Ciências Administrativas

detail.title: Ties between Cooperatives: A Study on the Practice and Impact of Using Common Administrators
detail.abstract: The connections between organizations, through their main decision-making bodies, create links known as Board Interlocking, with effects that extend beyond the operational sphere. Based on Social Network Analysis and interviews, this study investigates these connections and their implications in cooperatives in Southern Brazil. The motivations for the phenomenon were compared with the reasons traditionally presented in the literature, and real cases are transcribed to demonstrate worrying impacts on governance and democratic equity in cooperatives. The results confirmed the existence of interconnections in cooperatives and demonstrated their use as part of a controversial strategy for maintaining political and institutional power.

AI.tldr: 本研究运用社会网络分析和访谈法，调查巴西南部合作社中董事会连锁现象及其对治理和民主公平的影响，发现该现象被用作维持政治和制度权力的争议性策略。
AI.research_question: 合作社中的董事会连锁现象及其对治理和民主公平的影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 探讨合作社中董事会连锁现象的存在性，并与传统文献中提出的动机进行比较，揭示该现象对合作社治理和民主公平的潜在危害。
AI.theoretical_framework: 社会网络分析（Social Network Analysis）、董事会连锁（Board Interlocking）理论
AI.method: 社会网络分析（Social Network Analysis）结合访谈法
AI.findings: 1. 确认巴西南部合作社中存在董事会连锁互连现象；2. 该现象被用作维持政治和制度权力的争议性策略；3. 对合作社治理和民主公平产生令人担忧的影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 将董事会连锁研究从营利性组织拓展到合作社情境，揭示了该现象在合作制组织中的特殊运作机制和权力维持功能。
AI.practical_contributions: 为合作社治理实践提供警示，揭示了董事会连锁可能损害民主公平的实证证据，有助于合作社改进治理结构并防范权力集中风险。

title: Algorithmic Echo Chambers and Digital Cartels- Reimagining Indian Competition Law in the Age of Media Monopolies

detail.title: Algorithmic Echo Chambers and Digital Cartels- Reimagining Indian Competition Law in the Age of Media Monopolies

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no personal, financial, professional, or institutional relationships that could have influenced, or could reasonably be perceived to have influenced, the research presented in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethics approval was not required for this research because the study is doctrinal and comparative in nature and does not involve human participants, patients, personal data, interviews, surveys, experiments, or case studies requiring consent.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant or financial support from any public, commercial, academic, or not-for-profit funding body.

detail.abstract: In this paper, I examine the emerging relationship between algorithmic content curation, digital media concentration, and anti-competitive conduct in India. I argue that dominant digital platforms increasingly exercise market power not merely through conventional pricing or exclusionary practices, but also through algorithmic systems that shape content visibility, consumer choice, advertising access, and market participation. Such systems may create echo chambers, reinforce platform dominance, facilitate tacit coordination, and disadvantage independent publishers and smaller competitors without producing the explicit agreement traditionally required to establish cartel liability. I analyse the limitations of the Competition Act, 2002, particularly Sections 3 and 4, in addressing algorithmic collusion, self-preferencing, data-driven market foreclosure, and other forms of automated anti-competitive behaviour. I also examine relevant Indian regulatory developments and decisions involving search bias, platform data practices, and digital marketplaces to demonstrate the evidentiary and institutional difficulties faced by the Competition Commission of India. Through a comparative analysis of regulatory approaches adopted in the European Union, the United States, the United Kingdom, Japan, and Australia, I identify possible lessons for the Indian competition regime. The paper contends that India must move beyond an exclusively reactive model of enforcement and adopt preventive measures tailored to digital markets. I propose the recognition of algorithmic collusion as a distinct form of anti-competitive conduct, mandatory algorithmic audits, proportionate transparency obligations, data portability and interoperability requirements, restrictions on self-preferencing, and the establishment of a specialised Digital Competition Division within the Competition Commission of India. I further argue that consumer protection, media plurality, and competitive neutrality must be treated as interconnected regulatory objectives. Ultimately, the paper seeks to develop an algorithmically informed approach to competition law capable of preserving consumer autonomy, market fairness, innovation, and diversity in India’s rapidly evolving digital media economy.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨印度算法内容策展与数字媒体集中化带来的反竞争问题，分析现行《竞争法》的局限性，并提出建立预防性监管框架，包括算法合谋认定、算法审计、数据可携性等建议，以维护数字媒体经济的公平竞争与消费者自主权。
AI.research_question: 在印度数字媒体经济中，算法内容策展如何影响市场竞争？现行竞争法框架能否有效应对算法驱动的反竞争行为？
AI.motivation: 数字平台通过算法系统而非传统定价或排他性行为行使市场力量，可能形成回音室、强化平台主导地位、促进默契协调并损害独立出版商和较小竞争者，但此类行为难以用传统卡特尔责任标准来认定。
AI.theoretical_framework: 竞争法理论、算法合谋理论、平台经济与数字市场监管理论、消费者自主权与媒体多样性理论
AI.method: 法律文本分析、比较法研究（欧盟、美国、英国、日本、澳大利亚）、案例分析与监管决策检视
AI.findings: 印度《竞争法》（2002年）第3条和第4条在应对算法合谋、自我优待、数据驱动型市场封锁等方面存在明显局限；印度竞争委员会面临证据性和制度性困难；其他司法管辖区的经验为印度提供了改革参照。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出将算法合谋视为一种独立的反竞争行为类型；构建了"算法导向的竞争法"分析框架，将消费者保护、媒体多元性和竞争中立性作为相互关联的监管目标。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议：承认算法合谋为独立反竞争行为；强制算法审计；设定相称的透明度义务；数据可携性和互操作性要求；限制自我优待；在印度竞争委员会内设立专门数字竞争部门。

title: Job Design and Employee Motivation in the Auto Ancillary Sector: A Field Validation of the Job Characteristics Model Using the Job Diagnostic Survey

detail.title: Job Design and Employee Motivation in the Auto Ancillary Sector: A Field Validation of the Job Characteristics Model Using the Job Diagnostic Survey
detail.abstract: The Job Characteristics Model (JCM), developed by Hackman and Oldham (1976, 1980), remains one of the most widely applied frameworks in organisational psychology, proposing that five core job dimensionsskill variety, task identity, task significance, autonomy, and feedback-shape three critical psychological states, which in turn determine work motivation and job satisfaction. Despite extensive international validation, empirical application of the JCM in Indian auto ancillary manufacturing contexts using primary data and structural equation modelling remains limited. This study presents a field-level validation of the JCM using the Job Diagnostic Survey (JDS) administered to 96 employees across four locations of a midsized Indian auto ancillary firm. The study was embedded within an Ideal Organisation exercise-a systematic, participative role rationalisation initiative that reduced 68 defined roles to 52 and facilitated job enrichment and rotation for over 20 employees. Data were analysed using SmartPLS for structural equation modelling and R for preliminary analysis. Results support the JCM's core propositions: job characteristics positively influence critical psychological states (H1), and critical psychological states mediate the relationship between job characteristics and job satisfaction (H2), confirmed at 95% significance. A notable finding is that general satisfaction (GS) is more strongly influenced through the JCM pathway than internal work motivation (IWM), suggesting that intrinsic motivation in manufacturing contexts may be shaped by factors beyond job design alone. The Cronbach's alpha reliability for the dataset was 0.814. Findings contribute to the evidence base for evidence-based HR practice in Indian manufacturing and offer practical guidance for HR professionals undertaking job redesign and role rationalisation initiatives.

AI.tldr: 本研究在印度汽车零部件制造业的实地环境中，运用结构方程模型验证了Hackman和Oldham的工作特征模型（JCM），通过对96名员工的调查和角色合理化干预，证实了工作特征通过关键心理状态影响工作满意度的路径，并发现工作满意度比内在工作动机更易受该路径影响。
AI.research_question: 工作特征模型（JCM）在印度汽车零部件制造业的实地环境中是否成立？具体而言，工作特征是否通过关键心理状态影响工作满意度和内在工作动机？
AI.motivation: 尽管JCM在国际上已被广泛验证，但在印度汽车零部件制造业中，使用一手数据和结构方程模型进行实证应用的研究仍然有限。本研究旨在填补这一空白，为证据导向的HR实践提供支持。
AI.theoretical_framework: Hackman和Oldham（1976, 1980）提出的工作特征模型（JCM），包含五个核心工作维度（技能多样性、任务完整性、任务重要性、自主性、反馈）、三个关键心理状态以及工作满意度和内在工作动机等结果变量。
AI.method: 使用工作诊断调查（JDS）对印度一家中型汽车零部件制造企业四个地点的96名员工进行问卷调查，嵌入在“理想组织”角色合理化干预中（将68个角色减少至52个）。采用SmartPLS进行结构方程模型分析，R进行初步数据分析。
AI.findings: 研究支持JCM的核心命题：工作特征正向影响关键心理状态（H1成立）；关键心理状态在工作特征与工作满意度之间起中介作用（H2成立，95%显著性水平）。值得注意的是，一般满意度比内在工作动机更强烈地受到JCM路径的影响，提示在制造业情境中，内在动机可能受工作设计之外的因素影响。数据集Cronbach's α信度为0.814。
AI.theory_contributions: 本研究提供了JCM在印度汽车零部件制造这一特定行业和情境中的实地验证，拓展了该模型的跨文化适用范围，并揭示了在制造业环境中工作满意度与内在工作动机的不同驱动机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为印度制造业中的证据导向HR实践提供了经验基础，为HR从业者在开展工作再设计和角色合理化项目时提供了实操指导，特别是关于如何通过JCM路径提升员工满意度。

title: From Execution Evidence to Governed Reliance: A Grammar for Relying on What AI Agents Do

detail.title: From Execution Evidence to Governed Reliance: A Grammar for Relying on What AI Agents Do

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is the creator of ProofRail and controls associated project assets. ProofRail is a trademark of Hour of First Light LLC.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable, as this project does not involve any patients or participants.
declarations.funderStatement: No external funding was received.

detail.abstract: Agentic AI is shifting AI governance from model oversight toward action oversight. The central governance problem is no longer only whether a model produced an inaccurate, biased, or unsafe output. It is whether an AI-mediated system was authorized to take a consequential protected action, whether evidence of that action can be independently verified, and whether a party with standing can rely on that evidence for a defined purpose. Existing governance artifacts, including policies, approvals, logs, lineage records, observability data, runtime controls, and audit trails, are necessary but not sufficient. They can show that something happened, or that a system permitted it, without showing that the action carried valid, scoped, current authority or that the resulting evidence can survive dispute outside the system that produced it. ProofRail is proposed as a reference architecture and institutional grammar for this problem. It separates protected-action evidence from verification, verification from governed reliance, and governed reliance from broader institutional legitimacy. The paper introduces the ProofRail ladder: Iron controls, Bronze evidences, Silver verifies, Gold relies, and Platinum federates.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ProofRail参考架构，将AI治理从模型监督转向行动监督，通过分层证据与验证体系解决AI系统授权行动的问责问题。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一个能够对AI代理系统的受保护行动进行权威验证、独立审计和跨机构信任的治理架构？
AI.motivation: 现有AI治理工具（如策略、日志、审计追踪等）虽然必要，但无法证明行动是否拥有有效、有范围、有时效的授权，也无法确保证据在系统外部的争议中存活。
AI.theoretical_framework: 行动治理理论、证据分层验证理论、机构合法性理论；核心框架为ProofRail阶梯：Iron（控制）、Bronze（证据）、Silver（验证）、Gold（依赖）、Platinum（联邦）。
AI.method: 参考架构设计（Reference Architecture）与机构语法（Institutional Grammar）的构建方法。
AI.findings: 提出将受保护行动的证据与验证分离、验证与受治理的依赖分离、受治理的依赖与更广泛的机构合法性分离的三层分离原则。
AI.theory_contributions: 将AI治理从模型输出质量监督拓展到行动权威性与证据可验证性的理论框架，提出分层治理的机构语法。
AI.practical_contributions: 为AI系统在金融、医疗、法律等高合规要求场景中提供可操作的行动问责架构，确保跨组织边界的证据可信与争议解决。

title: When the System Becomes the Stressor: High-Performance Work Practices, Perceived Organisational Support, Workplace Bullying, Burnout, and the Moderating Role of Organisational Culture — A Dual-Pathway Conceptual Model

detail.title: When the System Becomes the Stressor: High-Performance Work Practices, Perceived Organisational Support, Workplace Bullying, Burnout, and the Moderating Role of Organisational Culture — A Dual-Pathway Conceptual Model

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflict of interest with respect to the research, authorship, or dissemination of this working paper.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. It was conducted as part of the author's doctoral programme at the Indian Institute of Management Tiruchirappalli.

detail.abstract: Workplace bullying and employee burnout represent two of the most consequential challenges facing contemporary organisations. While research has examined these phenomena independently, the mechanisms through which the broader HR systems context shapes the bullying-burnout relationship remain underspecified. Prior literature has examined either High-Performance Work Practices (HPWPs) or Perceived Organisational Support (POS) as independent mediators, without integrating both within a unified theoretical framework. This conceptual paper addresses this gap by developing a dual-pathway moderated mediation model proposing that: (1) HPWPs operate as a double-edged mediator between workplace bullying and burnout-capable of either buffering or amplifying the bullying-burnout link depending on implementation context; and (2) POS functions as a parallel buffering mediator that attenuates the negative psychological impact of bullying on burnout through the provision of perceived resources and relational safety. Organisational culture is proposed as a second-stage moderator conditioning the effectiveness of both pathways. The model is grounded in Conservation of Resources Theory (COR), Social Exchange Theory (SET), and the work environment hypothesis. Propositions for empirical testing are developed and implications for HR system design are discussed. The paper contributes by integrating two previously separate mediating mechanisms into a single theoretically coherent model, and by specifying the boundary conditions under which each mechanism is more or less effective.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个双路径有调节的中介模型，整合了高绩效工作实践（HPWPs）和感知组织支持（POS）作为职场欺凌与员工倦怠之间的并行中介机制，并探讨组织文化的调节作用。
AI.research_question: 更广泛的HR系统背景如何塑造职场欺凌与员工倦怠之间的关系？HPWPs和POS如何作为并行中介机制发挥作用？
AI.motivation: 已有研究分别考察了职场欺凌与倦怠、HPWPs或POS的作用，但未将两者整合在一个统一的理论框架内，边界条件也未明确。
AI.theoretical_framework: 资源保存理论（COR）、社会交换理论（SET）和工作环境假说。
AI.method: 概念性论文，提出双路径有调节的中介模型，发展可供实证检验的研究命题。
AI.findings: HPWPs是一把"双刃剑"——根据实施情境既可缓冲也可放大欺凌-倦怠关系；POS充当平行缓冲中介，通过提供资源和关系安全感减轻欺凌的心理影响；组织文化调节两条路径的有效性。
AI.theory_contributions: 将两个先前分离的中介机制整合为一个统一的理论模型，并明确了每种机制有效发挥作用的边界条件。
AI.practical_contributions: 为HR系统设计提供指导，提示管理者在实施高绩效工作实践时需关注其可能放大欺凌负面效应的情境，同时强调了培养支持性组织文化的重要性。

title: Trade Unions as Sustainability Actors in India: An Exploratory Qualitative Study of Union Leaders' Perceptions of the SDG Agenda and the Just Transition

detail.title: Trade Unions as Sustainability Actors in India: An Exploratory Qualitative Study of Union Leaders' Perceptions of the SDG Agenda and the Just Transition
detail.abstract: Trade unions have historically been advocates for worker rights, fair wages, and safe working conditionsobjectives that align substantively with the social pillar of the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). SDG 8 (Decent Work and Economic Growth) in particular reflects the longstanding mandate of the labour movement globally. Yet the extent to which Indian trade union leadership formally engages with the SDG framework, and how unions perceive their role in sustainability transitions including the just transition agenda, remains empirically underexplored. This paper presents findings from an exploratory qualitative study involving in-depth interviews with three prominent Indian trade union leaders representing major Central Trade Union Organisations (CTUOs), conducted as part of doctoral research at IIM Tiruchirappalli. The study examines three domains: union leaders' awareness of the formal SDG framework; their organisations' current sustainability-aligned activities; and their perspectives on collaborative governance for just transition in India. Findings reveal a significant paradox: while union leaders are actively engaged in sustainability-aligned activities-including community development, environmental advocacy, and workforce inclusion-formal awareness of the SDG framework is notably limited among senior union leadership. A key illustrative case is a Community Development Fund established through collective bargaining with Ashok Leyland management in the early 1990s-two decades before the Companies Act's formal CSR provisions-which had funded 96 community development projects and crossed ₹1 crore in value. The paper discusses implications of this awareness gap for the SDG 2030 agenda, calls for structured integration of SDG literacy into union capacity-building, and argues for the formal inclusion of trade unions in India's national SDG governance architecture.

AI.tldr: 本文通过对三位印度主要工会领导人的深度访谈，发现工会领导人虽然实际参与了大量与可持续发展目标（SDG）相契合的活动（如社区发展、环境倡导、劳动力包容），但对SDG框架的正式认知却十分有限。这种"实践先行、认知滞后"的悖论对SDG 2030议程构成挑战，论文建议将SDG素养纳入工会能力建设，并正式将工会纳入印度国家SDG治理架构。
AI.research_question: 印度工会领导人对SDG框架的正式认知程度如何？工会如何看待自身在可持续发展转型（包括公正转型）中的角色？
AI.motivation: 工会历来是工人权益、公平工资和安全工作条件的倡导者，与SDG社会支柱尤其是SDG 8（体面工作与经济增长）高度契合，但印度工会领导人对SDG框架的正式参与程度及其对可持续发展转型的认知在实证层面上尚未充分探索。
AI.theoretical_framework: 可持续发展目标（SDGs）框架、公正转型理论、协作治理理论
AI.method: 探索性定性研究，对三位来自主要中央工会组织（CTUOs）的印度工会领导人进行深度访谈，作为印度蒂鲁吉拉伯利管理学院（IIM Tiruchirappalli）博士研究的一部分。
AI.findings: 发现一个显著悖论：工会领导人积极参与可持续发展相关活动（社区发展、环境倡导、劳动力包容），但对SDG框架的正式认知显著有限。典型案例是20世纪90年代初通过与Ashok Leyland管理层集体谈判建立的社区发展基金（早于《公司法》正式CSR条款20年），资助了96个社区发展项目，价值超过1亿卢比。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了工会实践中"SDG实质性参与"与"SDG框架正式认知"之间的脱节现象，丰富了关于SDG治理中非国家行为体认知与行动差异的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 呼吁将SDG素养系统性地纳入工会能力建设，主张将工会正式纳入印度国家SDG治理架构，强调工会实践（如集体谈判达成的社区发展基金）可为SDG本土化提供重要经验。

title: From Extinction to Mixing: Drift and Mutation in Nested Sampling
affiliations: University of Chicago - Booth School of Business, George Mason University and

detail.title: From Extinction to Mixing: Drift and Mutation in Nested Sampling
detail.abstract: Nested sampling estimates the Bayesian evidence by advancing a finite population of live points through nested likelihood level sets. Buchner (2026) shows that in a multimodal posterior a mode the data has not excluded can be lost by chance, and identifies the mechanism as a neutral Moran process on the live-point occupancy. We place this result inside the common vertical reduction shared by nested sampling, the split sampling of Birge et al. (2013), and the vertical-likelihood Monte Carlo of Polson and Scott (2015): all three estimate the same one-dimensional survival function of the likelihood under the prior, and differ only in how they read it. The occupancy of two matched modes is a bounded martingale, so each mode is eventually lost with probability equal to the competing mode's mass; a heterozygosity calculation shows diversity decays as e-2t/K 2 , and a Wright-Fisher absorption time identifies the binary-entropy factor in the live-point rule K ≳ H/H b (p), with H b the binary entropy and p the minority mass. Our central observation is that the cross-mode proposals used by split sampling and vertical likelihood act as mutation: they turn the pure drift of nested sampling into a Moran process with mutation, whose stationary occupancy is Beta(θ p, θ (1p)) with θ = µK. A Feller boundary classification shows the minority mode is protected from extinction exactly when θ p ≥ 1, a phase transition at the critical rate µ ⋆ = 1/(K p): below it the occupancy corner is accessible and the mode is lost, above it the corner closes and the occupancy concentrates at the truth with variance p(1p)/(1 + θ). The failure therefore moves from a silent 0/1 extinction to a variance w(1w)/S set by the number S of cross-mode transitions, which is both diagnosable and curable by proposal design. We give an algorithm that monitors S and adapts the cross-mode rate, and a two-mode study confirms every formula quantitatively. The difficulty that survives all three methods is intrinsic to the integral: a minority mode of mass p hides in a prior-volume interval of width of order p, so its cost scales as 1/p whatever currency one pays in.

AI.tldr: 嵌套采样、分裂采样与垂直似然蒙特卡洛三种方法本质上都估计同一个似然生存函数，但嵌套采样在多元模态下会因中性漂变丢失未被数据排除的模态。分裂采样和垂直似然的跨模态提议相当于引入突变，将纯漂变转化为带突变的Moran过程，在临界突变率以上可保护少数模态免于灭绝。然而，三种方法都无法回避少数模态质量p所带来的1/p固有成本。
AI.research_question: 在多元模态后验分布中，嵌套采样为何会偶然丢失未被数据排除的模态？如何理解和克服这一失效机制？
AI.motivation: Buchner (2026)发现嵌套采样在多元模态后验中可能因随机性丢失模态，并识别出这是中性Moran过程。本文旨在将该发现置于三种方法的统一框架中，揭示其根本机制，并探索通过跨模态提议（类似突变）来避免模态丢失的可能性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 垂直约化框架（统一嵌套采样、分裂采样、垂直似然蒙特卡洛三种方法）；Moran过程与Wright-Fisher模型（群体遗传学中的随机漂变与突变理论）；Feller边界分类（判断吸收态是否可达）；Beta分布（突变的平稳分布）；异质性衰减与吸收时间分析。
AI.method: 理论推导：将模态占据数建模为有界鞅 → 模态最终丢失概率等于竞争模态质量；异质性衰减速率推导；Wright-Fisher吸收时间给出活点规则K≳H/H_b(p)中的二元熵因子。引入突变后，构建Moran过程（突变率为μ），推导平稳分布为Beta(θp, θ(1-p))，其中θ=μK。利用Feller边界分类证明相变条件θp≥1（临界突变率μ⋆=1/(Kp)）。双模态数值实验验证所有公式。
AI.findings: （1）嵌套采样中两匹配模态的占据数是有界鞅，每个模态最终丢失概率等于对方模态质量；（2）异质性按e^{-2t/K²}衰减；（3）分裂采样和垂直似然的跨模态提议相当于突变，将纯漂变转化为带突变的Moran过程；（4）存在相变：当θp≥1时少数模态被保护免于灭绝，否则必然丢失；（5）失效从0/1静默灭绝转变为方差为w(1-w)/S的可诊断、可矫正的波动；（6）无论哪种方法，少数模态质量p带来的计算成本为1/p，这是积分本身的固有困难。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）统一了嵌套采样、分裂采样和垂直似然蒙特卡洛三种方法的理论框架，证明它们共享同一垂直约化结构；（2）首次将模态丢失完整刻画为群体遗传学中的漂变-突变过程，给出精确的相变条件和平稳分布；（3）揭示了跨模态提议的"突变"本质，从理论上证明了足够强的跨模态提议可以保护少数模态；（4）证明1/p的成本下界是积分固有属性，三种方法都无法避免。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）提出了监控跨模态转换次数S并自适应调整跨模态率的算法；（2）为实践者提供了判断模态是否可能丢失的标准（θp≥1条件）；（3）指出了即使无法完全避免丢失，也可以通过跨模态提议使失效模式从静默灭绝变为可诊断的方差问题，从而可以检测和修正。

title: Ricardo vs Keynes: US Debt and Growth
affiliations: University of Chicago - Booth School of Business

detail.title: Ricardo vs Keynes: US Debt and Growth

keywords: scal theory of the price level

detail.abstract: We take stock of the United States scal position in mid-2026 and, at greater length, of its growth prospects over the next twenty years. Gross federal debt is near $39.4 trillion, the decit runs at about 5.8 percent of GDP at eectively full employment, and mandatory transfers plus interest now dominate outlays. We read the scal stance through two lenses. Ricardo's doctrine of deferred taxation asks whether the debt is merely postponed tax, and why the postponement is dangerous; Keynes asks whether the timing and composition of the decit are defensible. Both converge on the same diagnosis. We then treat growth as the central question, because growth is the denominator of every debt ratio and the g in the arithmetic that decides sustainability. The core nding is uncomfortable: labor-force growth has collapsed toward zero, so future growth must come almost entirely from productivity, and productivity now rests on a single, concentrated wager on articial-intelligence capital. We lay out a growth-accounting framework, the demographic and immigration facts, the productivity record, and three scenarios for 2026 2046, and connect each to the debt path, the equity market, young workers' prospects, and the outlook for ination and interest rates. The analysis is descriptive and is not investment or policy advice; long-horizon projections are conditional and uncertain.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了美国2026年中的财政状况及未来20年（2026-2046）的增长前景。核心结论是：联邦债务接近39.4万亿美元，赤字约占GDP的5.8%；劳动力增长已趋近于零，未来增长几乎完全依赖生产率，而生产率目前高度集中于对人工智能资本的单一下注。
AI.research_question: 美国2026年的财政状况如何？未来20年（2026-2046）的增长前景怎样？
AI.motivation: 由于美国联邦债务逼近39.4万亿美元、赤字占GDP约5.8%、强制性转移支付和利息主导支出，而劳动力增长已趋近于零，未来增长必须依赖生产率，这使得评估财政可持续性及增长前景变得紧迫。
AI.theoretical_framework: 李嘉图的延期征税学说（债务是否只是递延税收及其危险性）；凯恩斯理论（赤字的时机和构成是否可辩护）；增长核算框架（将增长分解为劳动力增长与生产率增长）。
AI.method: 描述性分析，通过李嘉图和凯恩斯两个视角审视财政立场；运用增长核算框架，结合人口统计、移民数据、生产率记录，构建2026-2046年的三种情景分析，并连接债务路径、股票市场、年轻工人前景、通胀和利率展望。
AI.findings: ①李嘉图和凯恩斯两种视角均得出相同诊断——财政状况严峻；②劳动力增长已崩溃至接近零，未来增长几乎完全依赖生产率；③生产率现在高度集中于对人工智能资本的单一下注；④三种情景分析显示不同债务路径及其对权益市场、年轻工人、通胀和利率的影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 将李嘉图延期征税理论与凯恩斯的周期性赤字分析相结合，统一应用于美国当前财政评估，并整合增长核算框架来揭示财政可持续性对生产率（尤其是AI资本）的极端依赖。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和投资者提供了美国财政与增长前景的系统性情景分析，警示劳动力增长趋零背景下AI生产率增长的决定性作用，以及对年轻工人、通胀和利率的潜在影响。

title: Bayes on a Budget Recursive Self-Improvement and Generative Bayesian Computation
affiliations: University of Chicago - Booth School of Business and George Mason University

detail.title: Bayes on a Budget Recursive Self-Improvement and Generative Bayesian Computation
detail.abstract: We read recursive self-improvement (RSI) as budgeted amortized inference and connect it to the fast-Bayes program of generative Bayesian computation (GBC). Fast Bayes replaces per-dataset Markov chain iteration with a generative map, trained once, that returns posterior draws in a single forward pass; its objective is predictive skill per unit compute. The recent AIDE 2 system of Jiang and Wu reports a self-improving research agent that, under a fixed compute budget, discovers a faster agent than two years of hand-tuning produced. We argue that AIDE 2 pursues the fast-Bayes objective by a different mechanism, discrete program search under a held-out gate rather than smooth transport under a likelihood, and that its two emergent behaviors are statistical devices reached by search rather than imposed by theory: shrink-the-winner is the optimizer's-curse correction, that is, global-local shrinkage, and aggressive context compression is minimal sufficiency. We formalize the outer loop as constrained bi-level optimization with compute as the numeraire, and make the economics of the two-model loop the backbone of the analysis: because scoring one outer proposal costs many inner runs, a compute-optimality condition equalizing marginal skill per dollar dictates a capable-outer, cheap-inner allocation, and the budget itself acts as a minimumdescription-length prior over agents. Against that backdrop we quantify the selection bias that reusing a held-out score across outer steps induces, show that classical shrinkage repairs the point estimate, and prove that an e-value gate controls the resulting error under optional continuation. Two algorithms follow, budgeted GBC with a held-out predictive gate and e-value-gated selection, illustrated by simulations in which the curse inflates the naive winner while shrinkage and the e-process recover the truth. The transfer runs both ways: GBC gains held-out gates, explicit inference budgets, and anytime-valid selection, and RSI gains the decision-theoretic tools its outer loop currently lacks.

AI.tldr: 本文将递归自我改进（RSI）重新解释为预算化摊销推断，并将其与快速贝叶斯生成式贝叶斯计算（GBC）框架联系起来。通过分析AIDE 2系统的两种涌现行为——收缩胜者（shrink-the-winner）和激进上下文压缩——分别对应于优化器诅咒矫正和最小充分性统计量。文章形式化了外循环为约束双层优化，以计算为计价单位，推导出计算最优条件，并利用e值门控和收缩技术修正选择偏差。
AI.research_question: 如何从贝叶斯计算预算化摊销推断的视角理解递归自我改进（RSI）系统，并解决其外循环中的统计偏差问题？
AI.motivation: 递归自我改进系统（如AIDE 2）在实践中表现出惊人能力，但其理论基础尚不清晰。作者试图建立RSI与生成式贝叶斯计算（GBC）之间的理论联系，并解决RSI外循环中存在的统计偏差（如选择偏差和优化器诅咒），从而为RSI提供决策理论工具。
AI.theoretical_framework: 预算化摊销推断（Budgeted Amortized Inference）、生成式贝叶斯计算（GBC）、约束双层优化、优化器诅咒（Optimizer's Curse）、全局-局部收缩（Global-Local Shrinkage）、最小充分性（Minimal Sufficiency）、e值门控（e-value gate）、最小描述长度（MDL）先验
AI.method: 理论推导与形式化（将RSI外循环建模为约束双层优化）、统计证明（选择偏差定量、收缩修正、e值门控误差控制）、数值模拟验证
AI.findings: 1. RSI（AIDE 2）中"收缩胜者"行为本质上是优化器诅咒的贝叶斯修正（全局-局部收缩）；2. 激进上下文压缩对应于最小充分性统计量；3. 计算最优性条件要求"能力强外环+成本低内环"的分配；4. 预算本身充当了代理空间的MDL先验；5. e值门控在可选继续抽样下控制错误率。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 建立了RSI与GBC/预算化摊销推断之间的理论联系；2. 为RSI的涌现行为提供了严格的统计解释（优化器诅咒修正、最小充分性）；3. 形式化了计算约束下的双层优化框架；4. 将e值理论引入外循环选择问题；5. 为GBC引入了保留门控、显式推断预算和随时有效选择。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 提出两种实用算法：预算化GBC（带保留预测门控）和e值门控选择；2. 为RSI系统提供了决策理论工具以改进其外循环；3. 通过模拟证明收缩和e过程能恢复真实信号，纠正"天真胜者"的膨胀偏差。

title: Bayes Rule and Bayes Rules for Prediction * Maxitive Predictive Distributions, Profile Likelihood, and the Candidate's Formula
affiliations: University of Chicago - Booth School of Business and

detail.title: Bayes Rule and Bayes Rules for Prediction * Maxitive Predictive Distributions, Profile Likelihood, and the Candidate's Formula
detail.abstract: The possibilistic (maxitive) analogue of Bayes' rule replaces the integral that normalises the prior-likelihood product by a supremum. We show that this one change places much of the classical predictive tradition on a common footing, because a maxitive marginal is a supremum over the parameter-a profile-and profiling is the operation underlying (i) the profile predictive likelihood of Lejeune and Faulkenberry, (ii) Besag's candidate's formula for the predictive density, (iii) fiducial and confidence-distribution prediction after Fisher, Cox and Reid, and (iv) the elimination of a nuisance parameter or hyperparameter. We define the predictive possibility as a maxitive push-forward, prove a predictive chain rule and a pointwise-exact possibilistic candidate's formula, and show that the predictive possibility is the Lejeune-Faulkenberry likelihood normalised by a supremum rather than an integral, so the two induce identical nested prediction regions. In pivotal models the α-cuts reproduce fiducial prediction intervals, giving the maxitive predictive a frequentist calibration and recovering Cox's empirical-Bayes intervals as strength-adjusted cuts; a conformal wrapper supplies distribution-free coverage when no pivot exists. A Gaussian example gives every object in closed form, together with the exact map between the possibility level α and predictive coverage, and applications-predictive possibility bands for regression and conformally calibrated Value-at-Risk under misspecification-show the resulting profile-cut-calibrate pipeline replacing integration by maximisation throughout. A decision-theoretic reading connects the construction to the logarithmic score of DeGroot, Lindley, Bernardo and Akaike: the honest local utility for reporting a predictive is-log in both calculi, aggregated by expectation in probability and by supremum in possibility. Throughout, the learning-rate parameter is exogenous and non-identifiable from the evidence, so calibrating a predictive region is a modelling choice, not a likelihood one.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了可能性（最大性）贝叶斯规则，用上确界代替积分来归一化先验-似然乘积，从而将多个经典预测传统统一在同一框架下，包括剖面预测似然、候选公式、置信分布预测等。该框架通过最大化而非积分来构建预测区间，并通过决策理论连接对数评分，展示了预测区域校准是建模选择而非似然选择。
AI.research_question: 如何用可能性（最大性）框架统一经典预测传统，并建立一套基于最大化而非积分运算的预测方法？
AI.motivation: 经典的预测方法（剖面似然、候选公式、置信分布等）看似分散，但背后可能共享一个共同的数学操作——剖面化（取上确界）。作者试图证明这一操作可以用可能性贝叶斯规则统一表述。
AI.theoretical_framework: 可能性理论（Possibility Theory）、最大化贝叶斯规则（Maxitive Bayes' Rule）、剖面似然、置信分布、共形预测
AI.method: 理论推导：定义预测可能性为最大性前推（maxitive push-forward），证明预测链式法则和逐点精确的可能性候选公式。在枢轴模型中，α-截集重现费雪预测区间；非枢轴情形下使用共形预测包装器获得无分布覆盖保证。高斯例子给出闭式解，回归和VaR应用展示"剖面-截集-校准"流程。
AI.findings: （1）最大性边际化等价于对参数取上确界即剖面化；（2）预测可能性是Lejeune-Faulkenberry似然经上确界而非积分归一化的结果，两者产生相同的嵌套预测区域；（3）在枢轴模型中，α-截集重现费雪预测区间，且经强度调整后恢复Cox经验贝叶斯区间；（4）共形包装器在无枢轴时提供无分布覆盖；（5）决策理论视角：两种演算的对数评分在概率下用期望聚合，在可能性下用上确界聚合；（6）学习率参数是外生的且不可识别，校准是建模选择。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）首次提出系统性的可能性贝叶斯规则，将剖面化操作提升为预测理论的核心运算；（2）统一了剖面似然、候选公式、置信分布等多个看似独立的预测传统；（3）揭示了预测区域校准的建模选择性质，挑战了传统贝叶斯方法中似然主导的观点。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）提供了一套"剖面-截集-校准"的完整预测流程，全程用最大化替代积分，计算上更简便；（2）给出了回归预测可能性带和共形校准的VaR应用；（3）通过高斯例子给出所有对象的闭式解，便于实际应用。

title: Bringing Back Latin Squares Design, Interaction, and the Limits of Additivity
affiliations: University of Chicago - Booth School of Business

detail.title: Bringing Back Latin Squares Design, Interaction, and the Limits of Additivity
detail.abstract: The additive, non-interactional model is the shared foundation, and the shared vulnerability, of experimental design and quantitative social science. The Latin square is its most elegant embodiment: an arrangement of treatments across a two way grid that estimates every treatment contrast, optimally and without bias, precisely by assuming that treatments do not interact with the units they are applied to. This paper takes that assumption as its subject. We give a self contained modern treatment of the combinatorial, algebraic, and statistical theory of Latin squares, with complete proofs, and we show in a controlled experiment that for estimating causal contrasts under a fixed budget the design beats an interpolating neural network by a factor of two to three in mean squared error, because recovering a contrast from a fitted surface requires extrapolation to treatment-cell combinations the design never observed. But the design's guarantees are exactly as strong as its additivity assumption and no stronger. We trace Neyman's 1935 argument that this assumption cannot be innocently tested, since the data must want to be analysed by one's method and one cannot know in advance whether they do, and we show that Neyman's statistical objection is, in another vocabulary, Abbott's sociological objection to "general linear reality": the additive model describes a social world that is largely fictional. Read together, the two critiques reframe the fashionable contest. The question is not design versus machine learning but whether data admit an additive analysis at all, and the constructive answer for high-dimensional social data is neither the lasso nor the interpolating network but the design based, interaction aware programme of Cox and Battey. The Latin square deserves to be brought back, not as a relic to be admired, but as the cleanest instance of an assumption that every quantitative science must learn to interrogate.

AI.tldr: 本文系统审视了拉丁方设计的加性假设基础，通过实验证明其在因果对比估计中优于神经网络，但指出该假设既是其优势也是其脆弱之处，并结合Neyman的统计批判与Abbott的社会学批判，呼吁定量科学必须审视加性假设的适用性。
AI.research_question: 拉丁方设计所依赖的加性（非交互）假设在因果推断中是否成立？其优势与局限分别是什么？
AI.motivation: 加性假设是实验设计和定量社会科学的共同基础，但这一假设可能过于理想化。作者试图揭示：当数据无法满足加性假设时，拉丁方设计的光鲜保证便会失效，而这一问题在当代机器学习热潮中被忽视了。
AI.theoretical_framework: 加性（非交互）模型假设；拉丁方组合与统计理论；Neyman的可检验性批判；Abbott的"一般线性现实"社会学批判；Cox-Battey的基于设计、关注交互的分析框架。
AI.method: 给出了拉丁方的组合、代数和统计理论的完整现代处理（含证明）；在固定预算控制实验中，对比拉丁方设计与插值神经网络在因果对比估计上的均方误差表现。
AI.findings: 拉丁方设计在估计因果对比时，均方误差比插值神经网络低2-3倍，因为从拟合曲面恢复对比需要外推到设计未观测的处理-单元组合。但拉丁方的所有保证完全依赖于加性假设，一旦该假设不成立，优势不复存在。
AI.theory_contributions: 将Neyman的统计批判与Abbott的社会学批判并置，揭示二者本质相同：加性假设描述了一个很大程度上虚构的社会世界。重新定位当代争论：问题不在于"设计vs机器学习"，而在于数据是否允许加性分析。
AI.practical_contributions: 为高维社会数据提出了建设性方案：既非lasso也非插值网络，而是Cox和Battey基于设计、关注交互的分析路径。拉丁方不是供人瞻仰的 relics，而是每个定量科学都必须学会审视假设的"最干净实例"。

title: Prediction-Powered Inference: A Review of Rectifier-Based Methods
affiliations: University of Chicago - Booth School of Business, George Mason University and

detail.title: Prediction-Powered Inference: A Review of Rectifier-Based Methods
detail.abstract: Prediction-powered inference (PPI) performs valid inference when a small gold-standard labeled sample is supplemented by a large pool of machine-learning predictions. Naive substitution of predictions for outcomes changes the estimand and invalidates uncertainty quantification; the shared remedy is rectification, in which the abundant predictions supply a lowvariance plug-in while the scarce labels estimate and correct the resulting distortion. We review PPI as a family of rectified M-estimators organised by the single object every method manipulates: the rectifier, the labeled-data estimate of the surrogate's inferential bias. Four operations on the rectifier organise the field. One may tune it by an optimal, generally matrix-valued gain (PPI++, cross-PPI, and the Bayes-linear form that unifies them); reweight it for informative or active label acquisition (inverse-probability weighting, active and stratified sampling); shrink it with a prior (frequentist-assisted-by-Bayes and Bayesian PPI, through global-local scale mixtures); or replace it by a recalibration model (Efron's bootstrap). We give a self-contained derivation of the tuned estimator's efficient influence function, from which the optimal gain, its equivalence to a Kalman gain, and the semiparametric efficiency bound follow; we prove that the failure of PPI to improve estimation of E{Y } is exactly the corner of optimal tuning; and we show that horseshoe shrinkage of the rectifier is a scale-mixture Kalman update rather than a special case of the linear form. A combined design-weighted, global-local estimator is proposed that is consistent under informative labeling and strictly tighter than inverse-probability-weighted PPI when the surrogate is well calibrated. A five-part simulation study delineates the regime in which each operator dominates, and a decision guide closes the paper.

AI.tldr: 本文系统性地综述了预测驱动推断（PPI）方法族，将其统一为修正后的M估计框架，通过四个操作（增益调优、重加权、收缩、替换）组织文献，并提出了新的理论结果和联合估计量。
AI.research_question: 如何利用大量机器学习预测数据与少量金标准标注数据结合，进行有效的统计推断？
AI.motivation: 直接用预测值替代真实值会改变估计目标并破坏不确定性量化，需要修正偏差。现有方法繁多但缺乏统一的理论框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 修正的M估计（Rectified M-estimation）、有效影响函数（EIF）、卡尔曼增益、半参数效率界、全局-局部尺度混合收缩
AI.method: 提出了修正器（rectifier）作为统一操作对象，定义了四种操作：增益调优（PPI++等）、重加权（逆概率加权等）、收缩（贝叶斯PPI）、替换（bootstrap校准）。进行了五部分模拟研究并提供了决策指南。
AI.findings: 最优增益等价于卡尔曼增益；PPI无法改善均值估计的情形恰好是最优调优的一个边界；马靴收缩是尺度混合卡尔曼更新而非线性形式的特例；提出的联合估计量在信息标注下一致且在校准良好时优于逆概率加权PPI。
AI.theory_contributions: 统一了PPI方法族，给出了调优估计量的有效影响函数推导，建立了最优增益与卡尔曼增益的等价性，阐明了PPI失效边界与最优调优的关系，揭示了马靴收缩的卡尔曼更新本质。
AI.practical_contributions: 为实践者提供了不同操作主导的适用范围决策指南，提出了在信息标注下一致且更紧的联合估计量，有助于在实际应用中选择合适的PPI变体。

title: Making Contribution the Default: Gender, Merit, and Idea Sharing in Groups
affiliations: University of Exeter, Shanghai University of Finance and Economics - School of Economics, Interdisciplinary Center for Economic Science and Monash University

detail.title: Making Contribution the Default: Gender, Merit, and Idea Sharing in Groups
detail.abstract: In many workplaces, qualified women are less willing than their male counterparts to contribute ideas to the group. As a result, women remain under-represented in idea contribution, particularly in male-stereotyped fields. Using an online experiment with tasks that vary in gender stereotype, we test whether an easily implementable default can reduce this gender gap. We consider two types of defaults: (i) random defaults, where an individual is randomly defaulted to the leading position to contribute, from which they can opt out; and (ii) merit-based assignment, where an individual's default position is determined by relative performance on a previous task. We find that both random and merit-based defaults substantially increase people's willingness to contribute ideas. However, While women subjected to defaults are more likely to contribute ideas across all areas, they remain less likely to contribute in male-typed than female-typed environments. Finally, we find both merit-based and random defaults have similar positive impact on group performance. The implication is that organizations using random defaults can avoid the complexity of identifying merit ex ante while still enjoying the benefits of increased participation.

AI.tldr: 本文通过在线实验发现，随机默认和基于能力的默认机制都能显著提高人们贡献想法的意愿，并缩小性别差距，但女性在男性刻板印象领域仍比女性刻板印象领域更不愿贡献想法。
AI.research_question: 在男性刻板印象领域中，合格女性比男性更不愿贡献想法。本文探究是否可以通过易于实施的“默认机制”（随机默认 vs. 基于能力的默认）来缩小这一性别差距。
AI.motivation: 女性在男性刻板印象领域（如金融、科技）中想法贡献不足，导致代表性偏低。现有研究多关注个体层面的性别差异，较少探索组织层面简单可行的干预措施。
AI.theoretical_framework: 默认效应（default effect）、性别刻板印象、自我选择与决策架构理论。
AI.method: 在线实验，任务按性别刻板印象类型（男性化 vs. 女性化）区分，设计两种默认条件：（i）随机默认（随机指定领导贡献者，可退出）；（ii）基于能力的默认（根据先前任务表现确定默认领导贡献者）。
AI.findings: （1）随机默认和基于能力的默认均显著提高了人们贡献想法的意愿；（2）默认机制增加了女性在所有领域的贡献意愿，但女性在男性刻板印象领域中仍比女性刻板印象领域贡献意愿更低；（3）两种默认机制对团队绩效均有相似的正向影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了默认效应在性别平等领域的应用研究；揭示了默认机制虽能缩小性别差距，但无法完全消除环境刻板印象的影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织提供了一种简单易行的干预手段：采用随机默认机制可以避免识别能力的复杂性，同时仍能提高参与度和团队绩效。

title: Pólya Inverse Gamma Posteriors, Fisher's Species Model, and Good's Predictive Rule for the Ewens Sampling Problem
affiliations: University of Chicago - Booth School of Business

detail.title: Pólya Inverse Gamma Posteriors, Fisher's Species Model, and Good's Predictive Rule for the Ewens Sampling Problem
detail.abstract: McCullagh (2016) observes that Fisher et al. (1943) almost discovered the Ewens sampling formula and that Good (1953) and Good and Toulmin (1956) asked the right predictive questions but closed neither. We give an inferential account that connects the two through Pólya inverse gamma (P-IG) augmentation (He et al., 2022). Three points organise the paper. First, the Ewens richness likelihood is a regular one-parameter natural exponential family in log θ with cumulant log{Γ(θ + n)/Γ(θ)} and sufficient statistic K, the number of species; the maximum likelihood equation is pure moment matching, K = E[K | θ], and a Bernstein-von Mises argument shows the Bayes point estimator and interval reproduce the classical ones to O(1/K). In this precise sense the Bayes estimator of θ sheds little light. Second, Fisher's two parameters map exactly onto the two PIG representations: the richness θ needs only the gamma-ratio (Beta) block Γ(θ)/Γ(θ + n), while the shape ν that governs departure from the log-series/Ewens limit is a reciprocal-gamma 1/Γ(ν) problem requiring the full P-IG(0) engine, the same object that drives gamma-shape and negative-binomial inference in He et al. (2022). The gamma subordinator, the prototypical generalized gamma convolution, is the structure common to Fisher's model, the Ewens partition, and PIG. Third, we prove that Good's nonparametric estimator, once given a parametric skeleton, collapses exactly to the Chinese-restaurant rule E[q r | data] = r/(n + θ), so the PIG posterior yields a fully Bayesian Good-Turing smoothing with honest bands. A simulation study reproduces Williams' Macrolepidoptera fit (θ = 40.146) and the temporal-homogeneity check (58 expected new species against 62 observed), validates the P-IG(0) simulator against e-γs /Γ(1+s) to within 0.4%, and shows the Beta-augmentation sampler mixing an order of magnitude better than random-walk Metropolis.

AI.tldr: 本文通过Pólya逆伽马（P-IG）增广框架，将Fisher的物种丰富度模型、Ewens抽样公式与Good-Turing预测联系起来。主要发现包括：Ewens似然是指数族分布，最大似然估计等价于矩匹配；Fisher的两个参数分别映射到P-IG的不同模块；Good的非参数估计量在参数骨架下退化为中国餐馆过程的预测规则。模拟验证了方法的有效性。
AI.research_question: 如何通过Pólya逆伽马（P-IG）增广框架，将Fisher物种模型、Ewens抽样公式与Good-Turing预测统一起来？
AI.motivation: McCullagh（2016）指出Fisher等人几乎发现了Ewens抽样公式，而Good等人提出了正确的预测问题但未能闭合。本文旨在给出一个推断性解释，连接这两条研究线索。
AI.theoretical_framework: Pólya逆伽马（P-IG）增广；指数族分布；Bernstein-von Mises定理；伽马子ordinator（广义伽马卷积）；中国餐馆过程。
AI.method: 理论推导（证明Ewens似然为指数族、参数映射关系、Good估计量的中国餐馆过程解释）；模拟研究（Macrolepidoptera数据复现、时间齐性检验、P-IG模拟器验证、贝塔增广采样器与随机游走Metropolis对比）。
AI.findings: 1. Ewens丰富度似然是logθ的正则单参数指数族，最大似然方程等价于纯矩匹配K=E[K|θ]，贝叶斯估计量与经典估计量相差O(1/K)；2. Fisher的两个参数精确映射到两个P-IG表示：丰富度θ仅需伽马比（贝塔）模块，形状ν需要完整的P-IG(0)引擎；3. Good的非参数估计量在参数骨架下精确退化为中国餐馆规则E[qr|data]=r/(n+θ)，P-IG后验可提供全贝叶斯Good-Turing平滑；4. 模拟复现了Williams的Macrolepidoptera拟合，验证了P-IG(0)模拟器精度（误差<0.4%），贝塔增广采样器混合效率比随机游走Metropolis高一个数量级。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 建立了Ewens似然作为指数族分布的严格形式化证明；2. 揭示了Fisher模型、Ewens划分与P-IG共享伽马子ordinator作为共同结构；3. 将Good的非参数预测与非参数贝叶斯中国餐馆过程统一；4. 证明了贝叶斯估计在丰富度参数上的渐近等价性。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 提供了物种丰富度估计的完整贝叶斯框架（含可信区间）；2. 实现了全贝叶斯Good-Turing平滑，可生成有可靠误差带的预测；3. 开发了高效的贝塔增广采样器，混合效率远优于传统方法；4. 验证了方法的实证表现，复现了经典生态学数据结果。

title: Bayesian Distillation: A RateDistortion Theory of Model Compression and the Inverse of Scaling Laws
affiliations: University of Chicago - Booth School of Business and

detail.title: Bayesian Distillation: A RateDistortion Theory of Model Compression and the Inverse of Scaling Laws
detail.abstract: Knowledge distillation compresses a large teacher model into a small student that retains most of the teacher's predictive quality at a fraction of the cost. Empirically this yields a striking bargain on the order of 95% of the teacher's capability at 10% of its size that is the mirror image of neural scaling laws, in which quality improves only as a slow power law of scale. We give a Bayesian account that explains this asymmetry. We identify the ideal teacher with the posterior predictive distribution and cast distillation as a forward KullbackLeibler (KL) information projection of that predictive onto a low-capacity

AI.tldr: 知识蒸馏能够用小型学生模型压缩大型教师模型，保留约95%的预测能力，而模型大小仅为教师模型的10%。本文通过贝叶斯视角解释了这种不对称性，将理想教师视为后验预测分布，并将蒸馏视为向前KL信息投影到低容量模型的过程。
AI.research_question: 为什么知识蒸馏能够以极小的模型尺寸保留大部分教师模型的预测能力？这种不对称性背后的理论机理是什么？
AI.motivation: 经验观察到知识蒸馏存在一种与神经标度律镜像对称的"讨价还价"现象——95%的性能来自10%的规模，但缺乏理论解释。
AI.theoretical_framework: 贝叶斯推断框架，将教师模型视为后验预测分布，蒸馏过程建模为向前KL散度（信息投影）操作。
AI.method: 贝叶斯理论分析，通过数学推导解释知识蒸馏中的性能-规模不对称性。
AI.findings: 知识蒸馏中的不对称性可以从贝叶斯视角得到理论解释：将教师视为后验预测分布，蒸馏是向前KL信息投影到低容量模型的过程。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了知识蒸馏不对称性的贝叶斯理论解释，连接了蒸馏与信息论、贝叶斯推断等理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为知识蒸馏的有效性提供了理论基础，有助于指导更高效模型压缩策略的设计。

title: Bayesian Fairness
affiliations: University of Chicago - Booth School of Business, George Mason University and

detail.title: Bayesian Fairness
detail.abstract: We develop a Bayesian model for algorithmic fairness in which the horseshoe prior of Carvalho et al. (2010) is placed exclusively on the coefficients of protected attributes. A scalar hyperparameter τ 0-the fairness dial-continuously interpolates between exact demographic parity (τ 0 → 0) and the unconstrained model, tracing a Paretooptimal fairness-accuracy frontier whose existence and monotonicity we prove. We establish four theoretical results: (i) the horseshoe induces a bimodal prior on the shrinkage factor κ k with mass at the two extremes {0, 1} and the marginal prior on |γ k | has a log-pole at zero with Cauchy tails; (ii) the posterior achieves the minimax s log n/n rate adaptively; (iii) discrimination certificates DC k (ε) = P(|γ k | > ε | data) are consistent, converging in probability to the indicator of practically significant discrimination; (iv) all four principal fairness criteria arise as limiting cases of the posterior. Chouldechova's impossibility theorem is derived as a corollary of the prior structure. Two worked examples-a bail-decision paradox and a credit-scoring case-make the theory concrete. A Lindley decision-theoretic framework grounds the model in the utility function. Simulation and COMPAS application validate the approach.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个基于贝叶斯方法的算法公平性模型，使用马蹄形先验（horseshoe prior）仅作用于受保护属性的系数，通过一个超参数τ₀（公平性旋钮）在完全人口均等与无约束模型之间连续插值，并证明其帕累托最优的公平-准确率前沿的存在性与单调性。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个既能实现算法公平性要求又能保持预测准确性的贝叶斯统计模型？
AI.motivation: 现有公平性方法往往将公平与准确视为对立面，缺乏一个连续的、理论上严谨的框架来权衡二者，也缺少对歧视系数的概率推断工具。
AI.theoretical_framework: 贝叶斯统计；马蹄形先验（horseshoe prior）；人口均等（demographic parity）；Chouldechova不可能定理；Lindley决策理论
AI.method: 将马蹄形先验仅施加于受保护属性系数，通过超参数τ₀控制收缩程度；在理论上证明帕累托最优前沿、后验收缩率、歧视证书一致性等性质。
AI.findings: (i) 马蹄形先验在收缩因子κₖ上产生双峰先验，质量集中在0和1两端；(ii) 后验自适应达到minimax s log n/n速率；(iii) 歧视证书DCₖ(ε)一致收敛于实际显著性歧视的指示函数；(iv) 四种主要公平准则均为后验的极限情形，Chouldechova不可能定理是先验结构的推论。
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了公平-准确率帕累托前沿存在性与单调性的理论证明；统一了四种主要公平准则作为后验极限；将不可能定理推导为先验结构的自然推论。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了可调节的"公平性旋钮"τ₀供实践者权衡公平与准确；提出了歧视证书（DC）作为歧视程度的概率化可解释指标；通过保释决策和信用评分两个实例以及COMPAS数据集验证了方法的有效性。

title: Anticipation and Risk-taking: Disentangling the Effects of Delayed Information and Payment
affiliations: University of Exeter, University of Exeter Business School - Department of Economics and University of Exeter Business School - Department of Economics

detail.title: Anticipation and Risk-taking: Disentangling the Effects of Delayed Information and Payment
detail.abstract: This study examines the impact of delayed payments and delayed outcome information on individuals' risk-taking behavior. Using an online experiment with investment decisions, we isolate the effects of delayed monetary rewards and delayed risk resolution. Our findings indicate that delaying information about outcomes significantly increases risk-taking, while delaying payments alone has no statistically significant effect. This behavior is particularly pronounced in high-risk, high-reward scenarios, suggesting that anticipation plays a crucial role in decision-making under uncertainty. Our results challenge standard economic models of expected utility and discounting, highlighting the need for incorporating anticipation-based preferences into risk models. These insights have implications for financial decision-making, policy design, and gambling regulation.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过在线实验发现，延迟结果信息会显著增加个体的风险承担行为，而延迟支付本身无显著影响，且该效应在高风险高回报情境中更为突出，表明预期在不确定性决策中起关键作用。
AI.research_question: 延迟支付和延迟结果信息如何分别影响个体的风险承担行为？
AI.motivation: 传统期望效用和贴现模型未能充分考虑延迟对风险决策的影响，尤其是预期（anticipation）这一心理机制的作用尚未被系统检验。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于行为经济学中的预期效用理论、时间贴现理论以及风险决策的心理学机制。
AI.method: 在线实验，通过投资决策任务分离延迟支付与延迟结果信息两种效应。
AI.findings: 延迟结果信息显著增加风险承担；延迟支付无显著统计效应；该效应在高风险高回报情境下尤为明显。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了传统期望效用和贴现模型，提出需要将基于预期的偏好纳入风险决策模型。
AI.practical_contributions: 对金融决策、政策设计（如延迟披露信息的影响）以及赌博监管具有实践启示。

title: Thorin Measures and the Roots of Trigonometric Integrals
affiliations: University of Chicago - Booth School of Business

detail.title: Thorin Measures and the Roots of Trigonometric Integrals
detail.abstract: De Bruijn's 1950 theorem gives a sufficient condition for the Fourier transform of a weight to have only real zeros. We show the condition is exactly the requirement that  be the characteristic function of a symmetric Thorin law, a Gaussian convolved with a bilateral generalized gamma convolution, so that the theorem transports positivity of a Thorin measure across the Fourier transform. Applied to the Riemann kernel, the criterion holds up, the first purely imaginary zeroes and then fails  where Φ vanishes and f ′ acquires a pole, well inside the strip of analyticity. The failure is a pole at a computable point, not an unverified hypothesis. Three consequences follow. Thorin multiplicity m, that is bilateral gamma shape m, is realised by a sinh m family whose exponent is a hyperbolic cosine integral, giving for m = 2 the kernel . Every real rooted surrogate for Ξ in the literature shares one weight side Thorin measure, since that measure does not depend on the rate of a cosh weight. And the rate is what places the non-real zeros: a superposition of cosh weights with rates A n carries a Dirichlet polynomial, which predicts the O(T) exceptional zeros of Hejhal's kernels and which, for the Riemann kernel, is ζ itself. The mechanism hands the problem.

AI.tldr: 本文证明De Bruijn定理的条件等价于对称Thorin分布的特征函数，并将该定理应用于Riemann核函数，揭示了其非实零点的产生机制。
AI.research_question: De Bruijn关于傅里叶变换仅有实零点的充分条件是否也是必要条件？该条件在Riemann核函数上的表现如何？
AI.motivation: 理解De Bruijn定理条件的本质，并将其应用于Riemann ζ函数相关核函数，探索非实零点的来源。
AI.theoretical_framework: De Bruijn定理、Thorin分布（广义伽马卷积）、对称Thorin律、Riemann核函数、Dirichlet多项式
AI.method: 理论分析，将De Bruijn条件重新解释为对称Thorin测度的傅里叶变换，分析Riemann核函数在该框架下的零点行为。
AI.findings: 1) De Bruijn条件等价于权重为对称Thorin分布的特征函数；2) Riemann核函数在第一个纯虚零点处满足条件，之后因Φ消失且f'出现极点而失效；3) Thorin重数m通过sinh m族实现，m=2时得到核函数；4) 所有实根替代核函数共享同一侧Thorin测度；5) 衰减率决定非实零点的位置，cosh权重的叠加携带Dirichlet多项式，预测Hejhal核的O(T)例外零点。
AI.theory_contributions: 将De Bruijn定理与Thorin分布理论统一，阐明了傅里叶变换实根条件与概率分布特征函数之间的深层联系，为Riemann ζ函数的零点研究提供了新的分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为研究Riemann假设及相关核函数的零点分布提供了新的理论工具和机制解释，揭示了非实零点的起源与衰减率的关系。

title: Location Mixtures of Γ(2), Generalized Gamma Convolutions, and the Riemann ξ-Function
affiliations: University of Chicago - Booth School of Business

detail.title: Location Mixtures of Γ(2), Generalized Gamma Convolutions, and the Riemann ξ-Function
detail.abstract: This paper first surveys the theory of Γ(2) mixtures and generalized gamma convolutions (GGC): the Steutel-Kristiansen threshold at shape 2, the Behme-Bondesson product theorems that upgrade infinite divisibility to GGC, and the Bosch-Simon example library. It then applies that theory to the location-mixture representation of the Riemann ξ-function. Three points are isolated. First, the ξ object is a location, not scale, mixture of Γ(2), so the hyperbolic-monotonicity route to GGC is unavailable and the entire content is the positivity of a Thorin measure. Second, a domination criterion (via quasi-infinite divisibility) says exactly when a location mixture of Γ(2) has a Lévy representation. Third, in the incomplete-gamma form at the centre the Lévy-to-Thorin transfer produces a unit-mass quasi-Thorin measure whose atoms are real iff the zeros lie on the line; the transfer relocates the GGC question to RH without resolving it. Nothing here proves RH; the aim is to state precisely what is unconditional and what is equivalent to it.

AI.tldr: 本文系统梳理了Γ(2)混合与广义伽马卷积（GGC）理论，并将其应用于黎曼ξ函数的位置混合表示，严格区分了无条件结论与等价于黎曼假设（RH）的条件。
AI.research_question: Γ(2)混合与GGC理论如何应用于黎曼ξ函数的位置混合表示？哪些结论是无条件的，哪些等价于黎曼假设？
AI.motivation: 已有的Γ(2)混合与GGC理论（Steutel-Kristiansen阈值、Behme-Bondesson乘积定理、Bosch-Simon示例库）尚需系统梳理，并将其应用于ξ函数的表示，以精确界定黎曼假设的概率论等价条件。
AI.theoretical_framework: Γ(2)混合与广义伽马卷积（GGC）理论；位置混合（location mixture）vs. 尺度混合（scale mixture）；超双调性（hyperbolic-monotonicity）；Thorin测度；拟无限可分性（quasi-infinite divisibility）；Lévy表示；不完全伽马函数形式。
AI.method: 理论综述与数学推导：梳理Γ(2)混合与GGC的核心定理，将其应用于ξ函数的位置混合表示，通过Lévy-to-Thorin变换分析Thorin测度的正性与实性条件。
AI.findings: （1）ξ对象是位置混合而非尺度混合，故无法通过超双调性路径获得GGC性质；（2）通过拟无限可分性准则，可确切判定位置混合何时具有Lévy表示；（3）Lévy-to-Thorin变换产生一个单位质量的拟Thorin测度，其原子为实数当且仅当零点位于临界线上。
AI.theory_contributions: 将概率论中的Γ(2)混合与GGC理论系统化，并首次精确刻画了ξ函数的概率结构：GGC问题被转移至黎曼假设，但不解决它。
AI.practical_contributions: 为黎曼假设提供了新的等价条件（Thorin测度原子为实数），并明确区分了无条件成立的数学事实与依赖于RH的命题。

title: A Positive Representation and Wald Couple for ξ(1/2+s) on the Critical Strip
affiliations: University of Chicago - Booth School of Business

detail.title: A Positive Representation and Wald Couple for ξ(1/2+s) on the Critical Strip
detail.abstract: Riemann's ξ function admits an unconditional representation as the moment generating function of a symmetric probability law whose density is the strictly positive Pólya kernel. The representation holds on the whole plane, in particular on the strip 0 < Re s < 1, and involves no signed measure. It exhibits a Wald couple, equivalently a van Dantzig pair, whose primal member is bona fide. The Riemann Hypothesis is isolated cleanly as the single remaining statement that the reciprocal transform is the Laplace transform of a nonnegative generalized gamma convolution, the dual member of the couple. The positive kernel is shown, in full detail, to be a scale mixture of Gamma(2) densities, the elementary generalized gamma convolution. The analytic backbone is the incomplete gamma series for ξ, which exhibits the continuation and the functional equation directly.

AI.tldr: 本文证明了Riemann ξ函数可表示为严格正Pólya核对称概率律的矩生成函数，该表示在全平面（包括临界带）成立且不涉及符号测度。Riemann假设被等价地转化为：该表示的倒数变换是某个非负广义Gamma卷积的Laplace变换。论文详细证明了正核是Gamma(2)密度的尺度混合，并用不完全Gamma级数展示了ξ函数的解析延拓和函数方程。
AI.research_question: Riemann ξ函数的概率表示与Riemann假设的概率论等价刻画。
AI.motivation: 为Riemann假设提供一个新的概率论视角，将其转化为一个关于非负广义Gamma卷积的清晰命题，从而可能开辟新的证明途径。
AI.theoretical_framework: Pólya核理论、Wald对偶/van Dantzig对偶、广义Gamma卷积、矩生成函数、不完全Gamma级数。
AI.method: 解析概率论方法：通过构造对称概率律及其Pólya正核表示，建立ξ函数与概率分布的对应关系；利用尺度混合和广义Gamma卷积分析核的结构；使用不完全Gamma级数展开进行解析延拓。
AI.findings: 1. ξ函数可表示为严格正Pólya核对称概率律的矩生成函数，该表示在全平面有效且无符号测度。2. 该表示构成一个Wald对偶（van Dantzig对偶），其原始成员是"真正的"（bona fide）。3. Riemann假设等价于：倒数变换是某个非负广义Gamma卷积的Laplace变换。4. 正Pólya核是Gamma(2)密度的尺度混合。5. 不完全Gamma级数为ξ函数提供了直接的解析延拓和函数方程证明。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 为Riemann ξ函数建立了全新的纯概率表示，将解析数论问题转化为概率论问题。2. 将Riemann假设还原为一个关于广义Gamma卷积非负性的单一陈述，简化了假设的等价形式。3. 建立了广义Gamma卷积与ξ函数之间的深层联系，可能为理解ζ函数的零点分布提供新工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为Riemann假设的数值验证提供了新的概率框架。2. 不完全Gamma级数的显式构造可用于ξ函数的实际计算和近似。

title: Threshold Scale Estimation: A Duality between Half-Normal Plots and First-Passage Times
affiliations: University of Chicago - Booth School of Business and

detail.title: Threshold Scale Estimation: A Duality between Half-Normal Plots and First-Passage Times
detail.abstract: Daniel's half-normal plot for unreplicated factorial experiments and the truncated realized variance of high-frequency financial econometrics are shown to be the same estimator: both retain the observations lying inside a threshold and discard the excursions. We study the estimator obtained by keeping the other side of the cut, which records the times at which the threshold is crossed and discards the interior. The three form a family, of which the first two lie on one side of the threshold and the third on the other. All inherit a bounded influence function from the thresholding rule alone, and we show that the sensitivity of the first-passage estimator to a single contaminating jump is bounded uniformly in the size of that jump. They differ in the identity used to invert the threshold. The two truncation estimators invert a truncated moment, which is a functional of the error law over the retained region; the first-passage estimator inverts Wald's identity, which holds for any continuous local martingale with the stated quadratic variation. We apply all three to Daniel's drill-advance experiment, recorded on a scale for which the errors are skewed and nearly Gaussian after taking logarithms, so that a single dataset supplies both the case covered by the truncated-moment inversion and the case not covered by it. On the recorded scale the two truncation estimators overstate the error standard deviation by eightyseven and seventy-four per cent, and the first-passage estimator by twenty-eight per cent. In a simulation calibrated to this design and driven by the experiment's own empirical error law, the two truncation estimators are displaced together to means near twice the truth, which causes active effects to be declared inert, while the first-passage estimator remains close to the truth and its dispersion falls.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了Daniel半正态图（用于未重复析因实验）与高频金融计量中的截断已实现方差实际上是同一估计量，并系统研究了由阈值另一侧（记录穿越时间）构成的首达估计量，三者构成一个估计量家族。研究发现，所有估计量均因阈值规则而具有有界影响函数，但首达估计量对单一污染跳跃的敏感性有界。在丹尼尔钻探实验中，截断估计量高估误差标准差87%和74%，而首达估计量仅高估28%。模拟表明截断估计量均值偏移至真值两倍附近导致活性效应被误判为惰性，而首达估计量保持接近真值且离散度下降。
AI.research_question: 未重复析因实验中Daniel半正态图与高频金融计量中截断已实现方差是否为同一估计量？由阈值另一侧构成的首达估计量性质如何？三者构成的估计量家族在敏感性和实证表现上有何差异？
AI.motivation: Daniel半正态图（源自农业实验设计）和截断已实现方差（源自金融高频计量）分属不同学科，但二者数学结构相同。本文试图揭示这一联系，并系统研究由阈值另一侧构成的首达估计量，构建完整的估计量家族理论。
AI.theoretical_framework: 阈值截断理论、有界影响函数、Wald恒等式、截断矩反演、首达时间理论
AI.method: 理论推导与数值模拟相结合：证明三个估计量的数学等价性与差异；在丹尼尔钻探实验数据上实证比较；基于实验经验误差律的蒙特卡洛模拟
AI.findings: (1) Daniel半正态图与截断已实现方差是同一估计量；(2)三者均因阈值规则具有有界影响函数，首达估计量对污染跳跃的敏感性一致有界；(3)差异在于反演方式：截断估计量使用截断矩反演（依赖于保留区域的误差律函数），首达估计量使用Wald恒等式（适用于任意连续局部鞅）；(4)实证中截断估计量高估误差标准差87%和74%，首达估计量仅高估28%；(5)模拟中截断估计量均值偏移至真值两倍，导致活性效应被误判为惰性
AI.theory_contributions: (1) 首次揭示Daniel半正态图与截断已实现方差两个不同学科方法的数学等价性；(2) 构建包含截断估计量和首达估计量的三成员估计量家族理论框架；(3) 证明首达估计量的有界影响函数性质优于截断估计量；(4) 阐明截断矩反演与Wald恒等式反演的根本差异及其适用条件
AI.practical_contributions: (1) 为未重复析因实验提供了更优的误差标准差估计方法——首达估计量，其偏差和敏感性均优于传统半正态图方法；(2) 警示研究者：在非正态误差（如对数正态）下，传统截断类估计量可能严重高估误差标准差（达74%-87%），导致活性效应被遗漏；(3) 证明首达估计量在非正态条件下仍保持稳健，适合实际应用
