detail.abstract: Internationally comparable commercial-structure depreciation estimates are scarce because prices bundle land and structure. Using MSCI Real Capital Analytics data524,600 screened transactions across 1,627 countrycitysector pairsour primary, robustly identied result is a world-scale distribution of bundled survivor age gradients of about 1%/yr, net of cohort and location. To translate this into a structure value rate we divide each pair's gradient by its replacement-cost-to-property-value ratio ρ RC (a ratio, not a share; Turner & Townsend/Arcadis-anchored, pooled per pair), obtaining about 1.3%/yr (conditional sampling CI 1.11.6; full-pipeline simulation interval 0.42.3), within the 1.42%/yr U.S. literature. This is a replacement-cost-scaled proxy under a maintained bridge, not a bound: it scales with the age-curvature (0.52.0%/yr) and the cost anchor (±30% → 1.01.9%/yr), a calibration range we report in full. Cohort eects trim the gradient by only ∼ 9%; we present the rates as land-rich-market benchmarks, not national averages.

AI.tldr: 本文利用全球52.46万笔交易数据，估算出国际可比的结构折旧率约为1.3%/年，并详细报告了校准范围。
AI.research_question: 如何利用捆绑土地和结构的交易价格数据，估算国际可比且独立于土地价值的商业建筑结构折旧率。
AI.motivation: 国际市场缺乏可比的结构折旧估计，因为房价通常捆绑土地和结构，难以分离。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于幸存者年龄梯度（survivor age gradients）与重置成本-物业价值比（ρ RC）的桥接框架，将捆绑价格中的结构折旧信号提取出来。
AI.method: 使用MSCI Real Capital Analytics的524,600笔交易数据，覆盖1,627个城市-行业-国家配对；通过幸存者年龄梯度回归（净除队列效应和区位效应），结合Turner & Townsend/Arcadis重置成本数据进行转换。
AI.findings: 全球捆绑幸存者年龄梯度约1%/年；转换为结构价值折旧率约1.3%/年（条件抽样CI: 1.1-1.6；全管道模拟区间: 0.4-2.3）；年龄曲率敏感性范围0.5-2.0%/年，成本锚定敏感性范围1.0-1.9%/年；队列效应仅削减梯度约9%。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一种利用全球交易数据估算国际可比结构折旧率的新方法论框架，并提供了完整的校准范围而非单个点估计。
AI.practical_contributions: 为国际市场提供了土地富裕型市场的结构折旧率基准（约1.3%/年），可作为国家平均水平的参考下限。

title: Reciprocal Deposit Networks and Funding Stability
affiliations: Federal Reserve Bank of Boston and Quantitative Supervision and Research - Federal Reserve Bank of Richmond

detail.title: Reciprocal Deposit Networks and Funding Stability
detail.abstract: We study banks' participation in reciprocal deposit networks and their financial stability implications. Our results show banks increasingly participate in these networks, with reciprocal deposit growth positively correlated with lagged uninsured deposits. Using daily Fedwire data, we provide first evidence that reciprocal deposits improve overall-not just deposit-funding stability during the 2023 Silicon Valley Bank (SVB) crisis. Using unique multi-network membership data, we identify key drivers of network participation. Our novel data and findings advance understanding of how banks use network-based arrangements to manage funding risk, with implications for both deposit insurance policy and network design.

AI.tldr: 本文研究银行参与互惠存款网络及其对金融稳定性的影响，发现2023年硅谷银行危机期间互惠存款提升了存款稳定性。
AI.research_question: 互惠存款网络如何影响银行的金融稳定性？
AI.motivation: 银行越来越多地参与互惠存款网络，但其稳定性影响尚不明确，尤其是危机期间的表现。
AI.theoretical_framework: 互惠存款网络、存款稳定性、银行间风险传递
AI.method: 使用每日Fedwire数据及多网络成员数据，进行实证回归分析。
AI.findings: 互惠存款增长与滞后无保险存款正相关；2023年SVB危机期间互惠存款改善了整体存款稳定性。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次提供互惠存款提升危机期间存款稳定性的证据，推进了对银行利用网络安排管理融资风险的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 对存款保险政策制定和互惠存款网络设计具有参考价值。

title: When to Spray: A Rainfall-lagged Optimal Control Model for Desert Locust Intervention Timing in Pakistan

detail.title: When to Spray: A Rainfall-lagged Optimal Control Model for Desert Locust Intervention Timing in Pakistan

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare no conflict of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: N/A
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not use any funding.

detail.abstract: Desert locust upsurges represent one of the most acute threats to food security in Pakistan, as demonstrated by the 2019-2021 outbreak during which 93 districts were simultaneously infested, and a national emergency was declared. This study develops a three-compartment discrete-time model of solitarious adults S(t), gregarious adults G(t), and crop biomass C(t), incorporating a rainfall-lagged phase transition function φ(S, G, R) = φ₀•(S+G)/K•(1 + γ•R(t-τ)) that links premonsoon Balochistan rainfall to gregarisation with a two-month lag. The optimal pesticide spray schedule u*(t) is derived using Pontryagin's Maximum Principle and solved numerically via a forward-backward sweep algorithm. The model suggests that optimal reallocation of the same amount of control effort in the pre-gregarisation window defined by φ(S,G,R) would have reduced total outbreak cost by an estimated 17.6% (best heuristic schedule) to 30.1% (Pontryagin optimum) provided spray capacity was available during 2019-2021. The findings of the model carry several policy implications suggesting that optimal intervention timing determines the phase transition of locusts from solitarious insects to gregarious adults.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个包含散居成虫、群居成虫和作物生物量的三室离散时间模型，利用庞特里亚金最大值原理推导最优农药喷洒策略，发现将防控努力重新分配至降雨滞后定义的预群居化窗口期，可在同等资源下降低17.6%-30.1%的总暴发成本。
AI.research_question: 如何通过优化农药喷洒时机，在同等防控资源下降低沙漠蝗虫暴发对巴基斯坦粮食安全造成的经济损失？
AI.motivation: 2019-2021年巴基斯坦93个地区同时遭受沙漠蝗虫侵袭，国家宣布紧急状态，亟需更高效的防控策略以缓解蝗灾对粮食安全的威胁。
AI.theoretical_framework: 三室离散时间种群动态模型（散居成虫S、群居成虫G、作物生物量C）；降雨滞后的相变函数φ(S,G,R)；庞特里亚金最大值原理。
AI.method: 构建离散时间微分方程模型；通过降雨滞后函数（俾路支省季风前降雨，两个月滞后）刻画群居化过程；使用庞特里亚金最大值原理推导最优喷洒计划u*(t)；采用前向后向扫描算法进行数值求解。
AI.findings: 将相同防控努力重新分配至φ函数定义的预群居化窗口期，相较于最佳启发式调度可降低17.6%的总暴发成本，相较于庞特里亚金最优解可降低30.1%，前提是2019-2021年期间具备喷洒能力。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将降雨滞后效应与相变函数纳入蝗虫种群动态最优控制模型；证明了干预时机是决定蝗虫从散居向群居相变的关键变量。
AI.practical_contributions: 为巴基斯坦等蝗灾频发国家提供了基于模型的政策建议：在降雨后预群居化窗口期集中喷洒农药，可在不增加总预算的情况下显著降低灾害损失。

title: Low-latency Execution Infrastructure for Funding-Rate Arbitrage: Architecture and a Reproducible Single-host Benchmark

detail.title: Low-latency Execution Infrastructure for Funding-Rate Arbitrage: Architecture and a Reproducible Single-host Benchmark

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author maintains godzilla.dev, the open-source framework described in this paper, and is associated with the Godzilla Foundation, which offers enterprise deployment services for the framework.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract:
Funding-rate arbitrage combines a perpetual-futures position with an offsetting spot or derivatives position to receive funding while limiting directional exposure. Although the economic signal is relatively transparent, implementation remains sensitive to stale market data, delayed order submission, incomplete hedges, and venue-specific failures. This paper presents godzilla.dev, an open-source, self-hosted C++/Python execution framework for funding-rate arbitrage, market making, and other latency-sensitive cryptocurrency strategies. The framework separates market-data, strategy, and trade-execution responsibilities into independently managed processes connected through a journal-based shared-memory event path. We describe the process model, persistent event records, the native C++ and Python strategy boundary, and the operational rationale for process isolation and replayable state. 
     We evaluate a narrowly defined local software path using native mock market-data and trade components on a single host. The benchmark measures the interval from generation of a synthetic top-of-book journal frame to generation of a corresponding local order-report frame. It excludes network transport, exchange protocol handling, matching-engine processing, fills, queue position, and strategy profitability. On an Intel Core i7-1360P host, five runs retained 900 post-warm-up order cycles each. Run-level median latency ranged from 121.1 to 135.4 microseconds, while run-level p99 latency ranged from 434.8 to 662.0 microseconds. These measurements characterize only the specified single-host, low-utilization configuration and do not establish a production latency bound or a comparison with another trading framework. The benchmark scripts, journal-derived event records, analysis code, and per-run summaries are published with the source repository.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了godzilla.dev，一个开源的、自托管的C++/Python执行框架，专为资金费率套利、做市及其他对延迟敏感的加密货币策略设计。该框架通过基于日志的共享内存事件路径，将市场数据、策略和交易执行职责分离到独立管理的进程中。作者在单主机本地软件路径上进行基准测试，测得中位数延迟在121.1至135.4微秒之间，p99延迟在434.8至662.0微秒之间。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一个开源、低延迟的执行框架，以支持加密货币市场中的资金费率套利、做市等延迟敏感型交易策略？
AI.motivation: 资金费率套利虽经济信号透明，但实际执行中受制于陈旧市场数据、延迟订单提交、不完全对冲以及交易所特定故障等问题。现有框架缺乏针对此类策略的、开源且低延迟的解决方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 进程隔离与可重放状态架构、基于日志的共享内存事件路径、市场数据/策略/交易执行职责分离的设计模式。
AI.method: 提出godzilla.dev框架设计（C++/Python混合架构，进程隔离，日志型共享内存事件路径）；通过单主机本地软件路径基准测试，测量从合成top-of-book日志帧生成到本地订单报告帧生成的时间间隔，排除网络传输、交易所协议处理等外部因素。
AI.findings: 在Intel Core i7-1360P主机上，5轮测试每轮保留900个热身后的订单周期；运行级中位数延迟范围为121.1至135.4微秒，p99延迟范围为434.8至662.0微秒。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一种基于进程隔离和日志型共享内存的低延迟执行架构，为加密货币交易框架的设计提供了理论层面的系统化方案。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 提供了一个开源的、自托管的C++/Python交易框架，可直接用于资金费率套利和做市策略。2. 提供了可复现的基准测试脚本、日志事件记录和分析代码，便于社区验证和改进。3. 明确了延迟测量的边界条件（仅限单主机低负载配置），为实际部署提供了性能参考。

title: AI-driven Forecasting and Execution in Soccer Prediction Markets: A Production System with a Decision Ledger, Model-aware Cash-out, and Event-gated In-play Entry

detail.title: AI-driven Forecasting and Execution in Soccer Prediction Markets: A Production System with a Decision Ledger, Model-aware Cash-out, and Event-gated In-play Entry

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing interests.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable; this study uses market/trading and sports event data and does not involve human subjects or patients.
declarations.funderStatement: No external funding was received for this research.

detail.abstract: We present the statistical methodology of a production forecasting-and-trading system for 2026 World-Cup prediction markets, and argue that its central scientific object is the decision ledger: the measure-theoretic discipline that makes every recorded bet a function of pre-kickoff information only. A Dixon-Coles kernel, fed by anchored and point-in-time (PIT) validated rating blends, feeds probability calibration on the simplex refit on an expanding window; we prove that the common practice of reapplying the current calibration to past decisions renders the recorded decision process non-adapted, measure the drift on our own data, and repair it with an append-only frozen ledger. A decision layer de-vigs venue quotes, prices known frictions (longshot, draw) into PIT-swept thresholds, and sizes by fractional Kelly under a bounded confidence blend. A conditional in-play model drives both a first-crossing cash-out rule (sell when the market overshoots model fair value by a validated margin) and an event-gated in-play entry: we prove pre-event "edges" merely re-observe the pre-match disagreement-removing the gate cuts the hit rate from 65.5% to 52.1% and profit 3.6fold. Validation on a sub-100-match sample uses a 6,912-point grid scored by calibrated Brier, bootstrap-rank robust selection, walk-forward gates, and published negative results. Across 100 settled matches-a record accrued in production one settlement at a time as the tournament progressed, never restated after the fact-the frozen ledger records a PIT-calibrated Brier of 0.540 (uniform 2/3); P&L decomposes into a pre-match stream (hold-to-settlement +15¢, lifted to +1,597¢ by the cash-out) and an in-play stream (+2,872¢ at 65%), for +4,469¢ combined-while closing-line value is slightly negative, locating the realised edge in in-play timing rather than pre-match price selection. All figures are generated from the production database and shipped code, and the platform's twenty audited views are public at https://someopark.web.app; the companion papers develop the microstructure theory [34] and the agentic-simulation subsystems [33, 35].

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个为2026年世界杯预测市场设计的生产级预测-交易系统，其核心是"决策账本"——一种测度论纪律，确保每个记录赌注仅依赖开球前信息。系统在100场世界杯比赛中实现+4,469¢利润，并证明常见的"重新校准"做法会导致决策过程非适应，通过冻结账本修复。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一个生产级的预测市场交易系统，确保决策过程的信息适应性（仅使用赛前信息），并实现可持续盈利？
AI.motivation: 现有预测市场系统中，交易者常使用赛后信息重新校准历史决策，导致决策过程"非适应"（non-adapted），产生虚假的预测绩效。同时，需要对预测市场的盘中交易策略（如现金卖出和盘中入场）进行严格验证。
AI.theoretical_framework: 决策账本（Decision Ledger，基于测度论的适应性纪律）、Dixon-Coles核模型、点时间（PIT）校准、分数凯利准则（Fractional Kelly）、有界置信混合（Bounded Confidence Blend）、首次穿越现金卖出规则（First-crossing cash-out rule）。
AI.method: 构建生产级交易系统：使用锚定和PIT验证的评级混合输入Dixon-Coles核，在单纯形上进行概率校准（扩展窗口重拟）；使用"只追加、不可更改"的冻结账本修复非适应问题；去庄家赔率偏差、定价摩擦（长尾、平局）构建决策层；使用条件盘中模型驱动现金卖出规则和事件门控入场策略；在100场世界杯比赛的生产环境中验证。
AI.findings: 1) 常见的"重新应用当前校准到历史决策"做法使决策过程非适应，需使用冻结账本修复；2) 去除事件门控后，命中率从65.5%降至52.1%，利润下降3.6倍，证明盘中时机是利润核心来源；3) 冻结账本PIT校准Brier得分为0.540（基准2/3）；4) 总利润+4,469¢（赛中+2,872¢，税前+15¢，现金卖出后+1,597¢）；5) 收盘线价值略为负，说明实现的优势来自盘中时机而非赛前价格选择。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"决策账本"概念，将测度论中的适应性（adaptedness）引入预测市场方法论，严格区分了信息集的时间边界，证明了"重新校准"导致非适应性的数学机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一个完整的、生产验证的预测-交易系统架构，包括盘中现金卖出规则和事件门控入场策略，并公开了平台审计视图（https://someopark.web.app）以供复现检验。

title: Information Comparison of Order Statistics, with Applications to Auctions and Voting
affiliations: Bocconi University - Department of Economics, Bocconi University - Department of Economics and University of Copenhagen - Department of Economics

detail.title: Information Comparison of Order Statistics, with Applications to Auctions and Voting

declarations.funderStatement: Financial support from the European Research Council (HEUROPE 2022 ADG, GA No. 101055294) is gratefully acknowledged.

detail.abstract: We compare the informativeness of order statistics in a sample of conditionally independent draws from a distribution F(x|θ) as the sample size n increases. The k-th highest of n + 1 draws is more accurate than the k-th highest of n if and only if the cumulative reverse hazard - log F(x|θ) is log-supermodular. Symmetrically, the k-th lowest is more accurate if and only if the cumulative hazard - log(1-F(x|θ)) is log-supermodular. Reversals are exceptional, occurring only for experiments that are, up to increasing transformations, exponential location experiments. In large samples, middle order statistics are asymptotically fully informative, while bounded lower and upper ranks require unbounded informativeness tail conditions. When full learning fails, bounded ranks converge to location experiments, and more central ranks are Blackwell more informative. Extending the analysis from scalar order statistics to blocks of selected data, we obtain multidimensional comparisons under log-supermodularity of hazard rates. The results unify and extend information-aggregation results in auctions and provide a new order-statistic approach to strategic voting.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了条件独立样本中顺序统计量的信息量如何随样本量变化，发现排序统计量的信息量变化取决于累积风险函数的对数超模性质，并统一了拍卖中的信息聚合结果，为策略性投票提供了新的顺序统计量方法。
AI.research_question: 在条件独立同分布样本中，顺序统计量的信息量如何随样本规模n变化？具体而言，第k高的顺序统计量在n+1个样本中是否比在n个样本中更具信息量？
AI.motivation: 理解大规模样本中顺序统计量的信息含量变化规律，以统一和扩展拍卖中的信息聚合结果，并为策略性投票提供新的分析视角。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信息经济学、顺序统计量理论、Blackwell信息比较、对数超模性、累积风险函数
AI.method: 理论建模与比较静态分析，利用对数超模性（log-supermodularity）条件刻画顺序统计量信息量的单调性，并通过Blackwell信息准则进行比较。
AI.findings: (1) 第k高顺序统计量的信息量随n增加的条件是累积反向风险函数 -log F(x|θ) 是对数超模的；(2) 第k低顺序统计量的信息量随n增加的条件是累积风险函数 -log(1-F(x|θ)) 是对数超模的；(3) 反转情况仅发生在指数位置实验；(4) 大样本下中间顺序统计量渐近完全信息，而边界秩需要无界信息尾部条件；(5) 当完全学习失败时，有界秩收敛到位置实验，更中心的秩Blackwell信息量更大。
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了顺序统计量信息量与对数超模性之间的系统联系，统一并扩展了拍卖理论中的信息聚合结果，为策略性投票提供了新的顺序统计量分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为拍卖设计、投票机制设计等领域提供了关于如何利用顺序统计量进行信息聚合的理论指导，帮助理解大规模决策中信息效率的边界条件。

title: The Riemann Xi Function in the Critical Strip as a Wald Couple
affiliations: University of Chicago - Booth School of Business

detail.title: The Riemann Xi Function in the Critical Strip as a Wald Couple
detail.abstract: Riemann's ξ function is the Mellin transform of an explicit generalized gamma convolution: the Gaussian variance clock of a Wald couple whose non-negative leg is a sum of two squared Kolmogorov-Smirnov variables and whose Gaussian leg is a sum of two logistics. The functional equation is exactly the symmetry of that clock's Mellin transform about q = 1/4, and the folding variable w = s(1-s) linearises the symmetry, turning ξ into an entire function of order exactly 1/2 whose Taylor coefficients at the centre of the strip are the even moments of the Riemann kernel. In these coordinates the Riemann Hypothesis says that the reciprocal of a hyperbolic cosine moment function is a Thorin transform. Crossing to the line it says that ξ(1 2)/ξ(1 2 + λ) is the characteristic function of γ>0 (E γ-E ′ γ)/γ, the exact analogue of the classical representation L d = n≥1 (E n-E ′ n)/n of a logistic variable, with the integers replaced by the ordinates. The clock lies in a family containing the Pólya-Gamma laws of Bayesian data augmentation, whose Mellin transforms we identify as completed Dirichlet L-functions: shape one gives the odd character modulo four, shape two gives ξ, and no other shape gives a single completed zeta. Ostrovsky's Barnes beta laws supply the double gamma layer beneath, and we correct a natural but incorrect reading of that layer as a subordination.

AI.tldr: 本文通过广义伽马卷积和Wald耦合的Mellin变换重新诠释了Riemann ξ函数，建立了其与 logistic 分布、Pólya-Gamma 分布及 Barnes beta 律的深刻联系，并揭示了 Riemann 假设可表达为双曲余弦矩函数的Thorin变换。
AI.research_question: 如何通过概率论中的广义伽马卷积、Wald耦合及其Mellin变换来重新理解Riemann ξ函数的结构，并在此框架下重新表述Riemann假设？
AI.motivation: Riemann ξ函数与Riemann假设是数论的核心问题。作者试图建立ξ函数与概率分布（如 logistic 分布、Pólya-Gamma分布）之间的深层联系，从而为Riemann假设提供一个新的分析视角。
AI.theoretical_framework: 广义伽马卷积（Generalized Gamma Convolution）；Wald耦合（Wald Couple）；Mellin变换；Thorin变换；Pólya-Gamma分布；Barnes beta律。
AI.method: 通过Mellin变换将Riemann ξ函数表达为高斯方差钟（Gaussian variance clock）的变换，利用折叠变量 w = s(1-s) 线性化对称性；将Riemann假设转化为双曲余弦矩函数倒数的Thorin变换问题，并对比logistic变量的经典表示。
AI.findings: (1) Riemann ξ函数是Wald耦合中高斯腿（两个logistic变量之和）的Mellin变换；(2) 功能方程恰好对应钟在 q=1/4 处的对称性；(3) 折叠变量将ξ转化为阶数恰好为1/2的整函数；(4) Riemann假设等价于双曲余弦矩函数倒数为Thorin变换；(5) ξ(1/2)/ξ(1/2+λ) 是某个正随机变量的特征函数，形式与logistic变量的经典表示完全类比；(6) Pólya-Gamma分布的Mellin变换可识别为完整的Dirichlet L-函数，其中形状2对应ξ函数；(7) Ostrovsky的Barnes beta律提供了双重伽马层结构。
AI.theory_contributions: (1) 将Riemann ξ函数置于概率论框架中，揭示了其与logistic分布、Pólya-Gamma分布的深层次类比；(2) 将Riemann假设转化为概率论中Thorin变换的存在性问题，开辟了新的研究路径；(3) 统一了ξ函数、Dirichlet L-函数与Pólya-Gamma分布之间的Mellin变换关系。
AI.practical_contributions: (1) 为Riemann假设的证明提供了新的概率论工具和转化视角；(2) 建立了数论对象与贝叶斯统计中数据增广技术（Pólya-Gamma分布）之间的桥梁，可能启发交叉学科应用。

title: Efficient Inference for Counterfactual Distributions under a Sufficient Reduction of Confounding
affiliations: Stanford Graduate School of Business, University of Chicago - Booth School of Business and George Mason University

detail.title: Efficient Inference for Counterfactual Distributions under a Sufficient Reduction of Confounding
detail.abstract: We study efficient inference on counterfactual distributions when confounding admits a low-dimensional sufficient reduction. Assuming unconfoundedness together with an index restriction, L(Y (z) | X) = L(Y (z) | A ⊤ 0 X) with A 0 ∈ R p×k unknown and the propensity score unrestricted, we characterise the semiparametric efficiency bound for the counterfactual distribution process and its functionals. Two results are central. First, the efficient influence function conditions on the reduced propensity score e S (S) = E[e(X) | S] rather than on e(X), so adjusting for the full propensity score is strictly inefficient by an explicit conditional Jensen gap. Second, and contrary to what a rate calculation suggests, the index direction is not ancillary: the score for A 0 falls outside the outcome tangent space, the counterfactual functional is not orthogonal to it, and the efficiency bound rises by vec(Γ) ⊤ I-1 A vec(Γ), where Γ is the covariance between X and e(X) within index level sets, projected on the gradient of the counterfactual regression. Adaptivity holds if and only if Γ = 0. We characterise the frontier exactly: across all counterfactual functionals at once, estimating the reduction is free precisely when the covariates are conditionally uncorrelated with the propensity score given the index. We derive the efficient influence function for the whole counterfactual distribution process, establish a functional central limit theorem in ℓ ∞ (Y) and a valid multiplier bootstrap, exhibit a cross-fitted estimator attaining the bound under the rate condition 2β > k, and prove that the resulting n-2β/(2β+k) rate is minimax over the index-restricted class. Because Γ depends on the evaluation point, index estimation injects a drift process into the limit rather than a scalar variance inflation, so inference that treats the estimated reduction as fixed is invalid non-uniformly. We implement the bound with a quantile neural network and illustrate the results on simulated and observational data.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了在混淆变量存在低维充分降维条件下的反事实分布高效推断问题。核心发现包括：倾向得分需基于降维后的充分统计量而非原始协变量进行调整，否则会因条件Jensen gap导致效率损失；索引方向并非辅助参数，其估计会引入方差膨胀项Γ，只有当Γ=0时才能实现自适应估计。作者推导了半参效率界，提出了满足率条件的交叉拟合估计器，并证明了基于分位数神经网络的实现方法。
AI.research_question: 在低维充分降维的混淆变量设定下，如何对反事实分布及其泛函进行半参有效推断？
AI.motivation: 高维协变量下的因果推断面临"维数诅咒"，但现有方法大多假设已知降维结构或采用非参数方法效率低下。本文试图在更现实的设定（降维方向未知、倾向得分无限制）下刻画效率边界，并解决索引估计带来的非标准推断问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 半参效率理论、充分降维（索引限制）、反事实分布、有效影响函数、交叉拟合估计、最小最大率。
AI.method: 推导半参效率界和有效影响函数；建立函数中心极限定理和 multiplier bootstrap；提出交叉拟合估计器；使用分位数神经网络实现。
AI.findings: (1) 倾向得分必须基于降维后的充分统计量调整，否则存在效率损失；(2) 索引方向不是辅助参数，其估计引入方差膨胀项Γ，仅在Γ=0时可自适应；(3) 索引估计导致极限分布中出现漂移过程而非标量方差膨胀，将估计的降维视为固定不变会导致非一致推断失败；(4) 在率条件2β>k下，交叉拟合估计器达到半参效率界。
AI.theory_contributions: (1) 刻画了索引估计对反事实分布推断效率的精确影响，揭示其非辅助性；(2) 给出了适应性的确切条件（协变量与倾向得分条件独立于索引）；(3) 识别了索引估计带来的推断非一致性问题（漂移过程而非方差膨胀）。
AI.practical_contributions: (1) 提供了可操作的交叉拟合估计器和 multiplier bootstrap 推断方法；(2) 通过分位数神经网络实现了所提方法；(3) 在模拟和真实数据上验证了方法的有效性。

title: Killing Adam: An Order-of-Magnitude LLM Training Speedup via Horseshoe Mixtures-of-Experts
affiliations: University of Chicago - Booth School of Business and George Mason University

detail.title: Killing Adam: An Order-of-Magnitude LLM Training Speedup via Horseshoe Mixtures-of-Experts
detail.abstract: We show that Horseshoe Mixtures-of-Experts trained with Scale-Mixture EM (SM-HS-MoE) delivers an aggregate wall-clock training speedup of approximately one order of magnitude for transformer language models relative to the standard mixed-precision Adam plus Shazeer top-k recipe. The speedup decomposes into three multiplicative sources: (i) a 2.4× per-iteration reduction in HBM traffic from elimination of the Adam optimizer state; (ii) a 3-10× reduction in iterations-toconvergence from second-order EM steps applied to ill-conditioned MoE gating problems; and (iii) a 1.1-1.2× end-to-end contribution from posterior-adaptive routing that reduces per-token MoE-layer HBM traffic. After honest accounting for activation traffic dilution, the central end-to-end estimate is ≈ 8× speedup on a single training run, with a 4-24× range depending on iteration-count and precision assumptions. An additional 5-10× reduction is available on top of this for hyperparameter search via sufficient-statistic caching, and a further ∼ 2× from FP4/FP8 quantization synergy. The speedup requires no change to the transformer architecture beyond the MoE gating layer and the optimizer, and introduces no auxiliary losses or learning-rate schedule. We give explicit byte-perparameter accounting for each source of savings, state the aggregate speedup as a formal proposition, describe the three kernel-level changes required to adopt the method in a production training stack, and analyse interactions with existing acceleration techniques including ZeRO sharding, FP8 mixed precision, expert parallelism, and FlashAttention. For a representative frontier-scale training run consuming ∼ $10-50M in compute over a month, our analysis predicts a wall-clock reduction to ∼ 3-5 days at equivalent quality, or a substantially better model at the original compute budget.

title: Thorin Measures of the Kolmogorov-Smirnov Law
affiliations: University of Chicago - Booth School of Business

detail.title: Thorin Measures of the Kolmogorov-Smirnov Law
detail.abstract: The square Kolmogorov-Smirnov Law K^2 is a generalized gamma convolution with purely atomic Thorin measure.

AI.tldr: 本文证明了平方Kolmogorov-Smirnov律K^2是一个广义伽马卷积，其Thorin测度是纯原子的。
AI.research_question: 平方Kolmogorov-Smirnov律K^2的分布性质是什么？
AI.motivation: 深入理解K^2分布的数学结构，将其归类到广义伽马卷积族中。
AI.theoretical_framework: 广义伽马卷积理论；Thorin测度理论。
AI.method: 数学推导与证明。
AI.findings: K^2属于广义伽马卷积分布族，且其Thorin测度是纯原子的。
AI.theory_contributions: 将K^2分布纳入广义伽马卷积框架，揭示了其深层数学结构。
AI.practical_contributions: 为K^2分布的性质研究和相关统计应用提供了新的理论工具。

title: Random Walks Against Tensor Cores: Where Monte Carlo Wins on GPU Accelerators
affiliations: University of Chicago - Booth School of Business and George Mason University

detail.title: Random Walks Against Tensor Cores: Where Monte Carlo Wins on GPU Accelerators
detail.abstract: Randomized linear solvers estimate components of A-1 b by simulating random walks, at a cost independent of the ambient dimension and proportional to the number of outputs requested. Classical operation counts make the case look overwhelming. Modern accelerators make it look hopeless: a factorization runs at three quarters of peak arithmetic throughput while a random walk runs three orders of magnitude below the memory roofline. Neither reading is right. We give a break-even theory identifying four conditions under which randomization wins, and show that the decisive one is the accuracy exponent rather than the dimension. Plain Monte Carlo has a break-even dimension growing as ε-2/3 , which excludes it from any tolerance a practitioner would report. Sequential residual correction replaces this with (log 1/ε) 1/3. We derive that rate rather than assume it: because the estimator's relative error is scale invariant, each correction round contracts by κ = c v N-1/2 , and optimizing the total budget gives a per-round sample size N ⋆ = e c 2 v , a universal contraction κ ⋆ = e-1/2 , and a total cost 2e c 2 v log(1/ε). The same analysis shows the boosted iteration needs 2 log(1/ε) operator products against the √ cond log(1/ε) of a Krylov method, so the walk acts as a preconditioner whose rate is set by sampling rather than by conditioning. We also correct a condition that is usually misstated: finite variance requires ∥I-GA∥ ∞ < 1, strictly stronger than convergence of the Neumann series. Four case studies follow. Transformer pretraining is a clean negative, with linear solves one part in 10 5 of the budget. Exact Gaussian process inference and influence-function attribution are clean positives, for the same reason, which is memory capacity rather than arithmetic.

AI.tldr: 本文重新审视了随机线性求解器（如随机游走方法）与传统直接求解器（如矩阵分解）的计算效率对比。作者提出一个"盈亏平衡理论"，指出随机化方法获胜的关键条件是"精度指数"而非维度。经典蒙特卡洛方法的盈亏平衡维度随 ε^{-2/3} 增长，使其在实际精度需求下不可行；但通过序贯残差校正，该增长率可降至 (log 1/ε)^{1/3}。论文进一步分析了收缩率、最优样本量、总成本等指标，并将随机游走视为一种以采样速率而非条件数驱动的预条件器。四个案例研究表明，该方法在精确高斯过程推断和影响函数归因等内存受限场景中具有优势，但在Transformer预训练（线性求解仅占极小计算预算）中不适用。
AI.research_question: 随机线性求解器（随机游走方法）在什么条件下能够在计算效率上超越传统确定性求解器（如矩阵分解）？
AI.motivation: 经典操作计数显示随机化方法很有希望（成本与维度无关），但现代加速器（GPU等）的运行结果却显示随机游走的吞吐量远低于内存带宽峰值（比分解方法低三个数量级）。两种观点都不正确，需要更严谨的理论分析来明确随机化方法真正适用的条件。
AI.theoretical_framework: 盈亏平衡理论（break-even theory），序贯残差校正（sequential residual correction），收缩率分析，精度指数（accuracy exponent）概念，Neumann级数收敛条件（要求 ∥I-GA∥∞<1，比传统表述更强）。
AI.method: 理论推导（包括蒙特卡洛估计量的方差分析、残差校正的收缩率推导、最优样本量 N* 和通用收缩率 κ* 的求解），结合四个案例研究（Transformer预训练、精确高斯过程推断、影响函数归因等）进行实证对比。
AI.findings: 1) 随机化方法获胜的关键条件是精度指数而非维度；2) 经典蒙特卡洛的盈亏平衡维度随 ε^{-2/3} 增长，实际不可行；3) 序贯残差校正将其降至 (log 1/ε)^{1/3}；4) 每轮收缩率 κ = c_v N^{-1/2}，最优样本量 N* = e c_v^2，通用收缩率 κ* = e^{-1/2}，总成本 2e c_v^2 log(1/ε)；5) 增强迭代需要 2 log(1/ε) 次算子乘积，而Krylov方法需要 √cond log(1/ε) 次；6) 有限方差需要 ∥I-GA∥∞<1，强于Neumann级数收敛。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提出并证明了随机化方法获胜的四个条件，指出精度指数是决定性因素；2) 推导了序贯残差校正的收缩率公式，而非仅仅假设其存在；3) 修正了随机游走方法的方差有限条件（∥I-GA∥∞<1），纠正了文献中常见的错误表述；4) 将随机游走重新概念化为一种预条件器，其收敛速率由采样决定而非条件数决定。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为 practitioners 提供了随机化方法是否适用的判断框架；2) 在内存受限场景（如精确高斯过程推断、影响函数归因）中确认了随机化方法的优势，其瓶颈是内存容量而非算术运算；3) 在Transformer预训练场景中明确否定了随机化方法的适用性（线性求解仅占预算的极小部分）。

title: Hilbert's Sixth Problem: Propagation of Chaos, SPDEs, and Bayes Hilbert's Sixth Problem: Propagation of Chaos, SPDEs, and Bayes
affiliations: University of Chicago - Booth School of Business and George Mason University

detail.title: Hilbert's Sixth Problem: Propagation of Chaos, SPDEs, and Bayes Hilbert's Sixth Problem: Propagation of Chaos, SPDEs, and Bayes
detail.abstract: Hilbert's Sixth Problem asks for an axiomatic foundation for probability together with a derivation of the macroscopic equations of physics from the stochastic motion of microscopic particles. Both halves are now settled. Kolmogorov supplied the axioms in 1933; Deng and Hani (2024) derived Boltzmann's equation from hard-sphere Newtonian dynamics on the full kinetic time scale, and Deng et al. (2025) passed from Boltzmann to the compressible Euler and incompressible Navier-Stokes-Fourier systems, completing the chain from Newton's laws to fluid mechanics. We give a probabilistic account of the whole programme organised around three objects: the Feynman-Kac formula, which represents each equation in the hierarchy as an average over random particle paths; Bayes' rule, which describes how a probabilistic description of a physical system updates under observation; and the McKean-Vlasov equation, whose solution is the law of a process satisfying the equation it generates. We then argue that the resolution of the derivational half sharpens rather than dissolves the statistical content of the problem. The theorems propagate a known initial law through a closed system; an observer holding partial and noisy measurements of a fluid must instead compute a conditional law, and conditioning replaces the Kolmogorov forward equation by a stochastic partial differential equation whose solution is a random measure. The representation theorem of Kurtz and Xiong (1999) returns that object to particle form, and its finite-N truncation is an algorithm. We develop this inferential hierarchy in parallel with the physical one, give a structural comparison of the Deng-Hani-Ma proof architecture with the Bayesian deep learning framework of Polson and Sokolov (2017), and trace the shared lineage of both through Boltzmann, Gibbs, Poincaré, Besag, and MacKay. A final layer treats von Neumann's quantum mechanics as a noncommutative deformation of the same architecture: measurement is Bayes' rule for a density matrix, the Lindblad equation is a quantum McKean-Vlasov equation, and the quantum Bayesian computation of Polson et al. (2023) delivers a quadratic speed-up in the Bayes update.

AI.tldr: 本文系统阐述了希尔伯特第六问题的解决历程：从牛顿力学推导出流体力学方程，并在此基础上构建了平行的统计推断层级，将物理定律与贝叶斯推断统一在同一概率架构下，最后延伸至量子力学的非交换变形。
AI.research_question: 如何从概率论基础出发，建立从微观牛顿力学到宏观流体力学方程的完整推导链，并将这一物理推导层级与统计推断层级进行结构对应？
AI.motivation: 希尔伯特第六问题要求为概率论建立公理基础并推导物理宏观方程。虽然两个目标均已实现（Kolmogorov公理、Deng-Hani链式推导），但推导过程的概率内涵尚未被充分阐释，且物理推导与贝叶斯推断之间的深层结构联系有待揭示。
AI.theoretical_framework: Feynman-Kac公式（将方程表示为随机粒子路径平均）、贝叶斯规则（系统概率描述在观测下的更新）、McKean-Vlasov方程（自生成过程的概率律）。量子层面涉及密度矩阵、Lindblad方程和量子贝叶斯计算。
AI.method: 理论分析：将Deng-Hani-Ma的物理推导链（牛顿力学→玻尔兹曼方程→欧拉/纳维-斯托克斯-傅里叶方程）与统计推断层级（条件概率→随机偏微分方程→Kurtz-Xiong表示定理→有限N截断算法）进行结构映射和比较分析。
AI.findings: 1. 物理推导（链式定理）强化而非消解了问题的统计内容；2. 物理层级与贝叶斯推断层级之间存在精确的结构对应；3. Deng-Hani-Ma证明架构与Polson-Sokolov贝叶斯深度学习框架共享共同谱系（Boltzmann、Gibbs、Poincaré、Besag、MacKay）；4. 量子力学是该架构的非交换变形，量子贝叶斯计算可在贝叶斯更新中实现二次加速。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 阐明了希尔伯特第六问题解决中的概率论深层结构；2. 建立了物理推导层级与统计推断层级的统一理论框架；3. 将量子力学视为经典概率架构的非交换变形，拓展了理论统一性。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为含噪声部分观测的流体力学问题提供了条件概率计算方法；2. 有限N截断算法为实际计算提供了可行路径；3. 量子贝叶斯计算的二次加速为高效推断提供了新方向。

title: Hilbert's Sixth Problem: Propagation of Chaos, SPDEs, and Bayes Hilbert's Sixth Problem: Propagation of Chaos, SPDEs, and Bayes
affiliations: University of Chicago - Booth School of Business and George Mason University

AI.tldr: 本文梳理了从希尔伯特第六问题（概率论公理化与从微观粒子运动推导宏观物理方程）到近期完整解决（Deng-Hani系列工作）的整个纲领，并在物理推导链之外构建了一条平行的贝叶斯推断链，论证了推导性问题的解决非但没有消解概率统计内容，反而凸显了条件概率在流体力学反问题中的核心地位。
AI.research_question: 希尔伯特第六问题如何被完整解决？在物理推导链完成后，概率与统计在该问题中扮演何种角色？
AI.motivation: 希尔伯特第六问题要求概率论公理化并从微观粒子随机运动推导宏观物理方程。前半部分（Kolmogorov公理）已解决，后半部分近期由Deng-Hani-Ma等人完成。然而，标准叙事往往忽视概率统计在推导完成后的持续重要性，作者希望纠正这一认知，建立与物理链平行的推断链。
AI.theoretical_framework: Feynman-Kac公式（将方程表示为随机路径平均）、贝叶斯规则（物理系统概率描述在观测下的更新）、McKean-Vlasov方程（自洽生成过程的律）。
AI.method: 概述Deng-Hani（2024）从硬球牛顿动力学到Boltzmann方程的全动力学时间尺度推导，以及Deng等人（2025）从Boltzmann到可压缩Euler和不可压Navier-Stokes-Fourier系统的推导。在此基础上构建平行的推断层次：Kurtz-Xiong（1999）表示定理将条件律的随机偏微分方程解还原为粒子形式，有限N截断即为算法。
AI.findings: 物理推导定理将已知初始律通过封闭系统传播；而持有部分含噪观测的观察者需计算条件律，此时Kolmogorov前向方程被随机偏微分方程取代，其解为随机测度。Kurtz-Xiong表示定理将该对象还原为粒子形式。作者还给出了Deng-Hani-Ma证明架构与Polson-Sokolov（2017）贝叶斯深度学习框架的结构比较，并追溯了两者通过Boltzmann、Gibbs、Poincaré、Besag和MacKay的共同谱系。
AI.theory_contributions: 澄清了推导性问题的解决非但未消解反而凸显了概率统计内容的理论地位；建立了物理推导链与贝叶斯推断链之间的结构对应关系；揭示了Kurtz-Xiong表示定理在流体反问题中的新角色。
AI.practical_contributions: 为基于粒子的流体反问题算法提供了理论基础（有限N截断即算法）；连接了物理推导与贝叶斯深度学习框架，为交叉领域研究提供了路线图。

title: The Geometry of Othello and Chess: Stored Optionality and the Break
affiliations: University of Chicago - Booth School of Business

detail.title: The Geometry of Othello and Chess: Stored Optionality and the Break
detail.abstract: In 2018 an eleven-year-old, Keisuke Fukuchi, won the World Othello Championship, beating two former world champions on the way. The result is not a curiosity but a clue. In Othello the payoff is scored only at the final move, so the state variable that matters during play is not materialdisc counts swing wildly and predict almost nothing-but the size and quality of the opponent's set of legal replies. Strong play therefore looks passive until a phase transition in which stored optionality converts into forced concessions. We formalise this as option-set dynamics, decompose evaluation into realised mobility, latent mobility, irreversible stability and parity, and show that the timing of the release is an optimal stopping problem with a free boundary. A geometric layer-line families, line status, critical squares as intersections of contested lines, colour complexes as irreversible partitions, and pawn chains as diagonal segments-then makes the framework operational, and we audit the chess openings that implement the mechanism, for both colours. Two computable estimators, one requiring an engine and one not, turn the framework into a falsifiable claim about master games, and we state the test they support.

AI.tldr: 论文通过分析黑白棋（Othello）中11岁少年夺冠的异常现象，提出了"期权集动态"理论框架，将棋类博弈中的走法选择建模为最优停时问题，并推广到国际象棋分析中。
AI.research_question: 如何理解并形式化棋类博弈中"被动式强手"直至临界点转化为强制让步的动力学机制？
AI.motivation: 2018年11岁少年Keisuke Fukuchi击败两位前世界冠军赢得黑白棋世界冠军这一反直觉结果，表明现有基于子力优势的评估范式存在根本性缺陷。
AI.theoretical_framework: 期权集动态（option-set dynamics）：将博弈走法选择分解为已实现机动性、潜在机动性、不可逆稳定性和奇偶性，并将释放时机建模为具有自由边界的最优停时问题。
AI.method: 构建几何层（线族、线状态、临界方格、颜色复合体、兵链）使框架可操作化；提出两种可计算估计量（一种需要引擎、一种不需要），并用大师级对局进行可证伪性检验。
AI.findings: 黑白棋中子力盘面计数剧烈波动且预测力极低，关键状态变量是对手合法应着集的大小和质量；强手表现为"存储可选性"直至相变点转化为"强制让步"。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将"期权集动态"概念引入棋类博弈理论，建立了从可选性存储到强制转换的相变模型，并以最优停时问题形式化表达。
AI.practical_contributions: 为棋类AI和人类棋手提供了超越传统子力评估的新分析框架，可通过两种可计算估计量（有引擎/无引擎）在实际对局中验证和应用。

title: GPU Acceleration of Bayesian Computation: Arithmetic Intensity, Sequential Depth, and Amortized Inference
affiliations: University of Chicago - Booth School of Business and George Mason University

detail.title: GPU Acceleration of Bayesian Computation: Arithmetic Intensity, Sequential Depth, and Amortized Inference
detail.abstract: Statistical methods are compared on statistical grounds: efficiency, robustness, minimaxity, coverage. On modern accelerators a second comparison dominates the first in practice. A method is fast if its dominant kernel achieves high arithmetic intensity and shallow sequential depth, and slow otherwise, whatever its statistical credentials. We formalize this with a cost model in which an algorithm is a triple (W, T, I) of width, depth, and intensity, and we define a dominance criterion, effective sample size per joule, that makes the exchange rate between hardware speed and statistical efficiency explicit. We then triage a body of Bayesian methodology and support each verdict with either a proposition or a numerical experiment. Six results are quantitative. First, the Pólya-Gamma series sampler admits a fixedtruncation form whose discarded tail has cumulants available in closed form through the polygamma function; matching two cumulants with a gamma variate reduces the bias in the mean by a factor of 2.1 × 10 4 at K = 20 and, inside a full Gibbs sampler checked against a posterior computed by quadrature, holds the posterior standard deviation to within 1.2 Monte Carlo standard errors at every truncation tested including K = 5, where the uncorrected sampler errs by 19 standard errors. Second, the warp-divergence penalty of an accept-reject kernel is bounded above by the harmonic number H W of the warp width, roughly 4.06 for W = 32, correcting a folklore figure that is too pessimistic. Third, running many short chains reduces variance as 1/M while leaving squared bias at a floor we confirm to within four percent; at M = 10 5 the reported standard error understates the true error by a factor of 180. Fourth, sequential accumulation of 10 7 unit-scale terms in bfloat16 does not degrade gradually, it stalls at exactly 256, and single precision stalls at 2 24 , which fixes a hard rule for the reductions that prediction-powered inference requires. Fifth, the conjugate gradient iteration count for a Bradley-Terry preference model is governed by the cluster structure of the comparison design rather than by the condition number, which the prior ridge masks: two designs with condition numbers 356 and 371 need 41 and 16 iterations respectively. Sixth, prediction-powered inference achieves a variance ratio 1-ρ 2 /(1 + n/N) that we verify at nominal coverage, a fivefold effective label gain at ρ = 0.9. The organizing conclusion is that amortization changes the class of the workload while constant-factor kernel tuning does not, and that two widely reported wins, coordinatewise shrinkage and spline networks, do not survive the hardware accounting in their standard form.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个以硬件效率为中心的统计方法评估框架，通过"有效样本量每焦耳"指标来权衡统计精度与计算速度。作者对贝叶斯方法体系进行了分类评估，通过六个定量实验揭示了统计效率与硬件性能之间的交换关系，并指出一些流行的统计方法（如坐标收缩、样条网络）在硬件成本核算下不再具有优势。
AI.research_question: 如何在统计效率与计算速度之间建立可量化的交换关系，从而对统计方法进行硬件感知的评估？
AI.motivation: 传统上统计方法仅基于统计性质（效率、稳健性、极小极大性、覆盖概率）进行比较，但在现代加速器（GPU等）上，计算速度往往成为实践中的主导因素。需要一种形式化的框架来明确统计效率与硬件速度之间的"汇率"。
AI.theoretical_framework: 提出了一个成本模型，将算法表示为三元组(W, T, I)——宽度、深度和强度。定义了"有效样本量每焦耳"这一优势准则，使硬件速度与统计效率之间的交换率显式化。
AI.method: 通过六个定量实验（命题证明+数值实验）对贝叶斯方法体系进行"分类评估"，涵盖：Pólya-Gamma截断采样器、接受-拒绝核的翘曲分歧惩罚、短链MCMC、bfloat16精度下的序列累加、Bradley-Terry偏好模型的共轭梯度迭代、预测驱动推理。
AI.findings: 1) Pólya-Gamma截断采样器通过两矩匹配可将偏差降低2.1×10^4倍；2) 翘曲分歧惩罚的上界约为4.06（W=32时），修正了过于悲观的传言；3) 短链的平方偏差存在下限，在M=10^5时标准误低估真实误差180倍；4) bfloat16序列累加在256处停滞，单精度在2^24处停滞；5) Bradley-Terry模型的迭代次数由比较设计的聚类结构决定，而非条件数；6) 预测驱动推理在ρ=0.9时可实现5倍有效标签增益。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了硬件感知的统计方法评估形式化框架，明确了"摊销"（amortization）与"常数因子核调优"的本质区别，揭示了一些流行方法（坐标收缩、样条网络）在硬件成本核算下不具优势。
AI.practical_contributions: 为统计方法设计者提供了硬件效率导向的评估准则和具体数值指导（如精度选择规则、链数选择警告等），帮助在统计精度与计算效率之间做出更明智的权衡。

title: The Reciprocal-Gamma Distribution and Reciprocal-Carrier Exponential Families
affiliations: University of Chicago - Booth School of Business

detail.title: The Reciprocal-Gamma Distribution and Reciprocal-Carrier Exponential Families
detail.abstract: We introduce the reciprocal-gamma family, the natural exponential family on the positive half-line whose carrier is the reciprocal gamma function. The family arises naturally in Bayesian count modelling: under a flat prior it is the exact posterior for the negative binomial dispersion and for the gamma-Poisson shape, and the carrier of a modulated posterior for the Dirichlet concentration in topic models. For unit prior sample size it coincides with the conjugate prior of Damsleth, whose normalizing constant has been unavailable in closed form. We give that closed form: the normalizer decomposes into an elementary exponential-of-exponential term and a transcendental correction that is, up to a location shift, the classical Ramanujan integral. At the origin the normalizer recovers the Fransén-Robinson constant. The correction is uniformly bounded by π-2 , admits an explicit Cauchy scale mixture of normals, and is an exact global-local mixture in the sense of Bhadra et al. We further prove that the square-root-reparameterized Laplace transform of the family is completely monotone, with Hausdorff-Bernstein mixing measure the law of X 2 /(2Z 2) for Z standard normalthe integrated analogue, with the threshold removed, of Hartman's gammafunction theorem-which places the family unconditionally within the mixture half of the Polson-Scott hierarchical duality. The family itself is not infinitely divisible: its ninth cumulant at the origin is negative. The decomposition is verified numerically to ten or more digits.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了倒数伽马族（reciprocal-gamma family），这是正半轴上的自然指数族，其载体为倒数伽马函数。该族在贝叶斯计数建模中自然出现：在平坦先验下，它是负二项分布色散参数和伽马-泊松形状参数的后验精确分布；也是主题模型中狄利克雷浓度参数的调制后验载体。当先验样本量为1时，该族退化为Damsleth共轭先验（其归一化常数此前无闭式解）。本文给出了该归一化常数的闭式解：它分解为基本指数-of-指数项与一个超越校正项，后者在位置平移后即为经典Ramanujan积分。在校正项原点处可恢复Fransén-Robinson常数。该校正项一致有界于π-2，具有显式柯西尺度混合正态表示，且是Bhadra等人意义上的精确全局-局部混合。本文进一步证明：该族的平方根重参数化拉普拉斯变换完全单调，其Hausdorff-Bernstein混合测度为X²/(2Z²)的分布（Z为标准正态）——这是去掉阈值的Hartman伽马函数定理的积分类比，将该族无条件置于Polson-Scott层级对偶的混合半部。该族本身并非无穷可分：其在原点的第九累积量为负。上述分解已通过数值验证达十位以上精度。
AI.research_question: 本文的研究问题是：如何定义并刻画倒数伽马族（reciprocal-gamma family）——正半轴上一类以倒数伽马函数为载体的自然指数族——并给出其归一化常数的闭式解，以及探明其数学性质（包括完全单调性、混合表示、无穷可分性等）。
AI.motivation: 倒数伽马族在贝叶斯计数建模中自然出现（如负二项色散参数、伽马-泊松形状参数、狄利克雷浓度参数的后验分布），但此前对其数学结构的系统研究缺失，尤其是Damsleth共轭先验的归一化常数长期没有闭式解。本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 自然指数族理论、倒数伽马函数、Ramanujan积分、Fransén-Robinson常数、完全单调性与Hausdorff-Bernstein定理、Polson-Scott层级对偶、无穷可分性理论、累积量分析、柯西尺度混合与全局-局部混合（Bhadra et al.）。
AI.method: 理论推导与解析计算，辅以数值验证（精度达十位以上）。具体包括：归一化常数的闭式分解（指数-of-指数项+超越校正项）、拉普拉斯变换的完全单调性证明、Hausdorff-Bernstein混合测度的推导、累积量分析检验无穷可分性。
AI.findings: (1) 给出了倒数伽马族归一化常数的闭式解，分解为基本项与超越校正项（后者为Ramanujan积分的平移）；(2) 校正项在原点处恢复Fransén-Robinson常数，一致有界于π-2，具显式柯西尺度混合正态表示和全局-局部混合形式；(3) 平方根重参数化拉普拉斯变换完全单调，混合测度为X²/(2Z²)的分布；(4) 该族本身非无穷可分（第九累积量为负）。
AI.theory_contributions: (1) 首次给出Damsleth共轭先验归一化常数的闭式解；(2) 发现校正项与Ramanujan积分的内在联系，并建立与Fransén-Robinson常数的关联；(3) 证明完全单调性并给出Hausdorff-Bernstein混合测度的显式形式（Hartman定理的积分类比）；(4) 通过累积量分析证明该族非无穷可分，丰富了自然指数族的分类理论；(5) 将倒数伽马族置于Polson-Scott层级对偶的框架中。
AI.practical_contributions: (1) 为贝叶斯计数建模（负二项回归、伽马-泊松模型、主题模型）中相关参数的归一化常数计算提供了精确闭式解，提升了计算效率与精度；(2) 混合表示与完全单调性为后续的马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（MCMC）采样和变分推断提供了新工具；(3) 数值验证达十位精度，确保了理论的可靠性与实用性。

title: The Illusion of Platform Protection: Securing the Virtual Identity under the Trade Marks Act
affiliations: S.K.J Law College

detail.title: The Illusion of Platform Protection: Securing the Virtual Identity under the Trade Marks Act

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflict of interest.

detail.abstract: The contemporary Indian creator economy is a multibillion-dollar enterprise where a creator's digital alias, visual architecture, and sonic branding serve as high value commercial assets. However, a pervasive legal misconception exists among digital entrepreneurs. They mistakenly equate compliance with social media platform guidelines to statutory intellectual property protection. This paper deconstructs this Platform Fallacy. It highlights the severe risks of relying on delegated, contractual protection from tech intermediaries. By examining the anatomy of a digital persona, this paper traces the jurisprudential evolution from early domain name disputes to modern litigations involving AI generated deepfakes and retail exploitation. Analyzing recent interventions by the Bombay High Court and the Delhi High Court, the research demonstrates that courts are aggressively protecting personality rights against unauthorized commercialization. Ultimately, this paper argues that formal registration under the Trade Marks Act, 1999, coupled with modern remedies like dynamic injunctions, is the only viable strategy to shield digital proprietors from trademark squatters, cross platform hijacking, and the unauthorized expansion of their brand into the physical goods sector.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了印度数字创作者普遍存在的"平台谬误"——将遵守平台指南等同于获得知识产权保护。通过追溯数字人格权的法律演变，论证了依据《1999年商标法》进行正式注册并辅以现代法律救济（如动态禁令）才是保护数字资产的唯一可靠策略。
AI.research_question: 印度数字创作者如何有效保护其数字人格资产免受侵权，以及为何依赖平台指南的保护存在重大法律风险？
AI.motivation: 当代印度创作者经济规模达数十亿美元，数字别名、视觉架构和声音品牌成为高价值商业资产，但创作者普遍存在将平台合规误认为法律保护的错误认知，亟需澄清这一法律误区。
AI.theoretical_framework: 平台谬误理论（Platform Fallacy）；人格权与商标法交叉理论；数字人格资产的法律架构分析。
AI.method: 规范性法律分析；案例研究法（追踪从早期域名争议到AI深度伪造、商业开发的现代诉讼）；司法判例分析（孟买高等法院、德里高等法院近期裁决）。
AI.findings: 印度法院正积极保护人格权免受未经授权的商业利用；依赖平台提供的合同性保护存在严重风险；《1999年商标法》注册+动态禁令是抵御商标抢注、跨平台劫持和品牌跨界侵权的可行策略。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统性地提出并解构"平台谬误"概念；完善了数字人格权在商标法框架下的理论分析；为新兴创作者经济中的知识产权保护提供了理论依据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为印度数字创作者提供了明确的法律策略指引：商标注册+动态禁令；警示创作者不要将平台合规等同于法律保护；为处理AI深度伪造、跨平台侵权等新型数字侵权问题提供了实践方案。

title: Amortized Quantile Inference for Astrophysics
affiliations: University of Chicago - Booth School of Business and George Mason University

detail.title: Amortized Quantile Inference for Astrophysics
detail.abstract: Modern astrophysics is increasingly simulation-first: the forward model-an N-body code, a radiative-transfer pipeline, a waveform generator, a supernova light-curve simulator-is trusted, but the implied likelihood is expensive, high dimensional, or unavailable in closed form. Generative Bayesian Computation (GBC) recasts posterior inference as supervised learning. A deep quantile network is trained on prior-predictive draws to represent the posterior quantile map θ = Q ϕ (τ, S(y)) directly, so that pushing a uniform base variable through the learned map yields posterior samples for any observed dataset-without densities, without normalizing constants, and without a Markov chain. We give a self-contained account of the quantile-transport formalism, prove the check-loss characterization on which training rests, and record the marginal-of-quantiles identity that makes credible sets and expected utilities immediate. We then contribute a theoretical analysis absent from earlier treatments: an excess-risk identity for the pinball loss, and a bound showing that the Wasserstein-1 error of the GBC posterior is controlled by the square root of the integrated quantile-regression regret, under a mild density lower bound. This lets us decompose posterior error into estimation, approximation, and specification terms, the last of which no amount of data removes. We situate GBC within the Bayesian tradition in astronomy-Loredo's inference-and-design program, the computer-model calibration of Higdon and collaborators, Wasserman's frequentist-coverage discipline, and the Ockham-factor view of Jefferys and Berger-and give a careful restriction of the method's advantage through an amortization break-even inequality. A controlled numerical study on dark-energy inference from Type Ia supernovae exhibits the theory: the GBC posterior matches an exact grid reference, passes simulation-based calibration, attains near-nominal coverage when well specified, and-as the theory predicts-loses coverage sharply under a 15% unmodeled contamination. We close with the Stage-IV survey application and a candid account of model comparison, where GBC's density-free stance is a genuine limitation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出生成贝叶斯计算（GBC）框架，利用深度分位数网络将后验推断重构为监督学习问题，无需密度函数、归一化常数或马尔可夫链。通过理论分析建立了分位数回归遗憾与Wasserstein-1误差之间的泛化界，并将后验误差分解为估计误差、逼近误差和设定误差。在Ia型超新星暗能量推断的数值实验中验证了理论预测。
AI.research_question: 如何在不依赖显式似然函数的情况下，高效、准确地实现贝叶斯后验推断？
AI.motivation: 现代天体物理学日益采用"模拟优先"范式，前向模型（如N体模拟、辐射传输管线、波形生成器等）可信但对应的似然函数昂贵、高维或无法闭合表达，亟需一种无需显式密度的后验推断方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 分位数运输形式主义、钉球损失（check-loss）表征、边际分位数恒等式、超额风险恒等式、Wasserstein-1误差与分位数回归遗憾的泛化界。
AI.method: 在先验预测样本上训练深度分位数网络，直接学习后验分位数映射θ=Q_ϕ(τ, S(y))，通过将均匀基变量推过学习到的映射生成后验样本。
AI.findings: GBC后验与精确网格参考匹配；通过仿真校准测试；设定正确时达到近名义覆盖；在15%未建模污染下覆盖急剧下降（符合理论预测）；给出了摊销盈亏平衡不等式以界定方法优势范围。
AI.theory_contributions: (1) 建立了针球损失的超额风险恒等式；(2) 推导了Wasserstein-1误差由分位数回归遗憾的平方根控制的泛化界；(3) 将后验误差分解为估计项、逼近项和设定项。
AI.practical_contributions: 为模拟优先的天体物理学应用（如Stage-IV巡天）提供了一种无需密度、无需MCMC的快速后验推断方案；通过摊销机制实现观测数据到达时的即时推断。

title: Ordered Empirical Bayes: A Default Regularizer for Score-Based Generative Models
affiliations: University of Chicago - Booth School of Business, George Mason University and

detail.title: Ordered Empirical Bayes: A Default Regularizer for Score-Based Generative Models
detail.abstract: Score-based generative models are trained by score matching, a regression of the (noisy) score target on a network, and then regularized as an afterthought: a weight-decay coefficient tuned, layer by layer and noise level by noise level, on a held-out score-matching loss that is itself extremely high variance. We argue that regularization should instead be the default, read off the data in closed form, and we give the mechanism. The ordered empirical-Bayes (Deaton-Young) framework places a global-local prior on the read-out coefficients in a canonical (orthogonal) basis and estimates the local variance profile by marginal likelihood under a monotonicity constraint, solved in linear time by the pool-adjacent-violators algorithm (pava). The result is a closed-form, hyperparameter-free shrinkage rule that generalizes ridge and Stein's positive-part estimator. The fit is exact for score matching: denoising score matching is least squares against a known Gaussian target, the Fisher divergence equals squared coefficient error, and-because every diffusion marginal is data convolved with Gaussian noise-the ordered variance profile the method needs holds by construction. The rule incorporates double descent: capping the effective degrees of freedom at the signal dimension removes the score-estimation blow-up of ridgeless interpolation at p ≈ n without tuning. Theoretically the estimator is adaptively near-minimax in Fisher divergence, which by standard score-to-KL bounds controls generation quality at the same rate. Empirically, on a denoising score-matching task whose min-norm Fisher divergence explodes by twelve orders of magnitude through the interpolation threshold, ordered empirical Bayes holds Fisher divergence flat (≈ 0.32) across all over-parameterization ratios and across the diffusion noise schedule, with no tuning and at roughly five times lower cost than cross-validated ridge-which is itself unreliable here because the score-matching validation target has variance 1/σ 2 .

AI.tldr: 本文提出有序经验贝叶斯（Ordered Empirical-Bayes）方法，作为分数匹配生成模型的自适应正则化框架。该方法通过正交基上的全局-局部先验、边际似然优化和PAVA算法，实现了无超参数的闭式收缩规则，在去噪分数匹配任务中无需调参即可稳定控制Fisher散度，有效解决了过参数化导致的分数估计爆炸问题。
AI.research_question: 如何为基于分数的生成模型设计一种自适应的、无需调参的正则化方法，以解决分数匹配训练中高方差验证损失和过参数化导致的估计爆炸问题？
AI.motivation: 当前分数匹配生成模型依赖后置调参（逐层、逐噪声水平调节权重衰减系数），且验证损失本身方差极高，导致正则化不稳定、不可靠。需要一种可以数据驱动、闭式求解的正则化框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 有序经验贝叶斯（Deaton-Young框架）；全局-局部先验；边际似然估计；PAVA保序回归；Fisher散度与最小二乘的等价性；双下降理论。
AI.method: 在正交基下对读出系数施加全局-局部先验，通过边际似然在单调性约束下估计局部方差轮廓，利用PAVA算法（线性时间）求解，得到闭式收缩规则（推广Ridge和Stein正部估计）。在去噪分数匹配中，利用Fisher散度等于系数平方误差的性质，以及扩散边际为数据与高斯噪声卷积的特性，保证有序方差轮廓自然成立。
AI.findings: （1）有序经验贝叶斯在无调参情况下，在所有过参数化比例和扩散噪声调度下将Fisher散度稳定控制在≈0.32；而最小范数估计的Fisher散度在插值阈值处爆炸12个数量级。（2）该方法通过将有效自由度限制在信号维度，自动避免了无岭回归插值在p≈n处的分数估计爆炸（双下降现象）。（3）计算成本比交叉验证岭回归低约5倍，且后者因验证目标方差为1/σ²而本身不可靠。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）首次将有序经验贝叶斯框架引入分数匹配生成模型的正则化问题。（2）证明了该估计量在Fisher散度下具有自适应近极小最优性，并通过标准分数到KL界限控制了生成质量。（3）从理论上解释了双下降现象，并提供了无需调参的解决方案。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）提供了一种完全无需超参数调优的分数匹配正则化方法，大幅降低计算成本（约5倍）。（2）稳定地解决了过参数化场景下分数估计爆炸的实际问题，使模型在不同噪声水平和参数化比例下均能保持稳定的生成性能。

title: The Wald Reciprocal of ξ is a Harmonic Mean
affiliations: University of Chicago - Booth School of Business

detail.title: The Wald Reciprocal of ξ is a Harmonic Mean
detail.abstract: Riemann's incomplete gamma continuation presents the Pólya law U , the probability law whose characteristic function is  a location-scale mixture: a Gamma(2) scale mixture translated by the theta shift b n = log πn 2 and averaged over the cell index. This paper does two things with that representation. First, it identifies the law itself. The Esscher tilt of U by-1 2 , the shift that carries the critical line to the edge of the strip, is exactly the logarithm of 2/π times the maximum of the normalized Brownian excursion; and it is the logarithm of 2/π times the Kolmogorov-Smirnov statistic plus an independent logarithm of a Uniform(1, 2) variable, the uniform factor being precisely the alternating-toplain zeta correction. Both identities are proved by a two-line Mellin computation and verified numerically to 10-15 and 10-6. The Pólya density itself is strictly positive, with doubly exponential tails; what vanishes is its characteristic function, at the ordinates γ k , and a four-panel figure separates the two facts. Second, the paper analyses the Wald reciprocal.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示Riemann不完全Gamma延拓中的Pólya分布U本质上是：经-1/2 Esscher变换后等于归一化布朗游程最大值的对数变换（乘以2/π），也等于Kolmogorov-Smirnov统计量对数与独立均匀变量对数之和。论文还分析了Wald互反关系，并通过数值验证和四格图展示了该分布密度为正、特征函数在某些点为零的双重特性。
AI.research_question: Riemann不完全Gamma延拓中Pólya分布U的统计识别及其与经典概率分布（布朗游程、Kolmogorov-Smirnov统计量）之间的精确对应关系。
AI.motivation: 解析数论中的Pólya分布长期未被识别为已知概率分布，本文旨在揭示其与概率论中经典对象的深层联系，并澄清其密度为正与特征函数在某些点为零这一看似矛盾的事实。
AI.theoretical_framework: Riemann ζ函数的Gamma延拓；Pólya分布；Esscher变换；布朗游程；Kolmogorov-Smirnov统计量；Mellin变换。
AI.method: Esscher变换（指数倾斜）；Mellin变换计算（两行推导）；数值验证（10^-15至10^-6精度）；四格图可视化。
AI.findings: (1) Pólya分布U经-1/2 Esscher变换后等于log(2/π·布朗游程最大值)；(2) 也等于log(2/π·Kolmogorov-Smirnov统计量)与独立Uniform(1,2)对数之和；(3) Pólya密度严格正且具双指数尾部，但其特征函数在纵坐标γ_k处为零。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将解析数论中的Pólya分布与概率论中布朗游程最大值和Kolmogorov-Smirnov统计量建立精确等价关系，架起了数论与概率论的桥梁。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解Riemann ζ函数临界线的概率意义提供了新视角；Pólya分布的双指数尾部及其特征函数零点结构可应用于相关统计检验和数值计算。

title: A Tutorial on Generative Bayesian Computation
affiliations: University of Chicago - Booth School of Business and George Mason University

detail.title: A Tutorial on Generative Bayesian Computation
detail.abstract: Generative Bayesian Computation (GBC) recasts posterior inference as a supervised-learning problem. Rather than iterating a Markov chain to sample from a posterior, GBC learns a map-a deep neural network-that transports draws from a simple base distribution to the posterior of interest, evaluated at the observed data. The method is simulation-based and density-free: it requires only the ability to simulate parameter-data pairs, and never evaluates a likelihood. This tutorial gives a self-contained account of the generative principle (noise outsourcing), the quantile-neural-network architecture that serves as its workhorse, the training algorithm and its amortization property, approximation guarantees, and practical guidance on base distributions, summary statistics, and diagnostics. We validate the method on a conjugate Gaussian model with a closed-form posterior and on the g-and-k distribution, a likelihood-free benchmark with no tractable density, where GBC recovers the parameters and passes simulation-based calibration. We summarize a growing suite of applications: likelihood-free (simulation-based) inference, maximum expected utility and portfolio choice, causal inference, prediction, surrogate modeling for expensive computer experiments, and hyperparameter learning. The tutorial is meant to be read alongside our textbook Bayes, AI and Deep Learning: Foundations of Data Science (Polson and Sokolov, 2026c) and our forthcoming companion volume on generative methods and surrogate modeling (Polson and Sokolov, 2026d), both from Chapman & Hall/CRC.

AI.tldr: 本文系统介绍了生成式贝叶斯计算（GBC）方法，将后验推断重新定义为监督学习问题，通过深度神经网络学习从简单基础分布到后验分布的映射，无需迭代马尔可夫链或评估似然函数，并提供完整的方法论教程与应用综述。
AI.research_question: 如何利用深度神经网络和生成式方法，将贝叶斯后验推断转化为监督学习问题，从而避免传统MCMC的迭代计算和似然函数评估？
AI.motivation: 传统贝叶斯计算依赖MCMC采样，计算效率低且需要显式似然函数，难以处理复杂模型和大规模数据。GBC通过模拟-学习范式提供了一种密度无关、计算高效的替代方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 生成原理（噪声外包）、分位数神经网络架构、摊销推理、仿真校准理论。
AI.method: 基于模拟的监督学习方法：生成参数-数据对，训练深度神经网络（分位数神经网络）将基础分布映射到后验分布，通过噪声外包原理实现。
AI.findings: 在共轭高斯模型（存在封闭形式后验）和g-and-k分布（无易处理密度）上验证了方法的有效性，通过了仿真校准检验。总结了在似然自由推断、投资组合选择、因果推断、预测、替代建模、超参数学习等领域的应用。
AI.theory_contributions: 将后验推断重新概念化为生成式监督学习问题，提供了GBC方法的完整理论框架，包括近似保证和诊断准则。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一套即用型方法论，包括基础分布选择、汇总统计和诊断的实践指导，为似然自由推断、资产定价、因果推断等实际场景提供了高效计算工具。

title: Bayesian Sparsity: From Dantzig and Markowitz to Non-Gaussian Data Augmentation
affiliations: University of Chicago - Booth School of Business and George Mason University

detail.title: Bayesian Sparsity: From Dantzig and Markowitz to Non-Gaussian Data Augmentation
detail.abstract: The Dantzig selector of Candès and Tao (2007) crowned a research program-begun in Candès and Tao (2005)-that recovers sparse signals by linear programming, honoring George Dantzig, whose simplex method made such programs solvable, and drawing on a computational tradition in which sparsity was first an engineering resource: Markowitz's minimal-fill pivot rule for the elimination form of the inverse. We revisit this program from a fully Bayesian standpoint. We trace the lineage from Dantzig's linear programming and Markowitz's portfolio and sparse-matrix work to modern ℓ 1 recovery, and then place the Dantzig selector inside the regularization hierarchy running from Tikhonov to global-local shrinkage. Three structural conclusions emerge. First, the Dantzig selector is the mode of no posterior: its score constraint is a limited-information device, and a proximal-operator analysis shows its estimating map-exactly soft-thresholding in orthogonal designs-can never be a posterior mean under any proper prior. Second, moderate deviation principles do apply, and indeed constitute the calibration theory of sparse thresholds: the universal √ 2 log p level is a moderate-deviation quantile fixed at the worst case, whereas the Bayesian two-groups threshold log{(1-θ)/θ} learns the moderate-deviation zone from the data, which is why adaptive posteriors attain the sharper s log(p/s) rate. Third, the variancemean mixture data augmentation framework of Polson and Scott extends coherent sparse inference beyond Gaussian likelihoods: conditionally Gaussian representations of logistic, and support vector objectives reduce each posterior sweep to a Tikhonov-regularized least squares solve. A controlled sparse logistic regression experiment-Pólya-Gamma horseshoe sampling against an iteratively reweighted Dantzig selector and cross-validated ℓ 1 logistic regression-shows the Bayesian method delivering superior estimation accuracy, competitive prediction, and the only calibrated uncertainty in the field.

AI.tldr: 本文从完全贝叶斯视角重新审视Dantzig选择器，追溯了从线性规划、稀疏矩阵到ℓ1恢复的学术谱系，论证了Dantzig选择器是"无后验的众数"（无法在任意恰当先验下成为后验均值），并展示了贝叶斯两群组阈值方法如何达到更优的s log(p/s)收敛速率，最终通过稀疏逻辑回归实验证明了贝叶斯方法在估计精度、预测校准和不确定性量化上的优势。
AI.research_question: 从完全贝叶斯视角看，Dantzig选择器在统计推断中处于什么理论位置？其与贝叶斯收缩方法在理论性质和实践表现上有何根本差异？
AI.motivation: Dantzig选择器是稀疏信号恢复的重要方法，但其理论基础与贝叶斯范式的关系尚未被系统厘清。本文旨在填补这一空白，通过追溯学术谱系和严格理论分析，阐明Dantzig选择器的贝叶斯解释局限性，并展示贝叶斯替代方案的理论优势。
AI.theoretical_framework: 正则化层级理论（从Tikhonov到全局-局部收缩）、中偏差原理、方差-均值混合数据增广框架（Polson & Scott）、近端算子分析。
AI.method: 理论分析（近端算子、中偏差原理）与实证研究（稀疏逻辑回归实验：Pólya-Gamma马蹄采样 vs. 迭代重加权Dantzig选择器 vs. 交叉验证ℓ1逻辑回归）。
AI.findings: (1) Dantzig选择器是"无后验的众数"：其得分约束是有限信息工具，在正交设计中映射恰好是软阈值，但无法在任何恰当先验下成为后验均值；(2) 贝叶斯两群组阈值log{(1-θ)/θ}从数据中学习中偏差区域，达到更优的s log(p/s)速率；(3) 实验显示贝叶斯马蹄方法在估计精度、预测校准和不确定性量化上均优于Dantzig选择器和交叉验证ℓ1逻辑回归。
AI.theory_contributions: (1) 首次严格论证Dantzig选择器无法在任意恰当先验下成为后验均值，将其定位为"无后验的众数"；(2) 揭示了中偏差原理作为稀疏阈值校准理论的基础，并对比了频率学派通用阈值与贝叶斯自适应阈值的理论差异；(3) 将方差-均值混合数据增广框架扩展到逻辑回归和支持向量机目标，实现超越高斯似然的相干稀疏推断。
AI.practical_contributions: (1) 为高维稀疏逻辑回归问题提供了Pólya-Gamma马蹄采样这一实用的贝叶斯解决方案，在估计精度和不确定性校准上优于传统ℓ1方法；(2) 通过实验验证了贝叶斯方法在实际应用中的竞争力，特别是在需要校准不确定性的场景下具有明显优势。

title: Location and Scale Mixtures of Gamma(2) Densities for ξ( 1/2 + s)
affiliations: University of Chicago - Booth School of Business

detail.title: Location and Scale Mixtures of Gamma(2) Densities for ξ( 1/2 + s)
detail.abstract: Each Gamma(2) scale mixture is infinitely divisible, so its transform is zero free; the zeros of ξ come only from the location mixture that assembles the blocks, translated by the theta shifts log(πn 2). This note collects the methods available for such a sum, the reality of zeros theorems for location mixtures, the deformation of the sum into a real rooted class, the total positivity of the summed kernel, the conversion of the sum into a convolution, and the positivity criteria equivalent to the hypothesis, and locates where each halts. The zero freeness of the summands is unconditional; the admissibility of the location structure is the hypothesis. The five families meet it as three faces of one obstruction: the shifts are not admissible, the collapsed mixing measure is signed, and the summed kernel is not a Pólya frequency function. The reciprocal Thorin form of the block representation (Theorem 2) is stated and proved in full from a single compensation identity. The construction is unconditional: it needs only that each block B n be infinitely divisible, which Kristiansen supplies from g_n ≥ 0 so that the Lévy density ℓ_n ≥ 0; hyperbolic complete monotonicity is not required. Each cell acquires a reciprocal Thorin density V_n ≥ 0, produced from ℓ_n by the 2 sin^2 transform with the weight x ℓ_n (x) from the barrier level of the first passage identity, and the completed zeta is the sum over n of the reciprocal Thorin cells. No primal per-block Thorin measure enters. The single assembled measure is not the sum of the V_n : it is discrete, supported on the ordinates, and is the subject of Theorem 3, positive exactly under the Hypothesis. A Stieltjes proposition (Proposition 4) records what the block sum forces: products of the blocks keep their zeros real while the sum does not, the difference being the arithmetic phase carried by the theta weights. Theorem 4 then delimits the real axis route to the dual positivity: the first twenty two rungs of its complete monotonicity ladder hold unconditionally, the first 10 12 on the verified spectrum, yet the ladder is blind to any individual off line zero, so the certifying inequality is the Pick sign off the axis and the rungs are zero density statements. Companion notes. Four linked notes treat one object, the Wald couple for Xi: (I) A Positive Representation and Wald Couple, on the positive Pólya density, the Gamma(2) scale mixture, the location of the hypothesis, and the hyperbolic complete monotonicity and Lee-Yang obstructions; (II) The Reciprocal of Xi, on the dual member 1/ξ, its lack of a density, the dual variable H and its density f H , and the Möbius signed mixture; (III) De Bruijn's Theorem and the Gamma(2) Mixture, on the bound Λ ≤ 1 2 and where it stops; and (IV) Handling the Sum, on the methods for the location mixture and where each halts. The present note is (IV), with the Theorem 2 proof and Proposition 4 incorporated.

AI.tldr: 本文是系列笔记的第四部分（IV），系统分析了Gamma(2)尺度混合的位置混合和。每块Gamma(2)尺度混合是无限可分的，其变换无零点；零点仅来自位置混合（由theta位移log(π_n^2)平移）。本文整理了可用于此类求和的多种方法，包括位置混合的零点实性定理、求和的实根类变形、求和核的全正性、求和的卷积转换以及等价于假设的正性判据，并定位了每种方法的停滞之处。核心定理2给出了块表示的倒易Thorin形式，定理3给出了组装测度的正性条件，定理4界定了对偶正性的实轴路径。
AI.research_question: 如何分析Gamma(2)尺度混合的位置混合和ξ的零点分布、正性条件及其数学结构？
AI.motivation: 理解位置混合和中零点产生的机制，以及各种分析方法（如零点实性定理、全正性、卷积转换等）适用的边界。
AI.theoretical_framework: 无限可分性、Gamma(2)尺度混合、位置混合、倒易Thorin表示、全正性（Pólya频率函数）、完全单调性、Pick符号、Stieltjes命题
AI.method: （1）定理2：基于单一补偿恒等式的倒易Thorin块表示；（2）定理3：离散组装测度的正性条件；（3）命题4：Stieltjes记录块求和迫使的乘积与求和零点差异；（4）定理4：完全单调性阶梯的前22阶无条件成立，前10-12阶在验证谱上成立
AI.findings: （1）加项的无零点性是无条件的，位置结构的可容性是假设；（2）五个族系归结为三个阻碍面：位移不可容、坍缩混合测度带符号、求和核不是Pólya频率函数；（3）每块获得倒易Thorin密度V_n≥0，由Lévy密度经2 sin²变换和首达恒等式的屏障水平生成；（4）组装测度非V_n之和，而是离散的、支撑在纵坐标上；（5）乘积保持零点实性而求和不能，差异在于theta权重携带的算术相位
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了倒易Thorin形式的块表示（定理2），将无限可分性与位置混合结构相结合；给出了组装测度的正性判据（定理3）；揭示了完全单调性阶梯对离轴零点的盲目性，指出认证不等式是轴外Pick符号
AI.practical_contributions: 为分析Gamma(2)尺度混合的位置混合和提供了系统的方法论框架，明确了各种分析方法的适用边界和停滞点，有助于相关领域的实际计算和验证工作

title: Perplexity is a Large Deviation: A Sanov Interpretation of the Cross-Entropy Loss
affiliations: University of Chicago - Booth School of Business and

detail.title: Perplexity is a Large Deviation: A Sanov Interpretation of the Cross-Entropy Loss
detail.abstract: Perplexity is the standard yardstick for probabilistic predictors, from n-gram models to large language models, yet it is usually presented as a bookkeeping device: the exponentiated average log-loss. We give it a probabilistic identity. Via the method of types, the log-perplexity of a sample under a model q splits exactly into the entropy of the empirical type and the Kullback-Leibler divergence from that type to q, and the second piece is precisely the Sanov rate function governing how rarely q would have generated such data. Perplexity therefore charges a predictor for two distinct things: the irreducible randomness of the source (a counting term) and its own misspecification (a rarity term). Because log-perplexity is a linear functional of the type, its entire deviation theory reduces to the one-dimensional cumulant generating function of the log-loss: the central limit, moderate-deviation, and large-deviation regimes are the successive Taylor data of a single convex function, the Sanov minimiser is an explicit exponential tilt obeying a Pythagorean identity, and model selection by perplexity errs at the Chernoff rate. We develop these connections at length, with complete proofs and extensive interpretation, extend the decomposition to Markov sources via conditional types, situate the picture within the de Finetti-Sanov synthesis, and close with a fully worked numerical illustration.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了困惑度（Perplexity）的概率本质：困惑度可精确分解为经验类型的熵（数据本身的不可压缩随机性）与从该类型到模型的KL散度（模型误设的稀有性）之和。后者正是Sanov大偏差速率函数，控制着模型生成该类数据的罕见概率。论文完整推导了这一分解及其在大偏差、中偏差、中心极限定理等偏差理论中的统一框架。
AI.research_question: 困惑度作为概率预测模型的衡量标准，其概率本质是什么？它如何分解为有意义的统计量？
AI.motivation: 困惑度虽被广泛用作概率预测模型（从n-gram到大型语言模型）的标准评价指标，但通常仅被视为记录平均对数损失的簿记工具，缺乏深刻的概率解释。本文旨在为困惑度建立概率恒等式，揭示其内在统计结构。
AI.theoretical_framework: 核心理论框架包括：类型方法（Method of Types）、熵（Entropy）、KL散度（Kullback-Leibler Divergence）、Sanov定理（大偏差理论）、指数倾斜（Exponential Tilt）、毕达哥拉斯恒等式（Pythagorean Identity）、Chernoff速率、条件类型方法（针对马尔可夫源）、de Finetti-Sanov综合框架。
AI.method: 采用信息论与大偏差理论的数学分析方法：通过类型方法将对数困惑度分解为熵与KL散度之和；利用Sanov定理赋予KL散度项大偏差速率函数的意义；通过累积量生成函数统一中心极限、中偏差和大偏差三个偏差区间；使用指数倾斜显式求解Sanov最小化问题。
AI.findings: 1. 对数困惑度可精确分解为H(P̂) + D(P̂‖q)，分别对应数据的不可压缩随机性和模型的误设程度；2. D(P̂‖q)正是Sanov大偏差速率函数，衡量模型生成当前观测数据的罕见程度；3. 所有偏差区间（CLT、中偏差、大偏差）统一于对数损失的单变量累积量生成函数的泰勒展开；4. Sanov最小化解为指数倾斜分布，满足毕达哥拉斯恒等式；5. 基于困惑度的模型选择错误率由Chernoff速率控制；6. 该分解可扩展至马尔可夫源（通过条件类型）。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次为困惑度提供了严格的概率恒等式，将其从经验性簿记指标提升为具有深刻统计意义的量；2. 建立了困惑度与大偏差理论的系统联系，揭示了模型评估与稀有事件概率的内在关联；3. 统一了困惑度在不同偏差区间（CLT、中偏差、大偏差）下的行为，为模型比较提供了完整的偏差理论框架；4. 将de Finetti可交换性观点与Sanov大偏差理论综合，丰富了贝叶斯非参数推断的理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为机器学习从业者提供了理解困惑度的全新视角：低困惑度可能源于数据本身低熵，而不一定是模型拟合好；2. 为模型选择提供了理论指导：困惑度差异的统计显著性可由Chernoff速率量化；3. 提供了一套完整的数学工具，可用于分析模型误设程度、评估预测不确定性；4. 为语言模型评估提供了更严谨的统计基础，帮助从业者正确解读困惑度数值的含义与局限性。

title: Synaptic Subset Selection: Biological Learning as Zero-Order Proximal Optimization
affiliations: University of Chicago - Booth School of Business and George Mason University

detail.title: Synaptic Subset Selection: Biological Learning as Zero-Order Proximal Optimization
detail.abstract: Biological neural networks do not compute gradients by backpropagation. Instead, they learn through local, spike-timing-dependent rules modulated by a global reward signal. Schmidt-Hieber (2023) showed that such Hebbian, reward-modulated updates are best understood as a zero-order (derivative-free) optimization method: the stochasticity of spike trains supplies a random search direction, and the reward acts as a noisy directional finite difference. We take this interpretation one step further. The brain is not merely optimizing a loss; it optimizes a loss under a severe sparsity constraint, continuously pruning synapses so that only a small subset of connections survives. This is exactly the subset selection problem. We show that when the zero-order update of Schmidt-Hieber (2023) is composed with a sparsity penalty, the resulting rule is a proximal algorithm in the sense of Polson et al. (2015) and Polson and Sun (2019): the noisy Hebbian step plays the role of the gradient step, and synaptic pruning plays the role of the ℓ 0 hard-thresholding step. The biological "use it or lose it" principle is precisely the Single Best Replacement operator of Bayesian ℓ 0 regularization. We formalize this correspondence, prove an expectation identity relating the smoothed proximal zero-order iterate to a penalized gradient flow, and demonstrate on a sparse recovery problem that a biologically plausible proximal zero-order rule recovers the correct support while retaining an exactly sparse, prunable network. Because the zero-order expectations are low-dimensional integrals, they are ideally accelerated by quasi-Monte Carlo: randomized Halton sequences (Halton, 1960; Owen, 2017) recover the O(N-1) rate, improving on the O(N-1/2) Monte Carlo rate by up to two orders of magnitude for the reward-baseline and Gaussian-smoothing subproblems. The synthesis places biological learning, proximal statistics, and fast computation within a single generative Bayesian framework (Polson and Sokolov, 2017a, 2020, 2023a).

AI.tldr: 本文提出生物神经网络中的赫布可塑性结合突触修剪，等价于一种近端零阶优化算法，其中随机脉冲发放提供搜索方向，奖赏信号充当噪声差分，突触修剪对应ℓ0硬阈值操作。该框架统一了生物学习、近端统计与快速计算。
AI.research_question: 如何从优化算法角度统一理解生物神经网络中的奖赏调制赫布可塑性（Reward-modulated Hebbian plasticity）与突触修剪（Synaptic pruning）机制？
AI.motivation: 生物神经网络不依赖反向传播计算梯度，而是通过局部脉冲时序依赖可塑性和全局奖赏信号学习。同时，大脑在稀疏性约束下持续修剪突触。现有理论尚未将这两种机制统一到一个优化框架中。
AI.theoretical_framework: 零阶优化（Derivative-free optimization）、近端算法（Proximal algorithm）、贝叶斯ℓ0正则化（Bayesian ℓ0 regularization）、准蒙特卡洛方法（Quasi-Monte Carlo）
AI.method: 理论推导：将奖赏调制赫布更新视为零阶优化，将突触修剪视为ℓ0硬阈值近端算子，证明两者组合等价于近端零阶算法。数值实验：在稀疏恢复问题上验证该生物可信规则的正确支持恢复能力，并使用随机化Halton序列加速零阶期望的低维积分计算。
AI.findings: 1. 奖赏调制赫布步长对应梯度步，突触修剪对应ℓ0硬阈值步，二者组合等价于近端零阶算法；2. "用进废退"原则对应贝叶斯ℓ0正则化的单次最佳替换算子；3. 建立了平滑近端零阶迭代与惩罚梯度流之间的期望恒等式；4. 随机化Halton序列可恢复O(N⁻¹)收敛速率，比蒙特卡洛O(N⁻¹/²)快两个数量级。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将生物学习统一到近端统计和贝叶斯ℓ0正则化的理论框架中；2. 揭示了"用进废退"原则与单次最佳替换算子的等价性；3. 证明了近端零阶迭代与惩罚梯度流之间的期望恒等式。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为神经科学提供了一个可计算的优化视角，解释大脑如何高效学习；2. 准蒙特卡洛加速方法可将计算效率提升两个数量级，适用于奖赏基线和高斯平滑子问题。

title: Generative Bayesian Computation for Prediction-Powered Inference
affiliations: University of Chicago - Booth School of Business, George Mason University and

detail.title: Generative Bayesian Computation for Prediction-Powered Inference
detail.abstract: Prediction-powered inference (PPI) combines a small gold-standard labeled sample with a large unlabeled sample scored by a black-box predictor, correcting the predictor's bias through a rectifier measured on labeled data. We recast PPI as posterior transport. The missing labels on the unlabeled set are treated as latent quantities and imputed by a learned conditional generative map, and the posterior over the estimand is the pushforward of a base measure through that map and the estimating equation. This is the Generative Bayesian Computation (GBC) construction applied to a missing-label problem. The additive rectifier of classical PPI, the power-tuning parameter of PPI++, Rubin's multiple imputation, and the augmentation term of doubly-robust estimation all appear as reductions of a single transport map: classical PPI is the feature-free mean-shift map, PPI++ is a shrinkage of the map toward the surrogate, multiple imputation is the map itself with a proper between-map variance, and the augmented inverse propensity weighted estimator is the Bayesian analogue with a labeling indicator whose propensity is known by design. Unlike linear corrections, the learned map captures nonlinear and heteroskedastic surrogate-totruth structure directly, so the stratified and filtered variants of PPI become choices of map class rather than separate methods. We give the transport formulation, prove the reductions, connect the construction to the semiparametric efficiency bound of the model that conditions on the surrogate, and provide an algorithm. We are explicit about the three places where the method can fail: honest extrapolation beyond labeled support, correct propagation of map uncertainty for calibration, and the price of a rich map relative to the PPI++ efficiency guarantee. When the map class contains the affine map, GBC-PPI inherits the guarantee that it is asymptotically no worse than the labeled-only estimator.

AI.tldr: 本文将预测驱动推断（PPI）重新表述为后验运输问题，将缺失标签视为潜在变量，通过条件生成映射进行插补，并证明经典PPI、PPI++、多重插补和双稳健估计均可归结为同一运输映射的不同简化形式。该方法能捕捉非线性异质结构，并明确指出了三条失败路径。
AI.research_question: 如何将预测驱动推断（PPI）统一重新表述为后验运输框架，并揭示其与现有方法（PPI++、多重插补、双稳健估计）之间的内在联系？
AI.motivation: 现有PPI方法及其变体（如PPI++、分层PPI、过滤PPI）看似各异，缺乏统一的理论框架。作者希望证明这些方法本质上都是同一后验运输框架的不同简化，从而揭示深层结构并指导方法选择。
AI.theoretical_framework: 后验运输（Posterior Transport）、生成贝叶斯计算（Generative Bayesian Computation, GBC）、半参数效率界（Semiparametric Efficiency Bound）、多重插补（Multiple Imputation）、双稳健估计（Doubly Robust Estimation）
AI.method: 将缺失标签视为潜在变量，通过条件生成映射（learned conditional generative map）进行插补，将目标量的后验分布定义为该映射和估计方程对基测度的推前（pushforward）。通过理论推导证明经典PPI、PPI++、多重插补、增广逆概率加权估计器（AIPW）均为该运输映射的特定简化形式。
AI.findings: (1) 经典PPI是特征无关的均值平移映射；(2) PPI++是该映射向替代变量的收缩；(3) 多重插补是该映射本身加上适当的映射间方差；(4) AIPW是贝叶斯类比加上倾向得分已知的标签指示变量；(5) 分层和过滤PPI成为映射类别的选择而非独立方法；(6) 该方法有三个失败场景：标记支持之外的外推、映射不确定性校准、丰富映射相对PPI++效率保证的代价。
AI.theory_contributions: (1) 首次将PPI统一为后验运输框架；(2) 证明线性校正方法（PPI、PPI++）和插补方法（多重插补、AIPW）是同一运输映射的简化；(3) 连接该构造与条件替代模型的半参数效率界；(4) 当映射类包含仿射映射时，GBC-PPI继承渐近不劣于仅标签估计量的保证。
AI.practical_contributions: (1) 提供了一种能捕捉非线性异质结构的PPI方法，无需依赖线性校正；(2) 将分层和过滤PPI统一为映射类选择，简化了方法选择；(3) 明确指出了方法失败的三条路径，为实践者提供了使用边界和注意事项。

title: The Bregman-Dantzig Selector: Restoring Likelihood Geometry to Sparse Estimation
affiliations: University of Chicago - Booth School of Business and George Mason University

detail.title: The Bregman-Dantzig Selector: Restoring Likelihood Geometry to Sparse Estimation
detail.abstract: The Dantzig selector minimizes the ℓ 1 norm subject to an ℓ ∞ bound on the score. We ask what happens when its ad hoc score geometry is replaced by the likelihood's own geometry-the Bregman divergence generated by the negative log-likelihood-and we answer completely. First, an alignment analysis isolates exactly what the Dantzig vertex lacks: the complementary slackness between primal signs and dual scores that characterizes every posterior mode; in dimensions p ≤ 2 the defect is vacuous and the Dantzig selector coincides with the LASSO, while for p ≥ 3 we exhibit instances where the vertex carries the wrong sign against its own score. Second, a collapse theorem: because the Bregman divergence of any smooth convex loss from its unconstrained minimizer is the loss, both Bregman-penalized and Bregman-ball (likelihood-ratio region) variants of the Dantzig selector reduce identically to the penalized-likelihood family-for exponential family models, with the deviance as the divergence. There is no coherent third way on the mode side. Third, a no-mean theorem in full generality: the Dantzig selector's estimating map is piecewise affine and nonlinear in the data, hence cannot be the posterior mean under any proper prior in any design-extending the known orthogonal-design obstruction. The coherent mean-side completion is given by Tweedie's formula in the X ⊤ X metric, under which every posterior mean is a Bregman-proximal operator of an implied penalty. Finally, we connect the Gauss-Dantzig refit to Bregman iteration: in orthogonal designs two Bregman iterations reproduce the refit exactly outside a boundary band, replacing its discontinuity with a continuous inverse-scale-space flow, and simulations show the flow's debiasing minimum matching the refit while the horseshoe posterior mean dominates both.

AI.tldr: 本文系统性地批判了Dantzig选择器的得分几何缺陷，证明其与似然几何（Bregman散度）不兼容，并证明了三个核心定理：对齐分析揭示其对偶互补松弛缺失、坍塌定理表明Bregman变体等价于惩罚似然族、无均值定理表明其估计映射不能是任何适当先验下的后验均值，最终连接了Gauss-Dantzig重拟与Bregman迭代，展示了连续逆尺度空间流的去偏优势。
AI.research_question: 当Dantzig选择器中的ℓ∞得分几何被负对数似然生成的Bregman散度替代时，会发生什么？Dantzig选择器的估计在几何和统计性质上有何根本性缺陷？
AI.motivation: Dantzig选择器作为LASSO的替代方法被广泛使用，但其使用的ℓ∞得分约束是一种特别且缺乏似然几何动机的几何。作者试图从似然几何视角系统性揭示Dantzig选择器的缺陷，并探索更合理的替代框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 似然几何、Bregman散度、对偶互补松弛、后验众数与后验均值、Tweedie公式、Bregman迭代与逆尺度空间流
AI.method: 理论证明（对齐分析、坍塌定理、无均值定理）、模拟验证
AI.findings: (1) Dantzig顶点缺乏原始符号与对偶得分之间的互补松弛，在p≥3时可能出现符号完全颠倒的病理情形；(2) Bregman散度惩罚和Bregman球（似然比区域）变体均坍缩为惩罚似然族，不存在第三种方式；(3) Dantzig选择器的估计映射是分段仿射且非线性的，不能是任何适当先验下的后验均值；(4) 在正交设计中，两次Bregman迭代可精确复现Gauss-Dantzig重拟，且其连续流在去偏和均方误差上优于重拟，但不及马蹄后验均值。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次从似然几何角度系统揭示了Dantzig选择器的根本性缺陷，证明了其对偶互补松弛缺失、Bregman变体的坍塌性质以及无后验均值解释性，并建立了与Tweedie公式和Bregman迭代的理论联系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为高维统计推断提供了理论指导：建议实践者避免使用Dantzig选择器，转而使用具有似然几何一致性的惩罚似然方法或基于Bregman迭代的去偏方法；展示了马蹄后验均值在去偏和预测中的优越性。

title: A Market-Based Cost of Capital
affiliations: University of Chicago - Booth School of Business, University of Chicago - Booth School of Business and Yale University

detail.title: A Market-Based Cost of Capital
detail.abstract: A firm's cost of capital is a central object in economics. It is often defined based on the expected long-run returns on the firm's assets in financial markets, but these expected returns are unobserved and there exists no method that delivers unbiased estimates out of sample. We provide a method that uses machine learning to predict future cash flows of firms and then derives long-run expected returns from observed market prices and the present value identity. We show that this method works better than predicting returns directly if the model determining cash flows is more stable than that determining expected returns, a condition that holds empirically. The resulting estimates are unbiased out of sample and have greater predictive power than existing alternatives. We use them to construct a firm-level "market-based cost of capital" (MCC). Consistent with the standard prediction that firms maximize their market value by using expected returns as their cost of capital, we find that firms whose perceived cost of capital is closer to the MCC have higher market values.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种利用机器学习预测企业未来现金流、进而从市场价格和现值恒等式推导长期预期收益的方法（MCC），该方法在样本外无偏且预测力优于直接预测收益的现有方法，并证实采用接近MCC的资本成本能提升企业市场价值。
AI.research_question: 如何从市场价格和现金流预测中推导出企业资本成本（预期长期回报率）的无偏估计？
AI.motivation: 企业的资本成本是经济学核心概念，但预期回报率不可观测，且现有方法无法在样本外给出无偏估计。
AI.theoretical_framework: 现值恒等式（present value identity）、企业价值最大化理论（企业使用预期回报率作为资本成本以最大化市场价值）。
AI.method: 使用机器学习预测企业未来现金流，再结合市场价格与现值恒等式反向推导长期预期回报率（MCC）。
AI.findings: （1）该方法在现金流预测模型比预期收益模型更稳定时（实证中成立），优于直接预测收益；（2）MCC在样本外无偏且预测力优于现有替代指标；（3）企业的感知资本成本越接近MCC，其市场价值越高。
AI.theory_contributions: 为资本成本估计提供了新的理论框架——通过现金流预测而非收益预测来获取无偏估计；验证了企业价值最大化理论的实证预测。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业管理者提供了一个无偏、预测力更强的资本成本度量指标（MCC），可用于投资决策、估值与绩效评估。

reference: TIAA Institute Research Paper Series Forthcoming
title: On the Margins of Mainstream Finance: Alternative Financial Service use Among Retirees in the United States

detail.title: On the Margins of Mainstream Finance: Alternative Financial Service use Among Retirees in the United States

publicationDetails.detailsText: TIAA Institute Research Paper Series Forthcoming

detail.abstract: This paper examines alternative financial service use among retirees over the age of 60 using the Federal Reserve Board's 2023 Survey of Household Economics and Decisionmaking. Alternative financial services (AFS) are financial products provided outside traditional, federally insured banks and credit unions, including payday loans, check cashing, pawnshops, and auto-title loans. They often serve low-to-moderate-income households or those with limited credit access, but they typically feature higher fees and interest rates than mainstream banking. In 2023, 9% of retirees were underbanked, maintaining bank accounts yet using AFS such as money orders, check cashing, and payday loans. This paper advocates for improved data collection to distinguish between sporadic and chronic AFS use, which is essential for identifying retirees most at risk and designing appropriate interventions.

AI.tldr: 基于2023年美联储数据，研究60岁以上退休人员使用替代性金融服务（AFS）的情况，发现9%的退休人员属于"underbanked"群体，呼吁改进数据收集以区分偶然性和慢性AFS使用。
AI.research_question: 60岁以上退休人员使用替代性金融服务的情况如何？哪些退休人员最容易陷入高风险AFS使用？
