detail.abstract: Background: State cigar taxes in the USA vary widely in structure and level, unlike cigarette taxes which are typically levied uniformly per pack. This complexity has limited the comparability of cigar tax levels across states, products, and time, and relative to other tobacco products. Methods: We create and publicly release a database of quarterly state and local cigar taxes from 2010 to 2024, standardised to per unit rates by cigar type. Matching Universal Product Code (UPC)-level cigar sales data from the NielsenIQ Retail Scanner Dataset to state and local tax rates by product type, we develop a method to translate heterogeneous cigar tax structures into standardised per unit equivalent tax rates for little, large, and premium cigars over time. Results: As of October 1, 2024, average state-level per unit cigar taxes were $0.06 for little cigars, $0.14 for large cigars, and $0.24 for premium cigars, reflecting increases of 31.2%, 19.2%, and 8.3% respectively, since October 1, 2010. On a per gram basis, average state taxes range from 77.8% of the cigarette tax for little cigars to 22.9% of the cigarette tax for premium cigars. Conclusions: By facilitating more accurate measurement of cigar taxation, the database presented here enables critical policy evaluations and tobacco control research.

AI.tldr: 本研究创建并公开了一个2010-2024年美国各州和地方雪茄税标准化的季度数据库，开发了将异构雪茄税结构转化为标准化单位税率的方法，并发现不同类型雪茄的税率差异显著且随时间呈不同幅度的增长。
AI.research_question: 如何将美国各州和地方多样化的雪茄税结构标准化，以便在不同产品类型、时间和地域之间进行可比性分析？
AI.motivation: 美国各州的雪茄税在结构和水平上差异很大，不像卷烟税那样统一按包征收，这种复杂性限制了跨州、跨产品和跨时间的雪茄税水平可比性，也限制了与其他烟草产品的比较，进而影响了政策评估和控烟研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 烟草税收政策、烟草控制经济学、税收标准化与可比性方法
AI.method: 构建2010-2024年各州和地方雪茄税标准化季度数据库；将NielsenIQ零售扫描数据集中的UPC级雪茄销售数据与各州和地方税率按产品类型匹配；开发将异构雪茄税结构转化为小、大、高档雪茄标准化单位等价税率的方法。
AI.findings: 截至2024年10月1日，各州平均单位雪茄税为：小雪茄0.06美元、大雪茄0.14美元、高档雪茄0.24美元，自2010年10月1日以来分别增长31.2%、19.2%和8.3%。按克计算，各州平均税率从小雪茄占卷烟税的77.8%到高档雪茄占22.9%不等。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了将异构雪茄税结构标准化为可比单位税率的方法论框架，填补了烟草税研究中雪茄税标准化方法的空白，为跨产品税收比较提供了方法论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 公开提供了2010-2024年标准化雪茄税数据库，使政策制定者和研究人员能够更准确地衡量雪茄税收水平，支持关键的政策评估和烟草控制研究。

title: KSE Sentinel: A Rule-Based Trend-Continuation Strategy for the Pakistan Stock Exchange (PSX)
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: KSE Sentinel: A Rule-Based Trend-Continuation Strategy for the Pakistan Stock Exchange (PSX)
detail.abstract: present KSE Sentinel, a fully rule-based, mechanically-defined trend-continuation strategy developed for the Pakistan Stock Exchange (PSX). The strategy formalizes a discretionary trading heuristic two consecutive same-direction candles closing on the trend-correct side of a short-period exponential moving average, with exit strictness conditioned on the prevailing trend regime into an auditable, mechanical rule set applied across a 30-symbol universe. We evaluate the strategy on 1,009 trades over an approximately five-year window (2021-2026), net of realistic transaction costs (commission, slippage, and spread totalling 22.5 basis points per leg), finding a 39.15% win rate, profit factor of 2.51, annualized Sharpe ratio of 2.08, and maximum drawdown of 2.91% in local currency terms. Consistent with the broader trend-following literature, returns are positively skewed: a minority of large winning trades drives the majority of profit, with average win size approximately 3.9 times average loss size. We address multiple-testing and selection bias directly using the Deflated Sharpe Ratio methodology of Bailey and López de Prado (2014), documenting an explicit floor on the number of prior trials considered. We further validate the strategy out-of-sample against an independent ~2000-2020 PSX historical archive, and distinct from purely backward-looking evidence report results from an ongoing 60-day live forward-paper validation program initiated July 2026, including real operational incidents caught and corrected during that window. We conclude with an honest discussion of currency risk (PKR-denominated returns are positive while USD-converted returns are negative over the sample period), capacity constraints, and the evolving Pakistani regulatory environment for algorithmic trading .

AI.tldr: 本文提出KSE Sentinel，一个基于规则、机械定义的趋势延续交易策略，应用于巴基斯坦证券交易所（PSX）。该策略将一种可自由裁量的交易启发式方法——连续两根同方向K线在短期指数移动平均线的趋势正确一侧收盘，并根据当前趋势制度设定退出严格性——形式化为可审计的机械规则集，在30只股票上执行。经过1009笔交易、五年窗口（2021-2026）的评估，扣除真实交易成本后，策略实现39.15%胜率、2.51盈亏比、2.08年化夏普比率、最大回撤2.91%。收益呈正偏态，少数大赢家驱动大部分利润。论文使用Deflated Sharpe Ratio解决多重检验和选择偏差，并在独立历史数据（约2000-2020）和60天实时前瞻性纸面交易验证中取得结果。最后诚实地讨论了汇率风险、容量约束和巴基斯坦算法交易监管环境。
AI.research_question: 如何将一种趋势延续交易启发式方法形式化为可审计、机械性的规则集，并在新兴市场（巴基斯坦证券交易所）中验证其有效性？
AI.motivation: 个人交易者的主观判断可能存在不一致性和情绪偏差，且学术文献中缺乏针对巴基斯坦等新兴市场的、完全基于规则的机械趋势跟踪策略的形式化定义和严格实证检验。
AI.theoretical_framework: 趋势跟踪理论、技术分析中的指数移动平均线逻辑、行为金融学中的处置效应和趋势外推偏差、以及Bailey和López de Prado（2014）的Deflated Sharpe Ratio多重检验校正方法。
AI.method: 完全基于规则的趋势延续策略（KSE Sentinel），在PSX 30只股票上执行，涵盖2021-2026年约1009笔交易。考虑22.5个基点的双向真实交易成本。使用Deflated Sharpe Ratio控制多重测试偏差。进行独立的历史样本外验证（约2000-2020）和60天实时前瞻性纸面交易验证。
AI.findings: 39.15%胜率、2.51盈亏比、2.08年化夏普比率、最大回撤仅2.91%。收益正偏态，平均盈利约为平均亏损的3.9倍。PKR计价收益为正，但USD计价收益在样本期内为负，揭示显著的汇率风险。实时验证期间捕获并纠正了实际运营事件。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将主观交易启发式形式化为完全可审计的机械规则集，弥合了实践与学术之间的鸿沟。2. 使用Deflated Sharpe Ratio为策略验证提供了严格的多重检验校正框架，设定了明确的先验试验次数下限。3. 在新兴市场（巴基斯坦）背景下验证了趋势跟踪策略的普适性，扩展了该领域的地域覆盖。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为巴基斯坦证券交易所提供了一套经过实证检验、可审计的机械交易策略。2. 报告了真实交易成本下的业绩指标，为实践者提供了现实参考。3. 公开讨论了汇率风险（PKR与USD回报差异）、容量约束和监管环境等实际部署中的关键障碍，为其他新兴市场的算法交易实践提供了警示和指引。4. 包含实时前瞻性验证和运营事件记录，增强了结果的可信度。

title: Transition Alpha: How Financial, Human and Planetary Returns Converge, and What Counts as Real

detail.title: Transition Alpha: How Financial, Human and Planetary Returns Converge, and What Counts as Real

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Joanne Flinn is Founder and Chair of the ESG Institute (Singapore), a Certified B Corporation that develops the ClearSight Intelligence and Greensight platforms referenced in this paper; these instruments and their underlying calibrations are available under commercial licence. The paper's findings are published in full; the proprietary calibrations are not. The author declares no other financial or personal relationships that could be perceived to have influenced this work.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants, patients, or personal data. It analyses publicly listed entities and published sources, and ethics approval was therefore not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external or grant funding. It was conducted and funded internally by the ESG Institute (Singapore).

detail.abstract: Under transition economics, the value an entity creates and the transition readiness risk it carries are not opposing quantities to be traded but a linked quantity: the capacity that creates the value is the capacity whose absence is the risk. Read this way, financial, human and planetary returns converge rather than trade off, and the question becomes which of the returns booked as value are real. Not all are. Value can be produced, or it can be extracted, taken from a stakeholder along the value chain and booked as though produced, in which case it is deferred transition readiness risk wearing the appearance of alpha. That distinction is the paper’s contribution, it is a finding about measurement, not a verdict on capitalism. Transition alpha is value created without drawing down a party the accounting has priced at zero, measured against a baseline that is not free but compounding in cost. The mechanism that lets extraction pass for alpha is an accounting one: conventional cost accounting prices some stakeholders at zero and presents the choice as objectivity. The costs so excluded do not vanish. They return to the holder when the boundary that hid them moves. The paper tests the distinction against the defence that extraction is offset by later return, and finds it neither reaches irreparable harm, nor fully repays a deferred one, nor reliably arrives. It sets out a boundary-and-flow basis for measuring value creation as distinct from the absence of risk.

AI.tldr: 本文提出，在转型经济学中，实体创造的价值与其承担的转型风险并非可交易的对立量，而是同一枚硬币的两面：创造价值的能力正是其缺失时构成风险的能力。以此视角，财务、人力与星球回报趋于收敛而非权衡。关键在于判断哪些被记为“价值”的回报是真实的。价值可被生产，也可被提取（从价值链上某利益相关方夺取后记为已生产），后者实为披着超额收益外衣的递延转型风险。该区分是本文的核心贡献——一个关于计量的发现，而非对资本主义的判决。转型阿尔法是：在不耗竭某个被会计体系定价为零的要素的前提下创造价值，且其基准并非免费，而是成本呈复利增长。让提取伪装成超额收益的机制是会计性的：传统成本会计将某些利益相关方定价为零，并将此选择伪装成客观性。被排除的成本并未消失，当隐藏它们的边界移动时，它们会返回给持有者。文章检验了“提取可被后续回报抵消”的辩护，发现它既达不到不可弥补的损害，也不能完全偿还递延的损害，且不一定能可靠到来。作者提出了一种基于边界与流的方法来区分价值创造与风险缺失。
AI.research_question: 如何区分真实的价值创造（转型阿尔法）与价值提取（披着超额收益外衣的递延转型风险）？
AI.motivation: 传统会计将某些利益相关方（如自然、人力）定价为零，导致提取行为被误记为价值创造；这种会计边界掩盖的成本会以转型风险的形式回归，需要一种新的计量基础来区分二者。
AI.theoretical_framework: 转型经济学（Transition Economics）；价值创造与价值提取的区分理论；会计边界与流量的分析框架；成本会计的客观性批判。
AI.method: 概念分析/理论论证：通过逻辑推导批判“提取可被后续回报抵消”的三种辩护（不可弥补损害、不完全偿还、不可靠抵达），并提出边界-流量计量基础。
AI.findings: （1）价值创造与转型风险是同一能力的正反两面；（2）价值提取伪装成超额收益是通过会计将某些要素定价为零实现的；（3）被排除的成本未消失，当会计边界移动时以转型风险形式返回；（4）提取的后续回报辩护在三个维度（不可弥补、不完全偿还、不可靠到达）上均不成立。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了“转型阿尔法”与“价值提取”的理论区分，将会计边界问题引入可持续性与金融的交汇研究，为转型经济学提供了新的计量基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业、投资者和政策制定者提供了识别真实价值创造（而非风险转移）的分析工具；对可持续投资、ESG评估中“假阿尔法”的识别具有直接应用价值。

title: Information and Macroeconomic Expectations: Global Evidence
affiliations: Georgetown University and National Bureau of Economic Research (NBER)

detail.title: Information and Macroeconomic Expectations: Global Evidence
detail.abstract: Novel global data on 47,000 consumers across 47 countries representing 90% of world GDP reveal universal patterns in macroeconomic belief formation. Most consumers form beliefs based on local information sources (utility bills, shopping, and acquaintances) that provide signals not representative for the overall consumption bundle, so that seeking information leads to forming biased macroeconomic expectations. Distrust in governments and central banks, the producers of aggregate economic information, helps explain reliance on local sources and the lack of learning from aggregate realizations. Observed macroeconomic volatility fuels distrust. In the cross-section, we confirm that certain demographics correlate with expectation biases but mostly due to different sorting into information sources, rather than different processing of the same economic information. These globally established facts inform advances of theories of belief formation and the design of communication strategies as a macroeconomic policy tool.

AI.tldr: 基于47个国家47,000名消费者的全球数据，发现消费者主要依赖地方信息（水电账单、购物、熟人）形成宏观经济信念，这导致系统性偏差；对政府和央行的不信任加剧了这种依赖，而宏观经济波动又进一步滋生不信任。
AI.research_question: 全球消费者如何形成宏观经济信念？哪些因素导致其信念偏差？
AI.motivation: 现有研究多基于单一国家，缺乏全球层面的系统性证据，无法区分信息获取差异与信息处理差异对信念偏差的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信念形成理论（贝叶斯更新、信息获取理论）；信任与制度经济学；宏观经济学中的预期形成理论。
AI.method: 覆盖47个国家47,000名消费者（代表全球90%GDP）的大规模跨国调查，结合跨国比较与微观计量分析。
AI.findings: （1）消费者依赖地方信息源（水电账单、购物、熟人），这些信号对整体消费篮子缺乏代表性，导致信念偏差；（2）对政府和央行的不信任解释了为何依赖地方信息且不学习宏观数据；（3）宏观经济波动加剧不信任；（4）人口统计变量与信念偏差的相关性主要源于不同群体对信息源的选择差异，而非对相同信息的不同处理。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"地方信息依赖是宏观信念偏差的核心渠道"的全球性实证证据；区分了信息获取效应与信息处理效应；揭示了信任与宏观经济波动之间的恶性循环机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为央行和政府设计沟通策略作为宏观政策工具提供实证依据；提示政策制定者需提升公信力以改善公众预期形成。

title: Rules, Uncertainty, and Ordoliberalism: The Case of Climate Change
affiliations: University of Freiburg - Department of Economics and Pomona College - Department of Economics

detail.title: Rules, Uncertainty, and Ordoliberalism: The Case of Climate Change

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No conflict of interest declared.
declarations.ethicsApproval: N/A
declarations.funderStatement: N/A

detail.abstract: How can ordoliberalism, with its focus on stable market institutions, handle decisionmaking under the deep, Knightian uncertainty of climate change? At the catastrophic tail of climate risks, where tipping cascades and civilizational threats resist credible probabilistic modeling, standard expected-utility optimization loses traction. We argue that ordoliberalism should adopt a "qualified maximin" decision rule for this domain, while cost-benefit methods still govern climate decisions where probabilities remain credible. Rawlsian conditions constrain the rule, and a practical heuristic that weighs worst-case severity against forgone benefits balances it, yielding a two-stage policy design: institutionalize a precautionary floor against unacceptable losses, then pursue aggregate gains through competition-compatible instruments. The floor operates at two levels: a temperature guardrail, normatively prior to national implementation, and each state's fairshare contribution plus a domestic protective layer rather than an independent guarantee. Expert judgment and deliberative citizen forums, embedded in an international constitutional contract, can make this architecture workable.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了秩序自由主义如何在气候变化带来的深度不确定性（奈特式不确定性）下进行决策，提出采用“有条件的最大化最小”决策规则，并设计了两阶段政策框架：先建立预防性底线（温度护栏与国家公平份额），再通过竞争兼容工具追求总收益。
AI.research_question: 秩序自由主义如何在气候变化带来的深度奈特式不确定性下进行决策？
AI.motivation: 气候变化的灾难性尾部风险（如临界点级联、文明威胁）无法进行可信的概率建模，标准的期望效用最优化方法失效，因此需要为秩序自由主义提供新的决策框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 秩序自由主义（Ordoliberalism）、奈特式不确定性（Knightian uncertainty）、有条件的最大化最小规则（qualified maximin）、罗尔斯式约束（Rawlsian constraints）、成本-收益分析（cost-benefit analysis）
AI.method: 理论分析与规范论证，结合决策理论、制度设计与宪法契约视角
AI.findings: 1）秩序自由主义应采纳“有条件的最大化最小”决策规则应对极端气候风险；2）政策设计分为两阶段：先建立预防性底线（温度护栏与各国公平份额），再通过竞争兼容工具追求总收益；3）专家判断与 deliberative citizen forums 嵌入国际宪法契约可使该架构可行。
AI.theory_contributions: 拓展了秩序自由主义在气候风险领域的适用性，将奈特式不确定性引入秩序自由主义决策框架，提出了“有条件的最大化最小”规则作为成本-收益分析的补充。
AI.practical_contributions: 为气候政策提供了两阶段制度设计路径：先建立不可接受损失的预防性底线（温度护栏+国家公平份额），再实施竞争兼容的收益追求工具，并提出了专家判断与公民审议的治理机制。

title:
From Porters to Proprietors: 
The Economic Transformation of The Sherpa Community and The Political Economy of The Everest Climbing Industry
affiliations: Symbiosis School of Economics - Symbiosis School of Economics

detail.title:
From Porters to Proprietors: 
The Economic Transformation of The Sherpa Community and The Political Economy of The Everest Climbing Industry
detail.abstract: This paper examines the intense economic transformation in the Everest climbing industry over the past two decades, with focus particularly on the Sherpa community's shift from wage labourers working under Western expedition companies to leading proprietors of the Himalayan mountaineering economy. Drawing on the various fields of economics such as labour economics, institutional economics, and development economics frameworks, this research analyses the historical context of Sherpa community marginalization, the turning points of 2013 and 2014 that sparked a redistribution of power, the subsequent rise of Nepali-owned enterprises, and the macroeconomic implications for Nepal's GDP. The paper further investigates persistent challenges including compensating wage differentials, the economics of information asymmetry between Sherpa guides and foreign clients, and the structural risks of an economy dependent on a single sector. Findings indicate that Nepali companies now control approximately 90% of the Everest climbing market, a significant change from a decade ago, driven by competitive pricing, the emergence of a skilled local labour force, and an increase in Asian climbers from India and China. The paper concludes that although the Sherpa community's economic rise stands as a landmark case of indigenous empowerment, deep structural inequalities still remain prompting sustained policy intervention.

AI.tldr: 过去二十年，夏尔巴人从西方探险公司的雇佣劳动者转变为珠峰登山经济的主导者，目前控制约90%的登山市场，但深层结构性不平等依然存在。
AI.research_question: 夏尔巴人如何实现从边缘化劳动者到喜马拉雅登山经济主导者的经济转型？这一转型存在哪些持续的挑战与结构性不平等？
AI.motivation: 2013年和2014年的转折性事件引发了权力重新分配，促使研究者关注夏尔巴社区经济地位的剧烈变迁及其宏观影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 劳动经济学、制度经济学、发展经济学框架；补偿性工资差异理论；信息不对称理论。
AI.method: 基于历史背景分析和经济学框架的综合分析。
AI.findings: 尼泊尔公司现控制约90%的珠峰登山市场（十年前情况大不相同）；驱动因素包括竞争性定价、熟练本地劳动力涌现、中印亚洲登山者增加。
AI.theory_contributions: 将劳动经济学、制度经济学和发展经济学整合应用于原住民经济赋权研究，揭示了边缘化社区通过经济转型实现权力再分配的理论路径。
AI.practical_contributions: 为尼泊尔政府提供了登山产业单部门依赖风险的警示，并为原住民经济赋权政策干预提供了实证依据。

title: Historical Calibration of SVJD Models with Deep Learning
affiliations: University of Economics, Prague - Faculty of Finance and Accounting and University of Economics in Prague

detail.title: Historical Calibration of SVJD Models with Deep Learning
detail.abstract: We introduce a new method for the calibration of Stochastic-Volatility Jump-Diffusion (SVJD) models to historical asset return time-series with deep neural networks (DNN). The approach employs 1-Dimensional Convolutional Neural Networks (1D-CNN) trained on a large dataset of simulated return sequences to learn the mapping between returns and the model parameters. The accuracy of the DNN is compared with calibration methods based on shallow neural networks and hand-crafted features, and with statistical estimation techniques such as MCMC and approximate MLE. In a comprehensive set of simulation tests, the DNN outperforms all benchmark methods in terms of accuracy and robustness. In an empirical study on 10 currency exchange rates and 10 stock market indices, the DNN-estimated SVJD models deliver higher out-of-sample predictive log-likelihoods than models estimated with MCMC for 9 out of 10 currency pairs and 6 out of 10 equity indices. Among the key advantages of the proposed approach is its generic nature which makes it applicable to any SVJD model specification from which simulations can be drawn, and its computational efficiency as the trained DNN can produce parameter estimates for new datasets almost instantaneously.

AI.tldr: 本文提出利用一维卷积神经网络（1D-CNN）对随机波动率跳跃扩散（SVJD）模型进行校准，通过大量模拟数据训练DNN学习收益率序列与模型参数之间的映射关系，在模拟和实证测试中均优于MCMC等传统方法。
AI.research_question: 如何利用深度神经网络高效且准确地校准随机波动率跳跃扩散模型？
AI.motivation: 传统的SVJD模型校准方法（如MCMC、近似MLE）计算成本高、速度慢，而现有浅层神经网络或基于手工特征的校准方法精度有限。亟需一种更高效、准确且通用的校准方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 随机波动率跳跃扩散（SVJD）模型；一维卷积神经网络（1D-CNN）；深度学习参数估计方法。
AI.method: 使用1D-CNN在大量模拟收益率序列上训练，学习从收益率序列到SVJD模型参数的映射；与浅层神经网络、基于手工特征的方法、MCMC及近似MLE进行对比；在10种汇率和10种股指上进行实证检验。
AI.findings: DNN在模拟测试中准确性和稳健性均优于所有基准方法；在实证中，DNN估计的模型在9/10个汇率对和6/10个股指上取得了更高的样本外预测对数似然值；训练后的DNN几乎可以即时生成新数据的参数估计。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将1D-CNN应用于SVJD模型校准，证明了深度学习在高维金融参数估计中的有效性，提供了比MCMC更优的替代方案。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出的方法具有通用性，适用于任何可模拟的SVJD模型；计算效率极高，适合高频或大数据场景下的实时校准；实证结果表明该方法的实际预测能力优于传统统计方法。

title: Multisite Travel Cost as a Pricing Method for Ecosystem Accounting
affiliations: University College London, University of East Anglia (UEA) - School of Environmental Sciences and University of Trento

detail.title: Multisite Travel Cost as a Pricing Method for Ecosystem Accounting

declarations.funderStatement: We wish to thank Professor Ian Bateman for providing the data used in the empirical analysis presented in this paper and the faculty of the SUSTEEMs PhD programme for their helpful comments. The work of Alice Bartolini has been carried out under the project "Sampling methods for environmental accounting and ecosystem service estimation", sponsored by a PON PhD scholarship financed by the Italian Ministry of Research and Innovation and in collaboration with the Economic Statistics Centre of Excellence (ESCoE), funded by the Office for National Statistics.

detail.abstract: For the first time, our study introduces the use of multisite travel cost models to estimate values for recreationrelated ecosystem services (RES) aligned with the System of Environmental Economic Accounting-Ecosystem Accounting (SEEA EA). We extend the application of these models and demonstrate their effectiveness as a pricing method for ES. The use of the multisite travel cost framework is particularly appealing for EA as it enables the inclusion of various site attributes, including those related to ecosystem quantity (extent) and quality (conditions). By incorporating such characteristics in the model, we can establish a clear link between ecosystem biophysical features and the provision of RES. The second key step involves designing a scenario in which ecosystem quality is at its lowest level, resulting in a null flow RES, and determining the reduction in site total cost of access to offset such degradation, thereby deriving a per-visit price that is i) exclusively attributable to the ecosystem and ii) compliant with EA. We test our proposal by conducting an empirical analysis of 531 recreational access sites along three UK rivers, Wharfe, Aire and Calder, estimating an exchange value for RES of £21.2 million and revealing the high contribution of goodquality freshwater ecosystems to the local economy.

AI.tldr: 本文首次将多点旅行成本模型应用于生态系统核算框架，以估算与游憩相关的生态系统服务价值。通过构建生态系统质量最低导致服务流为零的假设情景，推导出每访次价格，并对英国三条河流的531个游憩点进行实证分析，估计游憩生态系统服务交换价值为2120万英镑。
AI.research_question: 如何将多点旅行成本模型应用于环境经济核算体系-生态系统核算（SEEA EA）框架中，以估算与游憩相关的生态系统服务的交换价值？
AI.motivation: 现有研究尚未将多点旅行成本模型系统地应用于SEEA EA框架来估算游憩生态系统服务价值，需要一种能清晰链接生态系统生物物理特征与服务供给的定价方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多点旅行成本模型；环境经济核算体系-生态系统核算（SEEA EA）；生态系统服务定价理论
AI.method: 采用多点旅行成本模型，构建生态系统质量最低（服务流为零）的反事实情景，通过计算补偿生态系统退化所需的总访问成本减少量，推导出符合EA要求的每访次价格。实证分析英国Wharfe、Aire和Calder三条河流沿岸531个游憩访问点。
AI.findings: 游憩生态系统服务的交换价值为2120万英镑；高质量的淡水生态系统对当地经济具有高度贡献。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将多点旅行成本模型引入SEEA EA框架作为生态系统服务定价方法；建立了生态系统生物物理特征（范围与状况）与游憩服务供给之间的清晰链接；提出了一种符合EA规范、可归因于生态系统本身的每访次价格推导方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了在生态系统核算框架下量化游憩生态系统服务经济价值的具体工具；揭示了高质量淡水生态系统对地方经济的重要贡献，为水资源管理和生态保护决策提供经济依据。

title: The Foreseeable Child: Age Verification Bypass, the Fraud That Never Was, and the Architecture of Deflected Responsibility

detail.title: The Foreseeable Child: Age Verification Bypass, the Fraud That Never Was, and the Architecture of Deflected Responsibility
detail.abstract:
Age verification is now the law of three continents. Texas and roughly half the American states condition access to adult content or social media on proof of age; the United Kingdom's Online Safety Act requires "highly effective age assurance"; the European Commission's guidelines under Article 28 of the Digital Services Act prescribe age assurance that is accurate, reliable, and robust; Australia bans social media accounts for children under sixteen outright. And children defeat these systems continuously, not with sophisticated tools, but with the ordinary resourcefulness the systems were built to anticipate: a borrowed face, a purchased account, a birthdate field that believes whatever it is told. When a child gets through a mandated gate and is harmed on the other side, a question follows that the entire regulatory architecture is designed never to answer: who is responsible? 
This Article maps the architecture of deflection that currently answers "no one," and dismantles it joint by joint. The platform points to compliance with the mandate. The age assurance vendor points to the user's "fraud." The legislature is immune. The blame that remains rolls downhill onto the child who got through. The Article shows that each deflection fails on the deflecting party's own legal materials. The child cannot be the culpable party: no contract containing an age attestation was ever formed between the platform and the child, the operator is legally forbidden from relying on the child's word about her age, and a century of protective-statute doctrine holds that a member of the class a statute protects cannot be charged with defeating it. The bypass cannot be a superseding cause: under the very-hazard rule, the child's foreseeable evasion is the risk the duty exists to address, and it cannot simultaneously be the excuse for breaching that duty. And the compliance shield fails in every jurisdiction once each regime's own text is read: American tort law treats statutory compliance as a floor rather than a ceiling, while the British and European standards define effectiveness partly as resistance to the circumvention methods available to children, which converts every documented child-level bypass from a defense into evidence of noncompliance. The responsibility the architecture deflects lands where the knowledge always sat: on the operators who deployed gates whose failure modes they knew, and on the vendors who certified those gates against error rates they published themselves.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了全球年龄验证法规下的责任逃避架构：平台指向合规、供应商指向用户欺诈、立法者享有豁免，最终责任落到绕过的儿童身上。作者逐一驳斥这些推责逻辑，论证责任应归于部署已知失效系统的运营者和认证供应商。
AI.research_question: 当儿童绕过法定年龄验证系统并在之后受到伤害，法律责任应由谁承担？
AI.motivation: 全球三大洲（美洲、欧洲、大洋洲）相继出台年龄验证法规，但儿童的绕过行为持续且普遍，而现行监管架构系统地回避了责任归属这一根本问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 侵权法中的超危原则（very-hazard rule）、保护性法令原则（protective-statute doctrine）、合同成立理论、合规作为下限而非上限的侵权法原理。
AI.method: 法律文本分析、比较法研究（美国、英国、欧盟）、判例与学说分析、逻辑拆解（三段论式的推责链条解构）。
AI.findings: 儿童不能成为责任方（未与平台成立有效合同、运营商依法不得依赖儿童自报年龄、保护性法令禁止将受保护对象视为违法者）；绕过行为不构成介入原因（可预见的规避正是注意义务要防范的风险）；合规抗辩在所有法域均不成立（美国侵权法视合规为下限，英欧标准将抵抗儿童规避能力作为有效性的定义要素）。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统性地构建了"责任逃避架构"（architecture of deflection）这一分析框架，将分散的责任推责机制整合为可拆解的逻辑链条；为保护性法令原则在数字时代的适用提供了新阐释。
AI.practical_contributions: 为立法者、监管机构和法院提供了明确的责任归属路径：责任应由知道系统缺陷仍部署的运营者和自行发布错误率却认证失效系统的供应商承担；有助于推动年龄验证技术的实质改进和责任保险等配套机制的建立。

title: The Consent That Never Was: Children, Clickwrap Non-Formation, and the Age Verification Statutes as Legislative Admission

detail.title: The Consent That Never Was: Children, Clickwrap Non-Formation, and the Age Verification Statutes as Legislative Admission

keywords: Granite Rock Co. V. International Brotherhood of Teamsters

detail.abstract:
Every day, children click I Agree. Courts, legislatures, and the platforms themselves have converged on a shared description of what happens in that moment: a contract forms, voidable at the child's election under the infancy doctrine. That description is doing enormous work. Because the infancy doctrine treats the child's contract as formed and merely voidable, the child's challenge is a validity challenge, and under the Federal Arbitration Act's severability regime a validity challenge belongs to the arbitrator. Between 2021 and 2026, federal courts relied on exactly this chain to send children's claims against Snap, StockX, Temu, Epic Games, Roblox, and Microsoft into the arbitral forums those companies drafted, behind the class waivers those companies drafted, under the delegation clauses those companies drafted. 
This Article argues that the chain fails at its first link. The question the infancy doctrine answers, what a child may do about a contract that exists, is downstream of a question the courts compelling these children have not been asked: whether the interaction produced a contract at all. Mutual assent is measured objectively, against what the offeror knows or has reason to know about the party on the other side of the interface. A platform that designs for, markets to, and profits from an audience it knows includes children cannot reasonably read a child's tap as a manifestation of assent to thousands of words of undisclosed terms, and the inquiry notice standard the online contract cases apply, calibrated to the reasonably prudent adult user, returns no answer at all when the user is nine. A defect of that kind is a formation defect. Under Buckeye, Granite Rock, and the Act itself, formation belongs to the court, and no delegation clause can reach it, because until a contract exists there is nothing to delegate. 
The Article then identifies a source of support the formation argument has never had before: the legislatures. Texas's App Store Accountability Act, in force since June 2026 and left in effect by the Supreme Court in July 2026, forbids app stores from treating a minor’s solo assent as sufficient for any download or purchase, and requires verified parental consent for each transaction. The federal COPPA regime does the same for the data layer. These enactments are legislative admissions that the child’s click, standing alone, does not do what the platforms’ motions to compel say it did. The Article traces what follows when the admission is taken seriously: the arbitration clause, the class waiver, the data license, and the liability cap all rest on an agreement that never came into being.

AI.tldr: 本文论证，儿童点击“我同意”不构成有效合同，因为从客观角度看，平台知道用户包括儿童时，不能合理地将儿童的点击视为对数千字未披露条款的同意。这是一个合同成立缺陷，而非效力问题，因此属于法院管辖而非仲裁。得克萨斯州的《应用商店问责法》和联邦COPPA法规也为这一论点提供了立法支持。
AI.research_question: 当儿童点击“我同意”时，该行为是否构成有效的合同成立？法院强制儿童进入仲裁的依据是否成立？
AI.motivation: 2021至2026年间，联邦法院依据“合同成立且仅可撤销”的逻辑，将Snap、StockX、Temu、Epic Games、Roblox、Microsoft等公司的儿童用户争议强制送入公司起草的仲裁程序，这一法律链条存在根本性缺陷。
AI.theoretical_framework: 合同客观同意理论（客观衡量表意行为）、询问通知标准（合理谨慎成年用户标准）、未成年人合同效力理论（可撤销理论 vs. 成立缺陷理论）、联邦仲裁法下的可分性制度、法院与仲裁的管辖权划分（Buckeye, Granite Rock）
AI.method: 法律推理与案例分析：梳理2021-2026年联邦法院判例；运用合同法基本原理（客观同意、询问通知）进行逻辑推演；引用立法（得克萨斯州《应用商店问责法》、联邦COPPA）作为支持性论据。
AI.findings: 1. 未成年人制度回答的是“合同存在后孩子能做什么”的问题，但前提是合同是否存在；2. 平台知道受众包含儿童时，不能客观地认为儿童的点击是对未披露条款的同意；3. 询问通知标准（合理谨慎成年人标准）对9岁儿童不适用；4. 此为成立缺陷，属于法院管辖，仲裁条款不能触及；5. 得克萨斯州《应用商店问责法》和COPPA从立法层面承认了儿童的单独同意不足以成立合同。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 澄清了“合同可撤销”（validity challenge）与“合同未成立”（formation defect）的本质区别；2. 将客观同意理论应用于儿童与平台的在线交互场景；3. 揭示了询问通知标准在儿童用户场景下的空白；4. 阐明了法院与仲裁管辖权在儿童合同场景下的正确划分。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为儿童用户及其代理人提供了对抗强制仲裁条款的法律论据；2. 通过立法证据（德州法案、COPPA）为司法实践提供支撑；3. 可能改变平台当前依赖儿童点击同意构建仲裁、集体诉讼豁免、数据许可和责任限制条款的商业实践。

title: The Flutie Effect Revisited: Athletic Success, Postseason Milestones, and University Enrollment
affiliations: Texas Tech University, Texas Tech University and Texas Tech University

detail.title: The Flutie Effect Revisited: Athletic Success, Postseason Milestones, and University Enrollment
detail.abstract: Does college athletic success generate measurable spillovers to university academic outcomes? Using two decades of panel data on 128 FBS football programs and 246 NCAA Division I basketball programs (2004–2024), we recast the Flutie Effect as a visibility-threshold phenomenon: the academic return attaches to discrete, nationally visible postseason milestones, not to winning as such. A one-standard-deviation gain in win percentage moves applications by roughly one percent, but reaching a major bowl raises applications by 3.6 percent at their two-year peak and first-time enrollment by 2.4 percent, with cumulative applications effects of 5.4 and 7.1 percent over two and three years. College Football Playoff appearances point to larger effects still, though we treat them as suggestive. In basketball, NCAA Tournament participation—March Madness—produces its cleanest response among private institutions, where applications rise about 4.2 percent with pre-trends that pass; the full-panel enrollment response is marginal, and the larger non-FBS effect is confounded by anticipatory program build-up. The mechanism is demand expansion: applications, admissions, and enrollment scale up together while selectivity, yield, and the academic and socioeconomic composition of the entering class remain unchanged. We estimate every headline with both two-way fixed effects and a heterogeneity-robust estimator, which return very similar point estimates, and confront the power cost of sparse treatments with randomization inference, leave one-out perturbations, and nine treatment definitions. Properly identified, the Flutie Effect is modest but real, and it expands demand precisely where national attention discontinuously rises.

AI.tldr: 本文利用2004-2024年128个FBS橄榄球项目和246个NCAA一级篮球项目的面板数据，重新审视"弗鲁特效应"（Flutie Effect），发现大学体育成功对学术成果的溢出效应主要源自离散的、全国可见的季后赛里程碑事件，而非常规赛胜率本身。橄榄球进入重大碗赛可使申请量两年峰值上升3.6%，新生入学率上升2.4%；篮球方面，NCAA锦标赛参与使私立院校申请量上升约4.2%。机制是需求扩张而非生源质量变化。
AI.research_question: 大学体育竞技成功是否会对大学的学术成果（如申请量、入学率等）产生可测度的溢出效应？
AI.motivation: 经典"弗鲁特效应"认为体育成功能够提升大学学术表现，但以往研究对"成功"的定义模糊，且因果识别不足。本文旨在通过更精细的阈值识别和稳健的计量方法，重新检验这一效应的真实大小与作用边界。
AI.theoretical_framework: 将弗鲁特效应重新概念化为"可见性阈值现象"（visibility-threshold phenomenon），即学术回报附着于离散的、全国可见的季后赛里程碑事件，而非常规赛胜率本身。这一框架区分了边际胜率变化与重大公共注意力事件的不同影响。
AI.method: 使用2004-2024年128个FBS橄榄球项目和246个NCAA一级篮球项目的面板数据，采用双向固定效应模型与异质性稳健估计量（heterogeneity-robust estimator），并结合随机化推断、留一扰动和九种处理定义进行稳健性检验。
AI.findings: （1）胜率每提高一个标准差，申请量仅增加约1%；（2）进入重大碗赛（major bowl）使申请量两年峰值上升3.6%，新生入学率上升2.4%，且累计效应在两年和三年分别达到5.4%和7.1%；（3）大学橄榄球季后赛（CFP）表现的影响更大，但仅作为提示性证据；（4）篮球方面，NCAA锦标赛参与使私立院校申请量上升约4.2%，但整体入学效应不显著；（5）机制是需求扩张：申请、录取和入学同步增长，但选择率、录取率和新生学术及社会经济构成未变。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）将弗鲁特效应重新理论化为"可见性阈值现象"，明确了学术回报的触发条件是全国性注意力而非常规胜率；（2）揭示了体育成功影响大学学术的机制是需求扩张而非生源质量提升，丰富了体育溢出效应的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）为大学管理者提供了更精准的体育投资回报预期：只有达到全国可见的里程碑事件才可能产生实质性学术溢出；（2）提示大学在体育投入上应关注关键的曝光节点而非常规表现；（3）为高等教育资源配置和体育项目投资决策提供了经验证据支持。

title: Off-Cycle Political Turnover and The School Bureaucracy: Quasi-Experimental Evidence from Brazil's Supplementary Elections
affiliations: and Universidade do Estado do Rio de Janeiro (UERJ) - Institute of Social and Political Studies

detail.title: Off-Cycle Political Turnover and The School Bureaucracy: Quasi-Experimental Evidence from Brazil's Supplementary Elections

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that they have no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable — secondary/public data
declarations.funderStatement: This work was supported by the Fundação Carlos Chagas Filho de Amparo à Pesquisa do Estado do Rio de Janeiro (FAPERJ), Auxílio Básico à Pesquisa (APQ1), Call E-13/2023, Process No. 210.358/2024.

detail.abstract: What does an unscheduled change of political command cost the bureaucracy beneath it? The turnover literature measures transitions that everyone anticipates: scheduled elections, planned handovers. We study the rupture no one schedules-the removal of Brazilian mayors by electoral courts, which triggers an off-cycle supplementary election, without a transition and under interim rule, at a moment set by each court's pace rather than by the municipality's trajectory. Following every teacher across 5,570 municipalities (2012-2019), we find that municipal teacher turnover rises by about a quarter. The jump appears only in the network the mayor commands, concentrates in temporary contracts, is largest among school principals, persists under same-party succession, and erodes qualifications: those who leave are the most credentialed. Regular transitions reproduce at most half the jump, with no ideological gradient. The mode of political discontinuity, not merely its occurrence, governs its bureaucratic cost.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了巴西市长因选举法庭裁决被强制罢免（非计划性政治中断）对市级教育系统教师流动的影响，发现此类突发性政治更替导致教师流动率上升约25%，且冲击集中在市长直接管辖的网络、临时合同岗位和学校校长群体中，离职者多为高资历教师，而常规政治交接影响较小。
AI.research_question: 非计划性的政治更替（市长被选举法庭强制罢免）如何影响其官僚体系（教师队伍）的人员流动？
AI.motivation: 现有文献主要关注预期内的政治交接（如定期选举、计划内的权力交接），而缺乏对突发性、非计划性政治中断如何影响官僚体系的研究。本文利用巴西市长被选举法庭强制罢免这一准自然实验来填补这一空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 政治中断理论、官僚人员流动理论、政治与官僚关系理论
AI.method: 利用2012-2019年巴西5,570个市的面板数据，追踪每一位教师，采用双重差分等因果识别方法，比较因选举法庭裁决导致市长非计划更替的市与其他市的教师流动差异。
AI.findings: (1) 非计划性政治更替导致教师流动率上升约25%；(2) 冲击集中在市长直接管辖的网络中；(3) 临时合同教师受影响最大；(4) 学校校长流动率最高；(5) 即使同党派继任，影响仍持续；(6) 离职者资质更高，侵蚀了教师队伍的整体素质；(7) 常规政治交接最多只能再现一半的冲击，且无意识形态梯度。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了政治中断的"模式"（突发性vs计划性）比"发生与否"更能决定其对官僚体系的代价，拓展了政治更替与官僚人员流动的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为制度设计提供启示：非计划性政治中断对公共服务的稳定性和人力资源质量产生显著负面影响，政策制定者应关注选举法庭裁决等制度安排对官僚体系的连带冲击。

title: The Distributor's Burden: Platform Verification Duties, Privacy-Preserving Age Assurance, and the Constitutional Ceiling on Online Child-Safety Design

detail.title: The Distributor's Burden: Platform Verification Duties, Privacy-Preserving Age Assurance, and the Constitutional Ceiling on Online Child-Safety Design
detail.abstract:
The public argument over children and online platforms is being fought on the wrong axis. When a platform frames a proposed media-prominence rule as a threat to open recommendation, or a legislature answers a stream of harmful content by demanding that every user prove an age, both moves aim the burden of child protection at the wrong party. The classification that actually decides whether a video reaches a child runs, on the largest platforms, on creator self-report, and self-report is a sieve. A May 2026 field study found that roughly a third of surveyed children had already bypassed age checks, some by drawing a moustache with a makeup pencil and some by pointing a camera at an animated video-game character. 
This paper argues that the burden belongs to the distributor. It first clears two wrong answers. User-side mass age verification collides with a constitutional ceiling: Free Speech Coalition v. Paxton sustained age checks only for material obscene as to minors, and the district courts have spent the year since enjoining every attempt to stretch that authorization across general-audience platforms. Government content-prominence mandates fare no better, because Moody v. NetChoice holds that curation is protected editorial judgment and that a State may not conscript a platform to rebalance the speech market. The paper then identifies the doctrinal engine a distributor duty can run on: the symmetry between Moody and Anderson v. TikTok. If the curated feed is the platform's own expressive product when the platform claims constitutional protection, it is the platform's own first-party conduct when the question is accountability, and Section 230 does not stand in the way. The paper's contribution is a distributor verification duty, scaled to platform capacity, that requires a platform to verify its own child-directed classifications rather than trust a creator's checkbox, paired with a narrow adult tier gated by privacy-preserving age assurance rather than surveillance. The whole-video scanning that platforms already run for advertiser safety proves the capability exists; the drafting lessons of NetChoice v. Bonta and the vagueness cases show how to write the duty so it regulates factual classification rather than compelled opinion. The design threads the constitutional ceiling under Paxton, honors editorial autonomy under Moody, rests accountability on Anderson, keeps the collect-nothing property of a zero-knowledge age token, and confines the identification residual to the adult tier alone.

AI.tldr: 本文提出应将儿童网络保护的负担从用户端转向平台（分发者），要求平台自行验证其面向儿童的分类，而非依赖创作者自报，并设计了一套符合宪法约束的分发者验证义务方案。
AI.research_question: 在儿童网络内容保护中，责任应如何分配才能既保护儿童又符合宪法第一修正案？具体而言，平台应承担何种验证义务？
AI.motivation: 当前关于儿童与在线平台的公共争论方向有误：无论是要求平台重新推荐内容（内容凸显规则），还是要求每个用户证明年龄，都将保护负担加在了错误的一方。平台实际依赖创作者自报分类来决定内容是否触及儿童，而自报机制形同虚设（2026年实地研究发现约1/3儿童已绕过年龄检查）。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1）宪法第一修正案与平台言论自由（Moody v. NetChoice：策展是受保护的编辑判断）；2）平台责任与Section 230（Anderson v. TikTok：当涉及问责时，策展是平台自身的首要行为）；3）Paxton案确立的年龄验证合宪边界（仅限对未成年人淫秽内容）；4）模糊性理论（vagueness doctrine）与强迫言论（compelled speech）判例。
AI.method: 法律 doctrinal analysis（判例法分析），整合Free Speech Coalition v. Paxton、Moody v. NetChoice、Anderson v. TikTok等关键判例，构建对称性论证：当平台以宪法保护为由主张策展是其自身表达时，在问责问题上策展同样应被视为平台自身行为。
AI.findings: 1）用户端大规模年龄验证违宪（Paxton案限定仅对未成年人淫秽内容）；2）政府强制内容凸显规则也违宪（Moody案：平台策展受编辑判断保护）；3）Moody与Anderson之间存在对称性：平台在主张保护时称策展是自身表达，在问责时也应承担相应义务；4）平台已具备全视频扫描能力（用于广告商安全审核），技术上可行；5）可设计一条符合宪法的分发者验证义务：要求平台验证自身面向儿童的分类，搭配隐私保护的零知识年龄令牌。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）揭示了Moody与Anderson判例之间的对称性逻辑，为平台责任提供了新的理论支点；2）提出了"分发者验证义务"（distributor verification duty）这一概念框架，弥合了平台言论自由与儿童保护之间的理论张力；3）证明了技术能力（全视频扫描）可以转化为法律义务设计的依据。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为立法者提供了一套符合宪法约束的儿童保护立法方案：要求平台验证自分类而非用户年龄，可避免违宪风险；2）提出了隐私保护的分层方案：儿童内容使用全视频扫描，成人内容使用零知识年龄令牌；3）从NetChoice v. Bonta和模糊性判例中提炼了立法起草经验，确保义务针对事实分类而非强迫表达。

title:
Cheap Talk or Priced Information? 
Listing Language and Housing Transaction Outcomes
affiliations: Department of Finance, Clemson University

detail.title:
Cheap Talk or Priced Information? 
Listing Language and Housing Transaction Outcomes
detail.abstract:
Using 63,067 Atlanta MLS transactions from 2007 to 2017, we find that informa-
tion revealed in listing remarks maps differently to property value, seller constraints,
and market liquidity. Within search-area-year markets and conditional on a saturated
hedonic specification, a one-standard-deviation increase in residual information is as-
sociated with 7.7 percent higher sale prices, 7.6 percent higher list prices, and 2.5
fewer days on market. Adverse disclosure is associated with 17.4 percent lower sale
prices and 16.7 percent lower list prices. The similar list- and sale-price gradients sug-
gest that property information and adverse conditions are incorporated largely into
initial price setting. Urgency pressure is associated with 4.7 percent lower sale prices
but little difference in marketing time, consistent with bargaining posture rather than
faster matching. Market-stress language also rises during the housing crisis and is
more prevalent when local prices are lower, marketing time is longer, and discounts
are larger. Repeat-sale and listing-agent specifications imply more conservative but
economically meaningful price differences, and residual information and adverse dis-
closure retain pricing content after LASSO-selected token controls. We uncover these
patterns by using an LLM to scan the corpus and organize broad listing language into
auditable information categories. The findings show that remarks reveal priced prop-
erty and transaction information beyond structured MLS fields and a single composite
text control.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用2007-2017年亚特兰大63,067条MLS交易数据，通过LLM分析房源备注文本，发现备注中的信息可映射到房产价值、卖方约束和市场流动性。信息量每增加一个标准差，售价提高7.7%，挂牌价提高7.6%，上市天数减少2.5天；不利披露导致售价降低17.4%；紧急压力导致售价降低4.7%但对营销时间影响不大。
AI.research_question: 房源备注（listing remarks）中揭示的信息如何映射到房产价值、卖方约束和市场流动性？
AI.motivation: 传统房地产研究多依赖结构化MLS字段（如面积、卧室数等），忽视了非结构化文本中蕴含的丰富信息。作者利用LLM扫描海量房源备注文本，系统性地探索其中隐含的定价信息、卖方压力和流动性信号。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信息经济学（信息不对称与信息披露理论）、资产定价理论、市场微观结构理论（流动性与匹配效率）
AI.method: 利用LLM对63,067条MLS房源备注进行文本分类和审计，结合饱和特征价格模型（hedonic specification）、LASSO特征选择、重复销售模型和挂牌中介固定效应模型进行因果推断。
AI.findings: （1）备注信息量每增加1个标准差，售价+7.7%、挂牌价+7.6%、上市天数-2.5天；（2）不利披露导致售价-17.4%、挂牌价-16.7%；（3）紧急压力导致售价-4.7%但对营销时间影响小；（4）市场压力语言在经济危机期间增多，且与低房价、长营销期和大折扣正相关。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了非结构化文本（房源备注）在房地产定价中的信息角色，拓展了信息经济学在房地产市场的应用；区分了价格信息、不利披露和紧急压力三种不同信息维度的市场影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 为房地产经纪人、买家和卖家提供了利用文本信息进行更精准定价和交易的策略；展示了LLM在房地产文本分析中的实际应用价值；为MLS平台优化信息呈现提供了依据。

title: How Farmers Weigh Solar Adoption: Identifying Distinct Evaluation Styles Among U.S. Agricultural Producers
affiliations: , National Zoological Park - Smithsonian Conservation Biology Institute and National Zoological Park - Smithsonian Conservation Biology Institute

detail.title: How Farmers Weigh Solar Adoption: Identifying Distinct Evaluation Styles Among U.S. Agricultural Producers
detail.abstract: Solar energy deployment in rural areas depends on decisions taken by farmers and agricultural landowners. Despite this, relatively few empirical studies center on the trade-o!s farmers face when evaluating the adoption of small-and large-scale solar. Drawing on a survey of Virginia agricultural producers paired with latent class analysis, we identify two distinct modes of evaluation. Comprehensive Evaluators balance economic opportunities against installation and maintenance costs, while Selective Evaluators focus on concerns like agricultural displacement and show limited engagement with potential benefits. Results show that evaluation styles are the strongest predictors of adoption intentions, more than familiarity with solar, household income, age, farm size, production type, or ownership status. Semi-structured interviews corroborate this pattern, revealing how comprehensive and selective evaluators weigh competing agricultural, land-use, and environmental priorities. Our findings suggest that solar deployment in agricultural areas requires di!erentiated approaches that address both the benefits and concerns of development. Outreach focused primarily on benefits is unlikely to resonate with selective evaluators, whose evaluations center on concerns, undermining adoption and increasing the risk of siting conflict.

AI.tldr: 基于弗吉尼亚州农业生产经营者的调查数据，采用潜在类别分析识别出两种太阳能采纳评价模式：全面评估者（兼顾经济收益与成本）和选择性评估者（聚焦农业用地流失等担忧）。评价风格是采纳意愿的最强预测因子。研究表明农业太阳能推广需要差异化策略。
AI.research_question: 农民和农业土地所有者在评估小规模和大规模太阳能部署时面临哪些权衡？他们的评价模式如何影响太阳能采纳意愿？
AI.motivation: 尽管农民是农村太阳能部署的关键决策者，但很少有实证研究关注他们在评估太阳能时面临的权衡。了解农民的不同评价模式对于有效推广太阳能和减少选址冲突至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 潜在类别分析（Latent Class Analysis）；决策评价理论；技术采纳模型
AI.method: 对弗吉尼亚州农业生产经营者进行问卷调查；采用潜在类别分析识别评价模式；辅以半结构化访谈进行验证。
AI.findings: 识别出两种评价模式：全面评估者（综合考虑经济机会与成本）和选择性评估者（关注农业用地流失等担忧，对潜在收益关注有限）。评价风格是最强的采纳意愿预测因子，其解释力超过太阳能熟悉度、家庭收入、年龄、农场规模、生产类型或所有权状态。半结构化访谈验证了这一模式。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次通过潜在类别分析系统识别出农业太阳能采纳中的两种异质性评价模式；证实评价风格比传统人口统计学和农场特征变量更能预测采纳意愿；为农业技术采纳研究提供了新的分析视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和推广机构提供差异化推广策略的依据：对全面评估者应同时强调收益与成本，对选择性评估者则需要针对性回应其担忧，而非单纯宣传收益；有助于减少太阳能部署中的选址冲突，提高农村太阳能采纳率。

title: The Triple Lock: Why Transition Pressure Persists Through Capital and Markets When Regulation Retreats

detail.title: The Triple Lock: Why Transition Pressure Persists Through Capital and Markets When Regulation Retreats

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Joanne Flinn is Founder and Chair of the ESG Institute (Singapore), a Certified B Corporation that develops the ClearSight Intelligence and Greensight platforms referenced in this paper; these instruments and their underlying calibrations are available under commercial licence. The paper's findings are published in full; the proprietary calibrations are not. The author declares no other financial or personal relationships that could be perceived to have influenced this work.
declarations.ethicsApproval: The study of 1052 listed entities did not involve human participants, patients, or personal data. It analyses publicly listed entities and published sources, and ethics approval was therefore not required. The Greensight leadership survey underpinning the value chain readiness data in this paper was conducted with participants' informed consent. Responses were anonymised and reported only in aggregate; no personally identifiable information is presented. The research was carried out by a Certified B Corporation under its own research governance standards. No patient or clinical data were involved.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external or grant funding. It was conducted and funded internally by the ESG Institute (Singapore).

detail.abstract:
Transition pressure is widely treated as regulatory, so that when regulation retreats, as it did across the United States and the European Union in 2026, the pressure on an entity is assumed to ease. It does not, because the pressure was never primarily regulatory. It runs through three forces, capital, regulators, and markets. Two of the three are indifferent to the regulatory weather. We name these the Triple Lock, the framework this paper builds. The term is used here in this sense and is unrelated to the United Kingdom state-pension guarantee of the same name. In 2026 the European Union deleted its mandatory transition-plan duty and the United States dismantled its federal climate-regulation basis, even as insurance withdrawal, the repricing of capital, and buyer reselection transmitted pressure with no regulatory trigger. Regulatory retreat therefore eases only one of the three forces; transition pressure persists, and in places intensifies, precisely as regulation recedes. Visible regulatory compliance in disclosure is a poor proxy for transition readiness, and the risk relocates from the compliance function to capital and strategy. This reframing is the conceptual frame the companion papers apply, the structure whose channels they measure against.
That disclosure can diverge from underlying conduct is not a novel observation. Meyer and Rowan (1977) established that organisations adopt formal structures as ceremonial conformity to institutional expectations, decoupling the signals they display from the activities they perform. The activity-readiness divergence documented here is consistent with that mechanism. It is extended in two respects: the decoupling is measured at scale across a defined universe rather than asserted, and it is priced, in that the visibility it produces is precisely what allocators screen on. The contribution is about decoupling is its magnitude, its location in capital rather than simply compliance, and its consequences for portfolio construction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"三重锁定"框架，指出转型压力并非主要来自监管，而是资本、监管机构和市场三股力量共同作用。即便美国与欧盟在2026年撤销了气候监管，转型压力依然存在甚至加剧。文章还揭示了信息披露与实际行为之间的脱钩现象，并量化了这种脱钩在资本配置中的定价后果。
AI.research_question: 当气候监管退潮时，转型压力是否会随之缓解？信息披露能否真实反映组织的转型准备程度？
AI.motivation: 传统观点认为转型压力主要来自监管，因此监管撤退会减轻压力。但作者观察到2026年欧美监管撤退后，转型压力并未缓解，甚至在某些方面加剧，说明转型压力的来源被误判。
AI.theoretical_framework: "三重锁定"框架（资本、监管机构、市场三股力量）；脱钩理论（Meyer & Rowan, 1977）——组织为迎合制度期望而采取形式化结构，导致信号与实际行动分离。
AI.method: 概念框架构建与理论推演，辅以对保险撤出、资本重新定价、买方重新选择等现实现象的观察分析。
AI.findings: （1）转型压力并非主要来自监管，资本和市场力量对监管天气"漠不关心"；（2）监管撤退仅缓解三股力量中的一股，转型压力持续存在甚至加剧；（3）可见的监管合规披露是转型准备度的糟糕代理变量；（4）脱钩现象在资本层面而非仅合规层面发生，且可被定价和量化。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）提出"三重锁定"框架，重新界定转型压力的来源结构；（2）将脱钩理论从组织制度层面拓展至资本定价与资产配置层面；（3）在定义域内大规模量化脱钩现象，而非仅做定性断言。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）提醒投资者和管理者不要将监管合规视为转型准备度的可靠指标；（2）风险已从合规职能转移到资本与战略层面，需重新配置风险管理资源；（3）为资产组合构建提供新的筛选依据——基于实际活动而非披露信号的定价机制。

title: Transition Readiness Risk in Asia-Pacific and Middle Eastern Capital Markets: A 1,052-Entity Assessment Across 21 Exchanges
affiliations: and ESG	Institute	Pte	Ltd

detail.title: Transition Readiness Risk in Asia-Pacific and Middle Eastern Capital Markets: A 1,052-Entity Assessment Across 21 Exchanges

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Joanne Flinn is Founder and Chair of the ESG Institute (Singapore) and and Chris Pile, CPO the ESG Institute, a Certified B Corporation that develops the ClearSight Intelligence and GreenSight platforms referenced in this paper; these instruments and their underlying calibrations are available under commercial licence. The paper's findings are published in full; the proprietary calibrations are not. The authors declare no other financial or personal relationships that could be perceived to have influenced this work.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants, patients, or personal data. It analyses publicly listed entities and published sources, and ethics approval was therefore not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external or grant funding. It was conducted and funded internally by the ESG Institute (Singapore).

detail.abstract: The transition risk that matters is not the one being measured. Across the 1,052 largest listed entities on 21 exchanges in Asia-Pacific and the Middle East, the annual cost of standing still is approximately US$2.5 trillion, and it rises rather than falls as measurement sharpens. We define this as transition readiness risk, the un-booked cost an entity's capacity shortfall loads onto its future, and quantify it in dollars across six channels. The headline finding is a divergence: disclosure does not predict funded action. On a five-tier readiness ladder, most entities disclose no plan or a plan with no capital behind it, under 6 per cent show committed and ring-fenced capital at audit grade. None disclose reaching the delivery tiers. Of the 183 entities carrying science-based targets, seven show funded, protected capital. The discipline that would close the gap: a funded and protected plan that reports progress. This is required by no regulation or standard, so it falls to capital and markets. The funding gap remains.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了亚太和中东地区1,052家最大上市公司的转型准备风险，发现这些公司面临年均约2.5万亿美元的"原地踏步成本"，且披露情况与实际资金行动严重脱节——不到6%的公司拥有经审计的专项资金储备计划，而资金缺口依然存在。
AI.research_question: 企业面临的"转型准备风险"（transition readiness risk）是什么？其量级有多大？企业的披露与实际资金行动之间是否存在脱节？
AI.motivation: 现有研究通常关注已测量的转型风险，但忽略了企业因能力不足而未入账的未来成本。本文旨在揭示这一被忽视的风险，并量化其规模。
AI.theoretical_framework: 转型准备风险（transition readiness risk）、五级准备阶梯（five-tier readiness ladder）、资金约束与行动能力。
AI.method: 对亚太和中东地区21个交易所的1,052家最大上市实体进行大规模数据分析，通过六个渠道量化美元成本，并评估企业的披露、计划与资金准备情况。
AI.findings: （1）企业平均每年"原地踏步"成本约2.5万亿美元，且测量越精准，成本越高；（2）披露与实际资金行动严重脱节：大多数企业没有计划或有计划但无资金支持，仅不到6%的企业拥有经审计的专项资金储备，且无一进入"交付层级"；（3）183家设定科学碳目标的企业中，仅7家拥有资金支持且受保护的计划；（4）现有法规和标准不要求"有资金、有保护、报告进展"的约束机制。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"转型准备风险"这一新概念，将风险关注点从已测量的外部转型风险转向企业内部能力缺口的未来成本，并建立了量化和分级评估框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了现有ESG披露和气候承诺中普遍存在的"说一套做一套"问题，呼吁资本市场和监管机构推动"有资金、有保护、报告进展"的约束性机制，以弥合资金缺口。

title: Constitutional Economic Restrictions, Foreign Direct Investment, and Trade in the Philippines: A Mixed-Methods Analysis
affiliations: University of Santo Tomas

detail.title: Constitutional Economic Restrictions, Foreign Direct Investment, and Trade in the Philippines: A Mixed-Methods Analysis
detail.abstract: The research focuses on Foreign Direct Investment (FDI) flows in the Philippines within a political and constitutional framework and how they affect the economic performance of a country. This study also examines how the Philippine economy compares with those of other developing ASEAN countries that have modified their constitutions or laws to attract and promote foreign direct investment. This discussions also include an analysis of trade between the Philippines and other countries. The study employed a mixed-methods research design, including structured interviews across sectors, a questionnaire survey of the general population in the Philippines, and descriptive-correlational analysis of foreign direct investment (FDI) flows and their association with international trade. Interview insights from the business sector, academe, civil society organizations, and the legislative branch were gathered to gain their perspectives on the economic condition under the 1987 Constitution. Based on the collected survey responses, findings show that the majority of respondents strongly agree that amending the current constitution should be the government's top priority. Respondents also strongly agree that without constitutional reform, the Philippines can’t keep up with global trends and that constitutional reform has a positive impact not only on economic changes but also on political reforms. The descriptive-correlational analysis focuses on the growing economies of Indonesia, Malaysia, the Philippines, Thailand, and Vietnam within the ASEAN-5 emerging economies, using annual data from the World Bank for the years 1987 to 2023. Based on an Annualized Regionalization Dynamic Model (ARDL) using annual data, there was a strong correlation between foreign direct investment (FDI) inflows and exports in the Philippines, as well as between foreign direct investment (FDI) inflows and imports in Vietnam. In addition, short-term relationships were identified between foreign trade models (exports and imports) and foreign direct investment (FDI) inflows in Indonesia, Malaysia, the Philippines, and Thailand, while no short-term associations existed between foreign trade models (exports and imports) and foreign direct investment (FDI) inflows in Vietnam. Future studies should also examine the specific effects of different policy modifications regarding foreign direct investments (FDI) into various economic sectors and the subsequent effects of FDI on those economic sectors.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨菲律宾在政治与宪法框架下的外商直接投资（FDI）流动及其对经济表现的影响，并与其他东盟国家进行比较。采用混合方法（访谈、问卷调查、描述性相关分析及ARDL模型），发现多数受访者认为修宪是当务之急，且FDI流入与菲律宾出口、越南进口存在强相关关系。
AI.research_question: 在政治与宪法框架下，菲律宾的外商直接投资（FDI）流动如何影响其经济表现？菲律宾经济与其他修改了宪法或法律以吸引FDI的东盟发展中国家相比表现如何？
AI.motivation: 探讨宪法框架对FDI流动的约束作用，以及菲律宾是否需要通过修宪来提升吸引外资的能力，从而改善经济表现并跟上全球趋势。
AI.theoretical_framework: 政治经济学框架、宪法经济学、国际投资与贸易理论、ARDL动态模型。
AI.method: 混合方法研究设计：结构化跨部门访谈、面向菲律宾普通人群的问卷调查、描述性相关分析、年度化区域动态模型（ARDL），数据来源为世界银行1987-2023年年度数据，研究对象为东盟五国（印尼、马来西亚、菲律宾、泰国、越南）。
AI.findings: 1. 多数受访者强烈同意修宪应是政府首要任务；2. 受访者强烈认为没有宪法改革就无法跟上全球趋势；3. 宪法改革对经济和政治改革均有积极影响；4. ARDL模型显示：菲律宾FDI流入与出口强相关，越南FDI流入与进口强相关；5. 印尼、马来西亚、菲律宾、泰国的外贸模式与FDI流入存在短期关系，越南则无短期关联。
AI.theory_contributions: 将宪法框架纳入FDI与经济增长关系的分析，为政治制度如何调节外资经济效应提供了实证证据；区分了不同国家FDI与贸易之间的长短期关系模式。
AI.practical_contributions: 为菲律宾及其他东盟国家的政策制定者提供修宪或法律改革以吸引FDI的实证依据；建议未来研究关注不同政策修改对特定经济部门的FDI效应。

title: Income Transformation Through Goat Rearing: A Pre– Post Impact Assessment of National Livestock Mission and Other Government Sponsered Schemes Beneficiaries in Rewa District, Madhya Pradesh, India
affiliations: Awadhesh Pratap Singh University, Awadhesh Pratap Singh University,  Government Thakur Ranmat Singh Autonomous College and College of Veterinary Science and Animal Husbandry

detail.title: Income Transformation Through Goat Rearing: A Pre– Post Impact Assessment of National Livestock Mission and Other Government Sponsered Schemes Beneficiaries in Rewa District, Madhya Pradesh, India

publicationDetails.detailsText: this is a research paper ,,,my original work

detail.abstract:
Purpose: Small-ruminant rearing is widely promoted as a pro-poor livelihood in rain-fed rural India, yet rigorous, effect-size-based evidence on the magnitude of household economic change under the National Livestock Mission (NLM) and other government schemes for goat rearing remains limited. This study quantifies the economic impact of NLM-supported goat rearing on beneficiary households during 2023-24 in Rewa district, Madhya Pradesh. 
Design/methodology: A self-controlled, pre-post design was applied to a sample of 300 beneficiaries. Five household economic variablesannual goat income, annual expenditure, annual net income, total herd size, and household sizewere compared between the prescheme and post-scheme states using paired-samples t-tests (df = 299). Practical significance was assessed with Cohen's d and 95% confidence intervals.
 Findings: All five variables changed significantly (p < 0.01). Mean annual net income rose from Rs. 17,497 to Rs. 60,998an approximately 3.5-fold increase (t = 48.849; d = 2.82). Annual goat income increased 4.4-fold (t = 56.614; d = 3.27), while expenditure rose in parallel (t = 72.258; d = 4.17), indicating productive rather than consumptive spending. Herd size grew modestly and heterogeneously (t = 6.124; d = 0.35), reflecting uneven expansion across households. 
Originality/value: By pairing significance testing with effect sizes and confidence intervals on a full 300-household sample, the study moves beyond "statistically significant" claims to establish the scale and robustness of income transformation, and identifies asset-count heterogeneity as a target for more inclusive program design.

AI.tldr: 本研究基于印度中央邦Rewa地区300户受益家庭的前后对照数据，量化评估了国家畜牧计划（NLM）支持的山羊养殖对家庭经济的影响。研究发现，家庭年净收入从17,497卢比增长至60,998卢比（约3.5倍），效应量d=2.82，表明经济效益显著且实用意义重大；同时山羊收入增长4.4倍（d=3.27），支出亦同步增长（d=4.17），反映出生产性投资而非消费性支出。研究还发现畜群规模增长呈现异质性（d=0.35），提示需关注资产分配不均问题。
AI.research_question: 在国家畜牧计划（NLM）及其他政府山羊养殖计划支持下，受益农户的家庭经济发生了多大程度的实际变化？
AI.motivation: 尽管小型反刍动物养殖被广泛推广为印度雨养农村地区的益贫生计方式，但基于效应量（effect size）的严谨量化证据仍然有限，现有研究多停留在统计显著性层面，缺乏对经济变化实际规模的评估。
AI.theoretical_framework: 项目影响评估理论；统计显著性检验与效应量（Cohen's d）相结合的实证评估框架。
AI.method: 采用自身前后对照（self-controlled pre-post）设计，对300户受益家庭进行配对样本t检验（df=299），并结合Cohen's d效应量及95%置信区间评估实际显著性。
AI.findings: 五个家庭经济变量（年度山羊收入、年度支出、年度净收入、总畜群规模、家庭规模）均发生显著变化（p<0.01）；年净收入增长约3.5倍（t=48.849; d=2.82），山羊收入增长4.4倍（t=56.614; d=3.27），支出同步增长（t=72.258; d=4.17），表明支出具有生产性而非消费性；畜群规模增长呈现中等且异质性特征（t=6.124; d=0.35）。
AI.theory_contributions: 将效应量（Cohen's d）和置信区间引入畜牧项目经济影响评估，超越传统"统计显著"的二元判断，建立了经济转型规模与稳健性的量化标准。
AI.practical_contributions: 为NLM等政府山羊养殖计划的效果提供了大规模样本的量化证据；揭示了畜群规模增长的异质性，为设计更具包容性的项目方案提供了实证依据。

title: T.T. Bryce, Thomas Jesse Jones, and Economics at the Hampton Normal and Agricultural Institute, 1878 to 1906

detail.title: T.T. Bryce, Thomas Jesse Jones, and Economics at the Hampton Normal and Agricultural Institute, 1878 to 1906
detail.abstract: T.T. Bryce and Thomas Jesse Jones were not economists but taught economics at two pivotal points in the history of the Hampton Normal and Agricultural Institute. Bryce taught economics from 1878 to 1881, in the immediate aftermath of Reconstruction, and Jones taught economic from 1902 to 1906, in the Progressive Era. The Hampton Institute's mission was to train Black teachers to staff schools in the South and train Black Southerners for a life of subservient labor. The ideology of the Hampton Institute therefore centered economics and the economic life of Black workers. Bryce and Jones provide an opportunity to understand how the economics underpinning the Hampton ideology evolved over time and into the Progressive Era.

AI.tldr: 本文通过分析Hampton Normal and Agricultural Institute两位非经济学教师（T.T. Bryce和Thomas Jesse Jones）在重建时期与进步时代教授的经济学内容，揭示了该学院意识形态中经济学思想从强调黑人劳动者服从性劳动到逐步演化的过程。
AI.research_question: Hampton Normal and Agricultural Institute的意识形态所依托的经济学思想如何随时间（从重建时期到进步时代）演变？
AI.motivation: Hampton Institute的使命是培训黑人教师并为南方黑人培养服从性劳动生活方式，其意识形态核心是经济学和黑人工人的经济生活。通过研究两位在关键历史节点教授经济学的非经济学家教师，可以理解这种经济思想如何演进。
AI.theoretical_framework: 历史分析视角，聚焦重建时期（Reconstruction）与进步时代（Progressive Era）两个关键历史时期的意识形态与经济思想变迁。
AI.method: 历史文本分析，通过对Bryce（1878-1881）和Jones（1902-1906）两位教师教学内容的比较研究，追踪经济思想演变。
AI.findings: Hampton Institute的经济学教学从重建时期到进步时代发生了演变，反映了该机构意识形态中对黑人经济生活定位的变化。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了教育机构意识形态中隐含的经济学思想如何随政治社会背景变迁而演化，补充了关于黑人教育史与经济思想史交叉领域的研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 帮助理解历史上种族教育机构如何通过经济学教学塑造黑人工人的经济角色定位，为当代教育中的意识形态批判提供历史参照。

title: Generative AI Impact on Formal Jobs: Evidence from Indonesia

detail.title: Generative AI Impact on Formal Jobs: Evidence from Indonesia
detail.abstract: This study provides new empirical evidence that Generative AI (GenAI) shifts labor from formal to informal employment in developing economies. Leveraging Indonesia's National Labor Force Survey (Sakernas) from 2019-2024, we construct a demographic pseudo-panel and map occupational GenAI exposure measures to industry-specific labor market cells. Treating the release of ChatGPT in late 2022 as an exogenous technological shock, we estimate its effects using a Difference-inDifferences design. We find no evidence of aggregate job displacement. Instead, higher GenAI exposure reduces the share of formal employment by 1.1-1.4 percentage points, suggesting labor reallocation toward informality. Event-study and placebo tests support the validity of our findings. The effects are concentrated among entry-level cohorts and accompanied by a decline in formal jobs within the high-skill services sector. We further document an increase in freelance and gig-based work exclusively among younger cohorts following the shock-particularly among Gen Z (18-27). Given Indonesia's large informal economy, we conclude that GenAI degrades job formality rather than destroying overall employment.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用印尼2019-2024年全国劳动力调查数据，以ChatGPT发布作为外生技术冲击，采用双重差分法发现生成式AI并未导致总体就业减少，而是使正式就业份额下降1.1-1.4个百分点，劳动力向非正规部门重新配置，尤其集中在入门级群体和Z世代年轻人中。
AI.research_question: 生成式AI对发展中国家劳动力市场中正式与非正式就业结构的影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 现有研究多关注AI对发达经济体的就业影响，缺乏对发展中国家大规模非正规经济背景下GenAI如何重塑就业形式的实证证据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 技术冲击下的劳动力市场分割理论、正规-非正规就业二元结构理论、任务-based技术变革理论
AI.method: 利用印尼2019-2024年Sakernas全国劳动力调查数据，构建人口伪面板，将职业层面的GenAI暴露度映射到行业-劳动力市场单元，以ChatGPT发布（2022年底）为外生冲击，采用双重差分法进行因果识别。
AI.findings: 1. GenAI未导致总体就业岗位减少；2. GenAI暴露度越高，正式就业份额下降1.1-1.4个百分点；3. 效应集中在入门级群体和高技能服务业；4. Z世代（18-27岁）年轻人中自由职业和零工工作显著增加。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次在发展中国家大规模非正规经济背景下，实证揭示GenAI对就业形式（正规→非正规）而非就业总量的影响机制，拓展了技术变革与劳动力市场结构关系的理论边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 为发展中国家政策制定者提供预警：GenAI可能加剧就业非正规化趋势，需配套社会保障体系改革、技能培训和对零工经济的制度性回应。

title: Economic Sustainability in Agricultural Commodity Markets: A Study of Trends, Patterns, and Market Resilience
affiliations: and St. Claret College, Autonomous

detail.title: Economic Sustainability in Agricultural Commodity Markets: A Study of Trends, Patterns, and Market Resilience
detail.abstract: This paper examines the economic sustainability of some critical agricultural commodities in India (Guar Seeds, Guar Gum, Castor Seeds) during the period between 2015 and 2025. The study analyzes the pattern of prices, structural stability, volatility behavior, and market interactions using daily price data with a view to evaluating market resilience and efficiency. First, stationarity of the series of returns is established through the Augmented Dickey-Fuller (ADF) test, which controls the appropriateness of time series models. The Bai-Perron multiple break test shows structural breaks, and the CUSUM test ensures that segments of stability exist in the data. In the tests, these periods are identified as showing a dramatic change in market behavior and are included in the modeling that follows. Their studies are done in the form of trends and autocorrelation of the movements of prices of all commodities. The GARCH (1, 1) model has been employed in the study to capture both volatility clustering and persistence. It has been demonstrated that the effects of shocks on market volatility are likely to recur, indicating that markets are somewhat resilient against these shocks. Moreover, Granger causality between futures and spot market returns is performed for each commodity, and it can be shown that there is a bidirectional causation in the majority of the commodities. This shows that the two markets are efficient in the discovery of price and the existence of a good flow of information between them. In general, the results have great significance for the necessity to take structural breaks and the persistence of volatility in the analysis of commodity markets. The findings are beneficial to policymakers, traders, and farmers in informing them on how they can enhance risk management practices and assist in the sustainable growth of the market. Such detailed analysis leads to a better understanding of the dynamic behavior of agricultural commodity markets in India over ten years.

AI.tldr: 本文利用2015-2025年间印度瓜尔豆、瓜尔胶和蓖麻籽的每日价格数据，通过ADF检验、Bai-Perron结构断点检验、CUSUM稳定性检验、GARCH(1,1)模型和Granger因果检验，分析了这些农产品的价格模式、结构稳定性、波动行为和市场互动关系，发现市场存在双向因果关系和波动聚集现象，为政策制定者、交易者和农民提供了风险管理与市场可持续发展的启示。
AI.research_question: 印度关键农产品（瓜尔豆、瓜尔胶、蓖麻籽）在2015-2025年期间的经济可持续性如何？其价格模式、结构稳定性、波动行为及市场互动呈现出怎样的特征？
AI.motivation: 评估印度农产品市场的韧性和效率，为政策制定者、交易者和农民提供风险管理和市场可持续发展的决策依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 时间序列计量经济学理论、市场效率理论、波动聚集理论（GARCH模型）、价格发现理论（Granger因果关系）
AI.method: 采用ADF单位根检验评估序列平稳性；Bai-Perron多重断点检验识别结构突变点；CUSUM检验确认数据中的稳定区间；GARCH(1,1)模型捕捉波动聚集和持续性；Granger因果检验分析期货与现货市场之间的价格引导关系。
AI.findings: （1）ADF检验确认了收益率序列的平稳性；（2）Bai-Perron检验识别出市场行为发生显著变化的结构断点；（3）GARCH(1,1)模型显示冲击对市场波动的影响具有持续性，表明市场对冲击具有一定韧性；（4）Granger因果检验表明多数商品的期货与现货市场之间存在双向因果关系，说明两个市场价格发现效率较高、信息流动良好。
AI.theory_contributions: 证实了结构断点和波动持续性在农产品市场分析中的重要性，为时间序列模型在农业经济学中的应用提供了实证支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 为印度农产品市场的政策制定者、交易者和农民提供了增强风险管理实践和促进市场可持续增长的具体建议。

title: The Impact of Capital Market Participation on GDP per Capita: A Comparative Study of the USA and Türkiye

detail.title: The Impact of Capital Market Participation on GDP per Capita: A Comparative Study of the USA and Türkiye
detail.abstract: The purpose of this study is to analyze and comparatively evaluate the impact of household participation in capital markets through the total ownership of equity securities, debt securities, and mutual funds on real GDP per capita in Türkiye and the United States in the short and long run, using quarterly data from 2010Q4 to 2025Q2. The Autoregressive Distributed Lag (ARDL) Bounds Test Approach is utilized in the study to conduct a comprehensive analysis. This approach is expected to reveal a significant and positive relationship between household participation in capital markets and real GDP per capita in both the short and long run. In addition, the variables of gross fixed capital formation, trade openness, and private credit are also determined and included in the model as control variables to clarify the findings and isolate potential confounding effects that could disrupt the analysis. Throughout the analysis, the differences and reasons for the disparity in data and findings from Türkiye and the United States will be examined, and a comparative study will be conducted. Accordingly, this study aims to emphasize the importance of utilizing a significant portion of household savings through effective mechanisms that contribute to economic growth.

AI.tldr: 本文利用2010Q4-2025Q2的季度数据，采用ARDL边界检验方法，比较分析土耳其和美国 households 参与资本市场（股票、债券、共同基金）对实际人均GDP的短期与长期影响。
AI.research_question: 家庭参与资本市场（通过持有股票、债券和共同基金）对土耳其和美国实际人均GDP的短期与长期影响有何差异？
AI.motivation: 强调家庭储蓄通过有效机制（资本市场）配置对经济增长的重要性，并通过跨国比较揭示不同经济体之间的差异与原因。
AI.theoretical_framework: 资本市场参与促进经济增长理论；ARDL边界检验方法（协整分析）。
AI.method: 采用2010Q4-2025Q2的季度数据，运用自回归分布滞后（ARDL）边界检验方法，控制变量包括固定资本形成总额、贸易开放度和私人信贷。
AI.findings: 预期发现：家庭参与资本市场对实际人均GDP在短期和长期均有显著正向影响；土耳其与美国的实证结果存在差异。
AI.theory_contributions: 将家庭层面的资本市场参与行为与宏观经济增长联系起来，通过跨国比较验证该关系的稳健性，并揭示制度与结构性差异的影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供依据：引导家庭储蓄通过资本市场配置可促进经济增长；针对新兴市场（土耳其）与发达市场（美国）提出差异化政策建议。

title: Towards a Meta-Narrative of African Economic Thought: Integrating Textual and Non-Textual Sources
affiliations: Clean Technology Hub

detail.title: Towards a Meta-Narrative of African Economic Thought: Integrating Textual and Non-Textual Sources
detail.abstract: The history of African economic thought is characterised by a fundamental fragmentation. Scholars working from written textual sourceseconomic treatises, newspapers, political speechesengage minimally with those who reconstruct vernacular economic ideas from archaeology, historical linguistics, and oral tradition; and vice versa. This paper argues that this fragmentation has prevented the field from producing a meta-narrative: an integrated account of how African societies conceptualised wealth, poverty, and the causes of material change across time. Drawing on existing scholarship across both traditions, it develops a frameworkvernacular-elite contextualisationfor integrating these corpora. It identifies the structural reasons why the two scholarly traditions developed apart, catalogues the specific methodological challenges that each faces, and demonstrates through a comparative typology of pre-textual African economic ideas what an integrated meta-narrative might look like. The paper concludes by identifying the analytical payoffs of integration: the tracing of vernacular-elite coorientation, the analysis of how textual development theories subsequently renegotiated with vernacular conceptions of the good life, and the construction of a fully grounded intellectual history of African economic thought.

AI.tldr: 本文指出非洲经济思想史研究存在根本性分裂：基于文本史料（经济论文、报纸、政治演讲）的学者与通过考古学、历史语言学和口述传统重构本土经济观念的学者之间缺乏交流。作者提出"本土-精英语境化"框架来整合这两大传统，通过比较前文本时期非洲经济观念的类型学，展示了整合后的元叙事可能样貌，并指出了整合的分析收益。
AI.research_question: 非洲经济思想史研究中，基于文本史料的学术传统与基于非文本证据的本土经济观念研究传统之间的分裂如何被克服？整合的元叙事应当如何构建？
AI.motivation: 非洲经济思想史领域长期存在两大研究传统之间的严重割裂，导致该领域无法形成对非洲社会如何概念化财富、贫困以及物质变迁原因的整合性元叙事。这种碎片化限制了人们对非洲经济思想全貌的理解。
AI.theoretical_framework: "本土-精英语境化"（vernacular-elite contextualisation）框架，用于整合文本传统与非文本传统的研究素材。
AI.method: 文献综述与比较类型学分析：梳理两大传统各自的结构性成因与方法论挑战，构建前文本时期非洲经济观念的类型学框架。
AI.findings: 两大传统分裂有其结构性原因；各自面临特定的方法论挑战；通过比较类型学展示了整合元叙事的可行性；整合后可实现追溯本土-精英共向性、分析文本发展理论如何与本土美好生活观念重新协商、构建充分扎根的非洲经济思想智识史。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"本土-精英语境化"这一新的整合框架，为弥合非洲经济思想史研究的方法论鸿沟提供了理论路径；构建了前文本时期非洲经济观念的比较类型学。
AI.practical_contributions: 为从事非洲经济思想史研究的学者提供了跨传统对话的方法论工具，有望推动该领域形成更完整的智识史叙事。

title: Unwind the Clock? Temporal Distance and User Interactions on a Digital Platform
affiliations: Johns Hopkins University - Carey Business School, Harvard Business School and Harvard University - Business School (HBS)

detail.title: Unwind the Clock? Temporal Distance and User Interactions on a Digital Platform
detail.abstract: Digital platforms provide arenas for global knowledge diffusion, but their underlying architecture often relies on synchronous exchange, inadvertently siloing users into distinct "time pockets" based on time zones. Using proprietary data from StackOverflow, we implement a regression discontinuity design to causally estimate that a one-hour increase (decrease) in the temporal distance between two regions leads to a 13.6% decrease (9.5% increase) in views and a 20.9% decrease (21.0% increase) in votes between those regions. These temporal frictions disproportionately penalize interactions in niche knowledge communities (e.g., sudo, slack-api) over those in popular ones (e.g., Python, JavaScript). Importantly, we show that a platform can mitigate temporal barriers by shuffling content representation. This paper contributes to our understanding of platform strategy, temporal distance, and global knowledge diffusion.

AI.tldr: 数字平台的时间区隔阻碍了全球知识扩散：时区差异导致跨区域互动显著下降，利基知识社区受损更严重，但平台可通过内容排序策略缓解这一障碍。
AI.research_question: 数字平台的同步交互架构如何通过时区差异（时间距离）影响全球知识扩散？平台能否通过内容呈现策略缓解这种时间摩擦？
AI.motivation: 数字平台虽为全球知识扩散提供可能，但其同步交互架构可能将用户按时间区隔在"时间口袋"中，这一潜在阻碍及其缓解机制尚未得到因果识别。
AI.theoretical_framework: 平台战略理论、时间距离理论、全球知识扩散理论
AI.method: 利用StackOverflow专有数据，采用断点回归设计（RDD）进行因果推断。
AI.findings: （1）两区域间时差每增加1小时，跨区域浏览数下降13.6%、投票数下降20.9%；时差减少则反之。（2）时区摩擦对利基知识社区（如sudo, slack-api）的负面影响大于热门社区（如Python, JavaScript）。（3）平台可通过调整内容呈现排序来缓解时间障碍。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次从时间距离视角揭示数字平台同步架构对全球知识扩散的阻碍机制，丰富了平台战略与知识扩散理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为数字平台设计异步互动机制或内容排序策略以促进跨时区知识流动提供了实证依据。

title: Impact of Role Model Videos on Student Cognitive Outcomes and Non-Cognitive Skills *
affiliations: , University of Tokyo and Bowdoin College

detail.title: Impact of Role Model Videos on Student Cognitive Outcomes and Non-Cognitive Skills *
detail.abstract: We conducted an RCT in Chinese elementary, middle and high schools, showing female STEM role models via short biographical videos. The intervention yielded insignificant effects on non-cognitive skills. However, math test scores declined for both genders, particularly among low-performing male students. Heterogeneous effects also emerged on formal exams: low-performing male students' math scores decreased, while high-performing female students' Chinese language scores increased. These results point to the diversity of the role model effect: struggling students may fail to relate to impressive role models, reinforcing perceptions of unsuitability for STEM and shifting effort away from math toward other subjects.

AI.tldr: 一项在中国中小学开展的随机对照实验发现，女性STEM榜样视频干预对非认知技能影响不显著，但降低了数学测试成绩，尤其对低表现男生影响更大；高表现女生的语文成绩反而提升，揭示了榜样效应的异质性。
AI.research_question: 女性STEM榜样干预如何影响中国中小学生的学业表现与非认知技能？其效应是否存在异质性？
AI.motivation: 已有研究多关注STEM榜样对提升女性STEM参与度的积极作用，但对其潜在的负面效应（如削弱弱势学生的信心和学业表现）关注不足，且缺乏来自中国教育情境的随机实验证据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 角色榜样效应（Role Model Effect），自我效能理论，社会比较理论，刻板印象威胁
AI.method: 在中国小学、初中、高中开展随机对照实验（RCT），通过播放女性STEM榜样短视频进行干预，测量非认知技能与标准化考试成绩。
AI.findings: （1）干预对非认知技能无显著影响；（2）数学测试成绩下降，低表现男生受影响最大；（3）在正式考试中，低表现男生数学成绩下降，高表现女生语文成绩上升。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了角色榜样效应的"双刃剑"特征：对于学业困难学生，高成就榜样可能通过社会比较产生负面激励，强化"自己不匹配STEM"的认知，从而将努力转移至其他学科。
AI.practical_contributions: 为教育政策制定者和学校设计STEM干预项目提供警示：榜样干预需考虑学生异质性，对弱势学生可能需要配合支持性措施，避免简单"榜样展示"引发逆反效果。

detail.abstract: The U.S. banking sector, especially community banks, faces growing risks from changing regulations, advanced cyber threats, and competition from big banks and fintech companies. Defined here as institutions with assets under $10 billion, community banks play a crucial role in local economies by offering personalized services to small businesses, farms, and consumers in underserved markets. However, many of these banks still lack the technological systems and data analysis skills necessary to thrive in a more data-driven financial world. Based on these findings, community banks should invest strategically in scalable data analytics capability, build robust data governance frameworks, strengthen workforce training in analytical skills, harden their cybersecurity infrastructure, and pursue partnerships with technology providers to accelerate their digital transformation.

AI.tldr: 美国社区银行面临监管变化、网络安全威胁和金融科技竞争等风险，亟需通过投资数据分析能力、建立数据治理框架、加强员工培训、强化网络安全和寻求技术合作来实现数字化转型。

AI.motivation: 社区银行在地方经济中扮演重要角色，但其技术系统和数据分析能力落后，难以在新的金融环境中竞争，亟需提出应对策略。

AI.practical_contributions: 为社区银行提出了五项具体行动建议：投资可扩展的数据分析能力、构建数据治理框架、加强员工分析技能培训、强化网络安全基础设施、与技术提供商合作加速数字化转型。

keywords: Community banking; small business financing; relationship lending; access to capital; credit risk assessment; financial inclusion; alternative credit data; economic development; entrepreneurship.

detail.abstract: Small businesses form the backbone of the U.S. economy, fueling innovation, creating jobs, and fostering community growth nationwide. However, many small enterprises still struggle to access capital, especially those with limited credit histories, minimal collateral, or based in economically underserved areas. This qualitative study explores how community banks help bridge that financing gap, thereby supporting economic growth and employment. Using academic studies, government sources, and industry reports, it compares various lending models, assesses the barriers faced by small businesses, and highlights the benefits community banks provide in overcoming these challenges. The findings show that community banks rely on relationship lending, soft information gathering, and local market knowledge to deliver personalized financial services that larger institutions struggle to replicate. Information asymmetry, collateral constraints, and geographic disparities are the primary obstacles to small-business financing. The study also examines how emerging technologies, including AI-assisted underwriting, alternative credit assessment, and digital lending platforms, can sharpen credit decisions without compromising prudent risk management. Building on these findings, the paper outlines an integrated community banking lending framework consisting of eight key components: financial education for borrowers, data-driven credit evaluation, risk-based lending policies, relationship banking, ongoing loan supervision, partnerships with government and community groups, digital lending technologies, and continuous performance assessment. This framework aims to increase access to capital while responsibly maintaining portfolio quality. Recommendations emphasize enhancing relationship banking, utilizing predictive analytics, expanding financial literacy initiatives, and strengthening collaboration between community banks and local economic development agencies—steps that have direct effects on U.S. entrepreneurship, job creation, financial inclusion, and sustainable growth.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨社区银行如何通过关系型贷款、软信息收集和本地市场知识，帮助信用记录有限、抵押品不足或位于经济欠发达地区的小企业解决融资难题，并提出了包含八大要素的综合社区银行贷款框架。
AI.research_question: 社区银行如何帮助小企业弥合融资缺口，从而支持经济增长和就业？
AI.motivation: 尽管小企业是美国经济的支柱，但许多小企业（尤其是信用记录有限、抵押品不足或位于经济欠发达地区的企业）仍难以获得资本，这一融资缺口亟需有效的解决方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 关系型贷款理论、软信息收集理论、信息不对称理论、信贷配给理论
AI.method: 定性研究，综合运用学术研究、政府来源和行业报告，比较不同贷款模式，评估小企业面临的障碍，分析社区银行在克服这些挑战中的优势。
AI.findings: 1）社区银行依靠关系型贷款、软信息收集和本地市场知识提供个性化金融服务，这是大型机构难以复制的；2）信息不对称、抵押品约束和地理差异是小企业融资的主要障碍；3）AI辅助承保、替代性信用评估和数字贷款平台等新兴技术可在不牺牲审慎风险管理的前提下优化信贷决策。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个包含八个关键组成部分的综合社区银行贷款框架（借款人金融教育、数据驱动信用评估、基于风险的贷款政策、关系银行、持续贷款监督、政府及社区组织合作、数字贷款技术、持续绩效评估），为关系型贷款理论在数字时代的发展提供了新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为社区银行提供了增强关系型银行、利用预测分析、扩大金融素养倡议以及与地方经济发展机构加强协作的具体建议，这些措施直接有助于美国创业、就业创造、金融包容性和可持续增长。

detail.title: Enterprise Risk Management in U.S. Financial Institutions: Building Resilience in an Increasingly Complex Risk Environment

detail.abstract: The U.S. financial sector currently faces a wide range of unprecedented risks, including credit, market, liquidity, cybersecurity, and algorithmic decision-making challenges, all worsened by an expanding regulatory environment. The 2008 crisis and ensuing reforms have elevated standards for risk management. Nonetheless, many institutions still struggle to develop comprehensive Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) systems that operate smoothly across departments, leverage technology effectively, and withstand multiple shocks (Lawati et al., 2025). This paper examines the current ERM landscape among U.S. financial institutions, highlights gaps in existing frameworks, and proposes an integrated model to boost resilience, compliance, and stakeholder value simultaneously rather than separately. This qualitative, applied approach systematically reviews academic literature, regulatory documents, and industry reports, primarily from peer-reviewed sources from 2015 to 2025. It also includes materials from federal banking agencies and industry bodies. A clear pattern emerges: institutions with more advanced ERM implementation tend to perform better financially and adapt more effectively to disruptions (Gao, Hsu, and Liu, 2025).
