Nonetheless, this maturity level varies widely; smaller banks often struggle to adopt the technology and analytics that larger institutions readily implement. Cybersecurity has become the fastest-evolving risk category, surpassing others. The swift adoption of artificial intelligence and machine learning boosts capabilities but also introduces new risks not seen a decade ago (Ma, 2025). Overall, the evidence points to key priorities: develop an integrated ERM framework with a focus on risk governance, utilize predictive analytics, enhance cybersecurity, invest in employee training, and view regulatory engagement as an ongoing relationship rather than a mere checklist. Success hinges on genuine board ownership and embedding a risk culture into daily operations, beyond policy documents.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了美国金融机构企业风险管理（ERM）的现状，指出其面临信用、市场、流动性、网络安全和算法决策等多重风险，并提出一个整合模型以同时提升韧性、合规性和利益相关者价值。
AI.research_question: 美国金融机构当前企业风险管理（ERM）的实施现状如何？存在哪些框架缺陷？如何构建一个整合模型以同时提升韧性、合规性和利益相关者价值？
AI.motivation: 2008年金融危机后监管环境不断扩张，但许多机构仍难以建立跨部门顺畅运作、有效利用技术并能抵御多重冲击的综合性ERM系统，小型机构与大型机构之间风险管理成熟度差距显著。
AI.theoretical_framework: 企业风险管理（ERM）理论、风险治理理论、整合风险管理框架
AI.method: 定性、应用型研究方法，系统梳理2015-2025年同行评审学术文献、监管文件及行业报告，并纳入联邦银行机构和行业组织的资料。
AI.findings: 1) ERM实施更成熟的机构财务表现更佳、适应能力更强；2) 成熟度差异显著，小型银行在技术和分析应用上落后于大型机构；3) 网络安全已成为演变最快的风险类别；4) AI/ML在提升能力的同时也引入了新型风险。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个整合ERM框架，强调风险治理、预测分析、网络安全、员工培训和持续监管互动五大优先事项，超越了传统碎片化的风险管理视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为金融机构提供了可操作的建议：董事会真正"坐拥"风险责任、将风险文化嵌入日常运营而非停留于政策文件，以及将监管合规视为持续关系而非清单核查。

title: Falling Solar Costs, Temporary Tax Credits, and the Option Value of Green Investment
affiliations: Bradford University School of Management

detail.title: Falling Solar Costs, Temporary Tax Credits, and the Option Value of Green Investment
detail.abstract: Falling solar installation costs raise the value of waiting for cheaper capital; a temporary investment tax credit (ITC) creates opposing pressure to invest before the subsidy disappears. We develop a two-factor real-option model in which the ITC may last forever, expire at a known date, or be repealed at a random time; first-passage-time methods deliver closed-form thresholds, and the known deadline is solved by finite differences. Distinguishing finite subsidy duration from repeal risk---made vivid by the accelerated phase-out of the US solar ITC in 2025---proves quantitatively central. In a utility-scale solar calibration, for a project at the money a credible ten-year 30% credit preserves 73% of the option-value gain of a permanent credit, while repeal risk with the same expected life preserves only 46%---making the credit worth no more than a credible permanent 16% credit. The split between the two losses depends on moneyness: finite duration dominates for marginal projects, lack of credibility for projects near exercise---the very projects an accelerated phase-out strands. A known deadline accelerates investment but induces bunching before expiry and a post-deadline slump. Both credibility and duration substitute for subsidy magnitude.

AI.tldr: 本文构建双因子实物期权模型，研究太阳能投资税收抵免（ITC）的有限期限与 repeal 风险对投资决策的差异化影响。校准发现：有限期限与 repeal 风险的期权价值损失效应不同，且取决于项目"货币性"；已知截止日期会引发投资提前和到期后萧条。
AI.research_question: 太阳能投资税收抵免的有限期限与 repeal 风险如何差异化影响投资时机与期权价值？
AI.motivation: 太阳能安装成本下降提高了等待更廉价资本的价值，而临时性ITC则产生反向压力；2025年美国太阳能ITC加速退坡使区分有限补贴期限与 repeal 风险变得至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 双因子实物期权模型（two-factor real-option model），首次通过时间方法（first-passage-time methods），有限差分法（finite differences）。
AI.method: 理论建模：构建双因子实物期权模型，ITC可永久存在、在已知日期到期或随机时间被 repeal；用首次通过时间方法推导封闭解阈值，已知截止日期情形用有限差分法求解。
AI.findings: （1）对于平价项目，可信的10年期30%抵免保留了永久抵免73%的期权价值增益，而相同期望寿命的 repeal 风险只保留46%；（2）有限期限对边际项目影响更大，repeal 风险对接近行权的项目影响更大；（3）已知截止日期加速投资但引发到期前集中和到期后萧条；（4）可信度与期限均可替代补贴规模。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次在实物期权框架中系统区分有限补贴期限与 repeal 风险，揭示二者对投资时机的差异化影响机制，并通过货币性维度刻画其条件性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策设计提供量化依据：补贴的信誉与期限可替代补贴规模，加速退坡会搁浅接近行权的项目，政策制定需平衡截止日期效应与信誉风险。

title: What Factors Influenced the Voter Turnout in the 2024 Indian Elections?
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: What Factors Influenced the Voter Turnout in the 2024 Indian Elections?
detail.abstract: This paper examines the socio-economic determinants of voter turnout across Indian states in the 2024 general elections, using CSDS/Lokniti post-election survey data. Voter turnout is modelled as a function of the Human Development Index (HDI), literacy rate, and voter turnout in the 2019 elections, using an OLS regression. Turnout and literacy rate were log-transformed to address skewness typical of rate variables, while HDI was retained in its original bounded scale. The results show that 2019 turnout is a highly significant predictor of 2024 turnout (elasticity = 0.75, p < 0.001), indicating strong persistence in state-level voting behaviour. In contrast, neither HDI nor literacy rate showed a statistically significant relationship with turnout, and literacy rate's coefficient was unexpectedly negative — though not distinguishable from zero. Diagnostic tests (VIF, Breusch-Pagan, Goldfeld-Quandt) confirmed the model met standard OLS assumptions with no evidence of problematic multicollinearity or heteroskedasticity. These findings suggest that historical voting patterns, rather than socio-economic development indicators, are the dominant driver of state-level turnout in India, with implications for how policymakers and civic organisations target turnout interventions.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用2024年印度大选后的CSDS/Lokniti调查数据，通过OLS回归分析发现，2019年投票率是2024年各邦投票率的最强预测因子（弹性系数0.75），而人类发展指数和识字率等社会经济指标与投票率无显著统计关系。这表明历史投票模式而非经济发展水平主导了印度各邦的投票率。
AI.research_question: 印度各邦选民投票率的社会经济决定因素是什么？
AI.motivation: 理解投票率背后的驱动力对于政策制定者和公民组织设计有效的投票促进干预措施至关重要，特别是在印度这样一个多元化和人口众多的民主国家。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于发展经济学和投票行为理论，假设人类发展指数（HDI）和识字率等社会经济指标与投票率正相关，同时控制历史投票模式的影响。
AI.method: 使用CSDS/Lokniti 2024年大选后调查数据，采用OLS回归模型，将投票率与识字率进行对数变换以解决偏态问题，HDI保留原始有界尺度，以2019年投票率作为控制变量。
AI.findings: 2019年投票率对2024年投票率有高度显著的预测作用（弹性=0.75, p<0.001），表明各邦投票行为具有强持续性；HDI和识字率与投票率均无显著统计关系，且识字率的系数为负但不显著。模型通过VIF、Breusch-Pagan和Goldfeld-Quandt检验，满足OLS经典假设。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了"发展水平越高投票率越高"的传统假设，揭示了在印度语境下历史制度惯性（路径依赖）比社会经济因素更能解释投票率差异。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和公民组织提供了实证依据：提升投票率的干预措施应聚焦于改变历史投票惯性，而非依赖长期的社会经济发展指标，需要针对低投票率历史邦进行精准干预。

title: Digital Transformation as Organizational Change: Strategy, Culture, and Capability Building
affiliations: Texas A&M University (TAMU), Central Texas, Center for Migration Studies of New York, Inc. and Texas A&M University (TAMU), Central Texas

detail.title: Digital Transformation as Organizational Change: Strategy, Culture, and Capability Building
detail.abstract: This article examines digital transformation as a broad process of organizational change rather than a narrow technology implementation project. It argues that successful transformation depends on strategic alignment, leadership commitment, cultural adaptation, and the development of dynamic digital capabilities. The article highlights how organizations move from isolated digitization initiatives toward integrated transformation programs that reshape decision making, work design, customer engagement, and value creation.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨数字化转型是一个广泛的组织变革过程，而非狭义的技术实施项目。成功的数字化转型依赖于战略对齐、领导承诺、文化适应和动态数字能力的发展。文章强调了组织如何从孤立的数字化举措转向重塑决策、工作设计、客户互动和价值创造的综合转型项目。
AI.research_question: 数字化转型作为组织变革过程的关键成功因素和机制是什么？组织如何从孤立的数字化举措转向综合性的数字化转型？
AI.motivation: 现有研究往往将数字化转型视为技术实施项目，忽视了其作为组织变革过程的本质，缺乏对成功转型关键因素的系统性理解。
AI.theoretical_framework: 组织变革理论、动态能力理论、战略对齐理论
AI.method: 概念性论文/文献综述（基于摘要推断，未明确说明具体研究方法）
AI.findings: 成功的数字化转型取决于战略对齐、领导承诺、文化适应和动态数字能力的发展；组织需要从孤立的数字化举措向综合转型项目演进，以重塑决策、工作设计、客户互动和价值创造。
AI.theory_contributions: 将数字化转型重新概念化为组织变革过程而非技术实施项目，整合了战略对齐、领导力、文化和动态能力等理论视角来解释数字化转型的成功因素。
AI.practical_contributions: 为管理者提供了数字化转型的关键成功因素框架，指导组织如何从零散数字化举措走向系统性转型，强调了领导承诺和文化适应的重要性。

title: Sustainable consumption vs. green consumerism: efficiency, sufficiency, and the material conditions of household practices
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, University of Alcala and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Sustainable consumption vs. green consumerism: efficiency, sufficiency, and the material conditions of household practices
detail.abstract: The long-standing opposition between growth-oriented and limits-oriented visions of sustainable consumption —efficiency versus sufficiency— is usually debated on normative and macroeconomic grounds, and much less often examined at the level of the consumers and practices through which either vision would have to be realised. We ask whether the distinction between the green consumerist, who consumes more efficiently, and the comprehensive sustainable consumer, who also consumes less, reflects fixed individual dispositions or the material conditions under which consumption practices are performed. Drawing on social practice theory, we distinguish elective practices, which depend mainly on individual choice, from infrastructure-dependent practices, which rest on household equipment and the surrounding socio-technical system. Using latent class analysis on 937,154 respondents from ten Ibero-American countries, we find that practices sort households into a plurality of profiles rather than a dichotomy, and that cross-country variation concentrates in the practices tied to infrastructure and climate while sparing those left to individual choice. The distinction is therefore contingent rather than fixed: the green, efficiency-based profile is common in Spain (30% of respondents) and almost absent in countries such as Ecuador or Costa Rica (below 3%), where sustainability takes the comprehensive, sufficiency-inclusive form instead. The efficiency path to sustainable consumption thus presupposes a material infrastructure that many settings lack, whereas the sufficiency path is comparatively independent of it —an empirical asymmetry with direct implications for how sustainable consumption is studied, debated, and promoted.

AI.tldr: 本文通过分析10个伊比利亚美洲国家93.7万受访者的数据，发现可持续消费中的"效率"与"足量"路径并非固定的人格特质，而是取决于物质基础设施条件。效率路径依赖于发达的 socio-technical 系统，因此在基础设施薄弱的国家难以实现；而足量路径则相对独立于基础设施。
AI.research_question: 绿色消费主义（效率导向）与全面可持续消费（足量导向）之间的区分，是反映了固定的个人倾向，还是取决于消费实践得以执行的物质条件？
AI.motivation: 可持续消费领域的"效率vs足量"之争长期在规范性和宏观经济层面展开，很少在消费者和实践层面进行实证检验。本文试图弥补这一空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 社会实践理论（Social Practice Theory），区分了"选择性实践"（依赖个人选择）和"基础设施依赖型实践"（依赖家庭设备和社会技术系统）。
AI.method: 潜类别分析（Latent Class Analysis），样本涵盖10个伊比利亚美洲国家的937,154名受访者。
AI.findings: （1）实践将家庭分为多种类型而非简单的二分法；（2）跨国差异主要集中在与基础设施和气候相关的实践上，而非个人选择领域；（3）效率型绿色消费在西班牙常见（30%），在厄瓜多尔或哥斯达黎加几乎不存在（低于3%），后者以足量型全面可持续消费为主。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了"效率vs足量"作为固定个体倾向的假设，揭示了这一区分的情境依赖性；为可持续消费研究提供了基于实践理论的实证分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 效率型可持续消费路径需要物质基础设施支撑，而足量路径对此依赖较小——这一不对称性对发展中国家可持续消费的政策制定具有直接指导意义。

title: Birth by Fire: Exploring Identity, Trauma and the Naga Homeland in Temsula Ao's These Hills Called Home
affiliations: North Lakhimpur College (Autonomous) and North Lakhimpur University

detail.title: Birth by Fire: Exploring Identity, Trauma and the Naga Homeland in Temsula Ao's These Hills Called Home
detail.abstract: This paper examines Temsula Ao's These Hills Called Home: Stories from a War Zone as an emic literary representation of Naga identity, homeland, and collective trauma. It argues that Ao moves beyond conventional political narratives of insurgency by foregrounding the lived experiences of ordinary people caught between Naga nationalism and state counter-insurgency. Through selected stories, the paper analyses the symbolic significance of homeland, militarisation, fractured social relations, memory, and gendered violence in shaping Naga subjectivity. It contends that Ao's narratives preserve indigenous perspectives on conflict, revealing how violence transforms individuals, communities, and cultural identity while sustaining aspirations for dignity and self-determination.

AI.tldr: 本文以Temsula Ao的《These Hills Called Home: Stories from a War Zone》为研究对象，从主位（emic）视角分析那加人的身份认同、家园与集体创伤，指出Ao超越传统叛乱政治叙事，通过普通人经历揭示暴力如何形塑个体、社区与文化身份。
AI.research_question: Temsula Ao的短篇小说如何从主位视角表征那加人的身份认同、家园与集体创伤？
AI.motivation: 既有关于那加冲突的研究多聚焦于政治叛乱与国家反叛乱叙事，缺乏对普通人在民族主义与军事镇压夹缝中生活经验的本土视角呈现。
AI.theoretical_framework: 主位/客位理论（emic/etic）、集体创伤理论、后殖民身份认同理论、女性主义与性别暴力分析。
AI.method: 文本细读与叙事分析，选取多篇短篇小说作为分析对象。
AI.findings: Ao通过家园的象征意义、军事化、社会关系断裂、记忆与性别暴力等主题，揭示了暴力对个体、社区和文化身份的深层形塑，同时保留了那加人对尊严与自决的渴望。
AI.theory_contributions: 将主位视角引入那加冲突研究，丰富了集体创伤与身份认同理论在边缘族群文学中的运用，挑战了以国家为中心的主导叙事。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解那加冲突提供了本土文学层面的替代性叙事，有助于政策制定者与研究者重视受冲突影响的普通民众的声音与经验。

title: The Identification Frontier of Phillips-Curve Change: What Can and Cannot Be Known About Structural Change in Inflation Dynamics

detail.title: The Identification Frontier of Phillips-Curve Change: What Can and Cannot Be Known About Structural Change in Inflation Dynamics

declarations.declarationOfInterest: I am the sole author without any funding. Everything from ideas to finished article is done be me alone.

detail.abstract: The Phillips-curve flattening debate asks whether the structural relation between inflation and real activity weakened and, if so, where: in the propagation of shocks through price setting, in the shocks that arrive, in what inflation indices measure, or in the law governing the relation itself. This paper treats the question as an identification problem. Each policy regime is represented as a linear state-space system with three layers: a transition layer (propagation), an activation layer (shock loadings), and a readout layer (measurement). The internal coordinates of such a system are not unique: any invertible change of basis-called a gauge here-leaves every impulse response unchanged, and coordinates may be changed independently across regimes. Attribution of observed change to a layer is therefore a statement about a quotient space. I prove that the pair of regime transfer functions is the maximal invariant of this double coordinate action-the finest statistic the data can ever determine-and derive from it the complete identification frontier. Transition-layer change is decided, in every coordinate system, by the poles of the minimal realization. The hypothesis that all change is transition-layer change is equivalent to equality of the impactresponse matrix: an if-and-only-if specification test requiring no assumptions beyond shock identification. Pure readout change and pure activation change have exact stacked-Hankel rank tests, yet readout can never be separated from activation without an anchor-a declared coordinate convention-whose exact purchasing power is computed: partial anchors of ranks J 0 and K 0 leave residual attribution ambiguity of dimension (n-J 0)(n-K 0) per regime. A fixed nonlinear Phillips relation and a genuinely moving one are observationally equivalent on any single non-recurrent excursion of the state and are separated exactly when the state path is recurrent within the observation window-when, with positive probability and at arbitrarily fine scales, it revisits regions previously occupied, as after 2020. The historical scalar slope is shown to be well identified but layer-blind: its changes are neither necessary nor sufficient for change in any layer. The paper gives no verdict on United States inflation dynamics; it closes the identification problem behind the debate within the stated model class, classifying every expressible sub-question as answered, answered conditionally with the condition stated as a theorem, or provably unanswerable.

AI.tldr: 本文从识别问题的角度研究菲利普斯曲线平坦化辩论，提出一个三层线性状态空间系统框架（过渡层、激活层、读出层），证明各层变化的可识别性边界，指出许多问题具有根本性的不可识别性。
AI.research_question: 菲利普斯曲线平坦化究竟是源于价格传导（过渡层）、冲击来源（激活层）、通胀测量（读出层），还是结构关系本身的根本性改变？
AI.motivation: 菲利普斯曲线平坦化辩论长期存在，但各方争论的"变化"究竟发生在哪个层面缺乏严格的识别理论支撑，导致经验证据难以收敛。
AI.theoretical_framework: 三层线性状态空间系统（过渡层-传播、激活层-冲击载荷、读出层-测量）；规范场论中的"规范变换"概念（基变换不变性）；商空间理论；最小实现极点理论。
AI.method: 通过将每个政策体制表示为三层线性状态空间系统，利用双重坐标变换下的最大不变量（体制传递函数对）推导完整的识别边界，并给出了多个统计检验。
AI.findings: 1) 过渡层变化由最小实现的极点决定，在所有坐标系下均可识别。2) 读出层与激活层无法分离，除非有锚定坐标约定。3) 固定非线性菲利普斯曲线与真正的移动曲线在单次非递归轨迹下观察等价。4) 历史标量斜率是层盲的。
AI.theory_contributions: 为菲利普斯曲线平坦化辩论提供了严格的识别理论框架，明确了哪些问题可回答、哪些有条件可回答、哪些不可回答的边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 为实证研究提供了完整的检验方法：过渡层变化的冲击响应矩阵等式检验、读出/激活变化的堆叠Hankel秩检验，以及锚定购买力的量化计算。

title: From Perceived Luck and Background to Respect for the Rich: Dynastically Structured Meritocracy in South Korea
affiliations: Yeungnam University

detail.title: From Perceived Luck and Background to Respect for the Rich: Dynastically Structured Meritocracy in South Korea

declarations.funderStatement: No Funder

detail.abstract: This study examines how South Korean adolescents' perceptions of luck and background in success are associated with respect for the rich in a society where meritocratic competition is tacitly institutionalised. It tests whether meritocratic beliefs, materialistic values, credentialism (the status hierarchy attached to educational credentials and university prestige), and future-interest orientation (the prioritisation of individual achievement over historical or collective considerations) mediate this association, and whether family economic status and social recognition-seeking strengthen the pathway from meritocratic beliefs to respect for the rich. Using the 2023 Korean Youth Values Survey conducted by the National Youth Policy Institute, the study combines LASSO variable selection with path analysis for a national sample of 7,456 adolescents. Perceived importance of luck and background was positively associated with all four mediators, each positively associated with respect for the rich. The total association was .120, and the total indirect association (.075) exceeded the direct association (.045), indicating that approximately 63% of the association operated through the specified mediating pathways. The strongest indirect pathway operated through meritocratic beliefs (ab = .036), followed by materialistic values, credentialism, and future-interest orientation. Family economic status and social recognition-seeking each strengthened the association between meritocratic beliefs and respect for the rich, although their incremental explanatory power was small. The findings suggest that adolescents' recognition of luck and background does not necessarily undermine meritocratic legitimacy but may be absorbed into a dynastically structured meritocracy in which family background, economic capital, educational credentials, and social recognition are reinterpreted as signs of merit.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用2023年韩国青少年价值观调查数据（N=7,456），结合LASSO变量选择与路径分析，发现韩国青少年对运气和背景在成功中重要性的认知，通过 meritocratic beliefs、物质主义价值观、文凭主义和未来利益导向等中介路径，与对富人的尊重呈正相关，且家庭经济地位和社会认可寻求强化了 meritocratic beliefs 与尊重富人之间的关联。研究指出，青少年对运气和背景的认知并未削弱 meritocratic 合法性，反而可能被吸收进一种"王朝式 meritocracy"中。
AI.research_question: 韩国青少年对运气和背景在成功中作用的认知，如何与他们对富人的尊重相关联？
AI.motivation: 在 meritocratic 竞争被默认制度化的韩国社会中，探讨青少年对非 meritocratic 因素（运气、背景）的认知是否会削弱或反而被整合进 meritocratic 叙事中，从而影响其对富人的态度。该问题涉及 meritocracy 合法性再生产这一核心社会学议题。
AI.theoretical_framework: Meritocracy 理论、物质主义价值观理论、文凭主义（Credentialism）、未来利益导向理论、社会认知理论
AI.method: 数据来源：2023年韩国青少年价值观调查（韩国国家青年政策研究所）；样本量：7,456名全国青少年；分析方法：LASSO 变量选择 + 路径分析；中介效应检验：四种中介路径；调节效应检验：家庭经济地位和社会认可寻求的调节作用。
AI.findings: 1）运气和背景的感知与四种中介变量均呈正相关，四种中介变量均与尊重富人正相关；2）总关联为.120，总间接关联（.075）超过直接关联（.045），约63%的关联通过中介路径传导；3）最强的间接路径是 meritocratic beliefs（ab=.036），其次是物质主义价值观、文凭主义和未来利益导向；4）家庭经济地位和社会认可寻求正向调节 meritocratic beliefs 与尊重富人的关联，但增量解释力较小。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"王朝式 meritocracy"概念，解释了在 meritocratic 制度下，青少年如何将运气、背景等非 meritocratic 因素 reinterpret 为 merit 的符号，从而为 meritocracy 的合法性再生产提供了新的理论解释机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了韩国青少年价值观形成中的阶层再生产机制，为教育政策和社会公平政策的制定提供了实证依据，提示政策制定者需关注 meritocratic 叙事可能掩盖的结构性不平等。

title: Life at the Crossroads of Evolution of Epidemiology, Fiscal Pressure and Governance Void in Federal Nepal

detail.title: Life at the Crossroads of Evolution of Epidemiology, Fiscal Pressure and Governance Void in Federal Nepal

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial interests or relationships with any individuals or organizations regarding this work.
declarations.funderStatement: The author declares no body funded the research.

detail.abstract: The country is experiencing a massive epidemiological transition of public health in Nepal. The country is facing the burden of non-communicable diseases (NCDs) amidst a highly fragmented federal administration and a multitude of communicable diseases. Nepal made impressive progress in the maternal and child health indicators over the past 30 years. However, a structural paradox has emerged in which the clinical efficacy of the growing programs of interventions is now being jeopardised by considerable financial weaknesses, particularly increased out-of-pocket (OOP) expenses. The structural integrity of the healthcare system in Nepal is summarised in this paper. This paper identifies some of the most important governance gaps such as multi-role conflict of interest in the Ministry of Health and Population (MoHP), shrinking the allocation of health budget for the domestic health team (4.77%) and under-investment in the mental health infrastructure with health team as a passive buyer. When translated into a SWOT framework, we see that achieving the target of protecting the constitutionally guaranteed right to health requires some degree of conscious separation of the policy and provider functions, robust fiscal commitments and a rapid shift towards more preventive care and strategic procurement.

AI.tldr: 尼泊尔正经历公共卫生的流行病学转型，面临非传染性疾病与传染病双重负担。尽管母婴健康指标取得进步，但医疗体系存在结构性悖论：临床干预效果因财务脆弱性（尤其自付费用上升）而受损。论文识别了治理缺口（如卫生部多重角色冲突、卫生预算缩减、精神卫生投入不足），并运用SWOT框架提出需分离政策与提供者职能、加强财政承诺及转向预防性护理和战略采购。
AI.research_question: 尼泊尔医疗体系的结构性悖论及其治理缺口是什么？如何通过SWOT分析实现宪法保障的健康权？
AI.motivation: 尼泊尔面临非传染性疾病与传染病的双重负担，母婴健康虽有进展但财务脆弱性（自付费用上升）正侵蚀干预效果，亟需识别治理问题并寻找可行路径。
AI.theoretical_framework: 流行病学转型理论、公共行政/治理理论、SWOT分析框架。
AI.method: 基于现有数据和政策文件的结构性分析，辅以SWOT框架进行战略评估。
AI.findings: 1) 卫生部存在多重角色冲突；2) 国内卫生团队预算分配仅4.77%；3) 精神卫生基础设施投入不足，卫生团队作为被动购买者；4) 需分离政策制定与提供者职能、加强财政承诺、转向预防性护理和战略采购。
AI.theory_contributions: 将流行病学转型理论与公共治理分析结合，揭示了联邦行政碎片化背景下健康权实现的制度障碍。
AI.practical_contributions: 为尼泊尔及其他类似发展中国家提供改革建议：分离政策与执行职能、增加财政投入、优先预防和战略采购，以保障宪法健康权。

title: Operational-System Risk in Financial Institutions in the AI Transformation Era : A Conceptual Framework for Reconstructing Risk Management and Emergency Governance

detail.title: Operational-System Risk in Financial Institutions in the AI Transformation Era : A Conceptual Framework for Reconstructing Risk Management and Emergency Governance
detail.abstract:
Artificial intelligence (AI) transformation in financial institutions is often described as a matter of model adoption, digital innovation, or productivity improvement. This paper argues that such a framing is too narrow. In financial institutions, AI becomes consequential when it is embedded into business processes, customer interactions, risk measurement, compliance monitoring, supervisory reporting, cybersecurity, third-party dependencies, and accountability arrangements. The relevant unit of governance is therefore not the AI model alone, but the AI-enabled business operating system in which models, data pipelines, workflows, human review, control rules, reporting obligations, escalation paths, and fallback procedures interact.
The paper proposes operational-system risk as an analytical category under enterprise risk management (ERM). Operational-system risk refers to the risk that an AI-enabled business operating system fails to remain trustworthy in its actual context of use because the interaction among models, data, automated workflows, human review, internal controls, cybersecurity arrangements, third-party dependencies, reporting obligations, and accountability structures is inadequately designed, monitored, interrupted, substituted, or resumed. The concept does not replace Basel operational risk, operational resilience, model risk, cyber risk, internal control, or third-party risk. Rather, it is a conceptual bridge for understanding how these existing categories are reorganized when AI is embedded in the operating arrangements of financial institutions.
The paper draws on established risk-management and supervisory materials, including ERM, the NIST AI Risk Management Framework, Basel operational risk and operational resilience principles, and OECD work on AI in finance, AI supervision, AI incidents, and AI developer reporting. These materials are not used to dilute the paper's original claim. They are used to show that operational-system risk stands on the established foundations of strategy-performance integration, risk appetite, trustworthy AI, technology-neutral financial regulation, operational risk management, operational resilience, incident management, and third-party dependency management. 
The paper further develops two related concepts. First, wrong-but-running failure describes situations in which an AI-enabled operation continues to function while producing plausible but incorrect credit assessments, risk reports, compliance outputs, customer communications, or supervisory-reporting drafts. Second, interruption-and-resumption risk refers to the risk that a financial institution fails to make timely, proportionate, and well-controlled decisions about whether to continue, restrict, interrupt, substitute, validate, recover, or resume an AI-enabled operation. The paper concludes that AI transformation requires not only approval governance, but also emergency governance designed around critical operations, tolerance for disruption, risk appetite, internal-control verification, fallback capacity, and evidence-based resumption.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"运营-系统风险"作为分析金融AI治理的核心概念，强调AI嵌入金融机构后引发的系统性风险，并区分了"错误但运行中故障"和"中断与恢复风险"两种具体风险类型，主张AI转型需要"应急治理"而非仅依赖审批治理。
AI.research_question: 金融机构在AI转型过程中，如何理解和管理AI嵌入业务运营系统后产生的系统性风险？
AI.motivation: 既有文献将金融机构AI转型窄化为模型采用、数字创新或生产率提升，忽视了AI嵌入业务流程、客户交互、风控、合规、监管报告、网络安全等多环节后引发的系统性治理挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 企业风险管理（ERM）、NIST AI风险管理框架、巴塞尔操作风险与操作韧性原则、OECD关于AI金融与监管的相关工作。
AI.method: 基于既有风险管理与监管材料的理论概念构建与分析。
AI.findings: （1）提出"运营-系统风险"概念，作为理解AI嵌入后既有风险类别重组的概念桥梁；（2）识别"错误但运行中故障"——AI系统持续运行但产生看似合理却错误的输出；（3）识别"中断与恢复风险"——机构未能及时、适度地决定是否继续、限制或恢复AI运营。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"运营-系统风险"这一新的分析范畴，超越了模型风险等单一维度，为理解AI嵌入金融系统后的风险重组提供了概念工具；首次区分"错误但运行中故障"与"中断与恢复风险"两类特定风险形态。
AI.practical_contributions: 主张AI转型需要从"审批治理"扩展到"应急治理"，围绕关键操作、中断容忍度、风险偏好、内控验证、备用能力和基于证据的恢复来设计治理框架，为金融机构和监管机构提供了可操作的风险管理方向。

title: Relationship of Inflation, BI Rate and Deposit Interest Rate

detail.title: Relationship of Inflation, BI Rate and Deposit Interest Rate
detail.abstract: This study aims to model the relationship between the inflation rate, BI rate, and deposit interest rates, then analyze the model, and provide forecasting and structural analysis of the model. Therefore, the method used in this study is Vector Error Correction Model analysis which is applied to time series data of the inflation rate (CPI), BI rate, and deposit interest rates. The results of the model analysis show that the policy of changing the BI rate has an effect on the rise and fall of the inflation rate (CPI) and fluctuations in the deposit rate (deprate). The BI rate is also influenced by two other variables (CPI and Deprate), but the biggest influence is from the variable BI Rate itself, and CPI and Deprate are mutually influencing (causality effect), but like the BI rate, the most influential variable is the lag variable of each of these variables.

AI.tldr: 本研究运用向量误差修正模型（VECM）分析通胀率、BI利率与存款利率之间的动态关系，发现BI利率变动显著影响通胀率和存款利率，且各变量主要受自身滞后项影响，通胀与存款利率之间存在双向因果关系。
AI.research_question: 通货膨胀率、BI利率与存款利率之间存在怎样的动态关系？如何对这些变量进行建模、预测与结构分析？
AI.motivation: 理解央行政策利率（BI利率）在调控通胀和影响存款利率方面的传导机制，为货币政策制定提供实证依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 向量误差修正模型（VECM）理论，基于时间序列的协整关系与误差修正机制。
AI.method: 采用向量误差修正模型（VECM），对通胀率（CPI）、BI利率及存款利率的时间序列数据进行分析。
AI.findings: （1）BI利率变动对通胀率和存款利率有显著影响；（2）BI利率受CPI和存款利率影响，但自身滞后项影响最大；（3）CPI与存款利率之间存在双向因果关系，但各自受自身滞后项影响最大。
AI.theory_contributions: 实证了新兴经济体货币政策利率的传导机制，验证了VECM在分析利率-通胀动态关系中的适用性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为央行通过调整BI利率调控通胀和存款利率提供了实证支持，提示政策制定需关注变量的自回归特性。

title: The Infrastructure Loop: Digital Asset Ownership, Distributed Infrastructure Participation, and Economic Resilience

detail.title: The Infrastructure Loop: Digital Asset Ownership, Distributed Infrastructure Participation, and Economic Resilience
detail.abstract: This paper extends the External AI Dependence (EAD) research programme by introducing the Infrastructure Loop, a framework explaining how independent builders can transition from permanent users of AI infrastructure to participants in its long-term ownership and development. Building on the concepts of External AI Dependence and Specialized Digital Assets, the paper proposes a six-stage causal model in which revenue generated from owned digital assets is partially reinvested into AI infrastructure through public market participation, community knowledge transfer, and distributed capital formation. Comparative analysis across eleven economies identifies structural barriers and opportunities affecting infrastructure participation, including currency risk, retail investment access, and national AI capability. The paper argues that broader participation in infrastructure ownership can strengthen economic resilience, reduce external AI dependence, and create a more inclusive AI economy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了“基础设施循环”（Infrastructure Loop）框架，解释了独立建设者如何从AI基础设施的永久用户转变为长期所有权和开发的参与者，通过六阶段因果模型实现这一转型。
AI.research_question: 独立建设者如何从AI基础设施的永久用户转变为基础设施长期所有权和开发的参与者？
AI.motivation: 当前独立建设者高度依赖外部AI基础设施（外部AI依赖/EAD），缺乏参与基础设施所有权和治理的路径，导致经济脆弱性和权力不对称。
AI.theoretical_framework: 外部AI依赖（EAD）研究纲领、专业化数字资产（Specialized Digital Assets）、基础设施循环模型（六阶段因果模型）
AI.method: 跨11个经济体的比较案例分析，识别结构性障碍与机会。
AI.findings: 货币风险、零售投资渠道、国家AI能力是影响基础设施参与的关键结构性因素；部分再投资机制可通过公开市场参与、社区知识转移和分布式资本形成实现。
AI.theory_contributions: 将EAD研究纲领从依赖分析扩展到参与和所有权分析；提出了基础设施循环作为新型理论框架，连接数字资产与基础设施治理。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和建设者提供了减少外部AI依赖、增强经济韧性的具体路径；识别了不同经济体在基础设施参与中的障碍与机遇。

title: From Polarization to Convergence in China’s Urban System
affiliations: BNU-HKBU United International College

detail.title: From Polarization to Convergence in China’s Urban System
detail.abstract: Spatial equity is central to sustainable urbanization, yet rapid growth often intensifies regional polarization in large developing economies. This study examines β-and σ-convergence in real per capita GDP across 220 Chinese prefecture-level cities from 1980 to 2020. We find a marked reversal in China's urban system: σ-convergence emerged in the mid-2000s, while βconvergence was largely absent before 2000 but accelerated thereafter. Across pooled ten-year growth windows, average annual convergence rates reached 1.84% under the unconditional specification and 2.54% after accounting for population scale, capital investment, human capital, and inter-city connectivity. These patterns coincide with WTO accession, hukou liberalization, regional development strategies, and infrastructure expansion. These findings suggest that spatial convergence is possible in large developing urban systems, offering evidence relevant to contemporary debates on common prosperity, but infrastructure-led integration supports sustainable urbanization only when it is matched by local absorptive capacity and inclusive development institutions.

AI.tldr: 本研究分析了1980-2020年中国220个地级市的人均GDP收敛情况，发现2000年代中期出现σ收敛，β收敛在2000年后加速，年均收敛率达1.84%-2.54%，与WTO入世、户籍改革、区域发展战略和基础设施扩张相吻合。
AI.research_question: 在中国快速城市化进程中，地级市之间是否存在人均GDP的空间收敛（β收敛和σ收敛）？其收敛模式在1980-2020年间如何演变？
AI.motivation: 空间公平是可持续城市化的核心，但大型发展中经济体的快速增长往往加剧区域极化。现有研究对发展中国家的城市间经济收敛证据不足，本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 经济增长收敛理论（β收敛和σ收敛）；空间经济学与区域极化理论；城市体系演化理论。
AI.method: 基于1980-2020年220个中国地级市面板数据，采用β收敛回归模型（无条件与条件设定）和σ收敛分析；使用十年滚动增长窗口估计年均收敛率。
AI.findings: （1）2000年代中期出现σ收敛；（2）β收敛在2000年前基本不存在，之后加速；（3）无条件年均收敛率1.84%，控制人口规模、资本投资、人力资本和城际连通性后达2.54%；（4）这些模式与WTO入世、户籍改革、区域发展战略和基础设施扩张相吻合。
AI.theory_contributions: 证实了大型发展中城市系统存在空间收敛的可能性，拓展了经济增长收敛理论在发展中国家城市尺度上的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为"共同富裕"政策辩论提供实证依据；指出基础设施主导的区域整合需要匹配地方吸收能力和包容性发展制度才能支持可持续城市化。

title: The Physical Vulnerability of Embodied AI: Physical-layer Provenance, Compliance Architecture, and Safety Governance at the Kinetic Edge

detail.title: The Physical Vulnerability of Embodied AI: Physical-layer Provenance, Compliance Architecture, and Safety Governance at the Kinetic Edge

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author holds research-and-development interests in the field of physical-layer security. This study was not influenced by any external funding, employment, commission, or commercial sponsorship. The author declares no external conflict of interest sufficient to affect the academic objectivity of this work.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study is a theoretical and architecture-level analysis of physical-layer safety governance; it does not involve human participants, patient data, or animal subjects, and therefore no ethics approval was required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors. It was conducted independently by the author.

detail.abstract: When AI systems begin to drive motors, brakes, steering, and robotic arms, a hallucinated or hijacked command no longer produces merely a wrong sentence — it produces real-world kinetic harm. As artificial general intelligence (AGI) and large-language-model-driven agentic systems move into humanoid robots, L4+ autonomous driving, and other embodied-AI settings, the boundary of AI safety has crossed from the informational domain into the cyber-physical domain. This paper argues that software alignment, semantic filtering, RTOS scheduling, and software watchdogs are structurally insufficient to guarantee kinetic safety, because the safety interruption itself must traverse the same software stack that can be delayed, bypassed, or misled. We propose an auditable physical safety shell that is independent of the AI planner and anchors trust at the physical boundary through physical-layer provenance, inertial continuity, dissipation traces, and a hardware interruption path. Three mechanisms are introduced: Causal Vacuum Detection (CVD) audits whether an actuation command carries an explainable physical dissipation trace; Spatial-Inertial phase Identification (SII) checks continuity with the machine's current inertial state; and a Zeno-Triggered Joule Latch (ZTJ-L) provides a de-energize-to-trip fail-safe below the operating system. The key contribution is to relocate high-integrity safety responsibility away from unverifiable model weights toward a smaller, third-party-testable physical component, and to map this shell onto IEC 61508, ISO 26262, ISO 13849, and ISO/PAS 8800:2024 — including a concrete defense against the "substantial modification trap" under Machinery Regulation (EU) 2023/1230. The result is a governance pattern in which, even when the model errs, hallucinates, or is jailbroken, human control remains verifiable at an auditable physical boundary.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种独立于AI规划器的可审计物理安全外壳，通过物理层溯源、惯性连续性、耗散痕迹和硬件中断路径来保障具身AI系统的物理安全，解决了软件对齐和语义过滤等方法在保障运动安全方面的结构性不足。
AI.research_question: 当AI系统从信息域进入网络物理域（如人形机器人、L4+自动驾驶），如何确保即使在模型出错、产生幻觉或被越狱的情况下，物理运动安全仍能得到可靠保障？
AI.motivation: 软件层面的安全机制（对齐、语义过滤、RTOS调度、看门狗）在保障物理运动安全方面存在结构性缺陷——安全中断本身也需要穿越同一套可能被延迟、绕过或误导的软件栈。随着AGI和LLM驱动的具身AI系统进入现实世界，这种缺陷将导致真实的物理伤害。
AI.theoretical_framework: 物理层安全外壳理论、物理层溯源（physical-layer provenance）、惯性连续性、耗散痕迹（dissipation traces）、硬件中断路径、因果真空检测（CVD）、空间-惯性相位识别（SII）、芝诺触发焦耳锁存器（ZTJ-L）
AI.method: 提出了三种机制：1) 因果真空检测（CVD）——审计执行命令是否具有可解释的物理耗散痕迹；2) 空间-惯性相位识别（SII）——检查与机器当前惯性状态的连续性；3) 芝诺触发焦耳锁存器（ZTJ-L）——在操作系统之下提供"失能触发"的故障安全机制。并将该安全外壳映射到IEC 61508、ISO 26262、ISO 13849、ISO/PAS 8800:2024等安全标准。
AI.findings: 软件对齐、语义过滤、RTOS调度和软件看门狗在结构上不足以保障运动安全。提出的物理安全外壳可将高完整性安全责任从不可验证的模型权重转移至更小、可第三方测试的物理组件，并能抵御欧盟机械法规(EU) 2023/1230下的"实质性修改陷阱"。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 揭示了软件安全机制在具身AI场景下的结构性不足；2) 提出了将安全责任从软件层转移至物理层的理论框架；3) 建立了物理安全外壳与现有功能安全标准的映射关系。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为具身AI系统提供了可审计、可验证的物理安全保障方案；2) 提供了符合现有国际安全标准（IEC 61508、ISO 26262等）的具体实现路径；3) 为应对欧盟机械法规中的"实质性修改陷阱"提供了具体防御方案。

title: Exploring Art, Knowledge and Movement in Japanese Fashion

detail.title: Exploring Art, Knowledge and Movement in Japanese Fashion
detail.abstract: This synthetic dataset comprises computer vision training data designed for multi-task learning applications including object detection, semantic segmentation, and depth estimation. The dataset features scenarios involving water-based environments with emphasis on dynamic human interactions, specifically entrance and exit sequences in aquatic settings captured from boat-mounted perspectives. Generated using synthetic data generation techniques, it provides pixel-perfect ground truth annotations across multiple vision tasks, enabling robust model training without privacy concerns or real-world data collection constraints. The dataset is intended for researchers developing AI systems for marine surveillance, autonomous watercraft navigation, and emotion-aware computer vision applications in challenging water-reflected lighting conditions.

AI.tldr: 该论文介绍了一个用于多任务学习的合成数据集，专注于水上环境中人机交互场景（如上下船序列），提供像素级精确标注，支持目标检测、语义分割和深度估计等任务，旨在解决水上监控、自主航行等领域的训练数据匮乏问题。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个高质量、无隐私顾虑的多任务合成数据集，以支持水上环境中的计算机视觉模型训练？
AI.motivation: 真实水上场景的数据采集成本高、隐私限制多，且缺乏像素级精确的多任务标注数据，限制了AI在水上监控、自主航行等领域的应用发展。
AI.theoretical_framework: 合成数据生成技术、多任务学习范式、计算机视觉中的目标检测/语义分割/深度估计理论。
AI.method: 采用合成数据生成技术，构建以船载视角拍摄的水上环境场景，包含动态人机交互（上下水序列），并生成像素级精确的多任务标注（目标检测、语义分割、深度估计）。
AI.findings: 该数据集提供了无隐私顾虑、标注精确的训练数据，能够支持水上环境下的多任务视觉模型训练，尤其适用于挑战性的水面反射光照条件。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个面向水上环境的多任务合成数据集构建范式，为动态人机交互场景下的计算机视觉研究提供了标准化测试基准。
AI.practical_contributions: 为海洋监控、自主水运航行、水上安全监测等实际应用提供了可用的训练资源，解决了真实数据采集困难的问题。

title: Compute-Standard Money: A Theoretical Framework Based on the Algorithmic Compute Unit (ACU)
affiliations: and Nankai University

detail.title: Compute-Standard Money: A Theoretical Framework Based on the Algorithmic Compute Unit (ACU)

AI.tldr: 本文提出了"计算标准货币"这一理论构念，以标准化AI推理算力计量单位（ACU）为基础构建价值代币（t-coin），并设计了独立的铸币、信用担保和监管机制，从而建立一个独立于法币信用体系之外的价值锚定系统。
AI.research_question: 如何将异构计算资源客观转换为统一的价值单位，并以此为基础构建独立于法币体系的货币系统？
AI.motivation: 现有法币信用体系存在内在缺陷，而AI推理算力作为一种可客观测量、持续生产且具有广泛需求的价值基础，具有成为新型货币锚定物的潜力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 计算标准货币理论、算力价值锚定理论、分布式共识机制、信用担保理论
AI.method: 提出ACU测量框架，包括四维评分系统、时间锚定机制、连续随机化验证协议、拜占庭容错多节点共识协议，并构建t-coin的铸币、信用支持和监管三层机制。
AI.findings: 通过连续验证机制可以实现计算资产的客观量化，进而支持独立价值代币的铸币与信用创造，并对现有主权货币体系产生分层级的影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统性地提出"计算标准货币"理论构念，证明了计算资产的连续验证机制可以支撑独立价值代币的铸币与信用，拓展了货币理论的边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 为AI算力资产的货币化提供了可操作的技术框架（ACU测量框架），设计了独立于法币体系的铸币、信用担保和监管机制，为未来去中心化货币体系提供了实践路径。

title:
PaaF in the Field 
A Structural Reading of the Current AI Builder Landscape

detail.title:
PaaF in the Field 
A Structural Reading of the Current AI Builder Landscape
detail.abstract: This paper applies triNetra's PaaF (Patterns as a Framework) methodology to direct field observation of independent AI builder communities conducted during June and July 2026. Eighteen observations are documented across four analytical layers: surface behaviour, cognitive architecture, systemic environment, and developmental preconditions. Taken together, they identify a single structural condition operating simultaneously across all eighteen domains: the absence of a judgment layer at every level of the independent builder's activity. The observations converge with and are confirmed by the WIPO World Intangible Investment Highlights 2026, released July 8, 2026, which documents global intangible asset investment exceeding USD 10 trillion while the builders described here continue to invest in platform consumption rather than proprietary asset creation. This paper serves as the field evidence base for three companion research papers: EAD-2026-01 (External AI Dependence and Startup Financial Survivability), EAD-2026-03 (The Infrastructure Loop), and JLT-2026 (Judgment Layer Theory).

AI.tldr: 本文通过triNetra的PaaF方法论，对2026年6-7月独立AI构建者社区进行实地观察，发现18个观察结果均指向一个核心问题：所有活动层面普遍缺失"判断层"。这一现象与WIPO 2026年报告（全球无形资产投资超10万亿美元，而构建者仍在消费平台而非创造资产）相互印证。本文是三项配套研究论文的实地证据基础。
AI.research_question: 独立AI构建者社区在行为、认知、系统环境和发展前提四个层面是否存在共同的结构性缺陷？
AI.motivation: 观察到独立AI构建者虽然在积极活动，但可能陷入平台消费陷阱而非进行真正的资产创造，需要系统性的实地证据来揭示其根本问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: triNetra的PaaF（Patterns as a Framework）方法论；四层分析框架：表面行为、认知架构、系统环境、发展前提。
AI.method: 2026年6-7月对独立AI构建者社区的直接实地观察，采用PaaF方法论，在四个分析层记录18项观察结果。
AI.findings: 18个观察结果共同指向一个结构性条件：独立构建者活动的每个层面普遍缺乏"判断层"（judgment layer）。构建者持续投资于平台消费而非专有资产创造，与WIPO 2026年报告揭示的全球无形资产投资超10万亿美元形成反差。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"判断层缺失"作为解释独立AI构建者困境的核心结构性条件；为三项配套论文（外部AI依赖与创业生存率、基础设施循环、判断层理论）提供实地证据基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示独立AI构建者需要建立判断层以实现从平台消费到专有资产创造的转变；为政策制定者和投资者识别和评估构建者的资产创造能力提供分析框架。

title: The Digital Dinar and Monetary Policy Effectiveness in Jordan: A Counterfactual FARDL Simulation under a Fixed Exchange-rate Regime

detail.title: The Digital Dinar and Monetary Policy Effectiveness in Jordan: A Counterfactual FARDL Simulation under a Fixed Exchange-rate Regime
detail.abstract:
This study examines the potential implications of issuing a retail central bank digital currency in Jordan, referred to as the digital dinar, for monetary policy effectiveness. Since the digital dinar has not yet been issued, the study combines observed monthly data on monetary aggregates, banking variables, policy rates, foreign reserves, inflation, and digital payments with counterfactual CBDC adoption scenarios. Methodologically, the paper applies a Fractional-Frequency Flexible Fourier Autoregressive Distributed Lag (FARDL) approach to distinguish between short-run dynamics, long-run relationships, and gradual structural shifts in Jordan's monetary environment. The analysis first evaluates whether existing digital payment deepening has reduced cash intensity and strengthened policy-rate pass-through, then simulates alternative CBDC designs, including conservative, moderate, and interest-bearing scenarios. 
    The results indicate that digital payment deepening has not yet produced a significant decline in cash intensity in Jordan. The CBJ policy rate is significantly transmitted to deposit and lending rates, although pass-through remains incomplete. Among the simulated CBDC scenarios, a capped, non-interest-bearing, two-tier retail digital dinar provides the most balanced outcome. It strengthens deposit-rate pass-through without generating significant evidence of deposit migration or credit contraction. By contrast, broader or interest-bearing CBDC designs may enhance transmission but raise greater risks to bank deposits and financial intermediation. The findings support a cautious and phased CBDC strategy that prioritizes monetary stability, banking-sector resilience, liquidity observability, and consistency with Jordan's fixed exchange-rate regime.

AI.tldr: 本文研究约旦发行零售央行数字货币（数字第纳尔）对货币政策有效性的潜在影响。通过反事实情景模拟，发现有限额、无利息、双层结构的数字第纳尔最为平衡，能增强利率传导而不显著引发存款迁移或信贷收缩。
AI.research_question: 约旦发行零售央行数字货币（数字第纳尔）对货币政策有效性有何潜在影响？
AI.motivation: 约旦尚未发行CBDC，需要预先评估不同CBDC设计方案对货币政策传导、银行体系稳定和金融中介的影响，为政策制定提供依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 货币经济学中的利率传导机制、现金强度理论、金融中介理论；结合约旦固定汇率制度下的货币政策框架。
AI.method: 采用分频灵活傅里叶自回归分布滞后（FARDL）模型，结合月度数据与反事实CBDC采纳情景模拟（保守、温和、计息三种设计）。
AI.findings: （1）约旦数字支付深化尚未显著降低现金强度；（2）央行政策利率向存贷款利率传导显著但不完全；（3）有限额、无利息、双层结构的CBDC最为平衡，能增强存款利率传导且不引发存款迁移或信贷收缩；（4）更广泛或计息的CBDC虽能增强传导，但加剧银行体系和金融中介风险。
AI.theory_contributions: 将CBDC设计特征（限额、利率、双层结构）与货币政策传导机制系统关联，拓展了新兴经济体CBDC对货币政策有效性的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为约旦及类似固定汇率制新兴经济体提供CBDC策略建议：采取谨慎、分阶段推进，优先保障货币稳定、银行韧性、流动性可观测性及与汇率制度的协调性。

title: Central Bank Communication and Monetary Policy Effectiveness: Quantile-on-Quantile Regression

detail.title: Central Bank Communication and Monetary Policy Effectiveness: Quantile-on-Quantile Regression
detail.abstract: Purpose This research paper deals with building a quantitative indicator that expresses the tone of communication issued by the Central Bank of Jordan (decisions, statements, memoranda, speeches, interviews, and governor communications) and whether it adds explanatory value to assess the effectiveness of monetary policy in comparison with the effect of the Central Bank of Jordan's main interest rate. Design/methodology/approach The paper builds a cumulative CBJ Monetary Policy Tone Index (MPTI) from policy decisions, statements, memoranda, speeches, interviews, and governor communications. Documents are coded by hawkish, expansionary, and stability-oriented tone, aggregated monthly, and converted into a cumulative index. Using Quantile-on-Quantile Regression (QQR), the study compares the effects of the lagged MPTI and the CBJ main rate on inflation, credit growth, deposit rates, lending rates, and foreign-reserve growth. Findings The findings indicate that the MPTI adds information beyond the policy rate. While the CBJ main rate remains more relevant for inflation and lending-rate pass-through, the tone index is more informative for credit growth and foreign-reserve dynamics. This suggests that communication, credibility, and moral suasion operate as complementary channels of monetary policy transmission in Jordan. Originality/value This paper extends the study of Jordanian monetary policy beyond the policy-rate channel by developing a stability-adjusted CBJ communication tone index. Using QQR, it compares the effects of this tone-based index with the CBJ main rate across inflation, credit, bank rates, and foreign reserves, revealing asymmetric and state-dependent effects that conventional models may overlook.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了约旦中央银行货币政策语调指数（MPTI），发现该指数在解释信贷增长和外汇储备动态方面比政策利率更有效，表明沟通、信誉和道义劝告是货币政策传导的补充渠道。
AI.research_question: 约旦中央银行的沟通语调是否能为评估货币政策有效性提供超出主要政策利率的增量解释价值？
AI.motivation: 传统货币政策研究多聚焦于利率渠道，但央行沟通作为非传统工具的作用尚未被充分量化，尤其是在新兴经济体如约旦的背景下。
AI.theoretical_framework: 货币政策传导机制理论；沟通、信誉与道义劝告作为补充传导渠道的理论；语调指数构建方法。
AI.method: 构建累积性货币政策语调指数（MPTI），对政策决策、声明、备忘录、演讲、访谈及行长沟通文件进行鸽派/鹰派/稳定导向编码，采用分位数对分位数回归（QQR）比较滞后MPTI与主要利率对通胀、信贷增长、存款利率、贷款利率及外汇储备增长的影响。
AI.findings: MPTI提供了超越政策利率的增量信息；主要利率对通胀和贷款利率传导更相关，而语调指数对信贷增长和外汇储备动态更具解释力。沟通、信誉和道义劝告是约旦货币政策传导的补充渠道。
AI.theory_contributions: 将央行沟通语调量化并纳入货币政策有效性分析框架，证实沟通渠道是传统利率渠道之外的独立传导机制，尤其在解释信贷和外汇储备方面具有独特价值。
AI.practical_contributions: 为约旦央行及类似新兴经济体央行提供构建沟通语调指标的方法论，帮助政策制定者通过语调管理增强货币政策传导效果，特别在信贷和外汇市场领域。

title: Examining the Impact of Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism on Southeast Asian Countries: Evidence from India, China, and Japan
affiliations: Power Management Institute India and

detail.title: Examining the Impact of Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism on Southeast Asian Countries: Evidence from India, China, and Japan
detail.abstract: This paper quantifies the trade and production-network implications of the European Union's Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM) for three major Asian manufacturing economies-India, China, and Japan-across the carbon-intensive sectors most directly affected by the regulation: steel, aluminium, and cement. The analysis proceeds in four linked stages. A carbon cost accounting framework first translates sector-level embedded emissions into ad valorem trade cost equivalents at prevailing EU Emissions Trading System (ETS) prices. A structural gravity specification then maps these cost shocks into bilateral export-volume responses, using a calibrated trade-cost semi-elasticity drawn from the empirical trade literature. A scenario analysis evaluates the extent to which domestic carbon pricing aligned with EU ETS levels can mitigate exposure under the CBAM equivalency principle. An input-output extension based on OECD Inter-Country Input-Output (ICIO) tables traces direct and indirect supply-chain spillovers, with particular focus on India. Three findings emerge. First, ad valorem CBAM cost exposure varies widely across countries and sectors, ranging from 6 percent for Japanese steel to 72 percent for Indian cement, with crosscountry differences driven primarily by emissions intensity. Aluminium emerges as the most exposed sector across all three economies. Second, gravity-based simulations indicate that CBAM-induced export contractions to the EU are substantial for emissions-intensive sectors and only partially offset by reallocation to non-EU destinations, leaving meaningful net export losses. Third, full domestic carbon pricing alignment with the EU ETS reduces exposure by 59 to 94 percent across countries and sectors, but the residual gap is largest where emissions intensity is highest, indicating that pricing alignment is necessary but not sufficient. Input-output analysis for India further shows that 38 percent of the steel sector's exposure propagates through indirect supply-chain linkages, with non-CBAM sectors such as machinery, equipment, and construction absorbing material spillovers. The findings carry implications for the design of domestic carbon pricing instruments, industrial decarbonisation strategies, and trade policy adjustment in increasingly carbon-constrained global markets.

AI.tldr: 本文量化了欧盟碳边境调节机制（CBAM）对印度、中国、日本三大亚洲经济体在钢铁、铝、水泥等高碳行业的贸易与生产网络影响，发现各国暴露程度差异显著，国内碳定价可部分缓解但不足，且存在明显的供应链间接溢出效应。
AI.research_question: 欧盟碳边境调节机制（CBAM）对亚洲三大制造业经济体（印度、中国、日本）的贸易和生产网络有何影响？
AI.motivation: CBAM作为欧盟碳减排政策工具，可能对亚洲出口导向型经济体产生重大贸易冲击，但现有研究缺乏对亚洲主要经济体的系统量化评估，尤其是供应链间接溢出效应尚未被充分揭示。
AI.theoretical_framework: 碳成本核算框架、结构引力模型、CBAM等效性原则情景分析、投入产出模型（基于OECD跨国投入产出表）
AI.method: 四阶段分析：1）碳成本核算将嵌入排放转化为从价贸易成本等价；2）结构引力模型模拟出口量变化；3）情景分析评估国内碳定价与欧盟ETS对齐的缓解效果；4）投入产出扩展追溯直接与间接供应链溢出。
AI.findings: 1）CBAM从价成本暴露从日本钢铁的6%到印度水泥的72%不等，铝是最受影响的部门；2）CBAM导致对欧盟出口大幅收缩，向非欧盟市场的再配置仅能部分抵消；3）国内碳定价与EU ETS对齐可将暴露降低59%-94%，但排放强度最高的部门仍存在较大缺口；4）印度钢铁部门38%的暴露通过供应链间接传导至机械、设备、建筑等非CBAM部门。
AI.theory_contributions: 将CBAM影响分析从直接贸易效应拓展至生产网络间接溢出效应，整合碳成本核算、结构引力模型与投入产出方法，为国际贸易与气候政策交叉领域提供分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为亚洲经济体设计国内碳定价工具、制定工业脱碳战略及调整贸易政策提供量化依据，揭示CBAM等效性原则的局限性及供应链风险传导路径。

title: The Limits of Artificial Companionship

detail.title: The Limits of Artificial Companionship
detail.abstract: This Article argues that interactions with conversational agents that emulate human-like relationships should be subject to a clear structural distinction between commercial and non-commercial exchanges. The insertion of undisclosed promotional content into affective or relational exchanges should be prohibited, as it collapses the boundary between market transaction and communicative intimacy in ways that erode user autonomy and conversational context. The Article begins by theorizing digital companionship as a sociotechnical form that reconfigures intimacy and dependence, creating relational vulnerability. It then introduces the potential economic harms derived from conversational advertising. Evoking to the legal traditions across both sides of the Atlantic, the Article argues for a clear, legal and normative distinction between commercial and non-commercial conversational contexts as a precondition for the responsible stabilization of these technologies within social life

AI.tldr: 本文主张，对于模仿人类关系的对话式AI交互，应明确区分商业与非商业场景，禁止在情感或关系型交流中插入未披露的促销内容，因为这侵蚀了用户自主性和对话语境。
AI.research_question: 对话式AI交互中，商业与非商业交换应如何区分？未披露的促销内容对用户自主性和对话语境有何影响？
AI.motivation: 对话式AI越来越多地模仿人类情感关系，但商业内容悄然侵入这种亲密交互，模糊了市场交易与沟通亲密性的边界，可能对用户造成损害。
AI.theoretical_framework: 数字陪伴作为一种社会技术形式，重构了亲密性与依赖性，创造了关系脆弱性。
AI.method: 理论研究与法律传统分析，援引大西洋两岸的法律传统进行论证。
AI.findings: 未披露的促销内容在情感性或关系性交流中会侵蚀用户自主性和对话语境；需要建立清晰的商业与非商业对话语境的法律与规范区分。
AI.theory_contributions: 将数字陪伴理论化为一种重新配置亲密性与依赖性的社会技术形式，提出"关系脆弱性"概念。
AI.practical_contributions: 为对话式AI的负责任社会整合提供法律与规范的制度前提，建议禁止在情感性交互中插入未披露的商业内容。

title:
Paying for Backup Capacity, not Backup Delivery
Incomplete Insurance in Peru's Dual-fuel Generation Charge

detail.title:
Paying for Backup Capacity, not Backup Delivery
Incomplete Insurance in Peru's Dual-fuel Generation Charge
detail.abstract: Peru pays selected gas-red generators a security-of-supply charge (CAPSE/CUCSS) for being able to run on diesel when the Camisea gas system fails. The charge is written on recognized dual capacity, not delivered diesel energy an insurance whose payout falls due exactly in the contingency it hedges, a natural setting for wrong-way risk, since the backup can fail through the same correlated shock it insures against. I test delivery in the one unambiguous physical interruption in the record: the 114 March 2026 deagration of the Camisea pipeline, which cut roughly 90% of gas ow for two weeks. A new COES IEOD/IDCOS extraction that assigns half-hourly unit MWh to gas or diesel shows the dual eet delivered diesel energy equal to only about 2025% of paid dual capacity over the event, intermittently and unevenly: the diesel-capable Ventanilla TG4 delivered zero, Santa Rosa ickered, Fenix converted with multi-day lags, and part of the paid Fenix block is a steam turbine that cannot itself burn diesel. Because the cut fell in the wet season, with hydropower absorbing most of the gas hole, δ ≈ 0.2 is a ceiling, not a oorthe correlated bad state, a Camisea failure in a dry or El Niño year, remains untested. I frame two policies: ex-post derating of the charge by the realized factor versus ex-ante pay-for-performance that cuts the left tail. The regulator reached the same fork in 2016, scored availability-derating highest, and never enacted it; eight consecutive Precios-en-Barra xings (20172024) keep paying the formula it had declared defective.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了秘鲁天然气备用发电补贴（CAPSE/CUCSS）在Camisea管道中断事件中的实际效能，发现实际柴油发电量仅为付费容量的20-25%，存在严重的错误方向风险（wrong-way risk），并提出了两种政策改进方案。
AI.research_question: 秘鲁天然气备用发电补贴（CAPSE/CUCSS）在Camisea管道实际中断事件中是否有效实现了其保险功能？该机制面临怎样的错误方向风险？
AI.motivation: CAPSE/CUCSS补贴机制设计上存在天然的错误方向风险——备用容量所对冲的正是可能导致备用失效的同一冲击（Camisea系统故障）。2026年3月真实管道中断事件为检验这一风险提供了唯一清晰的自然实验窗口。
AI.theoretical_framework: 错误方向风险（Wrong-way risk）、保险理论、备用容量定价、绩效付费（Pay-for-performance）
AI.method: 利用COES IEOD/IDCOS新数据提取方法，将半小时级机组MWh归属为天然气或柴油发电，对2026年3月Camisea管道爆炸事件（114小时中断，约90%气源切断两周）进行实证分析。
AI.findings: 实际柴油发电量仅为付费容量的20-25%；Ventanilla TG4柴油机组零出力；Santa Rosa出力不稳定；Fenix多日延迟后才转换；部分付费Fenix容量实际为无法燃烧柴油的蒸汽轮机。由于中断发生在丰水季（水电弥补了大部分缺口），δ≈0.2仅为上限，干季或厄尔尼诺年的更坏情景尚未被检验。
AI.theory_contributions: 通过真实事件验证了备用容量保险中的错误方向风险，揭示了"按容付费"机制在极端事件中的系统性失效，为绩效付费设计提供了实证基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出两种政策方案：事后按实现因子折减补贴（ex-post derating）与事前绩效付费（ex-ante pay-for-performance）以削减左尾风险。指出监管机构早在2016年就得出类似结论但从未实施，2017-2024年连续八次市场定价仍沿用其宣称有缺陷的公式。

title: The Right to Life in Full: Towards A Holistic Conception of the Right to Life, Livelihood and Adequate Standard of Living in Nigeria
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: The Right to Life in Full: Towards A Holistic Conception of the Right to Life, Livelihood and Adequate Standard of Living in Nigeria

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None
declarations.funderStatement: This research work was personally funded

detail.abstract:
The right to life occupies a pre-eminent position in the hierarchy of human rights. Without life, the enjoyment of all other rights becomes impossible. Yet, despite its centrality, constitutional and judicial understanding of the right to life in Nigeria has remained remarkably narrow. The prevailing approach treats the right principally as a guarantee against arbitrary deprivation of life by the State or private individuals. Such an interpretation, though important, fails to capture the broader social, economic and material conditions necessary for meaningful human existence. The consequence is that millions of Nigerians may remain technically alive while being deprived of the basic necessities required to sustain life in dignity. 
This article argues that the right to life under section 33 of the Constitution of the Federal Republic of Nigeria 1999 (as amended) ought to be interpreted purposively and holistically to encompass the rights to livelihood, food, shelter, healthcare and an adequate standard of living. Drawing from comparative constitutional jurisprudence, international human rights law, and emerging trends in Nigerian judicial decisions, the article contends that the traditional distinction between civil and political rights on the one hand and socioeconomic rights on the other has become increasingly artificial and unsustainable. The article further examines the implications of contemporary economic reforms, sovereign borrowing practices and public expenditure priorities for the enjoyment of the right to life in Nigeria. It argues that where governmental policies foreseeably produce widespread hunger, destitution and deprivation without adequate social safeguards, such policies may raise serious constitutional and human rights concerns. Ultimately, the article advocates a transformative approach to constitutional interpretation capable of ensuring that the right to life is understood not merely as a right against death, but as a right to live in conditions consistent with human dignity.

AI.tldr: 本文主张尼日利亚宪法第33条的生命权应被目的性与整体性地解释，涵盖生计、食物、住房、医疗和适当生活水准等社会经济权利，呼吁从"免于死亡的权利"转向"有尊严地生活的权利"。
AI.research_question: 尼日利亚宪法中的生命权应如何被解释？其是否应涵盖社会经济权利（如食物、住房、医疗等）？
AI.motivation: 尼日利亚现行对生命权的解释过于狭窄，仅将其视为免于任意剥夺的权利，忽视了生命权所依赖的社会经济条件，导致数百万尼日利亚人虽"活着"但缺乏有尊严生活的基本条件。
AI.theoretical_framework: 目的性宪法解释理论；公民权利与政治权利同社会经济权利划分的传统二分法批判；国际人权法框架；比较宪法 jurisprudence。
AI.method: 比较宪法 jurisprudence 分析；国际人权法文本分析；尼日利亚司法判例分析；政府政策（经济改革、主权借贷、公共支出）影响评估。
AI.findings: 传统上将公民政治权利与社会经济权利严格区分的做法日益人为化和不可持续；政府政策若可预见地导致普遍饥饿、贫困和匮乏且缺乏社会安全保障，可能引发严重的宪法与人权关切。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了生命权作为纯粹消极权利的传统理解，提出了生命权应积极涵盖社会经济权利的理论框架，为发展中国家宪法解释提供了新的理论路径。
AI.practical_contributions: 为尼日利亚法院审理生命权案件提供了新的解释路径；为政府政策制定提供了人权合规的警示框架；为尼日利亚及其他发展中国家推动社会经济权利的司法保护提供了实践依据。

title: Non-Linear Relationship in Financial Inclusion Research: Thematic Review, Evidence, Mechanisms and Methods
affiliations: Central Bank of Nigeria

detail.title: Non-Linear Relationship in Financial Inclusion Research: Thematic Review, Evidence, Mechanisms and Methods
detail.abstract: Emerging studies document a non-linear relationship between financial inclusion and economic outcomes but offer little or no explanation for why a non-linear relationship may exist. This study reviews twenty-six research articles that report a non-linear relationship between financial inclusion and economic outcomes from 2020 to 2025 using the thematic literature review method. The findings show that the documented non-linear relationship in the literature is mostly U-shaped or inverted U-shaped. I offer explanations for why such nonlinear relationship exist and provide insights into theory and the methodological approaches that assist in unravelling the non-linear relationship in financial inclusion research. The study concludes by suggesting areas for future research. The insights offered in this article can assist policymakers and practitioners in understanding the role of inflection points in financial inclusion and the implications for financial inclusion practice and policymaking.

AI.tldr: 本文通过系统性文献综述，回顾了2020-2025年间26篇关于金融包容性与经济结果之间非线性关系的研究，发现这种关系多为U型或倒U型，并解释了其存在的原因，为理论和研究方法提供了洞见。
AI.research_question: 金融包容性与经济结果之间为何存在非线性关系？这种非线性关系呈现什么形态？
AI.motivation: 已有研究发现了金融包容性与经济结果之间的非线性关系，但几乎没有解释这种关系存在的原因，本研究旨在填补这一理论空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 非线性经济关系理论、金融包容性理论、拐点效应理论
AI.method: 主题文献综述法，系统回顾2020-2025年间26篇相关研究论文
AI.findings: 文献中记录的非线性关系大多呈现U型或倒U型；研究提供了非线性关系存在的解释；揭示了理论和研究方法上的洞见。
AI.theory_contributions: 为金融包容性研究中为何存在非线性关系提供了理论解释；厘清了拐点在金融包容性研究中的作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 帮助政策制定者和实践者理解金融包容性中拐点的作用，为金融包容性实践和政策制定提供启示。

title:
Buying the Top Score:
How Single High-stakes Exams Concentrate the Value of Fraud
Forensic Evidence from an Annulled University Admission

detail.title:
Buying the Top Score:
How Single High-stakes Exams Concentrate the Value of Fraud
Forensic Evidence from an Annulled University Admission
detail.abstract: A criminal organisation sold the question booklet of the March 2022 Human Medicine admission exam at Peru's Universidad Nacional Mayor de San Marcos. The university annulled that career's results validating every other career examined the same day and re-administered the exam three weeks later. The annulment creates a natural experiment: essentially the same applicant pool sat a compromised and a secured version of the same high-stakes exam. Using the complete published scores of both sittings, we document the statistical signature of the leak: the compromised sitting places 100 candidates above the clean re-exam's maximum, in identical-score clusters of up to twelve candidates at one exact mark the pattern a shared, imperfect answer key produces (p ≈ 0.001 against the empirical null of the clean re-exam; no clean career reproduces it). The anomaly touches at most 2% of candidates: the fraud is conned, not systemic. A single, one-date, score-decides-all exam concentrates the entire value of access in one capturable event, maximising both the incentive to leak it and the pay when a leak succeeds. Mechanisms that distribute access value across multiple assessments present a smaller attack surface, at other equity costs; the policy lever lies in mechanism design, not exam security.

AI.tldr: 利用秘鲁圣马科斯大学2022年3月医学入学考试试题泄露的自然实验，通过对比泄题版本与重考版本的分数分布，发现泄题版本中有100名考生分数超过重考最高分，且出现大量同分集群（最多12人同分），统计检验显著（p≈0.001），表明存在共享错误答案密钥的作弊模式。作弊仅影响最多2%的考生，属局部欺诈而非系统性。研究揭示单次、单日、一考定终身的考试机制将全部准入价值集中在一个可捕获事件上，最大化泄题动机与收益，建议通过机制设计（如分散评估）而非单纯加强考试安全来应对。
AI.research_question: 考试泄题事件中，泄题版本与安全重考版本的分数分布差异揭示了怎样的统计作弊模式？单次高利害考试的设计如何影响泄题动机与作弊规模？
AI.motivation: 现有研究缺乏利用自然实验直接比较同一考生群体在泄题与安全版本下表现的证据；高利害考试泄题事件频发，但对其统计特征和制度性成因的系统分析不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 考试安全经济学、机制设计理论、准入价值集中假说——单次考试将准入价值全部集中在一个可捕获事件上，最大化泄题激励。
AI.method: 自然实验设计：比较同一考生池在泄题版本（3月）与安全重考版本（3周后）的完整公开分数分布，采用统计检验（p值）验证泄题版本是否存在异常同分集群，并以未受影响的其它专业作为对照。
AI.findings: 泄题版本中有100名考生分数超过重考最高分；出现最多12人同分的异常集群，统计显著（p≈0.001）；该模式与共享错误答案密钥一致；作弊仅影响最多2%的考生；未受影响的其它专业未再现此模式。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出并验证了"准入价值集中假说"：单次高利害考试将全部准入价值集中在一个可捕获事件，是泄题动机的制度性根源；将机制设计视角引入考试安全研究，区分了"局部欺诈"与"系统性欺诈"。
AI.practical_contributions: 为考试泄题检测提供了可复制的统计诊断方法（同分集群分析）；建议将单次决定命运的考试改革为多维度、多时点评估体系，以分散风险，降低泄题激励。

title: Reset Value and Protection Restoration in Defined Outcome Overlays
affiliations: University of South Carolina - Darla Moore School of Business, University of North Florida and Duke University

detail.title: Reset Value and Protection Restoration in Defined Outcome Overlays
detail.abstract: Defined outcome strategies use option overlays to reshape equity exposure into capped participation, first-loss downside protection, and a scheduled reset. Buffer ETFs package that strategy into an investor-facing vehicle, yet the marketed expiration payoff says little about the live overlay an investor holds between reset dates. We ask when a seasoned overlay becomes inefficient relative to a freshly reset one. Listed annual buffer ETF families illustrate the basic trade-off, reducing volatility relative to SPY but surrendering enough participation to trail SPY on Sharpe ratios over the same sample period. This motivates a state-level analysis rather than a standalone evaluation of ETF performance. We develop a roll-versus-hold diagnostic that weighs a seasoned overlay against a fresh reset using its placement on the original strike map, remaining tenor, and the prevailing option-market environment. In a long simulated S&P 500 buffer panel, reset value measured by average roll-versus-hold return is modest and highly state dependent. The larger effect lies in protection restoration, where a reset can curb the give-back of accrued gains after rallies and limit further losses once the original buffer has been impaired or spent. The framework is a risk-management tool for seasoned defined-outcome exposures, not a mechanical trading rule.

AI.tldr: 本文研究缓冲ETF（Buffer ETFs）在两次重置日之间的“ seasoned overlay”效率问题，发现相对于重置后的新鲜头寸，老化的期权覆盖策略效率较低，尤其在波动率和夏普比率上表现不佳。研究开发了一个“滚动 vs 持有”诊断框架，通过状态分析发现重置价值有限且高度依赖市场状态，其主要作用在于保护恢复——即在市场上涨后防止已实现收益回吐，以及在原始缓冲耗尽后限制进一步损失。
AI.research_question: 当缓冲ETF的期权覆盖策略（seasoned overlay）在两次重置日之间相对于新重置的策略变得效率低下时，投资者应如何评估“滚动”（roll）即重置与“持有”（hold）即维持老化的覆盖策略之间的权衡？
AI.motivation: 缓冲ETF向投资者承诺了到期收益结构（如上限参与、优先损失保护），但投资者在两次重置日之间实际持有的是实时变化的期权覆盖组合，其表现可能显著偏离营销宣传的到期收益。现有文献缺乏对“ seasoned overlay”效率的评估工具，因此需要开发一个诊断框架来比较重置与持有的相对价值。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于期权定价理论、投资组合风险管理理论以及状态依赖分析方法。核心概念包括：原始执行价映射（strike map）、剩余期限（remaining tenor）、期权市场环境（option-market environment），以及“保护恢复”（protection restoration）机制——即在缓冲被侵蚀后通过重置恢复损失保护。
AI.method: 使用标普500缓冲ETF的长期模拟面板数据，构建“滚动 vs 持有”诊断指标，比较 seasoned overlay 与新鲜重置在原始执行价映射、剩余期限和期权市场环境下的相对表现。通过状态分析（state-level analysis）评估重置在不同市场条件下的平均价值和保护恢复效应。
AI.findings: （1）缓冲ETF相比SPY降低了波动率，但参与率下降导致夏普比率低于SPY。（2）重置的平均“滚动 vs 持有”回报适中且高度依赖市场状态。（3）重置的主要作用在于保护恢复：在市场上涨后重置可以防止已实现收益的回吐（give-back）；在原始缓冲被侵蚀或耗尽后，重置可以限制进一步损失。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）首次系统分析了缓冲ETF在两次重置日之间的“ seasoned overlay”效率问题，填补了该领域的研究空白。（2）提出了“滚动 vs 持有”诊断框架，将期权策略的状态依赖分析引入结构化产品评估。（3）揭示了保护恢复机制作为重置核心价值的理论逻辑，超越了简单的收益比较。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）为投资者提供了评估缓冲ETF持有 vs 重置决策的量化工具，而非机械化的交易规则。（2）帮助风险管理者识别 seasoned defined-outcome 暴露中的低效状态，优化滚动时机。（3）为缓冲ETF产品设计和信息披露提供参考，提醒投资者关注实际持有期间的实时风险收益特征，而非仅关注到期收益结构。

title: Algorithmic Demurrage and Velocity Optimization: Evaluating Economic Incidence in Programmable CBDCs

detail.title: Algorithmic Demurrage and Velocity Optimization: Evaluating Economic Incidence in Programmable CBDCs
detail.abstract: For over a century, proposals for expiring or decaying money have been marketed as egalitarian stimulus: a nudge that pushes everyone to spend. The lineage runs from Silvio Gesell's Freigeld and the stamp scrip of Wörgl in the 1930s to expiry features piloted in China's e-CNY and floated in the Reserve Bank of India's concept note on central bank digital currency (CBDC). This paper examines the implicit assumption underneath that framing: that the nudge lands evenly across the wealth distribution. It does not. Demurrage is functionally a tax on holding liquid balances, and the share of wealth exposed to such a tax falls steeply with net worth. Federal Reserve Distributional Financial Accounts data show the bottom 50% of U.S. households holding roughly twice as large a share of aggregate checkable deposits and currency (5.9% in 2022:Q2) as their share of net worth (approximately 3%), while the deposit share of the top 1% (31.1%) is roughly proportional to its wealth share. An agent based Monte Carlo simulation calibrated to this structure (10,000 households, 200 replications, a horizon of ten years) finds that a demurrage of 6% per year, the rate Gesell proposed, taxes the bottom 50% at approximately 0.31% of net worth per year, about four times the effective rate paid by the top 1%, shifting the wealth share of the bottom half down by roughly 1.9% relative to a counterfactual without demurrage. The sign of the transfer reverses when demurrage revenue is recycled as an equal per capita rebate, precisely the design feature present in historically celebrated demurrage systems (the relief fund of Wörgl, Sarafu in Kenya) and absent from modern proposals for programmable money. The paper concludes with a design rule for CBDC architects: no demurrage without a dividend.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了货币"存储损耗"（demurrage）机制本质上是对流动性资产的累退税，会加剧而非缩小财富不平等；只有配合人均等额返还机制才能逆转其分配效应。
AI.research_question: 货币存储损耗（过期/贬值货币）机制在不同财富群体间的分配效应如何？
AI.motivation: 一个多世纪以来，存储损耗货币一直被宣传为平等主义的刺激手段，但其"均匀推动所有人消费"的隐含假设从未被检验。
AI.theoretical_framework: 存储损耗实质上是对持有流动性余额征税；基于美联储Distributional Financial Accounts的财富分布数据以及代理人基蒙特卡洛模拟。
AI.method: 使用美联储Distributional Financial Accounts数据（2022年Q2），结合代理人基蒙特卡洛模拟（10,000个家庭，200次重复，十年期）。
AI.findings: 底部50%家庭的可支配存款和现金份额（5.9%）约为其财富份额（约3%）的两倍；6%年存储损耗率下，底部50%的有效税率约为净值的0.31%，是顶部1%的约四倍；底部50%的财富份额相对无存储损耗情景下降约1.9%。但当存储损耗收入以人均等额返还时，分配效应发生逆转。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了存储损耗货币作为平等主义工具的长期假设，揭示了其累退性；提出"无股息则无存储损耗"的设计原则。
AI.practical_contributions: 为央行数字货币（CBDC）架构师提供直接政策指导：若在CBDC中引入存储损耗机制，必须配套人均等额返还机制以避免加剧不平等。

title: De-risking and De-banking: implications for Financial Inclusion
affiliations: Central Bank of Nigeria

detail.title: De-risking and De-banking: implications for Financial Inclusion
detail.abstract: In this opinion piece, I unravel the nature, causes and effect of de-risking and debanking and the implications for financial inclusion. De-banking removes people from the formal financial system against their own will by closing their account while derisking restricts access to bank accounts which creates inconvenience and dissatisfaction. When banks de-risk and de-bank banked adults, their livelihoods, relationships, reputation, and access to essential banking services can evaporate or disappear immediately. Over time, de-risking and de-banking will push people outside the formal financial system and lead them to rely on the informal financial sector which would make financial inclusion efforts counterproductive. I argue that while there may be legitimate reasons for de-risking and de-banking banked adults, such actions, if excessive, wrongful and discriminatory, can have adverse consequences for financial inclusion. I suggest three remedies for combatting derisking and de-banking. They include using regulation to limit banks' discretion to derisk and de-bank people, urging banks to implement FATF's 2025 guidance on financial inclusion and anti-money laundering and terrorist financing measures, and using regulation or legislation to ensure that the right to own a fully operational bank account supersedes the right of a bank to restrict or close a bank account.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了去风险化和去银行化对金融包容性的负面影响，并提出三项补救措施：通过监管限制银行自由裁量权、实施FATF2025年指南、以及立法保障个人银行账户权优先于银行限制权。
AI.research_question: 去风险化和去银行化的本质、原因及影响是什么？它们对金融包容性有何影响？
AI.motivation: 银行对已开立账户的成年人进行去风险化和去银行化，可能将人们推向非正规金融部门，使金融包容性努力适得其反，因此需要深入分析并提出解决方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 金融包容性理论、反洗钱与反恐融资监管框架、银行账户权利理论
AI.method: 评论性文章（Opinion Piece），基于逻辑论证和现有监管框架分析
AI.findings: 去风险化和去银行化会立即损害个人的生计、关系、声誉和基本银行服务获取；长期会将人们推向非正规金融系统，抵消金融包容性成果；过度的、错误的或歧视性的此类行为会带来不利后果。
AI.theory_contributions: 厘清了去风险化与去银行化的概念区别及其对金融包容性的传导机制，揭示了银行风险管理行为与金融包容目标之间的内在张力。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出三项具体可操作的补救措施：监管限制银行自由裁量权、推动FATF 2025年指南实施、通过立法确立个人银行账户权优先于银行限制权的原则。

reference: Rotman School of Management Working Paper Forthcoming
title: Replaceable but Employed: Automation and the Meaning of Work
affiliations: University of Toronto - Rotman School of Management

detail.title: Replaceable but Employed: Automation and the Meaning of Work

publicationDetails.detailsText: Rotman School of Management Working Paper Forthcoming
publicationDetails.journalName: University of Toronto - Rotman School of Management Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Can automation harm workers without replacing them? We study jobs in which workers value both producing useful output and knowing that the output depends on their own contribution. A credible machine alternative can weaken that second source of meaning even when the firm retains the worker. Our model shows that this loss raises compensation when wages adjust fully; when they adjust only partly, workers bear some of the loss themselves. It can also make automation more likely. An external developer may profit by publicly demonstrating a machine before licensing it, because the demonstration lowers the value of the human alternative. This "meaning externality" can create demand for the machine and make profitable development socially harmful. Better technical quality and greater public salience have different effects: quality improves output, while salience alone weakens human work. Automation can, therefore, reduce the value of work before it eliminates jobs.

AI.tldr: 本文研究自动化如何在不直接替代工人的情况下，通过削弱工作的意义感（即工人对自身贡献的认知价值）而损害工人福利。即使企业保留员工，可信的机器替代方案也会降低工作意义，导致工资补偿变化或工人承担损失，并可能促使自动化更容易发生。外部开发者可通过公开展示机器来创造“意义外部性”，从而获利但可能对社会造成损害。
AI.research_question: 自动化如何在不替代工人的情况下，通过影响工作的“意义感”（工人对自身贡献的价值认知）来损害工人福利？
AI.motivation: 现有研究多关注自动化直接替代工人的就业效应，但忽略了自动化可能通过心理机制（如削弱工作意义）在保留工人的情况下仍对工人造成损害。作者试图揭示这一被忽视的渠道及其经济后果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于工作意义理论：工人不仅追求产出价值，还追求“自身贡献”的认知价值。引入“意义外部性”概念，即机器的公开存在降低了人类工作的意义价值，即使工人未被替代。
AI.method: 理论模型分析，构建包含产出价值与意义价值的效用函数，分析机器替代方案对工资、就业和福利的影响。
AI.findings: 1）可信的机器替代方案降低工作意义，当工资完全调整时企业需提高补偿；工资调整不完全时工人承担部分损失。2）意义损失可能使自动化更易发生。3）外部开发者可通过公开展示机器（而非仅许可）获利，因为展示降低人类工作价值，创造“意义外部性”。4）技术质量与公众显著性效果不同：质量改进产出，而显著性仅削弱人类工作价值。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统建模自动化通过“意义渠道”而非替代渠道损害工人福利的机制；提出“意义外部性”概念，拓展了自动化经济学与工作意义理论的交叉研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 提醒政策制定者关注自动化在替代就业之前就可能通过心理机制损害工人福利；警示技术开发者的公开展示策略可能造成社会福利损失；区分技术质量提升与公众关注度提升的不同政策含义。

title: Gaming Money

detail.title: Gaming Money
detail.abstract:
The over $250 billion video game industry, the largest entertainment industry in the world, has rapidly developed unregulated monetary systems. Gaming companies issue what this Article terms “gaming money”—points earned in play, gift cards, and platform-stored balances—and increasingly enable conversion of these instruments into bank deposits at scale. Although they adopt many of the features of “money,” they evade existing regulatory categorizations while producing familiar problems: rate manipulation, money laundering, and structural opacity and instability for firms in the gaming industry and their counterparties.

This Article shows how companies like Microsoft, Sony, and Roblox are not only harming gamers but issuing “shadow money,” evading a host of laws governing money, banking, and finance. Like nineteenth-century canal, railroad, and mining companies, as well as twenty-first-century fintech and cryptocurrency companies, gaming giants engage in private monetary governance. Gaming companies claim to operate “virtual” worlds of entertainment, media, and the arts, beyond the reach of regulators. Yet the law does not ask whether money is “real,” but whether its creation infringes on the state’s monetary sovereignty. Convertibility—the degree to which gaming money is convertible into currency and bank deposits at scale—should determine regulatory jurisdiction and intensity.

Sony has now applied for a new national charter to issue stablecoins, signaling that gaming companies are moving toward more sophisticated infrastructure. The stakes are high: Gaming introduces most U.S. children to the very idea of money. Regulation must confront a future that is already here.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示游戏巨头（微软、索尼、Roblox等）发行的"游戏货币"实际上是一种规避货币与金融监管的"影子货币"。随着游戏货币向银行存款的大规模可兑换性增强，这些公司构成了私人货币治理体系，但现行监管框架未能有效覆盖。文章提出应以"可兑换性"作为监管管辖权与强度的核心标准。
AI.research_question: 游戏行业发行的虚拟货币是否构成事实上的"货币"？现行监管框架如何应对游戏货币向银行存款大规模转换带来的金融稳定与消费者保护风险？
AI.motivation: 游戏产业作为全球最大的娱乐产业（超2500亿美元），其发行的"游戏货币"（积分、礼品卡、平台余额等）正在演变为事实上的私人货币体系，但现有法律分类无法有效监管其带来的操纵汇率、洗钱、结构性不透明等风险。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国家货币主权理论——法律关注的不是货币是否"真实"，而是货币发行是否侵犯国家货币主权；私人货币治理理论——类比19世纪运河/铁路公司及21世纪金融科技/加密货币公司的私人货币发行行为。
AI.method: 法律与规制分析方法，通过比较历史案例（19世纪私人货币、当代金融科技与加密货币）与当前游戏行业实践，进行法律概念与监管框架的批判性分析。
AI.findings: 游戏公司发行的货币具有许多"货币"特征但规避了现行监管分类；微软、索尼、Roblox等公司构成了"影子货币"体系；索尼已申请发行稳定币的国家特许牌照，显示游戏公司正迈向更复杂的金融基础设施；游戏行业向大多数美国儿童引入"货币"概念。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"游戏货币"这一新的法律概念分类；以"可兑换性"而非货币的"真实性"作为判断货币发行是否侵犯国家货币主权的核心标准；将游戏货币纳入"私人货币治理"的理论谱系中。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构提供了以"可兑换性"为核心的监管框架建议；呼吁监管必须直面"已然到来的未来"——游戏货币的金融化趋势；警示游戏货币对儿童金融概念的塑造影响及消费者保护需求。

title: Ownership, Reputation, and Trade in the Art Market
affiliations: and Cardiff University - Cardiff Business School

detail.title: Ownership, Reputation, and Trade in the Art Market

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Nothing to declare.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Theoretical paper, no ethics approval required.
declarations.funderStatement: No funders involved.

detail.abstract: We study a market for reputational goods in which willingness to pay depends not only on intrinsic consumption value but also on the reputation of other owners. We develop a network-based model of the art market where artists' and collectors' reputations are jointly determined through ownership links. This structure generates endogenous reputation spillovers that shape trade decisions and prices. We characterize emerging patterns of trade, specialization, and entry, and show how network effects can rationalize several empirical regularities of art markets. Our framework highlights why outcomes may systematically deviate from standard Walrasian predictions and emphasizes the central role of network structure in determining market dynamics.

AI.tldr: 本文通过构建基于网络的艺术品市场模型，研究了声誉商品市场中买卖双方声誉通过所有权关联共同决定的内生机制，并揭示了网络结构如何塑造交易决策、价格形成及市场动态。
AI.research_question: 在声誉商品市场中，当消费者的支付意愿不仅取决于内在消费价值，还取决于其他所有者的声誉时，市场交易模式、价格形成和市场均衡如何受到网络结构的影响？
AI.motivation: 艺术品市场等声誉商品市场存在许多难以用标准瓦尔拉斯均衡解释的经验规律（如价格偏离、专业化分工、入市模式等），亟需一个能够刻画声誉溢出效应的理论框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于网络模型的声誉溢出理论，将艺术家和收藏家的声誉通过所有权关联联合内生化，分析网络结构如何产生内生性声誉溢出效应，进而影响交易决策和价格。
AI.method: 构建网络博弈模型，对艺术品市场中艺术家与收藏家之间的所有权链接进行形式化建模，从理论上刻画交易、专业化和市场进入的模式。
AI.findings: 网络效应可以合理化艺术品市场的多个经验规律；市场结果会系统性偏离标准瓦尔拉斯均衡；网络结构在市场动态中发挥核心作用。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将声誉溢出效应纳入网络视角进行分析，为声誉商品市场提供了超越传统瓦尔拉斯框架的理论解释，揭示了网络结构的内生性作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为艺术品市场参与者（收藏家、艺术家、拍卖行等）理解价格形成和交易模式提供了理论指导；为政策制定者理解市场非效率来源提供了分析工具。

title: The Procurement Record: How AI Contracts Decouple Evidence, Risk, Control, and Accountability
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: The Procurement Record: How AI Contracts Decouple Evidence, Risk, Control, and Accountability
detail.abstract:
Ordinary contracting often assumes that evidence, economic risk, operational control, and accountability travel together. AI procurement strains that assumption. A vendor may control the records that explain an incident while bearing capped liability. A public buyer may remain answerable to regulators, courts, and affected persons while lacking access to the model history needed to account for its own use of the system. The procurement record is where that separation is either managed or lost. 

This Article treats the procurement file as a governance record and distinguishes six contractual evidence functions-selection, diligence, performance, change, incident, and allocation. Three decided disputes, none involving generative AI, show the remaining dimensions separating in practice: the Post Office Horizon litigation, in which accountability sat with the public body while dispositive records sat with the vendor; Michigan's MiDAS system, in which public accountability for automated accusation outran available evidence; and Mortenson and Soteria, in which technical failure produced consequences that turned on older contract vocabulary. Contract liability transfer in AI procurement is therefore broader than indemnity and narrower than accountability transfer. Procurement can shift evidence duties, cooperation duties, audit burdens, change-control duties, incident duties, and some economic risk, but it cannot move institutional responsibility wholesale. That the governing cases predate generative AI is the reason the record matters now, before litigation exists to discipline it.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨AI采购如何打破传统合同中证据、风险、控制和责任四位一体的假设，通过分析采购档案作为治理记录，区分六项合同证据功能，并结合三个未涉及生成式AI的典型案例，论证AI采购中的责任转移比赔偿更宽但比问责更窄，强调在诉讼形成前规范采购记录的重要性。
AI.research_question: 在AI采购中，当证据、经济风险、运营控制和问责分离时，采购档案如何履行治理功能？合同责任转移的边界在哪里？
AI.motivation: 传统合同假设证据、风险、控制和责任同步转移，但AI采购中这一假设被打破（如供应商控制记录但责任有限，公共买家承担责任但无法访问模型历史），因此需要审视采购档案如何管理这种分离。
AI.theoretical_framework: 将采购档案视为治理记录（governance record），区分六项合同证据功能：选择（selection）、尽职调查（diligence）、绩效（performance）、变更（change）、事件（incident）和分配（allocation）。
AI.method: 案例分析法：分析三个已决争议——英国邮局Horizon案（问责在公共机构，决定性记录在供应商）、密歇根MiDAS系统（自动化指控的公共问责超出可用证据）、Mortenson与Soteria案（技术失败后果依赖旧合同术语）。
AI.findings: 合同责任转移在AI采购中比赔偿更宽但比问责更窄。采购可以转移证据义务、合作义务、审计负担、变更控制义务、事件义务及部分经济风险，但不能整体转移制度性责任。关键判例均早于生成式AI，这正是当前需要重视记录的原因——在诉讼形成之前规范记录实践。
AI.theory_contributions: 将采购档案重新概念化为治理记录，系统区分六类合同证据功能，揭示了AI采购中责任转移的层级结构（证据义务→合作义务→审计→变更控制→事件义务→经济风险→制度责任），并指出制度责任不可合同化转移。
AI.practical_contributions: 为AI采购实践提供合同设计指南：明确哪些义务可转移、哪些不可转移；强调在生成式AI引发大规模诉讼之前，应主动规范采购记录的证据功能，以避免事后治理失灵。

title: Thermodynamic Boundaries and Physical-layer Compliance in AI Compute Infrastructure: Energy-to-Throughput Ratio (ΔETR) and Predictive Thermal Control Under Ultra-dense Chipsets

detail.title: Thermodynamic Boundaries and Physical-layer Compliance in AI Compute Infrastructure: Energy-to-Throughput Ratio (ΔETR) and Predictive Thermal Control Under Ultra-dense Chipsets

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author holds research-and-development interests in the field of physical-layer security.
