This study received no external funding and was conducted independently; the author declares no external conflict of interest sufficient to affect its academic objectivity.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study is a theoretical, architecture-level analysis of data-center physical-layer thermodynamic compliance; it involves no human participants, patient data, or animal subjects.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors. It was conducted independently by the author.

detail.abstract:
As AGI-scale compute expansion and advanced packaging (e.g., CoWoS) push chip-integration
density toward physical limits, conventional energy-saving techniques that rely on the operating
system, containerized scheduling, or software dynamic voltage-and-frequency scaling (DVFS) are
reaching a thermodynamic bottleneck at the edge of compute centers. This paper diagnoses the
"Thermodynamic Debt-Shifting Paradox" arising from the industry’s continued reliance on digital
equalization and passive liquid-cooling scheduling, and analyzes how fluidic micro-vibration in
liquid-cooling loops induces timing jitter and phase decoherence in high-frequency interconnects.
To address this long-standing and unmet industrial need, this paper proposes a physical-layer
compliance architecture that is independent of the main compute path. The architecture introduces
a dimensionless metric, the Energy-to-Throughput Ratio deviation (ΔETR), as a tamper-evident
thermodynamic-boundary audit baseline, and combines out-of-band predictive control to perform
active phase orchestration before thermodynamic collapse, locking high-frequency timing within
≤100 ps.
This study further argues, on thermodynamic grounds, the insufficiency of purely software-based
scheduling approaches, and explores a physical-layer technical pathway for aligning post-quantum
and AGI-scale compute facilities with international green regulations (such as the EU EED and
CSDDD). To preserve the novelty of related patents, all circuit-level implementation parameters, trace layouts, control registers, and specific material doping ratios have been de-sensitized; only
the high-level, mechanism-tier academic and regulatory-compliance architecture is retained.

AI.tldr: 本文诊断了AGI规模计算中由液冷微振动引发的高频互连时序抖动问题，提出了一种独立于主计算路径的物理层合规架构，通过引入无量纲指标ΔETR作为热力学边界审计基线，结合带外预测控制实现主动相位编排，将高频时序锁定在≤100 ps以内，并论证了纯软件调度方案在热力学层面的不足。
AI.research_question: 在AGI规模计算和高密度芯片集成（如CoWoS）逼近物理极限的背景下，如何从物理层解决液冷回路中流体微振动导致的高频互连时序抖动与相位退相干问题，以突破传统软件节能方案的热力学瓶颈？
AI.motivation: 传统基于操作系统、容器调度或软件DVFS的节能技术已触及计算中心边缘的热力学瓶颈；液冷微振动引入的时序抖动和相位退相干是长期未解决的工业需求；纯软件调度方案在热力学层面存在根本性不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 热力学债务转移悖论（Thermodynamic Debt-Shifting Paradox）；能量吞吐量比偏差（ΔETR）作为热力学边界审计指标；带外预测控制与主动相位编排理论。
AI.method: 提出独立于主计算路径的物理层合规架构；引入ΔETR无量纲指标作为篡改可检测的热力学边界审计基线；采用带外预测控制在热力学崩溃前进行主动相位编排。
AI.findings: 该物理层架构可将高频时序锁定在≤100 ps以内；纯软件调度方案在热力学层面不足以解决根本问题；物理层技术路径可对齐后量子与AGI规模计算设施的绿色法规（如EU EED和CSDDD）。
AI.theory_contributions: 诊断并定义了"热力学债务转移悖论"；提出ΔETR作为热力学边界审计的无量纲度量；论证了纯软件调度方案的热力学不充分性。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一种独立于主计算路径的物理层合规架构，不依赖操作系统或软件调度；为AGI规模计算设施满足国际绿色法规（EU EED、CSDDD）提供了物理层技术路径；通过去敏化处理保护了相关专利的电路级实现细节。

title: On Legal Bullshit - Frankfurt's Distinction and the Self-Reporting Fallacy in Litigation
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: On Legal Bullshit - Frankfurt's Distinction and the Self-Reporting Fallacy in Litigation

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is self-represented in ongoing civil and administrative proceedings in Portugal concerning matters structurally similar to those discussed in this paper's companion application piece. The theoretical framework presented here was developed in part through that practical engagement and is offered in general form independent of any specific proceeding; no specific party, case, or jurisdiction is addressed in this paper. The author is also the founder of a commercial venture (KYC.co) whose broader product and policy work intersects with some of the institutional design concepts discussed here.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This paper is a theoretical and doctrinal legal analysis; it does not involve human subjects, personal data collection, or empirical research requiring ethics review.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. It was conducted independently and self-funded by the author.

detail.abstract:
Harry Frankfurt drew a distinction that the law has never formally used: a liar knows the truth and asserts its opposite, while a bullshitter is indifferent to the truth altogether, producing assertion calibrated to what will work rather than to what is so. The distinction matters because the two are almost impossible to tell apart from their output alone, and because the law's machinery for detecting deception - intent, knowledge, scienter - is built entirely for the first category and has essentially nothing to say about the second. A professional who files a claim their own evidence already contradicts may have lied. They may equally have never checked, because checking was not necessary to produce a filing that does its job. The document looks the same either way. This paper argues that civil litigation, professional liability, and the institutions that sit above both have organised themselves around exactly this blind spot, and names the structural reason it persists: the Self-Reporting Fallacy.

The fallacy is this: every actor positioned to read a legal file has a stake in the answer it gives. A client depends on trusting their own lawyer's account - a client who does not trust it has already, in effect, dismissed their counsel. A lawyer who filed a document is committed to its coherence regardless of who created the gap inside it. An insurer receives a summary of the file, not the file. A court sees what each side chooses to argue, not what either side has chosen not to mention. None of this requires bad faith to operate; it requires only that each actor behave exactly as their position already rewards them for behaving. The result is a system that can prosecute the rare, provable lie but has no mechanism at all for the far more common case - the assertion nobody checked, made by someone with every reason not to check it, sitting undetected in a record that would have shown the gap to anyone reading without a stake in the outcome.

This paper specifies what a reading position with no stake in the outcome would need to do differently, building on this author's prior work on the distance between an assigned professional's competence and a matter's actual demands, and on the economics of strategic silence under current legal defaults. It adds a third element, specified here for the first time: a test for whether a filing's own positive factual claims survive contact with its own attachments -- and with what the record conspicuously fails to address -- independent of whether the gap originated in incompetence or in design. Demonstrated against one recurring event -- the moment a professional's own filed evidence contradicts their own asserted position, converting a routine dispute into an independent professional-liability exposure that frequently dwarfs the underlying claim -- the combination shows what becomes visible only once Frankfurt's distinction is taken as seriously in litigation as it has been taken in moral philosophy for forty years: not who is lying, but who has stopped checking, and what that costs everyone still relying on them to have checked.

This paper also situates the resulting method against the existing landscape of advocacy ethics, litigation analytics, and legal-AI document review, and argues that none of these literatures, individually mature as each is, was ever positioned to ask the question this paper asks. It closes by naming the category of instrument such a method makes possible, locating the professional-indemnity insurance industry as its natural first market, and offering, as existence proof rather than as its subject, a prototype instrument built by this author that demonstrates the method is achievable with present techniques.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了法律系统存在一个结构性盲点：它擅长识别故意撒谎（明知真相而说假话），却完全无法应对"胡扯"（bullshit）——即说话者对真相漠不关心，只在意说什么有效。作者称之为"自我汇报谬误"（Self-Reporting Fallacy）：每个阅读法律文件的人都有既得利益，导致没有人真正去核查陈述的真实性。文章提出了一种新方法，通过对比文件中的正面主张与附件证据及明显遗漏，来识别"谁停止了核查"，并指出专业责任保险行业是该方法的天然市场。
AI.research_question: 法律系统在处理"对真相漠不关心"（bullshit）而非"明知故谎"（lying）的专业行为时，存在怎样的结构性缺陷？如何通过一种新的检验方法来识别这种系统性的核查缺失？
AI.motivation: Frankfurt的区分在道德哲学中已存在四十年，但法律从未正式采用。法律检测欺骗的机制（意图、知识、知情要件）完全针对故意说谎，而对"胡扯"（不核查就断言）毫无办法。实际上，后者远比前者普遍，且造成的损失往往远超底层争议本身。
AI.theoretical_framework: Harry Frankfurt关于"说谎"与"胡扯"的区分；自我汇报谬误（Self-Reporting Fallacy）；委托人-代理人问题；战略沉默经济学；专业能力与案件实际需求之间的差距理论。
AI.method: 提出一种三重检验方法：(1)分析专业人员指派能力与案件实际需求之间的距离；(2)评估现行法律默认规则下战略沉默的经济激励；(3)检验文件正面事实主张在与附件证据及记录中明显遗漏进行对照时是否仍然成立——无论缺陷源于无能还是故意设计。文章还构建了一个原型工具作为存在性证明。
AI.findings: 法律系统的每个参与方——客户、律师、保险人、法院——都因制度性激励而不去核查文件陈述的真实性。结果是系统能够追诉证明的、罕见的撒谎行为，但完全没有机制应对更常见的"未经核查的断言"。当专业人员的自身归档证据与其主张相矛盾时，会引发巨大的独立专业责任风险。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将Frankfurt的"谎言-胡扯"区分系统性地引入法律分析；提出"自我汇报谬误"概念，解释为何法律系统无法识别"胡扯"；建立了检验"谁停止了核查"而非"谁在撒谎"的分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为专业责任保险行业提供了一种评估索赔文件真实性的新工具；提出了可操作的检验方法，可用现有技术实现原型；揭示了现行倡导伦理、诉讼分析和法律AI文档审查等领域的盲区。

title: Physarum-Inspired Urban Network Optimization for Structural Traffic Gridlock Mitigation in Gulshan-e-Iqbal, Karachi
affiliations: University of Karachi

detail.title: Physarum-Inspired Urban Network Optimization for Structural Traffic Gridlock Mitigation in Gulshan-e-Iqbal, Karachi
detail.abstract: Urban traffic gridlock in dense, rapidly growing neighborhoods such as Gulshan-e-Iqbal, District East, Karachi, is conventionally addressed through slow, expensive manual traffic consultancies. This paper presents a lightweight, computational alternative: a bio-inspired network optimization system modeled on the adaptive foraging behavior of Physarum polycephalum, the true slime mold, which has previously been shown to replicate efficient real-world transport networks such as the Tokyo rail system. We construct a corridor-level road network for the study area using real topology extracted from OpenStreetMap, estimate commuter demand at each intersection from point-of-interest density, and simulate network adaptation using the saturating reinforcement rule established in the Physarum modeling literature. The resulting bio-efficiency score ranks each corridor by its capacity to sustain commuter flow, identifying structurally weak corridors as priority candidates for widening or bypass construction. We extend this core model with a costbenefit layer grounded in published Pakistani road construction cost data, a simulation-verification step that directly measures the projected impact of a widening intervention rather than relying on a static formula, and a resilience-routing module that identifies alternate paths under simulated corridor closures. On a validated six-corridor pilot network, we find that the corridor with the lowest raw structural efficiency is not necessarily the corridor with the best simulated return on investment-a distinction that a purely heuristic cost-benefit approach would have missed. The complete system is implemented as an interactive, publicly deployable dashboard and is intended as the technical foundation for Malyx Systems, a GovTech venture in formation aimed at providing this decision-support capability to provincial planning bodies in Karachi and beyond.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于黏菌（Physarum polycephalum）觅食行为启发的轻量级计算系统，用于识别卡拉奇Gulshan-e-Iqbal地区交通网络中的薄弱走廊，并通过成本效益分析、模拟验证和弹性路由模块，为城市交通规划提供决策支持。
AI.research_question: 如何利用生物启发式计算方法，在数据有限的发展中国家城市中，低成本、高效地识别交通网络中的结构性薄弱走廊并评估干预措施的可行性？
AI.motivation: 传统交通咨询方法成本高、周期长，难以适应快速城市化的发展中国家城市需求；而黏菌网络优化模型已被证明能复现高效运输网络，具有轻量级、自适应的优势。
AI.theoretical_framework: Physarum polycephalum（真黏菌）自适应觅食行为的饱和强化规则（saturating reinforcement rule），该模型曾成功模拟东京铁路系统等现实世界高效运输网络。
AI.method: 从OpenStreetMap提取真实拓扑结构构建走廊级路网；基于兴趣点密度估算交叉口通勤需求；采用Physarum建模文献中的饱和强化规则模拟网络自适应演化；引入基于巴基斯坦道路建设成本数据的成本效益层、模拟验证步骤和弹性路由模块。
AI.findings: 在六条走廊的试点网络中，原始结构效率最低的走廊并非模拟投资回报率最佳的走廊——这一区别是纯启发式成本效益方法无法识别的。
AI.theory_contributions: 将Physarum网络优化模型从宏观轨道交通系统扩展到城市道路走廊级网络分析，验证了生物启发算法在发展中国家城市交通规划中的适用性。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一个交互式、可公开部署的仪表盘系统，作为Malyx Systems（一家GovTech初创企业）的技术基础，旨在为卡拉奇及更广泛地区的省级规划机构提供低成本、数据驱动的交通决策支持。

title: Dynamic Capabilities in Turbulent Institutional Environments: How Chinese Firms Navigate Policy Volatility in Indonesia's Nickel Sector
affiliations: Pelita Harapan University

detail.title: Dynamic Capabilities in Turbulent Institutional Environments: How Chinese Firms Navigate Policy Volatility in Indonesia's Nickel Sector

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that they have no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This manuscript presents a conceptual framework and a prospective research design. It does not report on any primary data collected from human participants or animal subjects. Therefore, ethics approval was not required for the submission of this theoretical paper. As explicitly stated in the methodology section, ethical clearance from the Universitas Pelita Harapan ethics committee will be obtained prior to commencing the planned retrospective interviews in the subsequent empirical phase of this research
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: Between late 2025 and mid-2026, Indonesian regulators cut nickel-ore mining quotas under the Work Plan and Budget scheme (RKAB) by more than seventy percent for some producers, raised mining royalties on a progressive scale, imposed a mandatory onehundred-percent, one-year retention of natural-resource export proceeds, and revised the mineral benchmark price formula in ways that pushed smelter input costs up by close to two hundred percent. This paper builds a conceptual framework and a research design for understanding how Chinese multinational enterprises operating in Indonesia's nickel downstreaming sector build the dynamic capabilities needed to survive, and even grow, through that kind of shock. Drawing on three theoretical traditions, dynamic capabilities, organizational learning and ambidexterity, and institutional entrepreneurship, the paper argues that under conditions of extreme institutional turbulence, firm survival hinges less on sensing or seizing in the classic sense than on a more specific capability we term institutional reconfiguration capability: the continuous, proactive rearrangement of investment portfolios, ownership structures, and political-relational strategies in response to policy changes that arrive in rapid succession and are often difficult to anticipate. The paper further proposes that dynamic capabilities in emerging-market multinationals differ qualitatively from those of developed-market multinationals, because emerging-market firms can draw on home-country institutional support that is mobilized across borders. To examine these propositions, the paper designs a longitudinal, multiple-case study (2014-2026) of two to three Chinese firms in Indonesia's nickel sector, tracing how their capabilities evolved across an entry phase (2014-2019), an expansion phase (2020-2024), and a policy-turbulence phase (2025-present), drawing on retrospective interviews, company documents, and media analysis. The expected contribution is an extension of dynamic capabilities theory into highly unstable institutional settings, together with a more contextualized account of how home-country advantage shapes the dynamic capabilities of emerging-market multinationals.

AI.tldr: 本文研究中国跨国企业在印尼镍下游产业中，面对极端政策动荡（如配额削减、税收提高、出口收益留存等）如何通过构建"制度重构能力"生存并发展。作者提出，在高度不确定的制度环境中，企业生存的关键不是传统的感知与捕获能力，而是持续主动地调整投资组合、所有权结构和政治关系策略的能力。
AI.research_question: 在极端制度动荡条件下，在印尼镍下游行业运营的中国跨国企业如何构建动态能力以生存甚至增长？新兴市场跨国企业的动态能力与发达市场跨国企业有何本质区别？
AI.motivation: 印尼政府于2025年底至2026年中实施了一系列剧烈政策变化（镍矿配额削减超70%、矿区使用费大幅提高、出口收益强制留存、矿产基准价公式调整导致冶炼成本飙升近200%），这些极端制度动荡对中国企业在印尼的镍下游投资构成巨大挑战，亟需理论解释。
AI.theoretical_framework: 动态能力理论、组织学习与双元性理论、制度创业理论。核心概念为"制度重构能力"——连续、主动地重新配置投资组合、所有权结构和政治关系策略的能力。
AI.method: 纵向多案例研究（2014-2026），选取2-3家在印尼镍行业的中国企业，追踪其在三个阶段（进入期2014-2019、扩张期2020-2024、政策动荡期2025至今）的能力演变，采用回顾性访谈、公司文件和媒体分析。
AI.findings: 尚属研究设计阶段，预期发现：在极端制度动荡下，企业生存更依赖于"制度重构能力"而非传统的感知与捕获能力；新兴市场跨国企业的动态能力因可利用母国制度支持跨境调动而与发达市场跨国企业存在质的差异。
AI.theory_contributions: 将动态能力理论拓展到高度不稳定的制度环境；提出"制度重构能力"这一新概念；更情境化地解释母国优势如何塑造新兴市场跨国企业的动态能力。
AI.practical_contributions: 为中国等新兴市场跨国企业在高风险制度环境中的海外投资策略提供指导；帮助企业理解如何在政策剧烈波动中通过灵活配置投资组合、所有权结构和政治关系来提升生存能力。

title: The Equivalence Trap: Redesigning India's CCTS for CBAM

detail.title: The Equivalence Trap: Redesigning India's CCTS for CBAM
detail.abstract: India’s Carbon Credit Trading Scheme (CCTS) is structurally unable to secure offset credit under the European Union’s Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM) because the two systems are built on fundamentally different carbon governance logics. The central problem is not the absence of climate ambition in India, but the mismatch between an intensity-based domestic carbon market and CBAM’s requirement for an explicit carbon price paid on embedded emissions. Using the steel sector as the primary case study, this paper shows that India may reduce emissions intensity while still facing full CBAM liability, since CBAM is based on absolute embedded emissions rather than relative performance. The paper also explains India’s preference for an intensity-based approach by examining its industrial growth priorities, infrastructure limitations, and constitutional issues. To underline this incompatibility, it introduces the concept of a Carbon Governance Trilemma, which captures the tension between industrial expansion, CBAM compliance, and carbon market sovereignty. The paper is concluded with a three-stage strategy to tackle this trilemma. Beginning with establishing emissions data infrastructure, rethinking the CCTS for sectors covered by CBAM, and investing in the long-term green steel transformation.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示印度碳信用交易计划（CCTS）与欧盟碳边境调节机制（CBAM）之间存在结构性不兼容。核心矛盾在于印度基于排放强度的碳市场逻辑与CBAM要求的绝对碳排放定价逻辑之间的根本差异。通过钢铁行业案例，论文提出"碳治理三难困境"概念，并给出三阶段应对策略。
AI.research_question: 印度的碳信用交易计划为何在结构上无法满足欧盟碳边境调节机制的要求？两者不兼容的根本原因是什么？
AI.motivation: 澄清中印等发展中国家碳市场与发达国家碳边境调节机制之间的制度性错配，避免因"气候雄心不够"的误读导致贸易摩擦和政策错位。
AI.theoretical_framework: 碳治理逻辑比较框架、碳治理三难困境（工业扩张、CBAM合规与碳市场主权之间的张力）
AI.method: 以钢铁行业为主要案例的质性分析，辅以制度比较分析
AI.findings: （1）印度基于强度的碳市场即便降低排放强度，仍可能因绝对排放量高而面临CBAM全额碳税；（2）印度偏好强度导向碳市场的原因包括工业增长优先、基础设施局限和宪法问题；（3）两个体系存在结构性不兼容，非简单的"气候雄心不足"。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"碳治理三难困境"概念，系统化阐释发展中国家在参与全球碳治理时面临的工业发展、国际合规与制度主权三者之间的结构性张力。
AI.practical_contributions: 为印度及其他发展中国家制定应对CBAM的策略提供三阶段路线图：建立排放数据基础设施、重新设计CBAM覆盖行业碳市场机制、投资长期绿色钢铁转型。

title: External AI Dependence and Startup Financial Survivability: How Dependence on Externally Owned AI Infrastructure Affects the Financial Survivability of Independent Businesses

detail.title: External AI Dependence and Startup Financial Survivability: How Dependence on Externally Owned AI Infrastructure Affects the Financial Survivability of Independent Businesses
detail.abstract: This paper examines how dependence on externally owned AI infrastructure affects the financial survivability of independent businesses. It introduces the concept of External AI Dependence (EAD) and the External AI Dependence Index (EADI) as frameworks for assessing structural exposure to foreign-owned AI models, cloud infrastructure, and compute resources. The paper identifies five mechanisms through which AI dependence can reduce startup resilience: currency-denominated cost asymmetry, investor-subsidized pricing risk, competitive asymmetry, platform switching costs, and AI project failure amplification. It argues that financial resilience depends not on avoiding AI, but on progressively converting rented AI capability into Specialized Digital Assets that remain under the firm's ownership. Drawing on publicly available international datasets and comparative analysis across ten economies, the paper proposes a framework for understanding AI dependence as a structural economic variable with implications for entrepreneurship, innovation policy, and long-term business competitiveness.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了对外部AI基础设施的依赖如何影响独立企业的财务生存能力，提出了外部AI依赖（EAD）和外部AI依赖指数（EADI）的概念框架，识别了五种降低创业韧性的机制，并主张企业应将租用的AI能力逐步转化为专有数字资产。
AI.research_question: 对外部拥有的AI基础设施（如海外AI模型、云基础设施和计算资源）的依赖如何影响独立企业的财务生存能力？
AI.motivation: 随着AI基础设施日益集中在少数大型科技公司手中，独立企业面临结构性的外部依赖风险，但现有研究缺乏系统评估这种依赖对企业财务韧性影响的框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 外部AI依赖（EAD）概念、外部AI依赖指数（EADI）、五种降低韧性的机制（货币计价成本不对称、投资者补贴的定价风险、竞争不对称、平台转换成本、AI项目失败放大效应）。
AI.method: 基于公开的国际数据集，对十个经济体进行比较分析。
AI.findings: AI依赖通过五种机制降低创业韧性；财务韧性不取决于避免使用AI，而取决于将租用的AI能力逐步转化为企业拥有所有权的专有数字资产。
AI.theory_contributions: 将AI依赖概念化为一种结构性经济变量，为理解AI时代的创业韧性提供了新的理论框架，补充了资源依赖理论和数字化转型文献。
AI.practical_contributions: 为创业者提供了管理外部AI依赖的策略指南，为政策制定者评估AI基础设施集中化对创业生态的影响提供了分析工具。

title: General Non-Clairvoyant KV-Cache Scheduling via Regime-Aware Routing
affiliations: , Shanghai Jiao Tong University, Shanghai Jiao Tong University (SJTU) and Shanghai Jiao Tong University (SJTU)

detail.title: General Non-Clairvoyant KV-Cache Scheduling via Regime-Aware Routing
detail.abstract:
We study non-clairvoyant scheduling for batched Large Language Model (LLM) inference under a hard Key-Value (KV) cache memory budget. Each request has a known prompt length but an unknown response length, and its memory footprint comprises a fixed prompt component together with a response component that grows with each decoded token. At each decoding round, the scheduler chooses a feasible batch of active requests; evicting a request discards its accumulated cache states, wasting prior computation. The goal is to minimize total completion time against the optimal clairvoyant schedule that knows all response lengths. 
We present the first O(1)-competitive algorithm for arbitrary prompt lengths and arbitrary response lengths with no additional assumptions. Rather than relying on a single universal scheduling policy, our algorithm is built on a novel regime-aware routing framework. Specialized sub-schedulers handle different memory-growth geometries, while a meta-scheduler time-shares the memory budget across them and dynamically routes each job as its execution progressively reveals its behavior. This framework also yields constant-competitive guarantees for makespan and for total completion time under online arrivals.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了在硬性KV缓存内存预算约束下，非预知型批量LLM推理调度问题。提出首个O(1)-竞争比的算法，通过新颖的"状态感知路由框架"处理不同内存增长几何特性，实现无需额外假设的常数竞争比保证。
AI.research_question: 在硬性KV缓存内存预算约束下，如何设计非预知型调度算法（即请求响应长度未知），使得总完成时间尽可能接近预知最优解？
AI.motivation: LLM推理中KV缓存内存是稀缺资源，非预知响应长度与动态内存增长使得调度极具挑战。现有方法缺乏理论保证，需要设计具有常数竞争比的在线算法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 在线调度理论、竞争比分析、非预知型调度（non-clairvoyant scheduling）、批处理调度、内存约束调度。
AI.method: 提出"状态感知路由框架"（regime-aware routing framework）：包含多个专门子调度器以处理不同内存增长几何特性，以及一个元调度器在子调度器之间进行时间共享和内存预算分配，并根据作业执行过程中逐步暴露的行为进行动态路由。
AI.findings: 1. 首次实现任意提示长度和任意响应长度下O(1)-竞争比的非预知调度算法；2. 该框架同样对makespan和在线到达下的总完成时间给出常数竞争比保证。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首个针对KV缓存约束下LLM推理调度的常数竞争比算法；2. 提出"状态感知路由"这一新的算法框架，为处理具有异构内存增长特征的在线作业调度提供了通用方法论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为LLM推理系统中的内存调度器提供了具有理论保证的设计方案，有助于在实际部署中更高效地利用有限GPU内存资源，降低推理延迟。

title: Survivorship Bias in Indian Equities is not a Number: Vintage- and Filter-dependence in Point-in-Time Universes

detail.title: Survivorship Bias in Indian Equities is not a Number: Vintage- and Filter-dependence in Point-in-Time Universes

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author operates a commercial data-integrity practice; the proprietary datasets described in the paper are used in that practice.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study uses only historical market price data; no human participants, patient data, or personal data were involved.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: Survivorship bias is routinely quoted as a constant: "backtests overstate returns by X percent per year." We show the constant does not exist. Using point-in-time top-500 universes of Indian equities with dead names retained, we run paired honest-versus-survivor backtests under a 2x2 design: two universe vintages (2013, 2015) crossed with two survivor definitions (alive in the research panel; resolvable on yfinance, the free data source that serves as the Python ecosystem's de facto default). The measured bias spans +0.8 to +3.3 percentage points per year (a factor of four), with terminal-wealth inflation from +7% to +38%, on the same market with identical construction and a common end date. We further document the death term-structure of Indian equity universes (roughly a quarter of a top-500 universe becomes invisible within a decade), show that 24% of a 2015 universe cannot be resolved on the leading free data source, and that exits are not uniformly losers: merger and buyout exits mean survivor filters sometimes remove winners. The practical implication is that no single-number survivorship correction is defensible: the bias must be stated with its vintage, filter, and window, or measured directly on point-in-time data.

AI.tldr: 本文通过印度股市的真实数据，证明幸存者偏差并非固定常数，偏差大小随数据 vintage、幸存者定义和回测窗口的不同而显著变化（0.8%–3.3%/年），因此不能用单一数字修正，必须在点及时数据上直接测量。
AI.research_question: 幸存者偏差是否是一个固定常数？不同条件下偏差的异质性有多大？
AI.motivation: 业界普遍用单一数字（如"回测高估X%/年"）来修正幸存者偏差，但该假设缺乏实证检验。
AI.theoretical_framework: 幸存者偏差理论；点及时数据 vs. 后视偏差；数据源可解析性偏差。
AI.method: 2×2实验设计：2013与2015两个 vintage × 两种幸存者定义（活体面板 vs. yfinance可解析）。在印度top-500股票中运行配对回测，保留已退市股票。
AI.findings: 偏差跨度0.8%–3.3%/年（差异达4倍），终值膨胀7%–38%；约1/4的top-500股票在10年内"消失"；24%的股票在免费数据源上无法解析；并购退出意味着幸存者过滤有时会移除赢家。
AI.theory_contributions: 证伪了"幸存者偏差是常数"的隐含假设，提出了偏差的三维依存框架（vintage、过滤器、时间窗口）。
AI.practical_contributions: 否定单一数字修正法，要求从业者必须注明偏差条件或直接使用点及时数据；指出免费数据源（yfinance）存在系统性遗漏。

title: Dynamic Operational Resilience for Small and Medium-Sized Enterprises During Prolonged Crises: A Stage-Based Crisis Management Framework

detail.title: Dynamic Operational Resilience for Small and Medium-Sized Enterprises During Prolonged Crises: A Stage-Based Crisis Management Framework
detail.abstract:
Small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) operating in environments characterized by geopolitical instability, inflationary shocks, supply chain disruptions, and financial uncertainty require crisis management approaches that evolve over time. Existing resilience literature has extensively examined organizational capabilities, business continuity, and crisis response mechanisms; however, most studies treat resilience as a static organizational attribute rather than a dynamic managerial process that changes throughout the progression of a crisis. Despite these contributions, limited attention has been devoted to how managerial priorities evolve throughout different stages of prolonged crises.

This paper addresses this gap by developing a stage-based operational resilience framework that conceptualizes crisis management as a sequence of interconnected decision stages. Building upon the literature on organizational resilience, crisis management, business continuity, and dynamic capabilities, the proposed framework distinguishes three sequential stages of organizational response: Survival, Adaptation, and Reconstruction. Each stage is characterized by distinct managerial objectives, dominant decision logics, operational priorities, and resilience outcomes.

Unlike conventional crisis management models that emphasize isolated response actions, the proposed framework argues that organizational failure frequently results from the misalignment between managerial decision-making and the evolving stage of crisis exposure. Accordingly, effective resilience depends not only on resource availability but also on the firm's ability to transition systematically between successive stages of crisis management.

The primary contribution of this study is the development of a dynamic conceptual architecture that integrates operational continuity, organizational adaptation, and long-term capability renewal into a unified temporal resilience model for SMEs. The framework offers a theoretical foundation for future empirical research while providing a structured analytical perspective for understanding resilience under prolonged and uncertain crisis conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文针对中小企业在长期危机下的管理需求，提出了一个包含"生存—适应—重构"三阶段的动态运营韧性框架，强调管理者决策与危机阶段的匹配度决定了企业能否有效应对危机。
AI.research_question: 在长期危机进程中，中小企业的管理优先级如何随着危机阶段演变？如何构建一个动态的阶段式运营韧性框架以解释这种演变？
AI.motivation: 现有韧性文献大多将韧性视为静态的组织属性，忽视了管理者在危机不同阶段决策优先级动态变化的过程。中小企业面临地缘政治动荡、通胀冲击、供应链中断和金融不确定性等多重挑战，亟需一个随时间演化的危机管理框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 整合了组织韧性、危机管理、业务持续性和动态能力理论，提出了三阶段（生存、适应、重构）的运营韧性框架，每个阶段具有不同的管理目标、主导决策逻辑、运营优先级和韧性结果。
AI.method: 概念性研究，通过理论整合与逻辑推演构建框架，属于理论开发型论文。
AI.findings: 组织失败往往源于管理者决策与危机暴露阶段的错配；有效韧性不仅依赖资源可用性，更取决于企业能否在危机管理各阶段之间系统性地过渡。
AI.theory_contributions: 将韧性从静态属性重新概念化为动态管理过程；将运营持续性、组织适应和长期能力更新整合为统一的时间性韧性模型；为中小企业危机管理提供了阶段匹配的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为中小企业管理者提供了"生存—适应—重构"三阶段的决策路线图，帮助其识别当前危机阶段并调整管理优先级，避免因决策与阶段错配而导致失败。

title: Interest on ITC Wrong Availed but Not Utilized Under GST Credit and Reversal: Research Review
affiliations: St. Francis Institute of Management and Research Mumbai.

detail.title: Interest on ITC Wrong Availed but Not Utilized Under GST Credit and Reversal: Research Review

declarations.funderStatement: Nil

detail.abstract: The GST Department has received complaints nationwide about incorrectly claimed but unutilized ITC. Such objections and the relevant legal laws will be covered in this article. First, interest payments are only made in cases when the output tax burden is reduced, as stated in the CGST Act Section 50(3) read with Section 42(10). Therefore, interest liability is not triggered in situations where the assessed has not used the unnecessary excess input credit, and there is no decrease in output tax due. Second, the company does not lose money because the assessed does not profit financially from using the surplus ITC. It is therefore against the rule of law. Government by laws and the administration of justice by the individuals who are currently in charge of government are both considered aspects of the rule of law. Under the rule of law, judgments must be rendered using established norms and principles, and they must generally be fair and alleviate the suffering of the populace. Thirdly, the GST Council agreed to amend Section 50(3) of the CGST Act to provide that interest would only be charged "on the amount payable through the electronic cash ledger" of the taxpayer after considering this scenario at its 31st meeting on December 22, 2018. The press release read as follows: Section 50 of the CGST Act should be amended to stipulate that interest should only be assessed on the taxpayer's net tax due after accounting for the allowable input tax credit; in other words, interest would only be assessed on the amount owed via the electronic cash ledger. In our opinion, then, there was no amount payable through the electronic cash ledger in circumstances where the excess input credit was mistakenly obtained but not used, and it was reversed through the unutilized credit balance available in the electronic credit ledger in the GST Portal.

AI.tldr: 本文讨论了印度GST制度中因错误申报但未使用的进项税收抵免（ITC）是否应支付利息的法律问题。文章指出，根据CGST法案第50(3)条，利息仅适用于输出税负减少的情形；若企业未使用多申报的ITC且未减少输出税，则不应触发利息责任。此外，错误申报但未使用的ITC并未给企业带来经济利益，因此征收利息违反法治原则。GST理事会已同意修订法案，明确利息仅对通过电子现金分类账支付的净税额计算。
AI.research_question: 在印度GST制度下，错误申报但未使用的进项税收抵免是否应产生利息责任？
AI.motivation: 实践中出现了大量错误申报但未使用的ITC案例，税务机关与纳税人之间对是否应支付利息存在争议，需要从法律条文和法治原则角度澄清这一问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: CGST法案第50(3)条与第42(10)条；法治原则（rule of law）。
AI.method: 法律条文解释与案例分析方法。
AI.findings: （1）利息责任仅在输出税负减少时触发，若多申报的ITC未被使用且已冲销，则不产生利息；（2）企业未从错误申报中获利，征收利息违反法治原则；（3）GST理事会已同意修订法案，明确利息仅对通过电子现金分类账支付的净税额计算。
AI.theory_contributions: 澄清了CGST法案第50(3)条中利息责任的触发条件，特别是"输出税负减少"这一要件的解释，为税法中利息条款的适用提供了理论依据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为纳税人应对因错误申报但未使用的ITC而被追缴利息的情形提供了法律抗辩依据；推动GST理事会修订法案，明确了利息仅对净税额（电子现金分类账支付部分）计算，减少了纳税争议。

title: The Strategic Bottleneck: How Generative AI is Reshaping Corporate Innovation

detail.title: The Strategic Bottleneck: How Generative AI is Reshaping Corporate Innovation
detail.abstract:
Based on insights from over 50 innovation and R&D executives, this paper highlights three critical trends shaping the generative AI landscape:

  • FOMO-Driven, Strategy-Less Adoption: Companies frequently rush AI implementation without clear strategic objectives, resulting in inefficiencies and a superficial focus on being "AI-driven" rather than actually solving core business problems.
  • The Bottleneck Shift: Rapid R&D acceleration has moved organizational bottlenecks away from basic execution and toward upstream ideation, strategic direction, and the rigorous review of AI-generated work.
  • Competitive Landscape Fragmentation: Lowered barriers to entry enable AI-native startups to easily disrupt traditional incumbents. Large firms must enhance their capabilities to sense fragmented market signals and respond with agility.

AI.tldr: 本文基于对50多位创新与研发高管的访谈，识别出生成式AI领域三大关键趋势：FOMO驱动的无战略采纳、瓶颈从执行转向创意与审查、以及竞争格局碎片化。
AI.research_question: 当前企业在生成式AI采纳过程中面临哪些关键趋势与挑战？
AI.motivation: 帮助企业理解AI浪潮中的真实困境，避免盲目跟风，提供战略洞察。
AI.theoretical_framework: 创新管理理论、组织瓶颈理论、竞争战略理论
AI.method: 基于50多位创新与R&D高管的深度访谈
AI.findings: 1. FOMO驱动但缺乏战略的AI采纳导致效率低下；2. 研发加速使瓶颈从执行端转移到上游创意与战略审查；3. 进入壁垒降低使AI原生初创公司更容易颠覆传统企业。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了生成式AI时代组织瓶颈转移的新模式，丰富了创新采纳与竞争战略理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业提供警示：AI采纳需以战略为导向；大企业需提升市场信号感知与敏捷响应能力。

title: Khan | From Frontier Crimes to Constitutional Rights: FATA's Long Road to Integration

detail.title: Khan | From Frontier Crimes to Constitutional Rights: FATA's Long Road to Integration

declarations.ethicsApproval: This paper does not involve original human participant research, interviews, or survey data collected for the purpose of this paper. It is based on published academic literature, government and international organisation documents, and the author's general professional experience in Merged Areas governance programming, described at a general rather than individual level. No ethics approval or participant consent was therefore required.
declarations.funderStatement: This paper received no specific grant or funding from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors, in either its original 2016–17 phase or its 2026 update. It was conducted independently by the author. The donor-funded governance programming referenced in Section 6 is separately funded, as disclosed in the text.

detail.abstract: For seventy-one years after Pakistan's independence, the Federally Administered Tribal Areas (FATA)home to over 4.4 million people along the Afghan border-were governed not by the Constitution of Pakistan but by the Frontier Crimes Regulation (FCR) of 1901, a colonial-era legal code that denied residents basic judicial, political, and civil rights. I trace here the origins of that system under British administrators seeking to control the Pashtun tribal belt as a strategic buffer against Russian and later Afghan influence, examine why successive Pakistani governments preserved rather than dismantled it, and analyse the security and human development costs of seven decades of non-integration-including the border region's emergence as what President Obama, in a March 2009 address announcing a new US strategy for Afghanistan and Pakistan, called "the most dangerous place in the world." I then examine the FATA-Khyber Pakhtunkhwa merger of May 2018, which formally abolished the FCR and the Political Agent system through the Twenty-Fifth Amendment to the Constitution of Pakistan, extending full constitutional rights to the former tribal areas for the first time in Pakistan's history. Drawing on recent post-merger assessments, I argue that the merger's legal and constitutional achievement has substantially outpaced its administrative and institutional implementation: six years on, Deputy Commissioners in the merged districts continue to operate in patterns closely resembling the Political Agent system they formally replaced, the informal Jirga continues to displace formal courts in practice, and residual militancy continues to complicate development delivery. I close with a practitioner's perspective on what durable integration still requires, drawing on the donor-funded governance programming I have worked on directly in the Merged Areas.

AI.tldr: 本文追溯了巴基斯坦联邦直辖部落地区（FATA）从英国殖民时期的1901年《边境犯罪条例》到2018年并入开伯尔-普赫图赫瓦省的历史，分析了殖民遗产如何导致该地区长期处于宪法权利缺失、安全恶化和发展滞后的状态，并论证了法律合并远快于行政与制度落地的现实困境。
AI.research_question: FATA地区为何长期处于宪法权利缺失状态？2018年合并政策在法律、行政和安全等方面的实际成效如何？
AI.motivation: FATA地区作为拥有440万人口的边境地带，长期被殖民法律FCR统治，导致该地区被称为"世界上最危险的地方"，但其历史根源和合并后的实施效果缺乏系统分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 殖民遗产理论、制度变迁理论、国家能力建设理论
AI.method: 历史制度分析、政策评估、基于作者在援助项目中的实践经验
AI.findings: （1）FATA的殖民治理体系被巴基斯坦历届政府延续而非废除，产生了严重的安全与人发展代价；（2）2018年合并虽然在法律和宪法层面取得了重大成就，但行政和制度实施严重滞后：副专员仍沿袭政治代理人模式、部落长老会议仍取代正式法院、残余武装活动阻碍发展交付。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了殖民法律制度的长期延续机制及其对后殖民国家治理转型的制约，拓展了制度变迁中"法律形式变革"与"制度实质变革"脱节的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为巴基斯坦政府及捐助方在合并地区的治理改革提供了实践建议，指出了从法律合并走向真正制度整合所需的具体方向。

title: New Methods for Mixed-Frequency Modeling Using Machine Learning: With An Application to Forecasting Stock Returns
affiliations: Sacred Heart University, Rutgers, The State University of New Jersey - Department of Economics, Rutgers University - Department of Economics and

detail.title: New Methods for Mixed-Frequency Modeling Using Machine Learning: With An Application to Forecasting Stock Returns
detail.abstract: This paper proposes and studies three new machine learning methods for incorporating mixed-frequency information into the prediction of lower-frequency time series variables in high-dimensional predictor environments. The methods are designed to preserve withinperiod dynamics across multiple data frequencies and utilize path embedding and encoding, dimension reduction and shrinkage, and various types of data aggregation. We use monthly stock returns prediction to illustrate implementation of the methods, with a dataset that contains more than 100 daily nancial and macroeconomic predictors and a common set of machine learning methods including LASSO and ridge shrinkage operators, random forests, support vector machines, feedforward neural networks, and long-short-term memory networks. Our ndings indicate that incorporating higher-frequency information signicantly improves forecasting performance and that predictive accuracy depends critically on how such information is incorporated into the forecasting process. Among the proposed methods, one called Group-Structured High-Frequency Path Embedding delivers the most consistent improvements across assets, forecasting models, and evaluation periods. This method also performs favorably when compared against extant mixed-frequency modeling methods such as MIDAS. Overall, the ndings highlight the importance of eectively utilizing higher-frequency information in mixed-frequency forecasting and suggest broad applicability to nancial and macroeconomic forecasting problems involving predictors and targets observed at dierent frequencies.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了三种新的机器学习方法，用于在高维预测变量环境中将混合频率信息纳入低频时间序列变量的预测中。通过月度股票收益率预测的实证发现，纳入高频信息能显著提升预测性能，其中分组结构化高频路径嵌入方法效果最为一致和优异。
AI.research_question: 如何在高维预测变量环境中，将混合频率信息有效纳入低频时间序列变量的预测中？
AI.motivation: 传统混合频率方法（如MIDAS）在高维环境下存在局限，而现有机器学习方法未能充分利用高频数据的内部动态信息，亟需开发能够有效嵌入和编码高频路径的新方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 路径嵌入与编码、维度缩减与收缩、数据聚合；基于LASSO、Ridge、随机森林、支持向量机、前馈神经网络和LSTM等机器学习框架。
AI.method: 提出了三种混合频率机器学习方法：利用路径嵌入与编码、维度缩减与收缩以及多种数据聚合技术；以超过100个日度金融与宏观经济变量预测月度股票收益率为应用场景，与LASSO、Ridge、随机森林、SVM、前馈神经网络和LSTM等基准方法进行比较。
AI.findings: （1）纳入高频信息显著提升了预测性能；（2）预测精度关键取决于高频信息如何被纳入预测过程；（3）提出的分组结构化高频路径嵌入方法在资产、预测模型和评估期间表现最为一致；（4）该方法优于MIDAS等现有混合频率模型。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统性地将多种机器学习方法（包括深度学习）与混合频率预测结合，提出了三种新的高频信息融入机制，揭示了高频信息嵌入方式对预测性能的关键影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 为金融和宏观经济预测中涉及不同频率数据的问题提供了有效的方法工具，特别是分组结构化高频路径嵌入方法可作为实用的高频低频数据融合预测方案。

title: When Less Data Is Better: Eliminating Stockout-Induced Bias in Choice Estimation
affiliations: , University of Southern California - Marshall School of Business and University of Texas at Dallas - Naveen Jindal School of Management

detail.title: When Less Data Is Better: Eliminating Stockout-Induced Bias in Choice Estimation
detail.abstract:
Problem definition: Firms frequently estimate customer choice probabilities from historical offline sales data using the multinomial logit model and maximum likelihood estimation. In settings with finite inventories, stockouts progressively shrink the available assortment over time. Prior literature has shown that maximum likelihood estimates can be biased because the timing of stockouts is unobserved and has developed methods for imputing the missing information. Our paper identifies a fundamentally different and underappreciated source of systematic bias: even when stockout timings are fully observed, maximum likelihood estimates of choice probabilities remain biased because of stockout-induced endogeneity.
Methodology/results: We prove that maximum likelihood estimates are biased, and the estimation error can be substantial. We then propose a remarkably simple remedy: removing observations that trigger stockouts from the dataset. Despite its simplicity, we prove that our proposed estimator is unbiased, and that our estimator is the uniformly minimum variance unbiased estimator. Thus, no other unbiased estimator can achieve a lower mean squared error than ours. Our methodology also enables us to obtain unbiased estimates of selection probabilities under arbitrary assortments.
Managerial implications: Numerical experiments on both synthetic data and sales data from a large online grocery retailer confirm that our estimator substantially improves prediction accuracy. We observe a significant reduction in estimation errors, even in settings where a single product is stocked out, demonstrating the robustness of our estimator. Our proposed estimator is operationally practical yet statistically optimal, showing that using less data can sometimes lead to better estimation.

AI.tldr: 本文发现，即使完全观察到缺货时间，基于历史销售数据的多项Logit模型最大似然估计仍会因缺货引发的内生性而产生系统性偏差。作者提出一个简单而有效的解决方案：删除触发缺货的观测值，该估计量不仅是无偏的，而且是均匀最小方差无偏估计量。
AI.research_question: 在有限库存环境中，当缺货时间可完全观测时，基于多项Logit模型的最大似然估计是否存在系统性偏差？如何纠正这种偏差？
AI.motivation: 已有文献关注了缺货时间不可观测导致的估计偏差问题，但本文识别并证明了即使缺货时间完全可观测，缺货引发的内生性仍会导致系统性偏差，这是一个被低估的重要偏差来源。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多项Logit模型、最大似然估计、缺货内生性、均匀最小方差无偏估计（UMVUE）
AI.method: 理论证明（证明MLE有偏及所提估计量的无偏性和最优性）+ 数值实验（合成数据与大型在线杂货零售商的实际销售数据）
AI.findings: 最大似然估计因缺货内生性存在显著偏差；删除触发缺货的观测值可得到无偏且均匀最小方差无偏的估计量；即使在单个产品缺货的场景下，该估计量也能大幅提升预测精度。
AI.theory_contributions: 识别并证明了缺货内生性这一被低估的系统性偏差来源；证明了所提简单估计量的无偏性和统计最优性（UMVUE）。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一个操作简单、统计最优的估计方法；表明在某些情况下使用较少的数据反而能获得更好的估计结果，对企业需求预测和库存管理具有直接指导意义。

title:
Governance & Development | Merged Areas, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Accelerating Development in Pakistan's Merged Areas: 
A District Development Package Framework for Post-FATA Integration

detail.title:
Governance & Development | Merged Areas, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Accelerating Development in Pakistan's Merged Areas: 
A District Development Package Framework for Post-FATA Integration
detail.abstract:
The merger of the Federally Administered Tribal Areas (FATA) into Khyber Pakhtunkhwa in 2018 represents the most significant constitutional transformation in Pakistan's post-independence history. Five million residents of the Merged Areas now stand at a critical juncture — transitioning from decades of punitive colonial administration and conflict toward a new era of mainstream governance and accelerated development.

This policy brief presents the Da Khushaale Lara (District Development Package) framework — a structured, community-driven development programme designed to address the immediate and medium-term infrastructure, services, and governance needs of the Merged Areas. With an overall programme size of PKR 9 billion over three years, the framework delegates development authority to district governments, anchors project selection in public consultations, and establishes transparent accountability mechanisms to ensure citizen confidence in the state.

The framework represents a practical bridge between citizen-articulated needs and government service delivery capacity — designed to accelerate visible development outcomes while building institutional trust in a post-conflict environment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"Da Khushaale Lara（地区发展包）"框架，这是一个结构化的社区驱动型发展计划，旨在帮助巴基斯坦联邦直辖部落地区（FATA）在2018年并入开伯尔-普赫图赫瓦省后，实现从殖民统治和冲突状态向主流治理与加速发展的转型。该框架在三年内规模达90亿巴基斯坦卢比，将发展权力下放至地区政府，以公众咨询确定项目，并建立透明问责机制。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一个能够满足巴基斯坦合并地区（原FATA）基础设施、服务和治理需求的社区驱动型发展框架？
AI.motivation: FATA合并是巴基斯坦后独立时代最重要的宪法变革，500万居民正处于从数十年惩罚性殖民统治和冲突向主流治理转型的关键节点，急需有效的发展方案来加速发展并建立对国家的信任。
AI.theoretical_framework: 社区驱动型发展（Community-Driven Development）、地方分权治理、公民参与与政府服务交付能力之间的桥梁构建、冲突后环境中的制度信任建设。
AI.method: 政策简报形式，提出结构化发展框架（Da Khushaale Lara框架），包括权力下放至地区政府、公众咨询选择项目、透明问责机制等设计要素。
AI.findings: 该框架以90亿卢比三年计划规模，通过发展权力下放、公众咨询和透明问责机制，能够有效衔接公民需求和政府服务能力，加速冲突后地区的可见发展成果并建立制度信任。
AI.theory_contributions: 为冲突后地区社区驱动型发展提供了一个可操作的政策框架，展示了如何将公众参与、地方分权与问责机制系统性地整合以建立制度信任。
AI.practical_contributions: 为巴基斯坦合并地区（原FATA）的发展转型提供了具体的政策设计方案，包括资金规模、治理结构、项目选择机制和问责安排，可供政府和政策制定者直接参考实施。

title: Formats Shape Incentives: A Quantitative Evaluation of the 2026 FIFA World Cup and Alternative Designs

detail.title: Formats Shape Incentives: A Quantitative Evaluation of the 2026 FIFA World Cup and Alternative Designs
detail.abstract: The 2026 FIFA World Cup expanded to 48 teams in twelve groups of four, with the top two teams of each group plus the eight best third-placed teams advancing to a new Round of 32. Using a Monte Carlo engine built on an offense-defense rating model, we quantify how this design can influence competitive integrity. Its problems come primarily from choices that could be addressed while maintaining a 48-team format. First, we found that the number of uncompetitive final group games nearly doubled using the 2026 format compared to the 2022 format. This was driven by using head-to-head tiebreakers (as opposed to goal differential) and having third-place teams qualify. The latter also resulted in more than tripling the rate of effortless biscotti, matches in which a mutual draw advances both teams, and gave teams a direct incentive to run up the score against the weakest team in the group. Furthermore, teams that play their final group game later have increased information and more temptation to play for an advancing result. Second, using results from every World Cup and European Championship of the three-points-for-a-win era, teams draw significantly more often when a draw is mutually beneficial, a pattern that betting markets priced before kickoff in 2026. Third, adding a Round of 32, while decreasing jeopardy in the group stage, increases it in the new knockout round, eliminating twice as many of the tournament's eight strongest teams. Finally, we propose a "pod" design in which the top two teams in each group advance with byes for specific group winners. This approach reduces dead rubbers and collusion opportunities and increases the odds that the strongest teams make the final rounds.

AI.tldr: 本文通过蒙特卡洛模拟，分析了2026年世界杯扩军至48队的新赛制对比赛竞争公正性的影响，发现该赛制导致小组赛末轮垃圾比赛增多、默契球风险上升、强队被过早淘汰等问题，并提出改进的“Pod”赛制方案。
AI.research_question: 2026年世界杯扩军至48队（12组×4队，小组前两名+8个最佳第三名出线）的赛制设计如何影响比赛的竞争公正性？
AI.motivation: 2026年世界杯将首次采用48队赛制，但该赛制可能带来竞争公正性问题。作者希望量化评估这些问题，并提出改进方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于进攻-防守评分模型的蒙特卡洛模拟引擎，结合历史比赛数据（世界杯和欧洲杯的三分制时代）和博彩市场赔率。
AI.method: 使用基于进攻-防守评分模型的蒙特卡洛模拟引擎，量化分析2026年赛制与2022年赛制的差异。利用历史比赛数据和博彩市场赔率验证模式。
AI.findings: (1) 2026赛制下小组赛末轮无竞争性的比赛数量较2022赛制几乎翻倍；(2) 采用相互战绩而非净胜球作为同分规则，加上第三名出线机制，导致默契球(biscotti)发生率增加三倍以上；(3) 最后进行小组赛的球队因信息优势更有动机打默契球；(4) 历史数据显示当平局对双方有利时，平局发生率显著升高；(5) 新增32强淘汰赛虽降低小组赛风险，但增加了对八支最强球队的淘汰概率。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统量化了48队世界杯赛制对竞争公正性的影响，揭示了小组赛编排顺序、同分规则与出线规则对球队行为的交互作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了改进的“Pod”赛制（每组前两名出线，部分小组头名轮空），可减少垃圾比赛、降低默契球机会、提高强队进入决赛轮的概率，为国际足联赛制设计提供参考。

title: Below the Disclosure Line: Transition Readiness Across MSMEs. Leadership Perception Evidence from 900 Firms in Asia, 2022-2025

detail.title: Below the Disclosure Line: Transition Readiness Across MSMEs. Leadership Perception Evidence from 900 Firms in Asia, 2022-2025

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Joanne Flinn is Founder and Chair of the ESG Institute (Singapore), a Certified B Corporation that develops the ClearSight Intelligence and Greensight platforms referenced in this paper; these instruments and their underlying calibrations are available under commercial licence. The paper's findings are published in full; the proprietary calibrations are not. The author declares no other financial or personal relationships that could be perceived to have influenced this work.
declarations.ethicsApproval: The Greensight leadership survey underpinning this paper was conducted with participants' informed consent. Responses were anonymised and reported only in aggregate; no personally identifiable information is presented. The research was carried out by a Certified B Corporation under its own research governance standards. No patient or clinical data were involved.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external or grant funding. It was conducted and funded internally by the ESG Institute (Singapore).

detail.abstract: Below the disclosure line sits the population this series reasons about but has not measured: the micro, small and medium firms (MSMEs) that carry the deep layers of every listed entity's value chain and are not subject to mandatory disclosure. This paper measures it from inside, across four survey waves and 900 leaders in Asia, 2022 to 2025. The finding is not that the transition is unfunded, but that it is unnamed. Fifteen per cent of leaders connect sustainability to capital expenditure, so allocation and commitment have nothing to attach to. The lever that moves firms initially is not money. Leadership tone, linked incentives and engaged people cost close to nothing and work at every size, and a quarter of the smallest firms already pull them. But practice converts to capital only higher up the chain: well-led large and mid-size firms connect it to the chequebook, while well-led small firms turn it to culture and people. This population is mainstream, willing, led, and under-resourced. Below the line, the binding constraint is not capital. It is the step from practice to capital.

AI.tldr: 本文通过对亚洲900名中小微企业领导者（2022-2025年，四轮调查）的内部分析发现，中小微企业的可持续转型并非缺乏资金，而是缺乏"命名"——仅15%的领导者将可持续性与资本支出联系起来。推动企业的最初杠杆不是金钱，而是领导基调、激励和人员参与。实践转化为资本的瓶颈发生在企业规模链的上游：大型和中型企业能将可持续实践与财务决策挂钩，而小型企业则转向文化和人员。结论是：中小微企业有意愿、有领导力，但资源不足，真正的约束不是资本，而是从实践到资本的转化步骤。
AI.research_question: 中小微企业（MSMEs）在可持续转型中面临的核心约束是什么？资金是否真的是主要障碍？
AI.motivation: 现有文献和披露框架主要聚焦于受强制性披露约束的上市公司，忽视了价值链深处未被测量的中小微企业群体。本文试图从内部视角测量这一"线下"群体的可持续转型真实状况。
AI.theoretical_framework: 可持续转型的"命名-实践-资本"三阶段理论：企业首先需要将可持续性"命名"（与资本支出建立联系），然后转化为实践（领导力、激励、人员参与），最终转化为资本配置。不同规模企业在这三个阶段的转化路径存在差异。
AI.method: 四轮问卷调查（2022-2025年），覆盖亚洲900名中小微企业领导者。
AI.findings: 1. 仅15%的领导者将可持续性与资本支出连接（"未命名"问题）；2. 推动企业的最初杠杆是领导基调、激励和人员参与，而非金钱；3. 四分之一的最小企业已在使用这些低成本杠杆；4. 大型和中型企业能将实践转化为资本（连接支票簿），而小型企业只能转化为文化和人员；5. 中小微企业有意愿、有领导力，但资源不足。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"未命名"概念，揭示可持续转型的瓶颈并非资本短缺，而是从实践到资本的转化步骤；发现不同规模企业在可持续转型转化路径上的结构性差异。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和金融机构提供启示：支持中小微企业可持续转型的重点不应是简单提供资金，而应帮助其建立可持续实践与资本支出之间的连接机制；对大型企业而言，应关注供应链中中小微企业的"实践到资本"转化支持。

title:
From Interstate Rupture to Interactive Resolution:

Applying Conflict Resolution Theory to the Pakistan–Afghanistan War of 2025–26

detail.title:
From Interstate Rupture to Interactive Resolution:

Applying Conflict Resolution Theory to the Pakistan–Afghanistan War of 2025–26

declarations.ethicsApproval: No patients or particpants were involved in the study. The research is done through the secondary research.
declarations.funderStatement: This paper did not received any funding from any donor, it is the work of the author.

detail.abstract: This paper analyses an active, rapidly evolving conflict. Casualty figures, ceasefire status, and diplomatic positions cited below are drawn from UN, government, and independent reporting available as of mid-2026 and may change before or shortly after publication. The analysis deliberately avoids assigning definitive blame for individual incidents where facts remain contested between parties, and instead applies established conflict resolution theory-which is concerned with underlying needs and interests rather than adjudicating culpability-to identify a possible path toward de-escalation. As a Pakistani national, I have made a deliberate effort to represent the security concerns, grievances, and stated positions of all parties-Pakistan, Afghanistan's de facto authorities, and the civilian populations of both countries-fairly and without partisan framing.

AI.tldr: 本文运用既有的冲突解决理论，在避免对争议事件明确归责的前提下，分析了一场快速演变的活跃冲突（巴基斯坦与阿富汗之间），并为缓和局势指出可能的路径。作者作为巴基斯坦国民，有意识地力求公平、无党派框架地呈现各方立场。
AI.research_question: 如何运用冲突解决理论（关注根本需求与利益，而非裁定责任归属），为巴基斯坦与阿富汗之间快速演变的活跃冲突找到一条可能的降级路径？
AI.motivation: 这是一场快速演变的活跃冲突，事实在各方之间存在争议，且伤亡数字、停火状态等随时可能变化；现有讨论容易陷入相互归责，缺乏基于理论的中立分析。作者作为巴基斯坦国民，希望以自觉的公正态度呈现各方安全关切与 grievance，填补这一分析空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 既有的冲突解决理论（conflict resolution theory），核心关注点在于：根本需求（underlying needs）与利益（interests），而非裁定（adjudicating）具体事件的罪责（culpability）。
AI.method: 基于联合国、政府及独立报告截至2026年中的公开数据，结合冲突解决理论进行定性分析；作者以巴基斯坦国民身份有意识地进行多立场公平呈现。
AI.findings: 通过避免对争议事件归责、转而关注各方根本需求与利益，可以识别出一条可能的冲突降级路径。
AI.theory_contributions: 展示了冲突解决理论（而非归责型分析框架）在快速演变、事实存争议的活跃冲突场景中的应用价值。
AI.practical_contributions: 为巴基斯坦、阿富汗当局及两国平民之间的冲突降级提供了基于理论的具体路径参考；展示了研究者即便身为冲突一方国民，仍可通过方法论自觉实现相对公允的分析。

title: Moving the Goalposts, Then Replacing the Referee: Earned Settlement, the IIAA, and the Skilled Workers Caught in Between

detail.title: Moving the Goalposts, Then Replacing the Referee: Earned Settlement, the IIAA, and the Skilled Workers Caught in Between
detail.abstract:
This article examines the interaction between the Government's proposed Earned Settlement reforms and the newly proposed Independent Immigration Appeals Authority (IIAA) under the Immigration and Asylum Bill 2026.

It argues that these measures should not be viewed in isolation. For existing Skilled Worker visa holders and their families, the retrospective extension of settlement requirements and the simultaneous restructuring of immigration appeals create a "pincer effect": the substantive conditions of lawful residence are altered while the institutional mechanisms for challenging those changes are simultaneously redesigned.

The article explores the implications for legal certainty, legitimate expectations, transitional fairness and administrative coherence within the UK immigration system. Drawing upon previous episodes of immigration exceptionalism and procedural derogation, it considers whether the cumulative effect of these reforms risks undermining public confidence in the stability and predictability of long-term migration pathways.

Originally published as a guest blog by the Electronic Immigration Network (EIN) on 8 July 2026.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了英国政府2026年《移民与庇护法案》中两项改革——追溯性延长定居要求与设立独立移民上诉机构——的相互作用，指出它们形成“钳形效应”，同时改变了合法居留的实质条件和挑战这些变更的制度机制，威胁法律确定性、合法预期、过渡公平和行政连贯性。
AI.research_question: 英国政府拟议的“挣得定居”改革与新设独立移民上诉机构（IIAA）之间如何相互作用？这种双重改革对现有技术工人签证持有者及其家庭的合法权利、法律确定性和制度信任产生何种影响？
AI.motivation: 两项改革往往被分开审视，但本文认为它们同时实施会产生协同效应，实质性削弱移民的法律保护。旨在揭示这种“钳形效应”对法治和公共信任的潜在危害。
AI.theoretical_framework: 法律确定性原则、合法期待原则、过渡公平理论、行政连贯性理论；以及“移民例外主义”和“程序减损”概念。
AI.method: 规范性法律分析，结合对英国过往移民政策中例外主义和程序减损的历史比较。
AI.findings: 两项改革形成“钳形效应”：一方面追溯性地改变定居的实质条件（延长要求），另一方面重新设计上诉机制以限制对变更的挑战能力；这种叠加效应损害了法律确定性、合法期待和过渡公平，可能削弱公众对长期移民路径稳定性的信心。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了“钳形效应”概念，用以描述实质法与程序法同步变更对移民权利的双重挤压；丰富了移民例外主义和程序减损的理论讨论，揭示了累积性制度变更的独特危害机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和法律从业者提供了审视移民改革协同效应的分析框架；警示立法者需关注过渡安排和制度信任问题，避免因改革叠加而引发系统性公平性危机。

title:
Grassroots and Elite Pathways to Countering Violent Extremism:
Two Community-level CVE Interventions in South Punjab, Pakistan

detail.title:
Grassroots and Elite Pathways to Countering Violent Extremism:
Two Community-level CVE Interventions in South Punjab, Pakistan
detail.abstract:
Countering Violent Extremism (CVE) programming in Pakistan's South Punjab region has to contend with
a specific set of drivers: youth unemployment and limited opportunity in a population where roughly 64
percent are under 30, entrenched sectarian division, and the circulation of extremist literature and social
media content exploiting local grievances.1 I present here a comparative case study of two community-level
CVE interventions I designed and managed under the USAID-funded Azm-e-Pakistan programme in 2019:
a youth- and community-elder-focused "Peace Ambassadors" initiative in Multan, and a literary-elite-
focused "Literature for Peace" initiative engaging prominent South Punjabi poets and writers. The two
interventions represent complementary, theoretically distinct pathways to the same objective — the former
working through grassroots youth mobilisation and horizontal peer influence, structured around interactive
theatre, sports, and interfaith exposure visits; the latter working through vertical opinion-leader diffusion,
leveraging the pre-existing cultural authority of literary figures, including a poet with over five million
social media followers, to model and disseminate counter-extremist narratives. I situate both designs within
established C/PVE theory — credible messenger theory, contact hypothesis, and social network diffusion
— and argue that their combination reflects a deliberately diversified portfolio approach: engaging both the
grassroots social fabric most vulnerable to extremist recruitment and the cultural elites most capable of
shifting broader community narratives.

AI.tldr: 本文比较了巴基斯坦南旁遮普地区两种社区层面的反暴力极端主义（CVE）干预措施——面向青年和社区长者的"和平大使"计划（通过互动剧场、体育和跨信仰接触进行基层动员），以及面向文学精英的"文学促进和平"计划（利用知名诗人/作家的文化权威扩散反极端主义叙事）。作者将两种设计置于可信信使理论、接触假说和社会网络扩散理论中分析，论证其组合体现了刻意多元化的投资组合策略。
AI.research_question: 在巴基斯坦南旁遮普地区，两种不同路径（基层青年动员 vs. 文化精英意见领袖扩散）的社区层面反暴力极端主义干预措施如何发挥作用？它们各自的理论基础是什么？
AI.motivation: 南旁遮普地区面临青年失业率高（64%人口低于30岁）、教派分裂根深蒂固、极端主义文学和社交媒体内容利用地方不满情绪传播等独特挑战，亟需有效的CVE干预方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 可信信使理论、接触假说、社会网络扩散理论
AI.method: 比较案例研究，分析作者在USAID资助的Azm-e-Pakistan项目下设计并管理的两个社区级CVE干预措施。
AI.findings: 两种干预措施代表了互补且理论上不同的路径：一种通过基层青年动员和横向同伴影响（互动剧场、体育、跨信仰接触）；另一种通过纵向意见领袖扩散（利用文学人物的文化权威传播反极端主义叙事）。两种方法的组合构成了一种刻意多元化的投资组合策略，同时作用于最容易受极端主义招募影响的基层社会结构，以及最有能力改变更广泛社区叙事的知识精英。
AI.theory_contributions: 将可信信使理论、接触假说和社会网络扩散理论整合应用于CVE实践，展示了多元理论框架下不同干预路径如何在同一个区域互补运作。
AI.practical_contributions: 为在类似背景下设计CVE项目提供了具体可操作的经验：同时针对基层青年群体和文化精英实施差异化干预，形成多层次的社区去极端化方案。

title:
Khan | Sustaining Campus CVE:
A Three-year Institutionalization Review in Pakistani Universities

detail.title:
Khan | Sustaining Campus CVE:
A Three-year Institutionalization Review in Pakistani Universities
detail.abstract:
Countering violent extremism (CVE) on university campuses has emerged as a distinct sub-field of practice
internationally, from the United Kingdom's statutory "Prevent Duty" requiring universities to actively
counter radicalisation, to the United States' Invent2Prevent programme engaging college students directly
in prevention design. I examine here a Pakistani case that adds a dimension largely absent from this
comparative literature: systematic institutionalization review. In April 2017, following escalating incidents
of campus violence — including a widely reported 2019 case in which a student murdered a professor at
Sadiq Egerton College, Bahawalpur, following a dispute over a student welcome event, and recurring ethnic
clashes at Bahauddin Zakariya University — the USAID-funded Azm-e-Pakistan programme convened 27
Punjab public universities to develop CVE action plans, with five universities selected for intensive, multi-
year partnership. I present here the design of a 2020 follow-up intervention I personally conceived and
managed: a second Vice-Chancellors conference explicitly structured to review, three years on, which
elements of the original action plans had been institutionalised — student peace societies, curriculum
integration, faculty training — and which had lapsed, with findings used to refine action plans for continued
sustainability. I situate this sustainability-review methodology against international practice, noting that
campus CVE evaluation literature broadly acknowledges longitudinal institutionalization assessment as an
underdeveloped area, and argue that structured, multi-year review of this kind represents a transferable
model for a field more commonly organised around one-off training interventions than sustained
institutional follow-through.

AI.tldr: 本文基于巴基斯坦旁遮普省27所公立大学的CVE（反暴力极端主义）行动计划的制度化审查实践，提出了一种结构化的多年度可持续性评估模型，弥补了校园CVE领域普遍缺乏纵向制度化评估的空白。
AI.research_question: 在巴基斯坦校园CVE行动计划的实施过程中，哪些元素被制度化、哪些元素被搁置？如何通过结构化的多年度审查机制来评估和提升CVE干预的可持续性？
AI.motivation: 校园CVE领域普遍存在"一次性培训干预"而缺乏长期制度化跟进的问题，现有文献也承认纵向制度化评估是薄弱环节；巴基斯坦校园暴力事件频发（如学生谋杀教授、族群冲突）凸显了系统化审查的必要性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 制度化理论（Institutionalization Theory）、可持续性评估框架（Sustainability Assessment）、CVE项目评估方法论
AI.method: 案例研究：基于美国国际开发署资助的Azm-e-Pakistan项目，于2020年设计并实施了第二次副校长会议，对比2017年首次会议上制定的行动计划，审查三年后各项措施（学生和平社团、课程整合、教师培训）的制度化程度。
AI.findings: 发现某些行动元素已被制度化，某些已搁置；利用审查结果修订行动计划以确保持续可持续性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一种可转移的、结构化的多年度制度化审查模型，弥补了校园CVE评估文献中纵向制度化评估的空白，将评估视角从"培训效果"拓展至"制度可持续性"。
AI.practical_contributions: 为巴基斯坦及其他发展中国家的校园CVE实践提供了系统化的可持续性评估工具；展示了如何通过周期性副校长会议机制实现跨大学的制度化跟进；可作为国际CVE实践从一次性干预转向持续制度建设的参考模板。

title: Hedging, not Choosing: Pakistan's Foreign Policy between Washington and Beijing in a Multipolar Order

detail.title: Hedging, not Choosing: Pakistan's Foreign Policy between Washington and Beijing in a Multipolar Order

declarations.ethicsApproval: This paper does not involve original human participant research, interviews, or survey data. It is based on published international relations scholarship, government and institutional reporting, and secondary journalistic sources, supplemented by the author's general professional experience described in Section 5. No ethics approval or participant consent was therefore required.
declarations.funderStatement: The author has no financial interest in, consulting relationship with, or advisory role regarding CPEC, Chinese state linked financing, or US government agencies referenced in this paper beyond his general professional history with USAID and other Western donors on unrelated governance and trade programming. This paper reflects independent analysis and is not commissioned by or prepared on behalf of any government, donor, or financial institution.

detail.abstract: A Note on Perspective This paper examines competing schools of international relations thought-hegemonic stability theory, multipolarity, and small-state hedging-as analytical frameworks, not as normative endorsements of any government's foreign policy. Where the paper describes the interests, claims, or grievances of the United States, China, or Pakistan, it does so descriptively, to explain observed state behaviour, rather than to argue that any one power's role in the international system is normatively preferable to another's.

AI.tldr: 本文旨在分析国际关系理论中三种竞争性思想流派——霸权稳定论、多极化与小国对冲——作为分析框架，而非对任何政府外交政策的规范性背书。文中对美国、中国或巴基斯坦的利益、主张或不满的描述，均旨在解释观察到的国家行为，而非论证某一强国在国际体系中的角色在规范上优于另一强国。
AI.research_question: 本文的研究问题是如何将霸权稳定论、多极化与小国对冲这三种竞争性国际关系思想作为分析框架来理解国家行为，而不是作为规范性判断。
AI.motivation: 研究动机在于厘清学术分析中描述性与规范性陈述的边界，避免将分析框架误读为对特定国家外交政策的支持或反对。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本文的理论框架包括霸权稳定论、多极化理论以及小国对冲策略三种国际关系思想流派。
AI.method: 本文采用理论分析的方法，对三种国际关系思想框架进行比较和辨析。
AI.findings: 本文发现，上述三种框架应被视为解释国家行为的分析工具，而非规范性评价标准；对美国、中国、巴基斯坦等国行为的描述是客观阐述而非价值判断。
AI.theory_contributions: 理论贡献在于澄清了国际关系研究中分析框架与规范性立场之间的区别，有助于避免理论应用中的混淆和误用。
AI.practical_contributions: 实践贡献在于为政策分析者和研究者提供更加清晰的方法论指导，帮助其在使用国际关系理论时保持学术中立性和客观性。

title: From Training to Print: Evidence on Peace Journalism as a Countering Violent Extremism Intervention in Pakistan

detail.title: From Training to Print: Evidence on Peace Journalism as a Countering Violent Extremism Intervention in Pakistan
detail.abstract:
Peace Journalism — a model of conflict reporting originally developed by Johan Galtung and subsequently
elaborated by Jake Lynch and Annabel McGoldrick, distinguishing war-and-violence-oriented reporting
from peace-and-conflict-oriented reporting — has increasingly been applied as a specific instrument of
Countering and Preventing Violent Extremism (C/PVE) programming, most rigorously documented in a
2024 study of Afghan journalist training that found a shift from a 23 percent to a 5 percent "War Journalism
quotient" and a 21 percent to 57 percent "Peace Journalism quotient" following training and mentorship. I
present here a Pakistani case — a 2016–17 USAID-funded activity I personally designed and managed,
working with the Bahawalpur Press Club in South Punjab — and evaluate it against this international
literature, using Alan Davis's influential three-tier framework for media development aid evaluation:
"benefit transferred" (knowledge conveyed in training), "benefit applied" (whether trainees changed their
actual published output), and "benefit beyond" (audience- and institution-level effects). Where much of the
peace journalism training literature has been able to document benefit transferred with more confidence
than benefit applied — a gap Lynch and Tiripelli's 2022 review of the field explicitly identifies — the
Pakistan case offers unusually concrete evidence of the latter: a Final Evaluation Report documenting
Bahawalpur Press Club's published columnist count rising from one to nine individuals, with twenty-two
specific, named, and dated articles published across regional and national outlets during and after the
training period. I argue that this concrete publication evidence, while lacking the systematic content-
analysis rigour of the Afghan comparative study, offers a rare and valuable contribution to a literature that
has more often had to rely on self-reported intention than documented published behaviour change.

AI.tldr: 本文通过巴基斯坦案例（2016-17年巴哈瓦尔布尔记者培训项目），评估和平新闻学培训在反暴力极端主义（C/PVE）中的实际效果，特别是证明"受益应用"（即培训后记者的实际发表行为改变）的可测量成果，弥补了该领域文献中"受益转移"（知识传递）易证而"受益应用"难证的缺口。
AI.research_question: 和平新闻学培训能否在实际的记者发表行为中带来可测量的"受益应用"效果？
AI.motivation: 现有和平新闻学培训文献多能证明"受益转移"（知识传授有效），但难以证明"受益应用"（记者实际发表行为的改变）。Lynch与Tiripelli（2022）的综述明确指出了这一缺口。本文试图通过巴基斯坦案例提供具体的发表行为证据来填补这一空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 和平新闻学理论（Galtung提出，Lynch & McGoldrick发展）：区分"战争/暴力导向报道"与"和平/冲突导向报道"；2. Alan Davis的媒体发展援助评估三层次框架："受益转移"、"受益应用"、"受益超越"。
AI.method: 案例评估研究：作者亲自设计和管理的2016-17年美国国际开发署（USAID）资助的巴哈瓦尔布尔记者培训项目，基于最终评估报告中的具体发表数据（专栏作者从1人增至9人，22篇具名、标注日期的文章在地区和国家媒体发表），对照国际文献和Davis的三层框架进行质性评估。
AI.findings: 1. 培训后巴哈瓦尔布尔记者协会的发表专栏作者从1人增至9人；2. 培训期间及之后，共有22篇具体具名、标注日期的文章在地区和国家级媒体发表；3. 该案例虽缺乏阿富汗比较研究的系统性内容分析严谨性，但提供了文献中罕见的"受益应用"具体行为证据，而非仅依赖自我报告意图。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了和平新闻学培训效果评估中"受益应用"层次的罕见、可验证的实地证据，回应了Lynch & Tiripelli（2022）对该领域文献缺口的识别，丰富了和平新闻学培训有效性的实证基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为C/PVE（反暴力极端主义）项目设计者提供了和平新闻学培训可转化为实际发表行为改变的实践证据；2. 为媒体发展援助的评估方法提供了"受益应用"的可操作化案例；3. 表明即使在缺乏系统内容分析资源的情况下，具体发表数据也能为项目效果提供有说服力的证据。

title: Statelessness, Atrocity, and the Limits of International Law: The Rohingya Crisis Nine Years on A Legal and Policy Analysis, with Reference to The Gambia v. Myanmar

detail.title: Statelessness, Atrocity, and the Limits of International Law: The Rohingya Crisis Nine Years on A Legal and Policy Analysis, with Reference to The Gambia v. Myanmar
detail.abstract: Nine years after the August 2017 exodus, the Rohingya crisis remains one of the world's most protracted and least resolved instances of mass statelessness. This paper examines the legal architecture underlying the Rohingya's exclusion from Myanmar citizenship, traces the humanitarian and political trajectory of the crisis from the 1982 Citizenship Law to the present, and analyses the unfolding Gambia v. Myanmar proceedings before the International Court of Justice, where merits hearings concluded in January 2026 and a binding judgment is expected later this year. Drawing on current UNHCR, ACAPS, and ICJ data, the paper documents a refugee population that has grown from roughly 700,000 in late 2017 to more than 1.3 million by mid-2026, compounded by renewed displacement since 2024 and a deepening humanitarian funding crisis. The paper argues that international law has proven far more effective at documenting and characterising the Rohingya crisis than at resolving it: legal categorisation as genocide, however well evidenced, has not yet translated into citizenship restoration, safe repatriation, or accountability. The paper concludes with a revised six-point framework for durable resolution, updated to reflect the post-coup Myanmar context and the prospect of an ICJ judgment on the merits.

AI.tldr: 本文系统梳理了罗兴亚危机的法律根源、人道主义演变及国际法院诉讼进程，指出国际法虽成功定性该危机为种族灭绝，但未能有效解决公民身份恢复、安全遣返和问责等核心问题，并提出更新后的六点解决方案框架。
AI.research_question: 国际法在罗兴亚危机中为何能够有效记录和定性，却无法有效解决公民身份恢复、安全遣返和问责等核心问题？
AI.motivation: 罗兴亚危机已成为全球最持久且最未解决的群体无国籍问题之一，急需系统审视国际法在其中发挥的实际作用与局限性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国际法中的种族灭绝认定框架、无国籍与公民权法律理论、国际司法（ICJ）的问责机制。
AI.method: 法律文本分析（1982年《公民法》至ICJ诉讼）、人道主义数据追踪（UNHCR、ACAPS）、案例研究（冈比亚诉缅甸案）、政策框架更新。
AI.findings: 难民人口从2017年底约70万增至2026年中超130万；国际法在定性（种族灭绝）上效果显著，但在解决问题（公民权、遣返、问责）上效果有限；ICJ判决有望成为转折点，但履约仍面临后政变缅甸的政治障碍。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了国际法在"标准设定"与"问题解决"之间的效能鸿沟，挑战了国际法作为危机解决工具的乐观假设。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出适用于后政变缅甸和ICJ判决预期的六点更新框架，为政策制定者和人道主义机构提供操作性指引。

title: The Foundations of Economic Inclusion: Understanding the Measurements, Determinants and Barriers
affiliations: Central Bank of Nigeria

detail.title: The Foundations of Economic Inclusion: Understanding the Measurements, Determinants and Barriers
detail.abstract: Economic inclusion-defined as increasing the participation of economic agents in the formal economy-can bring many benefits to the economy. Yet, little is known about the measurements and determinants of economic inclusion and the barriers affecting economic inclusion. This article explores the concept of economic inclusion, the measurements, determinants and barriers affecting it. I show that economic inclusion can be measured using either the financial inclusion approach, the working population approach and the taxation approach. The identified determinants of economic inclusion are a level playing field for economic agents, income equality, political stability, equal opportunities, labour market flexibility, absence of market failure, financial inclusion, trust in government, active participation in business groups and economic associations, the availability of digital public infrastructure systems and internet coverage and usage. The study also identified several individual, societal, and structural challenges that may be encountered in advancing economic inclusion. I argue that economic inclusion, if it can be achieved, will build strong connections with people, communities and the formal economy. The starting point is to infuse the consciousness of economic inclusion into policymaking, policy design, private sector innovations and people's everyday interactions.

AI.tldr: 本文系统梳理了经济包容性的概念、测量方法、决定因素及障碍，指出经济包容性可通过金融包容、劳动人口和税收三种方法衡量，并识别了11项关键决定因素及个体、社会和结构性三类挑战。
AI.research_question: 经济包容性的测量方法有哪些？其决定因素和障碍是什么？
AI.motivation: 尽管经济包容性对经济有诸多益处，但学界对其测量方法、决定因素及障碍的研究尚不充分。
AI.theoretical_framework: 经济包容性概念框架，涵盖金融包容、劳动参与和税收三个测量维度。
AI.method: 概念性文献分析，综合多学科视角进行理论整合。
AI.findings: 1）三种测量方法：金融包容法、劳动人口法、税收法；2）11项决定因素，包括公平竞争环境、收入平等、政治稳定、机会均等、劳动力市场灵活性、市场失灵消除、金融包容、政府信任、商业团体参与、数字公共基础设施及互联网覆盖；3）三类障碍：个体层面、社会层面和结构性挑战。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统整合了经济包容性的多维度测量框架与决定因素体系，填补了该领域理论空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者、私营部门创新和日常经济活动提供了将经济包容性意识融入实践的具体路径。

title:
Designing Sub-National Economic Policy:

The Sindh Domestic Commerce Policy and the Institutional Fragmentation Problem

detail.title:
Designing Sub-National Economic Policy:

The Sindh Domestic Commerce Policy and the Institutional Fragmentation Problem
detail.abstract: Sub-national economic policy-making in Pakistan operates within a specific structural constraint that is often under-examined in the policy documents themselves: the sheer density and fragmentation of the regulatory architecture any single reform must navigate. I examine here the Sindh Domestic Commerce Policy and Action Plan, developed in 2023–24 under the EU-funded GRASP project, as a case study in sub-national economic policy design within exactly this constraint. The policy, prepared through extensive stakeholder consultation involving the Department of Industries and Commerce, Sindh's Investment Department, the Karachi and Federation of Pakistan Chambers of Commerce and Industry, and other public and private actors, documents that approximately 35 distinct laws and regulations govern the conduct of business in Sindh, with registration and compliance responsibilities distributed across at least seven separate provincial agencies — the Directorate of Labour, the Sindh Employees' Social Security Institution, the Excise, Taxation and Narcotics Control Department, the Board of Revenue, the Sindh Building Control Authority, the Environmental Protection Agency, and the Water and Sewerage Board — in addition to federal registration requirements. I argue that this institutional fragmentation, rather than any single named barrier, constitutes the domestic commerce sector's binding constraint, and examine the policy's proposed responses — a dedicated Legal Reforms Cell, a Commerce and Trade Promotion Committee chaired by the provincial minister, and a Warehouse Receipt Financing mechanism piloted in Sindh as early as 2015–16 — against this diagnosis. Drawing on my direct experience commissioning and coordinating this policy process across the province's senior bureaucratic and political leadership, I offer a practitioner's account of what sub-national economic policy design requires when the problem is not the absence of good ideas, but the sheer number of institutional actors any single idea must pass through to become practice.

AI.tldr: 本文以信德省国内商业政策为案例，揭示了巴基斯坦省级经济政策制定面临的核心约束——监管架构的高度密集与碎片化。作者基于直接参与政策制定的实践经验，指出制约经济发展的不是单一障碍，而是改革需要穿越的庞大制度行动者网络，并分析了政策提出的应对机制。
AI.research_question: 在监管架构高度密集与碎片化的结构性约束下，巴基斯坦省级经济政策如何有效设计与实施？
AI.motivation: 政策文件本身常常忽视一个关键结构性约束——监管法规的密集性与制度碎片化。作者希望通过信德省案例，揭示省级经济政策设计在面对"不是缺乏好主意，而是好主意需要穿越大量制度行动者才能落地"这一困境时的真实挑战与实践应对。
AI.theoretical_framework: "约束条件"理论（binding constraint）：作者将制度碎片化而非单一障碍视为国内商业部门的"约束条件"；制度复杂性理论与政策实施的政治经济学。
AI.method: 单一案例研究（信德省国内商业政策与行动计划）；基于作者作为政策过程的委托与协调者的直接参与经验（从业者视角）；结合政策文本分析、机构图谱梳理与利益相关方协商过程观察。
AI.findings: 1. 信德省约有35部不同法律和法规来规范商业活动，注册与合规责任分散在至少7个省级机构及联邦机构之间。2. 制度碎片化而非任何单一障碍，构成了国内商业部门的"约束条件"。3. 政策提出的应对措施包括：设立法律改革专门小组、由省部长主持的商贸促进委员会、以及早在2015-16年试点的仓单融资机制。
AI.theory_contributions: 将"制度碎片化"理论化为经济政策制定的"约束条件"，超越传统关注"单一障碍"的分析框架；为"政策实施难"提供了一种结构性的解释路径——问题不在于政策设计本身，而在于政策必须穿越的制度行动者密度。
AI.practical_contributions: 为巴基斯坦及其他发展中国家的省级/地方经济政策制定提供了实践洞见：政策设计必须将制度碎片化作为核心约束来处理；提出了具体的应对机制（法律改革专门小组、高层级协调委员会、已有试点基础的融资机制）；为国际援助项目（如欧盟GRASP项目）在复杂制度环境中的操作提供了经验参考。

title: Mission Anchoring: The Fixed Point in a Volatile World
affiliations: University of California, Berkeley

detail.title: Mission Anchoring: The Fixed Point in a Volatile World

declarations.declarationOfInterest: n/a
declarations.ethicsApproval: n/a
declarations.funderStatement: n/a

detail.abstract: Organizations seeking to create impact over long periods must continually adapt to shifting political, economic, technological and social conditions, and doing so requires a fixed point of reference that does not change with them. This article argues that mission anchoring-the identification and maintenance of a stable, non-negotiable purpose that guides decisions such as methods, structures, partnerships, programs, products, services and operating models evolve-is a foundational capability of organizations designed for enduring impact, whether nonprofit or for-profit in form. The article defines nonnegotiable purpose and examines the mechanisms by which purpose is protected in practice including guardrails that subject new opportunities to mission-impact assessment, governance practices that include standing board review of purpose alignment and stakeholder feedback that surfaces inconsistencies early. The article further argues that endurance requires organizations to identify what they will refuse to become, converting abstract values into explicit refusal points that survive leadership transitions, and concludes by considering purpose discipline during scarcity, when the willingness to contract before surrendering identity, made possible by earlier investments in resilience, reveals whether mission anchoring is genuine or merely rhetorical.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"使命锚定"是组织实现长期影响力的基础能力——即识别并维护一个稳定、不可谈判的核心目的，指导战略与运营决策，并通过"防护栏"机制（使命影响评估、董事会审查、利益相关者反馈）来保护这一目的。文章还强调组织需明确"拒绝成为什么"，将抽象价值观转化为具体拒绝点，并在资源稀缺时展现真正的使命自律。
AI.research_question: 组织如何在持续适应外部环境变化的同时，保持核心目的不变？使命锚定作为组织长期影响力的基础能力，其机制是什么？
AI.motivation: 许多组织在追求长期影响力的过程中，往往在适应环境变化时偏离了初始使命。本文试图解决这一张力：如何在变化中保持不变的参照点。
AI.theoretical_framework: 使命锚定理论、非谈判性目的（nonnegotiable purpose）、防护栏机制（guardrails）、拒绝点（refusal points）、使命自律（purpose discipline）
AI.method: 理论构建与概念分析，结合组织实践中的机制阐述（如治理实践、利益相关者反馈等）
AI.findings: 使命锚定是组织长期影响力的基础能力，通过三大机制保护核心目的：使命影响评估的防护栏、董事会持续审查、利益相关者反馈。组织还需明确"拒绝成为什么"，将抽象价值观转化为具体拒绝点。在资源稀缺时，组织是否愿意"收缩而非放弃身份"是检验使命锚定真伪的关键。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"使命锚定"这一新概念，系统阐述了非谈判性目的的保护机制，丰富了组织战略与长期影响力的理论体系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织领导者提供了在变化环境中保持核心使命的具体实践路径：建立使命影响评估机制、完善董事会治理、收集利益相关者反馈、明确拒绝点清单、在稀缺时期践行使命自律。

title:
When the Secretariat Becomes the Directorate:

Institutional Design for Sindh's Department of Industries and Commerce

detail.title:
When the Secretariat Becomes the Directorate:

Institutional Design for Sindh's Department of Industries and Commerce
detail.abstract: The institutional strengthening study analysed in this paper was authored, on its technical substance, by Dr Nasir Javed, engaged as an independent consultant under a UN International Trade Centre (ITC) consultancy agreement, as part of the EU-funded Growth for Rural Advancement and Sustainable Progress (GRASP) project-a companion assignment to the Sindh Domestic Commerce Policy examined in a related paper in this series. My own role was to conceive and commission this institutional review, hire and manage the consultant, oversee the assignment budget, organise the Public-Private Dialogue sessions that tested the proposed reforms against stakeholder feedback, and coordinate directly with the Sindh Minister for Industries and Commerce, the Chief Secretary, the Secretary of the Industries and Commerce Department, and the Chairman of the Planning and Development Board. This paper draws on that vantage point to analyse the study's institutional design choices against comparative public administration theory; the underlying technical diagnosis is Dr Javed's work, properly credited throughout.

AI.tldr: 本文基于作者在联合国国际贸易中心（ITC）欧盟资助的GRASP项目中，委托并管理Dr Nasir Javed对信德省工商部门进行制度强化研究的亲身经历，结合比较公共行政理论，分析该研究的制度设计选择。
AI.research_question: 信德省工商部门的制度强化应如何设计，以提升公共行政效能？
AI.motivation: 作者作为项目的直接管理者和协调者，希望从实践者的视角，结合公共行政理论，反思和评估该制度强化研究的设计逻辑与合理性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 比较公共行政理论（Comparative Public Administration Theory）
AI.method: 委托独立顾问进行技术诊断；组织公私对话（Public-Private Dialogue）收集利益相关者反馈；基于作者的项目管理视角进行理论分析。
AI.findings: 该制度强化研究的技术诊断由顾问完成，作者通过组织多方协调和利益相关者对话，验证了制度改革的可行性。
AI.theory_contributions: 将比较公共行政理论应用于巴基斯坦省级工商部门制度改革的实际案例分析中，丰富了该理论在发展中国家地方治理场景下的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为信德省工商部门的制度改革提供了基于实证和利益相关方验证的设计方案；展示了国际组织与地方政府协作推动制度改革的运作模式。

title: The Dagger - The Human Story Hidden Inside Mathematical Symbols
affiliations: University of Birmingham

detail.title: The Dagger - The Human Story Hidden Inside Mathematical Symbols
